author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hori Khelain Shyama Shyam - Shri Roop Sakhi Ji Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (808)
hindi_text: (Raag Ramkali)Hori Khelain Shyama-Shyam.Drig Rang Bhari Bhrikuti Pichkai Chali Mridu Musikaani Baam. [1]Bajat Taal Mridang Ang Sang Vrindavan Chhavi Dham.Roop Sakhi Nyochhavar Kino Kotin Rati Jut Kaam. [2]- Shri Roop Sakhi, Shri Roop Sakhi Ji Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (808)The divine couple, Sri Shyama Shyam revel in the joyous colors of Holi, their captivating eyes drenched in the hues of divine love. Their arched eyebrows, like poised water guns, release a shower of playful glances, adorned with enchanting smiles. [1]With each movement, the rhythmic beats of the mridang blend harmoniously, as Vrindavan glows in its most radiant form.  Sri Roop Sakhi, overwhelmed by the glimpses of the couple, offers countless Ratis and Kamadevas upon them. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mere Pyare Mohna Mere Manke Chor - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Mere Pyare Mohna, Mere Manke Chor.Tero Mukh Dekhe Bina, Deekhat Nahin Koi Aur.- Braj Ke DoheO, My beloved Mohan (Sri Krishn), the thief of my heart! Without beholding your face, my eyes see nothing else.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Na Vishaya Bhogo Bhaagyam  - Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.62)
hindi_text: Na Vishaya Bhogo Bhaagyam Keertirvaa Vistṛitaa Loke.Brahmendradya-Abhilashitam Bhaagyam Vrindaavane Vaasah.- Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.62)Neither an abundance of material wealth nor worldly fame brings true fortune. True fortune lies in attaining residence in Shri Vrindavan, a blessing so rare that even Brahma, Indra, and other celestial beings yearn for it.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Phag Ki Bhir Abhiran Te Gahi - Shri Padmakar
hindi_text: (Savaiya)Phag Ki Bheer Abheeran Te Gahi, Govindai Lai Gayi Bheetar Gori. [1]Bhaay Kari Man Ki Padmakar, Upar Naay Abheer Ki Jhori. [2]Chheen Pitambar Kamar Te, Subida Dai Meed Kapolan Rori. [3]Nain Nachay Kahyo Muskayi, Lala! Phir Khelan Aiyo Hori. [4]- Shri PadmakarAmidst the bustling crowd of the Holī festival, fair-complexioned Śrī Rādhā playfully caught hold of Śrī Kṛṣṇa and pulled Him inside. [1]Then, following the delight of Her heart, She grabbed handfuls of abīra and gulala, showering them all over Śrī Kṛṣṇa. [2]Afterward, She mischievously snatched away His yellow garment and shawl, smearing fragrant red powder all over His cheeks. [3]With teasing glances and a playful smile, Śrī Rādhā lovingly taunted Him, saying—"O Lālā! Be sure to come again to play Holī!" [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ur Bich Gokul Nayan Jal Mukh Shrivallabh Naam - Goswami Shri Harirai Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (54)
hindi_text: Ur Bich Gokul Nayan Jal, Mukh Shri Vallabh Naam.As Tadrishi Ke Sang Tein, Hot Sakal Sidh Kaam.- Goswami Shri Harirai Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (54)One who keeps Gokul in their heart, tears of devotion in their eyes, and the divine name of Shri Vallabh (Krishna) on their lips—such a devotee attains the fulfillment of all their desires effortlessly.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Rangan Rang Ho Ho Hori Hai - Shri Lakshmiram
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Rangan Rang Ho Ho Hori Hai,Koou Bhalaou Burau Jini Mano.Manmohan Ke Man Mohan Koun,Shri Vrishabhanu Kishori Hai. [1]Hori Mein Kaha Kaha Nahi Kahiat,Yamain Kaha Kuch Chori Hai.Krishna Jeevan Lachhiram Ke Prabhu Saon,Jo Kahiye So Thori Hai. [2]- Shri Lakshmiram The festival of Holī is filled with vibrant colors—let no one perceive it as good or bad. The one who captivates even Manamohana's (Kṛṣṇa's) heart is none other than Śrī Vṛṣabhanu Kiśorī (Śrī Rādhā). [1]During Holī, words flow freely in playful exchange; there is no need for restraint in this joyous celebration. For Kṛṣṇa, who is the very life of Lakṣmīrāma, any praise we offer still falls short. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrindavan Viharahin Sada Gahe Paraspar Baanh - Shri Madhuri Das, Utkantha Madhuri (4)
hindi_text: Vrindavan Viharahin Sada, Gahe Paraspar Baanh.Lalach Tinke Milan Ko, Upaji Paro Jiya Maanhi. - Shri Madhuri Das, Utkantha Madhuri (4)Shri Radha Krishna, the divine couple, forever embrace in the eternal plays of “Nitya Vihara” within the bowers of Vrindavan. My heart, filled with deep longing, yearns to meet them.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Khelat Mohan Radha Gori - Shri Krishndas Adhikari Ji Ki Vani (976)
hindi_text: (Raag Kedaro)Khelat Mohan Radha Gori.Itahin Gopika Juri-Juri Aayi, Utahin Gwal Mandali Chaanchari Jori. [1]Piya Pyari Par Pyari Piya Par, Abir Gulal Ki Daarat Jhoori.‘Krisnadas’ Bali Jai Inni Par, Syama Syam Ki Jori. [2]- Shri Krishndas, Shri Krishndas Adhikari Ji Ki Vani (976)Shyamsundar joyfully plays Holi with the fair-complexioned Radhika.On one side, groups of Gopis eagerly gather, and on the other, the group of cowherd boys joined, dancing and playing in the rhythm of Chānchari. [1]Beloved Radha showers color upon Krishna, and Krishna lovingly showers color on Sri Radha in return, tossing handfuls of abir and gulal. Krishnadas says, “I surrender myself completely to this divine pair of Shyama and Shyam!” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Prem Peer Ati Hi Bikala Kal Na Parat Din Rain - Shri Dayabai
hindi_text: Prem-Peer Ati Hee Bikala, Kal Na Parat Din Rain.Sundar Syam Sarup Bin, ‘Daya’ Lahat Nahin Chain.- Shri Dayabai (a disciple of Shri Charan Das Ji of the Shuk sect.)The agony of divine love has made me so restless that neither day nor night passes in peace. Without beholding the beautiful form of my beloved Shyamsundar, my heart finds no solace, even for a moment, says Dayabai.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Niko Lage Radha Var Pyaro - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri
hindi_text: Niko Lage Radha Var Pyaro.Mor Mukut Piyaro Patuka Hai, Lakuti Kar Matwaro. [1]Rokat Gail Chhail Albelu, Natvar Vesh Sanwaro.Lalit Kishori Mohan Rasiya, Jeevan Pran Hamaro. [2]- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash MadhuriSri Radha’s beloved, Shri Krishna, is extremely dear to my heart. Adorned with a peacock feather crown, wearing yellow garments (Pitambar), holding a stick, with an enchanting swaying gait, He appears as the playful Lord. [1]That enchanting Lord, dressed in his ‘Natwar’ (divine dancer) attire, stands in the middle of the path, playfully blocking the way of the Gopis, engaging in loving pastimes. Shri Lalit Kishori Ji says—“That rasik (divine connoisseur of love) Mohan is the very essence of my life and soul.” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Asht Siddhi Nav Niddhi Jihin - Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Utsav Mala (92.2)
hindi_text: Nagiri Nagar Bhaav Ten, Mangal Roop Rasaal.Nit Mangal Vrindavipun, Nitya Phag Rasa Khyaal.- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh Ji), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Utsav Mala (92.2)The divine couple, Shri Radha Krishna, embodies supreme auspiciousness and the essence of nectaran bliss. In the ever-auspicious land of Vrindavan, the divine Holi of love and rasa is forever celebrated.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Laadili Lalchat Hai Man Mero - Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
hindi_text: (Raga Sorath)Laadili Lalchat Hai Man Mero.Avichal Vaas Basoon Barsaane, Nit Nirakhoon Mukh Tero. [1]Seva Karoon Kripaanidhi Teri, Rahoo Charan Ke Nero.Saras Maadhuri Chhavi Avlokoon, Karon Aapno Chero. [2]- Shri Saras MadhuriMy heart longs for my beloved Ladili (Shri Radha). May I always reside in Barsana and behold Your divine face every day. [1]O ocean of mercy, let me serve You, always remaining close to Your lotus feet. Shri Saras Madhuri prays, “May I forever gaze upon Your sweet form—please accept me as Your servant anyhow.” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Laaj Tajou Maskat Karo - Shri Hita Damodar Das, Nem Battisi (11)
hindi_text: Laaj Tajou Maskat Karo, Yau Nirvah Karaun.Shri Vrindavan Chhandi Ke, Anant Na Kit Hun Jaun.- Shri Hita Damodar Das, Nem Battisi (11)I will cast aside all hesitation and shame, embracing every hardship that comes my way. But I will never leave Vrindavan and go anywhere else.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hum Basi Des Divane Ke - Shri Kishori Ali
hindi_text: (Raga Jhanjhoti)Hum Basi Des Divane Ke.Devi Devan Kaun Nahin Mane, Chakar Ajab Amane Ke.Rahen Hazur Liye Rukh Sanmukh, Khas Neelambar Bane Ke.Kau Kahai Vanaraj Raj Ke, Kau Kahai Barsane Ke.Radha Naam Bharose Gajen, Bas Nahin Raja Rane Ke.Ved Lok Ki Kan Na Manen, Janen Jas Umandane Ke.“Kishori” Ju Ke Hvai Kain Phir Nahin, Aur Na Hath Bikane Ke.- Shri Kishori AliWe belong to the land of those who are mad in love of Sri Radha. [1]We do not acknowledge other gods or goddesses, for we are the servants of the most divine and sovereign Swamini (Shri Radha).We remain ever-present before Her, holding Her favor in our hearts and remain engaged in the personal service of the one adorned in blue garments (Shri Radha). [2]Some say we belong to Vrindavan, the king of forests, while others claim we are from Barsana. But we live solely by the power of Shri Radha’s holy name, and never surrender to any other king or queen, for our one and only sovereign is Shri Radha Herself. [3]We do not follow the customs of society, nor do we entangle ourselves in the rules and regulations of the Vedas, for we remain ever intoxicated in lovingly chanting the glories of Sri Radha. Shri Kishori Ali says—“Now that we have surrendered at Shri Radha’s lotus feet, we cannot belong to anyone else. Our everything, our very existence, belongs only to Shri Radha.” [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nain Bain Radha Gahe Rahe Preeti Ke Taari - Shri Vanshi Ali, Madhuriya Shat (102.2)
hindi_text: Nain Bain Radha Gahe, Rahe Preeti Ke Taari.Radha Ke Sakhi Vadan Kajhi, Rom Rom Phulwari.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Madhuriya Shat (102.2)Shri Radha, the supreme enchantress, has captured the eyes and voices of the sakhis, binding them completely under the spell of Her love. Each glance upon Her sweet form now fills their hearts with bliss, as if a garden of fragrant blossoms has bloomed in every pore of their being.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nirjanani Nagari Kalbaini Sukumari - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (75)
hindi_text: (Doha)Nirjanani Nagari, Kalbaini Sukumari.Shrihari Pyari Nit Hiye, Basau Sada Sukhkari.(Pad)Jai Jai Priya Pran-Piya Pyari.Jai Jai Roop Ujari Radhe, Ati Sundar Sukumari.Jai Jai Nirjanani Nagari, Kalbaini Kamala Ri.Jai Jai Shriharipriya Hiye, Nit Basau Sada Sukhkari.- Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (75)Seeing Shri Lal Ji’s deep yearning and restlessness, Shri Hari Priya Sakhi Ji humbly prays to Shri Priya Ji (Shri Radha) -(Doha)O graceful lotus-eyed Nagariji (Shri Radha)! O gentle and soft-spoken Sukumariji! You are the dearest beloved of Shri Hari. Therefore, please embrace Him and grant Him supreme bliss.(Pad)O Priyaju! You are dearer to beloved Lalji than His life—glory to You!O, the most resplendent Sri Radhaju, embodiment of supreme beauty—glory to You! [1]O Nagariji, with lotus-like eyes! O sweet-speaking Padmaniji—glory to You!You are the beloved of Sri Hari. May you forever reside in your beloved’s heart, showering love-bliss. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Guru Raakhai Phoutau Karvaa - Shri Lalitmohini Dev Ju Ki Vani (35)
hindi_text: Guru Raakhai Phoutau Karvaa, Lagaavai Raj.Chela Rangai Baanki, Banaavai Saj.- Shri Lalitmohini Dev, Shri Lalitmohini Dev Ju Ki Vani (35)What a strange irony it is that the Rasika Gurus lead an extremely simple life—keeping only a broken earthen pot, adorning themselves with the sacred dust of Shri Dham Vrindavan, and remaining immersed in pure, selfless devotion. Meanwhile, the so-called disciples consider the dust of Vrindavan insignificant, indulge in colorful attire, and remain engrossed in external decoration and display.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Khelat Phag Suhaag Bhari Anuraag Bhari - Shri Hita Vrindavan Das
hindi_text: (Raag Lalit)Khelat Phag Suhaag Bhari Anuraag Bhari Badbhaagi Piya Soon. [1]Baal Gulal Lai Laal Pai Daarat, Nihal Hoy Laal Lagaav Hiyaa Soon. [2]Kesar Ki Pichkaari Bharein Piya, Chhirakhin Chheent Sneh Jiyaa Soon. [3]‘Vrindavan’ Dampati Chhavi Nirakhat, Kaun Kare Rati Kaam Maya Soon. [4]- Shri Hita Vrindavan DasThe supremely fortunate Shri Radha, filled with divine love and bliss, joyfully plays Holi with her beloved Shri Krishna. [1]She takes handfuls of crimson gulal and sprinkles it upon Shri Krishna, while He, overwhelmed with bliss, lovingly embraces her. [2]Shri Krishna fills His pichkari (water gun) with saffron-colored water and playfully sprinkles it upon Radha with immense tenderness. [3]Shri Hit Vrindavan Das Ji says—“Upon witnessing the divine Holi pastimes of the beloved couple, who could still be drawn to the passions of Kamadeva (Cupid) and His consort Rati?” [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Priya Shyam Roop Rang Maati - Shri Thakurdas Ji
hindi_text: Priya Shyam Roop Rang Maati.Ang Ang Anuraag Badhao Ati, Sobha Kahi Na Jaati. [1]Tan Sau Tan Man Sau Man Milwat, Chhaati Sau Lagaai Chhaati.Thakur Sakhi Ya Chhabi Par Wari, Baar Baar Suukh Paati. [2]- Shri Thakur Das, Sri Thakur Das Ju Ki Vani, Pad (1)The divine couple, Shri Radha Krishna, are completely immersed in each other’s unparalleled beauty and sweetness. Every limb of their divine bodies overflows with ever-increasing love, a beauty beyond description. [1]They embrace each other so intimately, uniting their bodies, minds and souls, as if merging into one. Shri Thakur Sakhi repeatedly sacrifices Herself to these glimpses, immersed in the ecstasy of divine love-bliss. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Radhavallabh Ladilo Dulha Nity Kishor - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Shri Radhavallabh Ladilo, Dulaha Nity Kishor.Kunj Bihari Bhavanto, Mukh Pyari Chand-Chakor.- Braj Ke DoheBeloved Shri Radhavallabh Ji is the ever-youthful divine groom. He, the Kunja Bihari, remains forever enchanted by the moon-like face of His beloved, Shri Radha, just like a chakor bird drawn to the moon.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Namo Namo Shriharidas Vrindavipin - Shri Agradas Ji (Spiritual master of Nabha ji)
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Namo Namo Shriharidas VrindavipinVas Var Pran Sarvas Bankebihari. [1]Shyama Shyama Jugala Roopa Madhurya KeRasik Rijhwar Prem Avatari. [2]Param Vairag-Nidhi Basat NidhivanSada Bhavana Leen Supraveen Bhari. [3]Kamana Kalpataru Sakal Santaapahru‘Agradas’ Ali Kalyankari. [4]- Shri Agradas Ji (Spiritual master of Nabha Ji)Salutations, salutations to Svāmī Śrī Haridāsa, the rasika saint forever residing in Vṛndāvana,Whose very life and breath are entirely dedicated to Śrī Bāṅke Bihārī. [1]He is the crown jewel among Rasikas, those immersed in the sweetness of the divine couple, Śrī Śyāmā-Śyāma's eternal love-filled plays. In truth, He is the very embodiment of divine love. [2]With supreme renunciation, He resides eternally in Nidhivana, Vṛndāvana,Always absorbed in devotion and ever-attentive in the loving service of the divine couple. [3]Like a wish-fulfilling tree, He removes all kinds of sorrows.Śrī Agradāsa says, "Svāmī Śrī Haridāsa Jī is supremely benevolent and auspicious to those who come to Him." [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Prabhuta Hi Ko Sab Maro Prabhu Ko Marai Na Koy - Shri Malook Das
hindi_text: Prabhuta Hi Ko Sab Maro, Prabhu Ko Marai Na Koy.Jo Koi Prabhu Ko Marai, To Prabhuta Dasi Hoy.- Shri Malook DasEveryone desires lordship, but none desires the Lord Himself. If one surrenders to the Lord, then even lordship becomes a servant.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Rasa Lai To Dwaar Paryo Rahiyo - Sri Purushottam Ji
hindi_text: Rasa Lai To Dwaar Paryo Rahiyo.Jo Tu Rasiya Ras Ko Bhukho, Maar Dhaari Sab Ki Sahiyo. [1]Jaiyo Na Kahun In Dwaarana Te, Lali Charanana Ko Sukh Paiyo.Purushottam Prabhu Ki Chhavi Nirakhai, Prem Sudha Ko Ras Chakiyo. [2]- Sri Purushottam JiIf you truly desire the nectar of divine love, then remain steadfast at Her doorway. If you are indeed a true rasika (one who relishes divine love), then endure all hardships and afflictions with patience, for the reward (of rasa) is unparalleled. [1]Do not wander elsewhere, stay at the sacred doorsteps of Sri Radha, for only here will you attain the bliss of Shri Radha’s lotus feet. Shri Purushotam Ji says, Behold the divine beauty of the Lord, and relish the sweetest nectar of pure love. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sab Braj Gopin Ke Basi Baat Yehai Man Aan - Shri Brajavasidas, Braj Vilas
hindi_text: Sab Braj Gopin Ke Basi, Baat Yehai Man Aan.Hari-Radha Dou Milain, Nishi Vaasar Yeh Dhyaan.- Shri Brajavasidas, Braj VilasFor all the Gopis of Braj, only one thought fills their hearts—‘May Hari (Shri Krishna) and Radha unite, and may this be our constant meditation, day and night.’
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nit Nit Hori Braj Mein Rahau - Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Holi (79)
hindi_text: Nit Nit Hori Braj Mein Rahau.Viharat Hari-Sang Braj-Jubatigan, Sada Anand Lahau.Phulit Phalit Rahau Vrindavan, Madhup Krishna-Gun Kahau.‘Harichand’ Nit Saras Sudhamay, Prem-Pravah Chahau.- Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Holi (79)The festival of Holi is eternally celebrated in Braj, where Shri Hari joyfully plays with the young maidens of Braj, and they forever revel in divine bliss. [1]Eternal Sri Dham Vrindavan remains ever-blooming and fruitful, where Rasikas, like buzzing bumblebees, hum the glories of Shri Krishna. Shri Harichand prays—‘May my heart forever yearn for the ever-flowing, nectar-filled stream of divine love.’ [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrindavan Ki Yaad Jo Aawat Hai - Shri Ramray, Geet Govind Braj Bhasha, Doha (85)
hindi_text: Vrindavan Ki Yaad Jo, Aavat Hai Man Maahi.Tabhi Radha Naagri, Pati Sang Taahi Saranhi.- Shri Ramray, Geet Govind Braj Bhasha, Doha (85)Whoever remembers Vrindavan, at that very moment, Shri Radha, along with her beloved Shri Krishna, mercifully accepts and blesses them.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Payan Paayali Jagmag Jyoti - Shri Albeli Ali, Samay Prabandh (109)
hindi_text: Payan Paayali Jagmag Jyoti.Nav Navratan Deep Se Sohain, Tora Badide Moti. [1]Ta Par Nupur Subhag Birajen, Keli Kala Udyoti.Albeli Piya Hiy Ko Gahino, Naval Prem Ras Soti. [2]- Shri Albeli Ali, Samay Prabandh (109)The divine anklets of Sri Radha shine with unparalleled brilliance, adorned with nine precious gems that sparkle like radiant lamps. Strung together with large, lustrous pearls, they shimmer with divine beauty. [1]Her nūpura (ankle bells), ringing with enchanting melodies, illuminates the essence of 'Keli Kala' (playful pastimes). Sri Albeli Ali says that these anklets are the most treasured adornment of Her beloved’s heart, ceaselessly showering an eternal stream of ever-fresh divine love. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jog Yagya Tap Nem Kari Bhaje Nahin Govind - Shri Guruchauna Ji Maharaj
hindi_text: Jog Yagya Tap Nem Kari, Bhajai Nahin Govinda,‘Chhona’ Hari Ke Naam Bin, Chhoote Nahin Bhav Fanda.- Shri Guruchauna Ji MaharajOne may practice yoga, perform yajñas (sacrificial rituals), engage in penance, and follow strict vows, but without true devotion to Govinda (Sri Krishna) and the continuous chanting of God’s name, no one can be freed from the bondage of worldly existence.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Guna Mandira Sundara Yugala - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (184)
hindi_text: Guna Mandira Sundara Yugala, Mangala Modanidhan.Narayana Nija Charana Rati, Yaha Dijaim Varadan.- Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (184)The divine couple, Sri Radha Krishna, is the temple of virtues and the source of auspiciousness and happiness. Shri Narayan Swami humbly prays, “O gracious ones, grant me the priceless boon of love at your lotus feet.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Khelat Basant Hori Naval Chabili Jori -  Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Shringar Shat (3.21)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Khelat Basant Hori Naval Chabili Jori,Udat Gulal Anurag Kau Surang Ree. [1]Mridu Muskani Ur Phool Aayi Phool Bhaye,Haav-Bhaav Saundhe Bhinje Sohain Ang-Ang Ree. [2]Nainan Ki Chitvani Chirakani Prem-Neer,Seenchat Hain Piya-Hiya Bhari Ras-Rang Ree. [3]‘Hit Dhruv’ Bhinje Sukh Baridh Vilas Haans,Soi Sukh Dekhain Sakhi Dinahin Abhang Ree. [4]- Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Shringar Shat (3.21)The ever‑beautiful divine couple, Śrī Rādhā and Śrī Kṛṣṇa, celebrate the arrival of Vasant (Spring), the king of seasons, by joyfully inaugurating Holi, playfully scattering the gulālā of divine love. [1]Their gentle smiles and joyful hearts shower flower‑like bliss, filling the air with divine fragrance; Their limbs, soaked in the essence of love, appear even more enchanting. [2]Śrī Rādhā’s love‑filled glances become streams of colored nectar, gently sprinkling upon Kṛṣṇa’s heart, immersing Him in divine love. [3]Śrī Hit Dhruvadās Jī says, “In this ocean of joy and playful exchanges, the divine couple remains forever intoxicated in rasa (divine nectar), while the sakhīs relish this bliss eternally”. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hari Heera Guru Jauhari - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (23)
hindi_text: Hari Heera Guru Jauhari, Vyasa Hi Diyo Bataai.Tan Man Anand Sukh Mile, Naam Let Dukh Jaai.- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (23)Shri Hariram Vyas says, “Hari is the divine jewel, and the Guru is the jeweler. By chanting the Lord’s name, one attains bliss in both body and mind.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sajani Nav Nikunja Drum Phule - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (14)
hindi_text: (Raag Basant)Sajani Nav Nikunja Drum Phule,Ali-Kul-Sankul Karat Kulaahal,Saurabh Manmath Mule.Harashi Hindoren Rasik Raasi Var,Jugal Parspar Jhule.Shri Bithal Vipul Vinod Dekhi Nabha,Dev Vimaanani Bhule.- Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (14)While describing the unparalleled sweetness of Vasant (spring), one sakhi says to another—O sakhi! In this Vasant season, the trees and vines have fully blossomed, filling the entire forest with the intoxicating fragrance of flowers.Swarms of bees hum joyfully, their melodious buzzing weaving a song of love, awakening Cupid’s playful presence. [1]In this enchanting season, the king of rasikas, Shri Bihari (Shri Krishna), and Shri Biharini (Shri Radha) sway gently in divine union upon a swing, immersed in the ecstasy of love.The radiant beauty of this divine scene in Shri Vrindavan is so mesmerizing that even the celestial gods, beholding this scene, lose awareness of their own bodies, becoming utterly absorbed in divine love-bliss. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Avadhi Prem Ki Laadili Avadhi Prem Ki Laal - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (725)
hindi_text: Avadhi Prem Ki Laadili, Avadhi Prem Ki Laal,Avadhi Prem Ki Lalit Ju, Chhin Chhin Karat Nihaal.- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (725)Shri Radha is the pinnacle of divine love, and so too are Lalji (Shri Krishna) and Lalitaji, who perpetually bestow divine bliss.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hare Krishna Hi Krishna Ka Kirtan Mein - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Hare Krishna Hi Krishna Ka Kirtan Mein, Machata Rahe Ghanghor Yahan. [1]Sunlo Sunlo Yamunajal Mein, Murli Dhvani Ka Vah Shor Yahan. [2]Taru Radhe Hi Radhe Pukaar Rahe, Khinchata Man Hai Barjor Yahan. [3]Kar Prem Koi Lakh Le Usko, Rehta Ab Bhi Chitchor Yahan. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’In the kīrtana of Lord Kṛṣṇa, an intense devotional atmosphere resounds here. [1]Listen, listen to the sacred waters of Yamunā, where the melody of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's flute forever echoes. [2]Even the trees keep calling out 'Rādhe Rādhe', and the heart gets drawn strongly to this place due to that call. [3]Whoever longs for Śrī Kṛṣṇa's darśana with pure love shall still find the Heart-Stealer here, in this nectar-filled land of Vṛndāvana. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Vanraj Vilasini Mriduhasini Sukh Punj - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Shri Vanraj Vilasini, Mriduhasini Sukh Punj,Shri Krishna Vallabha Radhike, Jai Jai Sevakunj.- Braj Ke DoheO Shri Radhike! The one who delights in the sacred groves of Shri Dham Vrindavan, whose gentle smile steals the heart, the very embodiment of divine bliss and sweetness—All glories to you! O beloved of Shri Krishna, all glories to your Sevakunj Dham, where your most intimate pastimes eternally unfold!
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Radha Charan Pradhan - Shri Nabhadas, Bhaktamala (90)
hindi_text: (Chhapay)Shri Radha Charan Pradhan Hriday Ati Sudridh Upasi,Kunj Keli Dampati Tahan Ki Karat Khawasi. [1]Sarvasu Mahaprasad Prasiddh Take Adhikari,Vidhi Nishedh Nahi Das Ananya Utkat Vratdhari. [2]Shri Vyas Suvan Path Anusarai Soi Bhalai Pehichanihai,Shri Harivansh Gusain Bhajan Ki Reeti Sukrit Kou Janihai. [3]- Shri Nabhadas, Bhaktamala (90)Shri Nabha Das Ji describes the glory of Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu:Shri Harivansh Ji, a Rasik Acharya, is exclusively devoted to the lotus feet of Shri Radha. His entire devotion is centered upon the lotus feet of Shri Radha. He never wavers, nor does he seek anything beyond serving the divine feet of Swamini Shri Radha. Eternally, he resides and serves in the sacred Nikunj bowers, where the divine couple engages in eternal love plays. [1]His faith in the Mahaprasad (sacred remnants) of Shri Radha was unshakable, and he alone was truly deserving of it. For him, scriptural injunctions and prohibitions held no significance, as his sole dharma was to love and serve Shri Radha with utmost affection—this was his eternal vow. [2]The divine stature of Shri Harivansh Ji can only be understood by one who walks the path of exclusive devotion to Shri Radha’s lotus feet. Shri Nabha Das Ji declares that only a supremely fortunate devotee can comprehend the confidential depth and bhajan tradition of Shri Harivansh Goswami’s devotion. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ve Jamuna Ve Sakha Hamare - Shri Surdas, Sura Sagara (4892)
hindi_text: Ve Jamuna, Ve Sakha Hamaare, Nit Nav Keli Vihaari.Vrindavan Ki Gulm-Lata Hain, Man-Madhukar Ko Pyaari.- Shri Surdas, Sura Sagara (4892)Shri Krishna says to Satyabhama—“I solemnly swear that the sacred Yamuna, my beloved Brajvasi friends, my ever-new playful pastimes with the sakhis, and the flowers and vines of Vrindavan are all supremely dear to the bee of my heart.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Saghan Van Chhayo Praphullit Drumveli - Goswami Shri Harirai Ji
hindi_text: (Raga Bhairav)Saghan Van Chhayo Praphullit Drumveli,Bhayo Hulas Braj Jan Man. [1]Thor Thor Kokil Kal Kujat,Gunjar Madhup Gan. [2]Bhayo Prakat Aaj Rituraj,Vaas Kiyo Suniyat Vrindavan. [3]Rasik Preetam Piy So Ras Vilso,Aani Arpo Sakhi Tan Man Dhan. [4]- Goswami Shri Harirai JiSeeing the forest adorned with dense trees and blooming vines, the hearts of the people of Braj are filled with joy. [1]Everywhere, cuckoos sing their sweet melodies, and swarms of bees hum in harmony. [2]Today, the king of seasons, spring, has fully blossomed, gracing the sacred land of Vrindavan with its divine presence. [3]Preetam Lord Krishna engages in love-play with His beloved Radha. O Sakhi, surrender your body, mind, and wealth to the divine couple. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Rasik Kishori Nagari Nagar Rasik Kishor - Shri Priya Sakhi (Sri Brahm Gopal Goswami), Shri Hari Leela (11)
hindi_text: Rasik Kishori Nagari, Nagar Rasik Kishor.Jeevanidhan Shri Priya Sakhi, Sahchari Jan Chit Chor.- Shri Priya Sakhi (Sri Brahm Gopal Goswami), Shri Hari Leela (11)Ever-youthful Sri Radhika and ever-youthful Sri Krishn, the crown jewel among the Rasikas, is the treasure of my life, who steals the hearts of Sahcharis.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ankhiya Roopsudha Mad Matin - Shri Lalit Madhuri
hindi_text: (Raag Khammach)Ankhiya Roopsudha Mad Matin.Bin Dekhe Vah Yugal Sughar Chhavi, Bahu Atur Akulatin. [1]Vani Pari Rati Charan Kamal Ki, Av Kaise Sachupati.Lalit Madhuri Darsan Dijai, Vahiko Lalasatin. [2]- Shri Lalit MadhuriMy eyes are intoxicated by the nectar of the divine beauty of the Divine Couple, Shri Shyama-Shyam. Without beholding them, they remain restless and agitated. [1]Naturally bound in eternal love, they remain fixed at the lotus feet of the Divine Couple, finding no solace in anything else. Sri Lalit Madhuri says, “Grant me Your divine darshan, for that alone is my deepest longing.” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Prem Diwane Jo Bhay Kahe Bahkte Nain - Sri Sahjobai
hindi_text: Prem Divane Jo Bhaye, Kahain Bahakte Bain.Sahjo Mukh Hansi Chhute, Kabahu Tapkai Nain.- Sri SahjobaiThose intoxicated with the divine love of God may appear strange and speak in ways that seem bewildering. One moment, they shed tears in remembrance of the Lord; the next, they burst into blissful laughter.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Priya Main To Hoon Cherin Ki Cheri - Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (125)
hindi_text: (Raag Kanhara or Bilaval)Priya Main To Hoon Cherin Ki Cheri.Ab To Karun Sanbhar Ladili, Bahutak Bhai Aberi. [1]Nishidin Virah Satavat Moko, Sudhi Ab Levo Saberi.De Darshan Man Mohani Shyama, Tanak Na Kije Deri. [2]Tum Bin Mere Aur Na Koi, Sakal Thaur Ho Heri.“Roopmadhuri” ‘Saras’ Piyari, Tumhein Laaj Hai Meri. [3]- Shri Roop Madhuri, Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (125)O Priyaji (Sri Radha), I am the servant of your servants. Now, please take care of me, O Ladili, for it has already been delayed too long. [1]Day and night, the fire of separation torments me; please think about me now. O enchanting Shyama Ju (Radha), kindly grant me your divine darshan without further delay. [2]Without you, I have no one; I have searched everywhere, yet found no one to call my own. Sri Roop Madhuri says, ‘O beloved Swamini of Saras Madhuriji! My honor rests in your hands.’ [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mangal Nidhi Shri Radhika Mangal Radha Naam - Shri Kishori Ali, Radha Namavali (3)
hindi_text: Mangal Nidhi Shri Radhika, Mangal Radha Naam.Radha Radha Raton Karin, Jo Chahe Vishram.- Shri Kishori Ali, Radha Namavali (3)Shri Radhika is the treasure of all auspiciousness, and Her name itself is supremely auspicious. Whoever longs for true peace should chant ‘Radha Radha’.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Yah Ati Lagati Hai Ab Niko - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya
hindi_text: (Rag Basant)Yah Ati Lagati Hai Ab Neeko Kant-Kamini Kau Basant. [1]Arasi Parasi Biharo Bali Esehi Jahi Dekhi Dukh Nasant. [2]Sahaj Saunj Sukhdayak Sab Din Dampati-Duti Ju Lasant. [3]‘Rooprasik’ Jan Ke Man Kau, Mahaghanras Ban Barasanta. [4]- Shri Roop Rasik DevacharyaThis divine season of Vasant (spring), now graced by the presence of the divine couple, Shri Radha-Krishna, is utterly enchanting, filling the heart with immense joy. [1]Seeing them performing love-play in each other’s embrace, all sorrows naturally fade away. [2]They are the eternal source of supreme bliss, and the radiance of their divine limbs shines so brilliantly that all else fades in comparison. [3]Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya Ji says that Yugal Sarkar immerses the hearts of their devotees completely in the ocean of transcendental nectar. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Drishti Pari Sanket Main Jab Te Bhanukumari - Shri Brajnidhi Granthawali, Preeti Lata (59)
hindi_text: Drishti Pari Sanket Main, Jab Ten Bhanu-Kumari.Barsane Ki Or Kau, Tab Ten Rahe Nihari.- Shri Brajnidhi Ji, Shri Brajnidhi Granthawali, Preeti Lata (59)Ever since Shri Krishna first laid eyes on Shri Radha in Sanket Gram (situated between Barsana and Nandgaon), His gaze has remained fixed upon Barsana. His heart, lost in Radha’s beauty, yearns for the bliss of beholding Her again.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Chali Chalihi Vrindavan Vasant Aayo -  Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Uttarardh (326)
hindi_text: (Raag Vasant)Chali Chalihi Vrindavan Vasant Aayo.Jhoolat Phoolani Ke Jhanvara, Marut Makarand Udayo. [1]Madhukar Kokil Keer Keki Mili, Kolahal Upjayo.Naachat Shyam Bajavat Gavat, Radha Raag Jamayo. [2]Choba Chandan Booka Vandan, Laal Gulaal Udayo.Vyas Swamini Ki Chhavi Nirkhat, Rom Rom Sachu Payo. [3]- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Uttarardh (326)Come, let us go! Spring has arrived in Vrindavan. Clusters of blooming flowers sway gracefully, while the gentle breeze spreads their sweet fragrance far and wide. [1]Bees, cuckoos, parrots, and peacocks sing together in joyous celebration. Shyam (Krishna) dances, and plays His flute, while Radha enchants all with Her melodious raga. [2]Fragrant sandalwood, scented powders, and offerings of colors fill the sky with a burst of red gulal. Shri Hariram Vyas says, ‘Beholding the divine beauty of my Swamini, Shri Radha, every pore of my being is immersed in bliss.’ [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bansiali Haridas Ji Hit Haribansh Samet - Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket Lata (5)
hindi_text: Bansiali Haridas Ji, Hit Haribansh Samet.Vandi Charan Raj Dhari Shir, Pranat Alisanket.- Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket Lata (5)I offer my humble obeisances to Vanshi Ali, along with Swami Shri Haridas and Shri Hita Harivansh, reverently placing the dust of their lotus feet upon my head and seeking their mercy.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhajan Kundaliya Mein Rahau - Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Bhajan Kundaliyan (22)
hindi_text: Bhajan Kundaliya Mein Rahau, Pag Baahir Jini Dehu.Ekai Jugal-Kisor Saun, Kari Dhruv Sahaj Sanehu.- Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Bhajan Kundaliyan (22)Shri Dhruvdas instructs, O devotees! Remain firmly within the sacred circle of devotion, never allowing even a single step beyond its boundary. With unwavering faith, cultivate spontaneous and exclusive love for the divine couple, Shri Radha Krishna.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Agam Rituraj Ka Samaj-Saaj Vrindavan - Shri Sharan Bihari Goswamiji
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Agam Rituraj Ka Samaj-Saaj Vrindavan,Naach Rahi Sobha Har Upvan-Van-Kyari Ki. [1]Arunim Nav Paat-Paat, Gaat Gaat Gamak Uthi,Phoolan Sehnai Baji Madhup Mahari Ki. [2]Phoolan Ki Sej Pe Biraje Piy-Pyari, Nyari,Sakhiyan Ki Chaav-Bhari Bheer Bhaav-Bhari Ki. [3]Haridasi Phool Bhare Phool Soun Vasant Gaave,Vasant Ki Bahar Mein, Bahar Hai Bihari Ki. [4]- Shri Sharan Bihari GoswamijiWith the grand arrival of the king of seasons, spring, Vṛndāvan is adorned in splendor, dancing in joy, filling every grove and garden with its beauty. [1]The tender new leaves, glowing with a red hue, sway gracefully, while the buzzing bees play the śahanāī (wind instrument), announcing the festival of blossoms. [2]Upon a bed of soft blossoms, the divine couple, Priyā Priyatam, sit in divine resplendence, surrounded by a gathering of lovely sakhīs, filled with love and joyous enthusiasm. [3]Śrī Haridāsī Sākhī, utterly absorbed in love, sings songs of Basaṃta, carrying fragrant blooms, for in this festival of spring, the true glory is that of Śrī Banke Bihārījī. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jaaki Mayavash Biranchi Shiv - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Jaaki Mayavash Biranchi Shiv, Naachat Paar Na Paayo.Kartal Taal Bajay Taahi, Yuvtin Naach Nachayo.- Braj Ke DoheEven Brahma and Shiva, enchanted by the divine Maya of Bhagwan Shri Krishna, dance at His command yet fail to comprehend His true essence. Such Shri Krishna dances to the rhythmic claps of the maidens of Braj, bound by the pure love of their hearts.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Phoolyo Ri Saghan Van Tame - Shri Surdas, Sura Sagara
hindi_text: (Rag Malkos)Phoolyo Ri Saghan Van Tame Karat Ri Kokila Gaan. [1]Chal Ri Vrishbhan Nandini Chhadi Kathin Man Maan. [2]Nav Rituraj Aayo Ri Nairai Mili Kije Madhu Paan. [3]Soordas Piy Ko Rijhaiye Gai Sunai Meethi Taan. [4]- Shri Surdas, Sura SagaraO Pyari Ju! Behold how the dense bowers of Vrindavan are adorned with blooming flowers, spreading unparalleled beauty. The cuckoo sings sweet melodies among these vines as if whispering messages of love. [1]O charming daughter of King Vrishabhanu, Shri Radhe! Please set aside your sulk and come quickly. Your beloved Shyamsundar eagerly awaits you. [2]The glorious king of seasons, Basant, has arrived in all its splendor—why delay any longer? Unite with Shyamsundar, immerse yourself in the nectar of divine love, and revel in boundless bliss. [3]Shri Surdas Ji says, “Please your beloved Shri Krishna with your sweet melodies, so that He is irresistibly drawn to you, making this union even more enchanting.” [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ati Tondik Ati Chikniyan - Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (139)
hindi_text: Ati Tondik Ati Chikniyan, Adhik Chatur Itarai.Kitahi Vibhau Kit Thakurai, Juthani Kaun Lalachai.- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (139)Shri Krishna, in Braj, is naturally adorned with grandeur, elegance, and supreme splendor, filled with divine majesty. However, in the secluded bowers of Nikunj, as Kunja Bihari, He cares neither for His grandeur nor His lordly status. There, He remains surrendered at the lotus feet of Shri Priya Ji (Shri Radha), eagerly yearning for Her sacred prasad remnants.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Yeho Swamini Gajgamini Manbhamini - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (84)
hindi_text: (Raag Paraj)Yeho Swamini Gajgamini Manbhamini, Rasiya Lal Tiharo. [1]Karunadith Neeth Avaloko, Deen Dasa Meri Nirwaro. [2]Lalit Kishori Shrivan Vithin, Renu Banay Sees Pag Dharo. [3]Tarasat Hai Braj Dekhan Ko, Drig Yate Dukh Aur Kah Bharo. [4]- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (84)O my Swamini (Sri Radha), O graceful elephant-gaited, O enchantress of hearts, beloved Rasika Lal, Shri Krishna, belongs solely to you and follows only your instructions. [1]Please cast your merciful glance upon me and relieve me of my sorrowful state. [2]O Lalit Kishori (ever-youthful) Shri Radha! Please make me the dust of Shri Vrindavan’s pathways and bless me by placing your lotus feet upon my head. [3]My eyes long to behold the beauty of Braj—what greater sorrow could there be than this painful separation? [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nain Dalali Chauhate Mana Manik Piy Haath - Shri Raskhan, Raskhan Ratnavali
hindi_text: Nain Dalalin Chauhaten, Man Manik Piy Haath.Raskhan Dhol Bajaike, Bechyo Hiy Jiy Saath.- Shri Raskhan, Raskhan RatnavaliA gopi says, “These eyes, acting as merchants, have sold my precious, jewel-like heart to Lord Shri Krishna. Now, Krishna has taken full possession of my very being. In this way, I have openly and publicly surrendered my mind and life to Him, announcing it with a drum beat.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Biharin De Vrindavan Vaas - Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
hindi_text: (Raag Kanhara)Biharin De Vrindavan Vaas.Kunwari Kishori Swamini Mori, Vinay Suno Sukharas. [1]Seva Karun Kamal Pad Pyari, Man Mein Yeh Abhilas.Hazir Rahun Hajoor Hamesha, Nirkhun Raas Vilas. [2]Ati Kripal Karuna Ki Murti, Mohe Raabari Aas.Saras Madhuri Sharan Tihari, Devo Nikunj Nivas. [3]- Shri Saras MadhuriO Biharini (Shri Radha), grant me residence in Vrindavan. O ever-youthful, my beloved Swamini, please hear my humble plea, O ocean of bliss. [1]I yearn to serve your lotus feet, O Pyariju, I have no other desire. May I always remain present before you to serve you and behold your divine Raas Vilas. [2]O supremely merciful one, the very embodiment of grace, my only hope rests in you. Sri Saras Madhuri, in your shelter, prays—please grant me residence in the sacred Nikunj (secluded groves of Vrindavan). [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Taji Ke Sab Pauras Prabal Maane Tan Gun Heen -  Shri Priyadas Ji, Rasik Mohini (6)
hindi_text: Taji Ke Sab Pauras Prabal, Maanen Tan Gun Heen.Base Nirantar Vipin Mein, Jyon Jal Jeevan Meen.- Shri Priyadas Ji, Rasik Mohini (6)One should renounce all sense of strength and ego, considering oneself devoid of virtues and helpless. In this way, one must always reside in Shri Dham Vrindavan, just as a fish forever dwells in water.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Brahmapuri Shiva Ju Ki Puri - Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Chootak Kavitt (86)
hindi_text: (Savaiya)Brahmapuri Shiva Ju Ki Puri, Aru Indrapuri Hu Kaha Jiya Dharaum. [1]Deva Adevana Ki Je Puri, Puni Nagapuri Mukha Taim Na Nikaraum. [2]Auru Puri Bhuva-mandala Ki, Tinake Saba Kitekahu.n Namva Ucharaum. [3]Nagara Ye Ju Kahi So Puri, Saba Gokula Ravara Upara Varaum. [4]- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Chootak Kavitt (86)Why should Brahmapurī (the abode of Brahmā), Kailāśa (the abode of Lord Śiva), or even the celestial realms of Indra dwell within my heart? [1]The abodes of gods, demons, and serpents—these hold no place in my desire. [2]Nor do I care to even utter the names of other exalted abodes scattered across the earth. [3]Śrī Nāgrīdāsa says, "All these realms pale before the divine splendor of Gokula and can be sacrificed upon it." [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mandal Raas Rachyau Bimal Nirtati Kunwari Sujan - Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radhika Maharas, Doha (10)
hindi_text: Mandal Raas Rachyau Bimal, Nirtati Kunwari Sujan.Brajbala Mili Sukh Badhyau, Sab Ban Vaarat Praan.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radhika Maharas, Doha (10)When Shri Radha, the queen of divine love, performed Raas dance in the sacred Raas Mandala, with each gopi, the Braj gopis were immersed in the supreme ocean of bliss. Overwhelmed with love, they offered everything at the lotus feet of Shri Radha.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aaj Sakhi Sevakunj Kunjan Te - Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (96)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Aaj Sakhi Sevakunj Kunjan Te Aavat Ju,Praan Pyaro Preetam Ke, Sang Sukhdaayi Ju. [1]Madhur-Madhur Karen Baat, Mand Muskaay Jaat,Ras Sarasay Aat, Preeti Man Bhaayi Ju. [2]Aisi Albeli Pyaari, Shyama Sukhadhama Nyari,Kaun Bhaag Sakhi Aaj, Nainan Lakhaayi Ju. [3]Shri Gopalhit, Har Liyo Chitt-Vitt,Sharan! Chhodi Jaaun Kit, Kripa Barsayi Ju. [4]- Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (96)O Sākhī! Look, today Śrī Rādhā Pyārījū is emerging from the dense bowers of Sevākuṃja, showering nectar of love and bliss alongside Her beloved Śrī Kṛṣṇa. [1]Her sweet talks and playful laughter fill the heart with joy, and the shower of Her divine love has pleased my mind. [2]How blessed is this day, that these eyes have been graced with the divine vision of Albelī Sarkār, Śrī Rādhā Pyārījū, the very embodiment of love‑bliss! [3]Śrī Hit Gopāl Dās Jī declares, ‘Having glimpsed the divine beauty of Śrī Rādhā, my heart has been forever stolen, and now, I can never dream of leaving Her sacred refuge’. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Yah Ras Rasikan Ke Liye - Shri Premdas Ji [Brother of Shri Lal Balbir Ji], Shri Premdas Ji Ki Vani (106)
hindi_text: Yah Ras Rasikan Ke Liye, Rasikhi Ras Barsant.Rasik Jauhari Ras Ratan, Rasikan Hi Pai Basant.- Shri Premdas Ji [Brother of Shri Lal Balbir Ji], Shri Premdas Ji Ki Vani (106)This divine nectar of the divine couple Sri Radha Krishn, flows only for Rasikas, to whom the secrets of rasa are revealed. As the master connoisseurs of this priceless nectar-gem, their hearts remain forever immersed in the eternal Basant (spring) of divine love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Lalit Basant Saghan Vrindavan - Shri Radha Prasad Dev Ju
hindi_text: (Raag Basant)Lalit Basant Saghan Vrindavan, Phooli Rahi Ghum Beli.Kusumit Nav Pallav Naana Rang, Kanj Madhup Ras Keli. [1]Biharat Yugal Kishor Naval Var, Kanth Kanth Bhuj Meli.Shri Radhika Prasad Mudit Lalitaadik, Sab Vidhi Sakal Saheli. [2]- Shri Radha Prasad Dev JuIn the splendid spring season, the lush forests of Vrindavan bloom with joy as the vines sway gracefully. New buds and many colorful flowers blossom, while lotuses and bees indulge in their sweet play. [1]The ever-youthful divine couple, Shri Radha Krishna, blissfully strolls, embracing each other in divine love. Shri Radhikaprasad says that Lalita and the other sakhis delight, engaging in various loving services. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Priya Charan Soun Bhai Hai - Shri Ananya Ali, Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.38)
hindi_text: Priya Charan Soun Bhai Hai, Ankit Avani Rasaal.So Raj Bandat Rasik Piya, Lotat Karat Nihaal.- Shri Ananya Ali, Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.38)The sacred land of Shri Dham Vrindavan, adorned with the footprints of Shri Priya Ji (Shri Radha), is supremely blissful. Even Lord Shri Krishna, the crown jewel among Rasikas, humbly bows to its sacred dust and is immersed in divine love bliss as He rolls upon it.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hoi Ananya Bhajai Bhagwant Hi - Shri Sundar Ji
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Hoi Ananya Bhajai Bhagwant Hi,Aur Kachhu Ur Main Nahin Rakhai. [1]Devi U Dev Jahan Lag Hain,Dari Kain Tinaso Kahun Deen Na Bhakhai. [2]Jog Hu Yagya Bratadi Kriya,Tinakau Nahin Tau Supinai Abhilakhai. [3]‘Sundar’ Amrit Paan Kiyau Tab,Tau Kahi Kaun Halahal Chaakhai. [4]- Shri Sundardas JiOnly when an aspirant completely renounces all other shelters and worships the Lord with exclusive devotion does he become eligible for pure bhakti. [1]Such a devotee never turns to demigods out of fear or desire, for his heart rests in unshakable faith, devoted solely to his beloved Lord. [2]Not even in his dreams does he contemplate engaging in yoga, yajñas, pilgrimages, vows, or austerities. [3]Śrī Sundardās Jī declares that such a soul forever drinks the nectar of Hari-rasa, never tasting any other poison of desires. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bahu Bidhi Mardan Karen - Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyarasikabharan Granth (11.6.3)
hindi_text: Bahu Bidhi Mardan Karen, Nahin Chaitanya Hoi Sab.Bhagavat Ras Ki Baat, Kaha Janai Binu Anubhav.- Shri Bhagwat Rasik, Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyarasikabharan Granth (11.6.3)Sri Bhagavata Rasika Ji declares that just as a lifeless body can never be revived by any medicine or external effort, so too, a monotonous heart that has never experienced rasa (nectar) remains unable to grasp its essence, regardless of explanations or teachings.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Chali Radha! Tokau Syam Bulavai - Shri Parmanand Das, Parmanand Sagar (1194)
hindi_text: (Raag Basant)Chali Radha! Tokau Syam Bulavai.Uhei Dekhi Vainu Madhure Dhuni, Tero Namhin Lai Lai Gavai. [1]Dekhau Vrindavan Ki Sobha, Thaur Thaur Drum Phule.Kokil Naad Sunat Man Anand, Bhanwar Bhramat Ras-Jhoolein. [2]Unmad Jovan Madan Kulahal, Yah Aausar Hai Neekau.‘Parmanand’ Prabhu Pratham Samagam, Milayo Bhavato Jeekau. [3]- Shri Parmanand Das, Parmanand Sagar (1194)A Sakhi says to Shri Radha, “O Shri Radhe! Come, your beloved Shyamsundar is calling you. Just see, He is melodiously singing your name through the sweet tunes of His flute.” [1]Look at the unparalleled beauty of Vrindavan! Everywhere, the trees are in full bloom, marking the complete arrival of spring. At such a time, the enchanting notes of the cuckoo’s song bring joy to the heart, and the bees, intoxicated by nectar, sway in delight. [2]This moment is exceedingly delightful and auspicious, with the air filled with youthful exuberance and love at its peak. This is the perfect moment to meet your beloved Shri Krishna, whose presence fills the heart with supreme bliss, says Sri Parmanand Das. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Adeyam Chapi Ya Datte - Shri Vagish Shastriji, Sri Radha Naam Sudha (11)
hindi_text: Adeyam Chapi Ya Datte Datva Raksham Karoti Ya.Yog-Kshem-Karo Radha-Bhakta Anubhavanti Yam.- Shri Vagish Shastriji, Sri Radha Naam Sudha (11)Shri Radha, ever-merciful, grants even the most unattainable to her loving devotees (who worship Her name) and takes responsibility for their protection. She is their eternal refuge, as experienced by their devotees.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dekho Dekho Braj Ki Beethini Beethini - Shri Gadadhar Bhatt Ji Ki Vani (68)
hindi_text: (Raag Pancham or Raag Malkosa)Dekho Dekho Braj Ki Beethini Beethini Khelat Hain Hari Hori.Geet Vichitra Kolahal Kautuk Sang Sakha Lakh Kori. [1]Aayi Jhoomi Jhoomi Jhundan Juri Aganit Gokul Gori.Tinmein Juvati Kadamb Shiromani Radha Naval Kisori. [2]Chhirakat Gwalbaal Abalan Par Booka Vadan Rori.Arun Akaas Dekhi Sandhya Bhram Puni Manasa Bhai Bauri. [3]Rapata Charan Keech Aragaja Ki Kesari Kunkum Ghori.Kahi Na Jaay Gadadhar Pai Kachhu Budhibal Mati Bhai Thori. [4]- Shri Gadadhar Bhatt Ji, Shri Gadadhar Bhatt Ji Ki Vani (68)O friend, look! In every lane of Braj, Hari is joyfully playing Holi. With sweet songs, playful laughter, and enchanting pastimes, He plays Holi with thousands of cowherds. [1]Countless groups of gopis of Gokul are arriving, swaying joyfully. Among them shines the crown jewel among them, the ever-youthful, Shri Radha Rani, accompanying them. [2]The cowherd boys sprinkle abir and gulala on the gopis’ faces, turning the sky red as if dusk had arrived early, casting a mesmerizing charm upon the mind. [3]Fragrant sandalwood-mixed colorful water and red gulal spread across the ground, causing everyone to slip and slide. Shri Gadadhar Bhatt Ji says, ‘This Holi celebration has captivated my mind, leaving me unable to describe this wondrous scene.’ [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sri Radha Vrishbhanuja Bhaktiani Pranadhar - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Sri Radha Vrishbhanuja, Bhaktiani Pranadhar.Vrindavipin Viharini, Pranavon Barambar.- Braj Ke DoheO Shri Radha, the most enchanting daughter of King Vrishbhanu, you are the very life and support of your devotees. O you who engages in ‘Nitya Vihara’ (eternal love-play) in Vrindavan, I bow to you endlessly.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Radhe Ab To Hori Aani Bani Hai - Shri Vanshi Ali Ji, Varshotsav, Basant Ke Pad (10)
hindi_text: Shri Radhe Ab To Hori Aani Bani HaiTum Bin Kaisen Beetat Ho. [1]Bin Leene Sudhi Eri Meri MokoBirah Dabanal Jeetati Ho. [2]Ka Saun Khelo Jay Haay HoSabson Pari Achhiti Ho. [3]Ka Saun Mukh Hansi Maadi BhidaunJay Shri Vanshi Pari Aneeti Ho. [4]- Shri Vanshi Ali Ji, Varshotsav, Basant Ke Pad (10)O Shri Radhe, the festival of Holi has arrived, but without you, my heart feels empty. How can I celebrate this joyous occasion without your presence? [1]O My Swamini, until you think of me and bestow your grace, my heart will keep burning in the vast fire of your separation. How can I bear this pain? [2]With whom should I go and play Holi? Alas! I am forgotten and ignored by all. [3]Without you, who will smile and smear colors on my face? Even fate seems unfair, cries Vanshi Ali. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jagat Sowat Swapna Mein Bhor Dyos Nish Sanjh - Goswami Shri Harirai Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (74)
hindi_text: Jagat Sovat Swapn Mein, Bhor Dyos Nish Saanjh.Shri Vallabh Vraj Ish Ke, Charan Dharo Hiy Maajh.- Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (35)Whether in a state of awake, sleep, or dream, whether it is morning, noon, evening, or night, always keep the lotus feet of Shri Krishna, the beloved Lord of Braj, close to your heart.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jo Moson Mosi Karo Nahi Kachhu Mohi Thaur - Shri Madhuri Das, Utkantha Madhuri (76)
hindi_text: Jo Moson Mosi Karo, Nahi Kachhu Mohi Thaur.Tum Ho Taisi Kijiye, Aho Rasik Sir Mor.- Shri Madhuri Das, Utkantha Madhuri (76)If you judge me according to my deeds, O Lord, then I am such a great sinner that my redemption would never be possible. Apart from you, I have no other refuge. You are supremely merciful, the one who embraces even the fallen. Therefore, O crown jewel of Rasikas, please shower your grace upon this wretched soul, as per your compassionate nature.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nenk Aage Aa Shyam Tope Rang Darun - Sri Purushottam Ji
hindi_text: (Rasiya)Nenk Aage Aa Shyam Tope Rang Darun.Rang Darun Tere Marvat Madun, Galan Pai Gulcha Marun. [1]Edi Tedhi Pagiya Bandhu, Pagiya Pai Phulari Parun.‘Purushottam’ Prabhu Ki Chhavi Nirkhai, Tan Man Dhan Jeevan Varun. [2]- Sri Purushottam JiA gopi says - Come forward, O dark Shyamsundar! Let me rub colors on you and apply color to your forehead and cheeks. [1]Your turban is slanted; let me adorn it with flowers. Sri Purushottam Ji says, “I offer my body, mind, wealth, and life upon your divine glimpse.” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hari Ras Maate Je Rahain Tin Ko Mato Agaadh - Shri Dayabai
hindi_text: Hari Ras Maate Je Rahain, Tin Ko Mato Agaadh.Tribhuvan Ki Sampati ‘Daya’, Trin Sam Jaanat Saadh.- Shri Dayabai (a disciple of Shri Charan Das Ji of the Shuk sect.)Those who are immersed in the nectar of Shri Hari are beyond description. For them, the wealth of all three worlds is as insignificant as a mere blade of grass.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sant Jan Barah Maas Basant - Jagadguru Shri Kripaluji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Siddhant Madhuri (103)
hindi_text: Sant Jan Barah Maas Basant.Piu Piu Kahi Kahi Chhin Chhin Nishidin, Kukat Kokil Sant. [1]Kabahun Jharat Drigan Ansuva Jan, Jhar Taru - Patra Anant.Kabahun Jhumi Jhumi Madhukar Jan, Gungunat Gun Kant. [2]Kabahun Pramat Phool Sarson Jan, Phooli Phooli Harshant.Prem Basant ‘Kripalu’ Nitya Rah, Ras Sarasant Na Ant. [3]- Jagadguru Shri Kripaluji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Siddhant Madhuri (103)For saints, the season of spring lasts throughout all twelve months. They continuously chant Piu Piu (“Beloved! Beloved!”) in a voice overflowing with love, much like the warbling of a cuckoo in the springtime. [1]Just as leaves fall from trees in spring, saints ceaselessly shed tears of love from their eyes. Like the humming of bees in spring, they sing the divine attributes of Shyama Shyam, swaying in the intoxication of love. [2]Much like mustard plants in full bloom during spring, saints become completely immersed in divine ecstasy, their hearts overflowing with the love of their beloved. Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji says that while the earthly spring season lasts only two months, the saints’ spring season of love remains forever. It always keeps them submerged in the boundless ocean of divine bliss. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kunjbihari Ko Basant Sakhi - Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (99)
hindi_text: (Raag Gaud)Kunjbihari Kau Basant Sakhi,Chalahu Na Dekhan Jahin.Nav Ban Nav Nikunj Nav Pallav,Nav Juvatin Mili Mahin. [1]Bansi Saras Madhur Dhuni Suniyat,Phooli Ang Na Mahin.Suni Shriharidas Prem Soun Premahin,Chhirakat Chhail Chubanhin. [2]- Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (99)Haridasi (Lalita) Sakhi says to another Sakhi - O Sakhi! Come, let us witness the Vasanta Utsav (spring festival) of the divine couple, Sri Shyama Kunjbihari. Behold how Shri Dham Vrindavan overflows with fresh waves of bliss! The bowers and groves are adorned with vibrant blossoms, and the trees and flowers have blossomed anew. In such a delightful atmosphere, Sri Shyama Shyam, surrounded by young maidens, are celebrating Vasantotsav together. [1]Hearing the sweet and intoxicating melody of His flute, an ocean of divine love swells within Priya Ji’s heart, overflowing beyond the limits of her divine form. Shri Haridasi Ji, lost in these mesmerizing glimpses, says—when Priya-Priyatam, lost in the ecstasy of love, gently touch one another, it is as if two divine embodiments of pure love are bathing each other in the nectar of their boundless affection. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Karai Kripa Jab Ladili Mitai Hiye Bhram Jal - Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Shri Radha Ras Siddhant (5)
hindi_text: Karai Kripa Jab Ladili, Mitai Hiye Bhram Jal.Charan Kamal Ki Det Hai, Seva Sahaj Rasal.- Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Shri Radha Ras Siddhant (5)When Ladili’s (Shri Radha’s) mercy flows, all illusion fades away. She bestows the nectar of devotion, granting the bliss of serving her lotus feet.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Main To Govardhan Ko Jaun Meri Veer - Shri Chandrasakhi Ji
hindi_text: Mai To Govardhan Ko Jaun Meri Veer, Naay Mane Mero Manua.Naay Mane Mero Manua, Naay Mane Karo Kanua.Saat Serki Karoon Kadhaaiya. [1]Mai To Santan Nyot Jimaoon Mere Veer, Naay Mane Mero Manua.Saat Kos Ki De Parikrama.Mai To Maansi Ganga Nahaaoon Mere Veer, Naay Mane Mero Manua. [2]Kund Kund Ko Achman Kar Ko.Brajraj Sheesh Chadhaoon Mere Veer, Naay Mane Mero Manua. [3]Chakleshwara Ko Darshan Kar Ko.Jeevan Safal Banao Mere Veer, Naay Mane Mero Manua. [4]Chandrasakhi Bhaj Baal Krishna Chhavi.Baar Baar Bali Jaoon Mere Veer, Naay Mane Mero Manua. [5]- Shri Chandrasakhi Ji (Braj Ke Lok Geet)O sakhi, I shall go to Govardhan, for my restless heart finds peace nowhere else. With love, I will prepare an abundance of food, offer it as bhog, and invite saints to partake, as my heart is not satisfied otherwise. [1]With unwavering faith, I shall circumambulate the sacred seven kosa path, and immerse myself in the pure waters of Mansi Ganga, for my heart will never settle otherwise. [2]I will drink water from every sacred pond, anointing my head with the divine dust of Braj, I surrender myself completely, for my heart will never settle otherwise. [3]I will seek the blessings of Chakleshwar Mahadev and fulfill my life’s purpose, for my heart will never settle otherwise. [4]Shri Chandra Sakhi Ji proclaims, “By the mercy of my Guru, Shri Hit Bal Krishna Ji, I shall surrender at Govardhan, again and again, for my heart will never settle otherwise.” [5]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Barsane Ki Radhika, Radhe Kau Yah Gram - Shri Hita Parmanand Das
hindi_text: Barsane Ki Radhika, Radhe Kau Yah Gram.Barsane Ke Nari-Nar, Gavat Radha Naam.- Shri Hita Parmanand DasShri Dham Barsana is the personal abode of Shri Radhika Ju,  where every being, chants the sweet and sacred name of Shri Radha alone.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Rom Romni Arujhi Vilasat Kamini -  Shri Lalitmohini Dev, Ras Ke Pad (49)
hindi_text: Rom-Romni Arujhi Vilasat Kamini.Tan Mein Tan, Man Mein Man Basi Rahe, Ras Baadhyo Sukh Jamini. [1]Gavat Sab Sur Taar Milin Ras, Vihansat Hansat Prakas Swamini.Shri Lalita Mohini Yah Chhavi Johani, Khelau Hansau Sukh Dham Dhamini. [2]- Shri Lalitmohini Dev, Shri Lalitmohini Dev Ju Ki Vani, Rasa Ke Pada (49)Both the beloveds (Shri Radha and Shri Krishna), filled with divine love and desire, engage in such playful pastimes that their very hairs become entangled with one another. Their forms are deeply merged, and they are inseparably settled in each other’s hearts. On this blissful night, a flood of divine nectar overflows. [1]When Swamini (Shri Kishori Ji) smiles, the beauty of her divine face shines even more brilliantly. All the sakhis sing of this bliss in perfect harmony with rhythm and melody. Shri Lalitmohini Ji says, ‘O abodes of happiness, divine couple, may you both forever continue to smile and play like this endlessly.’ [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Rasikan Ke Ras Dain Kaun Pragate Rasikanand - Shri Pitambar Dev Ji
hindi_text: Rasikan Ke Ras Dain Kaun, Pragate Rasikanand.Aage Bhay Na Honge, Adbhut Anandkand.- Shri Pitamabar Dev JiThe unparalleled king, the crown jewel of rasikas, Swami Shri Haridas, has manifested on this earthly realm solely to bestow the supremely rare, uninterrupted, eternal Nitya Vihar Ras of Shyama-Kunjbihari upon the rasikas. Such an extraordinary source of divine bliss has never existed before, nor will it ever exist in the future.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jaise Sukhahin Tan Badhayo Taise Tanhin Anang - Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar
hindi_text: Jaisein Sukhahin Tan Badhayo, Taisan Tanhin Anang.Dhoom Badhayo, Lochan Khasyo, Sakha Na Soojhyo Sang.- Sri Surdas, Soor SagarAs the body thrived on comfort and nourishment, the fire of lust flared up. As a result, the smoke of ignorance grew so dense that it obscured the vision of wisdom, making it impossible to recognize the Lord, your true eternal friend.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sundar Sujan Par Mand Muskan Par - Shri Wahid Ali Ji
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Sundar Sujan Par, Mand Muskan Par,Bansuri Ki Taan Par, Thauran Thagi Rahai. [1]Moorati Bisal Par, Kanchan Ki Maal Par,Khanjan-Si Chal Par, Khauran Saji Rahai. [2]Bhaunhen Dhan Maan Par, Lone Yug Nain Par,Prem Bhare Bain Par, “Wahid” Pagi Rahai. [3]Chanchal Vaa Tan Par, Sanware Badan Par,Nand Ke Nandan Par, Lagan Lagi Rahai. [4]- Shri Wahid Ali JiŚrī Kṛṣṇa's mesmerizing form, gentle smile, and the sweet melody of His flute enchant all, leaving them motionless in awe. [1]His captivating form, adorned with a golden garland, His wagtail-like, graceful gait, and His sandalwood-adorned forehead are supremely mesmerizing. [2]With bow-like eyebrows, mischievous eyes, and love-filled words, Wāhid Jī's heart overflows with bliss. [3]May my heart forever remain devoted to Nanda's son, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, who has a playful form and a dark, radiant face. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mudit Lal Pyari Charan Chitra Kare - Shri Hita Krishn Chandra
hindi_text: Mudit Lal Pyari Charan Chitra Kare.Neel Kamal Kar Peet Pad Padam, Char Jalaj Drig Neh Bhare. [1]Komal Piy Parasit Najuk Priya, Ur Antar Anurag Dhare.Mor Peeth Bhari Surang Tulika, Sahajhi Chhap Vichitra Dhare. [2]Param Sukhi Ya Avasar Payen, Charan Sanwari Nahu Man Hare.Krishna Chandra Radha Charan Dasi Chhabi, Sukhad Keli Rachi Chitt Are. [3]- Shri Hita Krishn ChandraThe joyful Beloved (Sri Krishn) paints Pyariju’s (Sri Radha’s) feet.With His blue lotus-like hands, He decorates the golden lotus-like feet of Sri Radha, His tear-filled eyes brimming with love. [1]As His delicate hands touch the tender feet of Sri Radha, the depths of Her heart overflow with love.Taking a peacock feather dipped in red color, She effortlessly imprints intricate designs upon them. [2]Blessed by the fortune of this supreme moment, He finds endless joy in serving Radha’s feet. Shri Krishna Chandra, the eternal servant of Her lotus feet, remains absorbed in this divine pastime of love. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kunj Bihari Pad Kamal Vinavo Doukar Jor - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Kunj Bihari Pad Kamal, Vinavo Doukar Jor.Chero Charanan Rakhiye, Manahu Mor Nihor.- Braj Ke DoheWith folded hands, I bow at the lotus feet of Kunja Bihari and pray—O Lord, please keep me as your humble servant at your feet and kindly accept my plea.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ja Din Te Muskani Chubhi Chit - Shri Raskhan, Raskhan Ratnavali
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Ja Din Te Muskani Chubhi Chit,Ta Din Te Nikasi Na Nikari. [1]Kundal Lol Kapol Maha Chhabi,Kunjan Te Nikasyo Sukhkari. [2]Haun Sakhi Aavat Hi Dagren,Pag Paind Taji Rijhai Banwari. [3]‘Raskhani’ Pari Muskani Ke Panani,Kaun Ganai Kulkaani Bichari. [4]- Sri RaskhanA sakhi says to Her friend—O friend! Ever since Śrī Kṛṣṇa's sweet smile wounded my heart, I have been unable to forget it. [1]The blissful Śrī Kṛṣṇa, playfully moving His earrings against His cheeks, suddenly emerged from the bowers of Braj. [2]O friend, I was walking on my path, but completely captivated by that forest dweller (Kṛṣṇa), I lost my way. [3]Śrī Raskhān says, 'Now I am trapped in the snare of His smile. In such a state, how can I uphold the sense of social modesty and family decorum?' [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhatkayau Bahu Bidhi Jag Bipin - Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Bhakta Sarvasva (5)
hindi_text: Bhatkayau Bahu Bidhi Jag Bipin, Milyo Na Kahun Vishram.Ab Anandit Hwai Rahyau, Pai Charan Ghanasyam.- Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Bhakta Sarvasva (5)I wandered endlessly through the dense forest of the material world, seeking rest but finding none. Only now, having attained the lotus feet of Ghanshyam (Shri Krishna), I have discovered true peace and bliss.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Eti Kripa Swamini Man Chahai - Shri Lalit Viharini Ji
hindi_text: Eti Kripa Swamini Man Chahai.Parninda Abhiman Eershya, Bhed Bhavana Rahe Na Jahai. [1]Mo Se Adham Udhare Lakhana, Jor Padyau Swamini! Kachhu Naahi.‘Lalitviharini’ Ju Karunanidhi, Puni Sankoch Karo Man Kahai. [2]- Shri Lalit Viharini JiO Swamini Ji (Shri Radha), please grant me such grace so that all material afflictions such as censuring, fault-finding, pride, envy, and discrimination—are completely eradicated from my heart. [1]You have uplifted countless souls more fallen than me. Please extend your mercy to me as well, for I lack the strength to overcome on my own. Shri Lalit Viharini Ji says, ‘O Radha, delighting in the beautiful bowers! You are an ocean of compassion, so why hesitate to show mercy to me?’ [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shaak Paat Va Kand Phal - Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Madhurya Ras Dohavali (6)
hindi_text: Shaak Paat Va Kand Phal, Jo Kachu Mile Ahaar.Vrindavan Nahin Chhodiye, Surasthal Yugal Vihaar.- Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Madhurya Ras Dohavali (6)Be content with whatever sustenance is available, be it vegetables, leaves, roots, or fruits. However, one should never abandon Shri Vrindavan Dham, the sacred realm of the eternal love plays of the divine couple, Sri Radha Krishna, for residing in Vrindavan holds unparalleled glory.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Prem Katari Hansi Hansi Maari - Shri Guru Chhauna Ji Maharaj
hindi_text: Prem Katari Hansi Hansi Maari, Mohan Meet Hamare. [1]Bheetar Baahar Tan Man Chedo, Niksi Paile Paare. [2]Ghayal Pari Kasak Jiya Maahin, Darshan Aushad Deeje. [3]‘Sakhichhona’ Vyakul Bhare Aansu, Tum Bin Nahin Pateejai. [4]- Shri Guruchauna Ji Maharaj, Virah Ki Maanjh (3)With a mischievous smile, my beloved Mohan (Krishna) has pierced me with the dagger of love. [1]Both inside and out, my body and mind are deeply wounded, as the dagger has pierced through to the other side. [2]Lying wounded, the pain in my heart can only be soothed by the medicine of Shri Krishna’s divine darshan. [3]Shri Guruchhona Ji says, ‘Now I shed tears in anguish, for without Mohan, my heart finds no peace anywhere.’ [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jay Jay Bhanukunwari Jay Radha Asharan Sharan - Shri Kishori Ali, Saar Chandrika (1)
hindi_text: Jay Jay Bhanukunwari Jay Radha Asharan Sharan.Apno Virad Vichar Pyari Palahu Din Jan.- Shri Kishori Ali, Saar Chandrika (1)Glory, glory to Sri Bhanu’s daughter, Sri Radha, the refuge of the shelterless!  O Pyariju, considering your merciful nature, protect the humble and downtrodden like me.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Braj Ke Param Sanehi Log - Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Chootak Pad (2)
hindi_text: Braja Ke Param Sanehi Log.Gaari Dain Hanshi Milat Ghahbare, Antar Prem Samyog. [1]Prem Roop Ras Dampati Leela, Yah Tinkau Nit Bhog.‘Nagaridas’ Sada Anandi, Supne Hoon Nahin Sok. [2]- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Chootak Pad (2)The people of Braj are filled with boundless love. They lovingly exchange playful words, laughter, and meet with love, as their hearts overflow with affection. [1]They partake in the rasa pastimes of the divine couple, full of love and beauty, which serve as their daily sustenance. Shri Nagridas says, these Brajwasis are forever immersed in joy, untouched by sorrow, not even in their dreams. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Preetam Ke Praan Pyari - Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (37)
hindi_text: (Raag Eman)Preetam Ke Praan Pyari, Pyari Ji Ke Praan Piy.Prem Rasi Ek Ras, Doo Chhavi Dekhihin. [1]Tripit Na Hot Kyon Hoon, Badhat Adhik Ruchi,Chhin-Chhin Chomp Nai Laagai Nain Na Nimeshin. [2]Reejhi-Reejhi Rang-Bhare Umagi Loin Dhare,Ank-Ank Rahe Bharivhas Visheshin. [3]‘Hit Dhruv’ Yah Gati Heri Kain Magan Bhain,Sakhi Sab Aisain Rahi Mano Chitra Rekh Hin. [4]- Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (37)Shri Radha is the very life of Shri Krishna, and Shri Krishna is the very life of Shri Radha. This treasure of love, the divine couple, gazes continuously at each other’s enchanting form, yet they never feel satisfied; their longing only deepens. [1]New waves of divine love arise every moment from each other’s beauty, keeping their eyelids from ever closing. Their joy-filled eyes, overwhelmed with love, overflow with tears of love. Completely enchanted by rasa, they lovingly embrace each other again and again. Shri Hit Dhruvdas Ji says that seeing the couple in such a state of love-filled ecstasy, the sakhis, immersed in divine bliss, stand spellbound as if they were lines drawn in an eternal painting. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Murat Nainan Mein Rami - Shri Neh Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Dohavali (23)
hindi_text: mūrata naiṃnana meṃ ramai, hiya mathi guna rahai pūridaśā na koū samajhi hai, prema pahucanau dūri- Shri Neh Nagridas Ji, Shri Neh Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Dohavali (23)The form of the beloved resides in the eyes, and the heart remains filled with their virtues. Such a state cannot be understood from an external perspective; the depth of love is beyond reach.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nirakh Nirakh Shobha Harsh - Shri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Maan Leela Dohavali (93)
hindi_text: Nirakh Nirakh Shobha Harsh, Piy Hiy Hot Apaar.Darad Darad Binti Karat, Jai Shri Rajkumar.- Shri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Maan Leela Dohavali (93)Shri Krishna’s heart overflows with joy at the sight of Shri Radha’s resplendent form. In a bid to dispel her sulk, He kneels humbly and, with trembling words, entreats her forgiveness. Glory be to Shri Kishori Ji, the sovereign queen of Vrindavan!
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Uddhav Aadi Brahmaadik Durlabh - Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Kavitt-Sewaiya (61)
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Uddhav Aadi Brahmaadik Durlabh, Paree Pramaan Juhee Suk Bhaakhee.Jaako Sujas Bakhaanat Shreemukh, Syaamaa Syaam Sahasmukh Saakhee. [1]Shree Bihareedaas Viswaas Tihiin Bal, Umandi MaiND Marjaadaa Naankhee.Rahyau Na Man Bhai Bhram Kram Shram Kachhu, Braj Raj Kaaj Kiyo Raj Raakhee. [2]- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Kavitt-Sewaiya (61)Describing the significance of Braj Rāj (the sacred sand of Braj), Śrī Śukadeva Paramhaṃsa Jī states that even great personalities like Uddhava and Lord Brahmā consider it a rare treasure. The divine couple, Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, themselves have glorified this Braj Rāj through Their divine words, with Śrī Śeṣa Jī bearing witness to its greatness. [1]Śrī Bihārin Deva says that relying on its strength, we have cast aside all societal norms and broken every boundary with joy. Fear, doubt, labor, and rules have been eliminated from our hearts, and this divine sand has fulfilled our every desire. That is why we constantly place this sacred Braj Rāj upon our foreheads. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jaisi Ekta Priya Ki Aisi Kare Na Koi. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (108)
hindi_text: Jaisi Ekta Priya Ki, Aisi Kare Na Koi.Tan Man Bachanani Chitt Mein, Rom Rom Rahi Bhoi.- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (108)No one shares the oneness (closeness) with me that my beloved Priyaji (Sri Radha) does. She resides in my body, mind, words, and heart—in every fiber and pore of my being.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Tere Tan Ki Upma Kaun Dekhyo - Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki Vani (168)
hindi_text: (Raag Vilawal)Tere Tan Ki Upma Kaun DekhyoMain Vichar Ke Kaun Nahiin Bhamini. [1]Kaha Baparo Kanchan, Kadali, Kaha Keheri, Gaj,Kapot, Kumbh, Pik Kaha Chandrama Kaha Vapuri Damini? [2]Kaha Kurang, Suk, Bandhuk, Keki, Kamal Ya AageShri Dekhiye Sab Ki Nikhamini. [3]Mohan Rasik Giri-Dharan Kahat ‘Radhe’!Param Bhavanti Tu Hai ‘Kumbhandas’ Swamini. [4]- Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki Vani (168)Shri Krishna says to Shri Radha:O Bhāminī (beautiful lady), I ponder deeply, yet cannot find any suitable comparison for your divine form. [1]Neither gold, nor banana trees, the lion, the elephant, the dove, the pitcher, the cuckoo, the moon, nor lightning can match your radiance. [2]How can the deer, the parrot, the bandhuka flower, the peacock, or the lotus even compare to your divine splendor? They seem insignificant in comparison. [3]The enchanter of hearts, Rasika Manmohana, the lifter of Giriraj mountain, Shri Krishna, says: “O Kumbhandasa’s Swamini Radhe! You are supremely pleasing to me.” [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Soi Neh Nandlal Mein Prakati Na Pavein Jaan - Shri Dayaram Ji
hindi_text: Soi Neh Nandlal Mein, Prakati Na Pavein Jaan.Jas Asi Surachitra Kon, Anchyo Hoi Na Myan.- Shri Dayaram JiJust as the sword in the hands of a warrior depicted in a painting remains forever drawn and never returns to its sheath, similarly, one’s love for Nandalal (Shri Krishna) should be such that, once manifested, it should remain steadfast and never fade.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Biharini Binti Yah Sun Lijiye- Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
hindi_text: (Raag Bilawal)Biharini Binti Yah Sun Lijiye.Tuv Mukh Anandakand Chandr Ki, Mohi Chakori Kijiye. [1]Chhin-Chhin Chhata Lakhun Chabirashi, Nain Nirakh Nit Jeejiye.Saras Madhuri Suno Swamini, Darshan Ki Nidhi Dijiye. [2]- Shri Saras MadhuriO Nitya Biharini (Shri Radha)! Please listen to my humble plea. Grant me the fortune to forever remain as a chakori bird, captivated by the moon-like radiance of your blissful face. [1]May I spend every moment gazing at your wondrous beauty and live my entire life in this way. Shri Saras Madhuri Ji says, ‘O my Swamini Ju! Please bestow upon me the priceless treasure of your divine darshan.’ [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kim Dharmena Mamasti Kryamiha - Shri Govardhan Bhatt, Shri Radhakund Stava (42)
hindi_text: kiṃ dharmeṇa mamāsti kṛtyamiha kiṃ yogena kiṃ sadguṇaiḥkiṃ me brahmamukhena kiṃ murāripordhyānādhināpyadya caśrīvṛndāvipineśvarīsarasikāgarveṇa na kvāpi mecittaṃ kuṇḍarasāmṛtāmbuddhi bhṛtaṃ sajjītyatīvonmadama- Shri Govardhan Bhatt, Shri Radhakund Stava (42)What worth do rituals or religious practices hold for me now? Even yoga, disciplines, and virtues seem futile. My heart does not crave even the bliss of ‘Brahmanand’ (bliss of an impersonal form of God), nor can meditation on Murari (Shri Krishna) fulfill my yearning. My mind, absorbed in the pride and glory of the Queen of Vrindavan’s sacred lake (Shri Radha Kund), cannot stray elsewhere. It is so thoroughly intoxicated that it continually drinks nectar from the ocean of nectar that is Radha Kund.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kari Ken Aas Ju Aur Ki - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (71)
hindi_text: (Doha)Kari Ken Aas Ju Aur Ki, Takata Na It Ut Hoy.Tuv Pad Parchhaahi Bina, Nahin Bhaavat Man Koy.(Pad)Shri Radhe! Toh Pad Pankaj Ki Parchhaahi Rihat Sadaa Man Mero.Kariken Aas Aur It Utki Takata Na Daahin Derou. [1]Sakal Lok Sukh-Sampatti Kau Sukh Nahin Suhaavat Nerou.Shri Hari Priya Nirantar Rasnaa Ratat Naam Nit Tero. [2]- Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (71)Shri Lal Ji (Shri Krishna) is now restless, says -(Doha)O Beloved (Shri Radha), my mind does not wander here or there, leaving the hope of your lotus feet.  Beyond the shade of your lotus-feet, nothing else in this universe brings me peace.(Pad)My mind forever rests in the shadow of your lotus feet, abandoning all other hopes or desires. [1]Even the joys of all the fourteen worlds and the transcendental realms like Vaikuntha cannot match the bliss found beneath the shadow of your lotus feet. O Beloved Swamini (protectress) of Shri Hari, my tongue continuously chants your name, desiring nothing but the eternal shade of your lotus feet. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aisa Sumiran Keejiye Sahaj Rahai Lau Laay - Sri Sahjobai
hindi_text: Aisa Sumiran Keejiye, Sahaj Rahai Lau Laay.Binu Jibhya Binu Taaluai, Antar Surat Lagay.- Sri SahjobaiEngage in such remembrance (of the Lord) that your focus always remains effortlessly steady. Without engaging the tongue or palate, engage your mind entirely in the nectar of devotion.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aaju Nikunj Mahal Mein Gavat - Shri Ichcha Sakhi Ji
hindi_text: Aaju Nikunj Mahal Mein Gavat, Priyalal Dou Rangbhine. [1]Baaje Sab Mil Bajat Madhur Gati, Mohan Alap Kahen Sur Jheene. [2]Raag-Ragini Moorti Dharikai, Chakit Bhaye Maanau Likhi Deene. [3]‘Ichchha Sakhi’ Nirikh Ya Chhavi Kaun, Pran Waari Nyauchhaavar Keene. [4]- Shri Ichcha Sakhi JiIn the enchanting bower palace today, Sri Radha and Krishna sing together, immersed in divine love. [1]Sahcharis are playing instruments in perfect harmony with the rhythm, as soft notes and refined alaps of Priya Priyatam captivate the heart. [2]The personified forms of ragas and raginis stand mesmerized as if destiny itself had created this magical moment. [3]Ichcha Sakhi ji, beholding this captivating vision, sacrifices her very life in complete devotion. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Tuhi Ek Radha Kunwar Drig Darshat Nahin Aur - Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radhika Maharas, Doha (6)
hindi_text: Tuhi Ek Radha Kunwar, Drig Darshat Nahin Aur.Yehai Jaan Hum Bhajti Hain, Aho Rasik Sirmour.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radhika Maharas, Doha (6)You alone are my life, O eternally youthful, Radha, and my eyes seek no other vision but yours. Knowing this, I worship you exclusively, O crown jewel of all Rasikas.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kripa Karo Ab Naval Naveli - Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (34)
hindi_text: (Raag Durga Tritaal)Kripa Karo Ab Naval Naveli.Sevakunj-Nikunj Bhavan Ki, Lata Phool Banun Veli.Chhaki Rahun Ras Mati Nit Hi, Chhado Nanhi Akeli.Shri Gopalhit Hari Swamini, Jaise Phool Chameli. - Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (34)O ever-youthful Shri Radha! Please bestow your grace upon me so that I may become a vine, a flower, or a creeper in the Sevakunj (Nikunj forest). [1]May I always remain immersed in your divine nectar. Please don't leave me alone; let me always stay in your close proximity. Shri Hit Gopal Das Ji says, ‘O protectress of Shri Hari (Shri Radha), you are as radiant and pure as a jasmine flower.’ [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nachat Dou Rahas Mein Rang Bhine - Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyarasikabharan Granth (11.1)
hindi_text: (Raag Kedarau)Nachat Dou Rahas Mein Rang-Bhinain.Haav-Bhaav Upajat Ang-Angan, Kok-Kala Man Deenain. [1]Bajat Madhur Mridang Kinkini, Noopur Taal Nabeenain.Hoda-Hodi Taan, Tirap-Gati Let, Nahi Kou Heenain. [2]Raka-Rati, Rajanikar-Anan Udit Madan Bas Keenain.Reejhi-Reejhi Bhagwat Ki Swamini, Laal Ank Bhari Leenain. [3]- Shri Bhagwat Rasik, Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyarasikabharan Granth (11.1)Completely immersed in the ecstasy of divine love, the divine couple (Sri Radha Krishna) are dancing together in a secluded place. Engrossed in ever-new expressions of amorous pastimes, their every movement emits countless charming gestures and moods. [1]The enchanting mridang of ‘Nitya Vihara’ beats in perfect harmony, complemented by the soft jingles of their waistbands and anklets. The divine couple engage in a playful competition of melodic expressions and intricate dance rhythms, with neither falling short of the other. [2]At that moment, the full moon, glowing like the face of Rati (the goddess of love) in the night sky, rose to witness the scene and handed them over to the care of Kamadeva (the god of love). It was then that Bhagavata Rasik Ji’s Swamini Sri Radha was pleased, and embraced Lal Ji (Sri Krishn) lovingly within her tender arms. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Radhavallabha Param Dhan - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (5)
hindi_text: (Shri) Radhavallabha Param Dhan, Vyasa Hi Phabi Gayi Loot.Kharachat Hoon Nighatein Nahi, Bhare Bhandar Atoot. - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (5)Shri Radhavallabh is the supreme treasure, and Vyasji has joyfully plundered this divine wealth. No matter how much you draw continuously, the storehouse remains inexhaustible.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aarti Bhanu Dulari Ki - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj
