hindi_text: āratī bhānu dulārī kī, ki śrī barasāne vārī kīvirājeṃ siṃhāsana śyāmā, divya śrī vṛndāvana dhāmā,ḍhurāvaiṃ caṅvara sughara bāmā, paloṭaiṃ paga pūrana kāmālalī paga aṃka cāpi ni:śaṃka, śyāma janu raṃka,pāya nidhi pārasa pyārī kī, ki śrī barasāne vārī kī āratī (1)I perform the aarti of Barsane wari Radhey, the loving daughter of King Brishbhanu.She is seated on a golden throne adorned with jewels, in the divine abode of Vrindavan,Beautiful maidens are gently fanning Her with the chanwar (fly-whisk), and self-complacent absolute brahm, Shri Krishna, is pressing Her lotus feet.Holding Her feet in His lap, and pressing them with great care, He is doing this unhesitatingly with no fear of anyone's opinion, as if lost in the ecstasy of a pauper who has found a touchstone. [1]gaura sira kanaka mukuṭa rājaiṃ, candrikā cāru suchabi chājaiṃ,kuṭila kuntala ali bhala bhrājaiṃ, lakhata jehi śikhikalāpa lājaiṃmāṅga sindūra, motiyana pūra, sajīvani mūra,brahma govardhana dhārī kī, ki śrī barasāne vārī kī āratī (2)Her fair face is decorated with a gold crown and a beautiful chandrika,With the charming beauty of Kishoriji’s black and curly hair abashing the beauty of Shri Krishna’s peacock feather decorated on His head.The parting in Her hair is decorated with sindura and strings of pearls. Kishori Ji is the soul treasure of the Supreme Lord, Shri Krishna, the lifter of the Govardhana Mountain. [2]śravaṇa vica karaṇa phūla jhalakaiṃ, nāsikā vica besara halakaiṃ,nayana vica premasudhā chalakaiṃ, bandhu bala ke lakhi lakhi lalakaiṃcapala natha camaka, dasanaduti damaka, sumukhimukha ramaka,madhura musakina sukumārī kī, ki śrī barasāne vārī kī āratī (3)The lovely pendants of Her ears sparkle brightly, and the elegance of Her swaying nose pearl enchants all,Her eyes overflow with divine love, releasing such an intense nectar that ignites an ardent yearning in Sri Krishna, Balram’s brother.Her swaying nose-ring shimmers, the whiteness of Her teeth glistens and her radiant smile together make Her face indescribably beautiful and enchanting. [3]motiyana lara uramaṇimālā, cibuka jhalakata ika tila kālā,śambhu śuka daiṃ saṃga karatālā, lalī guṇa gāvati brajabālākabahuṅ mukha murani, kabahuṅ dṛga durani, kabahuṅ dṛga jurani,kabahuṅ sudhi bhurani vihārī kī, ki śrī barasāne vārī kī āratī (4)Her bosom is decorated with strands of pearls and jewelled necklaces, while a charming beauty spot adorns Her chin.Great paramahamsas like Lord Shankara and Shukadeva clap their hands joyfully as the maidens of Braja sing Her glories.Sometimes She turns Her face away from Shyamasundara, sometimes out of shyness, She averts Her eyes, and at other times, She casts a flirtatious glance in His direction, causing Shyamasundara to nearly lose consciousness with joy. [4]kinārina jarina nīla sārī, kaṃcukī kumakuma raṃga vārī,curī kara kaṃkana manahārī, chīna kaṭi kiṃkinī chavi nyārīpāyalani pagani, mahāvari lagani, bīchuvani nagani,'kṛpālu' sukīrti - kumārī kī, ki śrī barasāne vārī kī āratī (5)She is wearing a blue saree with a golden border, and the rosy pink blouse on Her body is charming.The elegance of fancy bracelets and bangles on Her hands is fascinating, and the beauty of the ornate waistband on Her thin waist is heart-captivating.She is wearing anklets, and Her lotus feet are decorated with mahavar (red color), while Her toes are adorned with delicate diamond toe rings.In this way, Kirti Kumari Radhey, beautifully dressed and adorned, sits on the golden throne as the maidens perform the aarti. [5]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Guru Sandhi Subhav Na Paavat - Shri Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (11)
hindi_text: Shri Guru Sandhi Subhav Na Paavat, Gaavat Jag Jas Dhuta.Bina Ananya Vihara Chahat, Kyon Paavhuge Puta.- Shri Nagri Dev, Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (11)Without comprehending the principle and nature of Swami Sri Haridas, the bestower of supremely divine Nitya Vihara nectar, deceitful people merely sing praises of worldly fame. How can one attain this eternal rasa of the divine couple without firm and exclusive devotion?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aj Bishnu, Mahesh, Brajesh, Shri - Shri Prem Ji
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Aj Bishnu, Mahesh, Brajesh, Shri, Nahin Paavat Paar Bade Adhikari. [1]Jag Jaal Jaadyau Jab Jeev Japai, Kare Sukkh Pradatt Shrikunjbihari. [2]Nity Bihar Bileen Chhabili Lai, Dhyavat Shri Haridas Dulari. [3]Tihaari Archana Prem Pujari Karen, Hiye Manhi Bithakar Bankebihari. [4]- Shri Prem JiEven the greatest personalities like Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, Brajeśvara Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and Goddess Lakṣmī remain unable to comprehend the infinite glory of Śrī Kuñjabihārī and Śrī Kuñjabihāriṇī, who are ever immersed in the eternal Nitya Vihāra rasa. [1]For the soul lost in the illusions of the material world, the mere remembrance of Their sacred names brings liberation from Māyā and bestows infinite bliss. [2]Śrī Kuñjabihārī eternally enjoys the divine Nitya Vihāra rasa with His beloved Śrī Kuñjabihāriṇī, who remains the constant focus of Śrī Haridāsa Jī’s meditation. [3]Śrī Prema Jī declares, "Only rasika devotees, filled with pure love, can truly keep Śrī Baṅke Bihārī enshrined in their hearts." [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ardhon Milita Lochanasya - Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.35)
hindi_text: ardhonmīlitalochanasya pibato rādeti nāmāmṛtam premāśrūṇi vimuñcataḥ pulakitāṁ sarvāṁ tanuṁ bibhṛtaḥ.kutrāpi skhalataḥ kvacicca patato vṛndāṭavīvīthiṣu svacchandaṁ vrajataḥ kadātisukhadā yāsyanti me vāsarāḥ.- Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.35)With half-closed eyes, May I chant “Shri Radhe! Shri Radhe!” overflowing with nectar.With my eyes flowing with tears of love, may my entire body shiver in blissful ecstasy.Stumbling, falling, and losing all awareness, I may wander freely through the lanes of Shri Vrindavan.When will such days of divine bliss arrive for me?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aao Pyare Hridaysadan Mein - Shri Yugal Priya
hindi_text: (Raag Peelu-Taal Kaharva)Aao Pyare Hridaysadan Mein,Pal Kapaat Dai Raakhungi. [1]Jaan Liye Chhal-Chhand-Phand SabAb Na Chalai Satya Bhaakhungi. [2]Karihai Jo Koi Vighan MilanmeinTaake Sab Kal-Bal Naakhungi. [3]Jugalpriya Manmohan Tumharau,Dragbhari Roopsudha Chaakhungi. [4]- Shri Yugal PriyaO Beloved,  step into the temple of my heart, where I shall forever keep you inside. [1]Having seen through all allure and false charms, I now declare that no deception of yours can distract me anymore. [2]If any obstacle dares to arise in our union, I shall overcome it with steadfast determination. [3]Sri Jugal Priya says, “O beloved Manmohan, I long to immerse myself in the nectar of your divine beauty.” [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Paudhe Mai Laalan Girivardhari - Shri Chhit Swami, Shri Chhit Swami Ji Ki Vani (159)
hindi_text: (Raag Vihagaro)Paudhe Mai ? Laalan Girivardhari.Kunj-Mahal Mein Kusum-Sej Par Sohati Sang Radhika Piyari. [1]Kanth Laagi Bhuj Diyein Sirhanein Adbhut Chhabi Laagat Ati Bhaari.Maanon Mili Rahi Damini Ghan Son ‘Chhit-Swami' Bhari Laee Ankavaari. [2]- Shri Chhit Swami, Shri Chhit Swami Ji Ki Vani (159)O friend, within the enchanting bower-palace, on a bed adorned with fragrant flowers, rests the glorious Shri Krishna, while beside Him, the supremely captivating Shri Radha Pyari gracefully rests. [1]With His arm tenderly placed beneath Shri Radha’s head, Shri Krishna draws her close to His heart. The splendor of this divine moment defies all description. Shri Chhit Swami beautifully compares it to lightning embracing a dark cloud as Shri Radha rests in Shri Shyamsundar’s loving embrace. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pai Mithas Ya Maar Ke Rom-Rom Bharpoor - Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (30)
hindi_text: Pai Mithas Ya Maar Ke, Rom-Rom Bharpoor.Marat Jiyai Jhukatau Thirai, Banai Su Chaknachoor.- Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (30)The wound of love is deep, yet sweet, filling the heart with boundless nectar. Only those who sacrifice themselves to love achieve immortality. Only by plunging into the depths of love can one rise to spiritual heights. True transformation begins when the ego is forsaken, and the soul advances toward love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bandaun Swamini Charan Tihaare - Shri Shyamdas
hindi_text: Bandaun Swamini Charan Tihaare.Arunkamal Mridu Amal Karun Ati, Ratipati Manahi Lubhavanvaare. [1]Sundar Saras Sucharu Sugandhit, Nakhmanichandr Amand Ujaare.Chandan Charchit Noopur - Naadit, Brahmanand Bhulavan Haare. [2]Sakhijan Sevit, Laalit-Paalit, Ashtayam Ghanshyamhin Pyare.Shyamdas Ke Isht Shiromani, Teen Lok Vedan Te Nyare. [3]- Shri ShyamdasO my Swamini Shri Radha, I bow to your lotus feet. Your feet, of a radiant red hue, are soft, pure, and filled with compassion, and enchant even the mind of Cupid, the deity of love. [1]These feet are supremely beautiful, filled with divine fragrance. The radiant gems of your toenails outshine the moon. Adorned with sandalwood paste and resonating with the melodious chime of anklets, they surpass even the bliss of ‘Brahmanand’ (the impersonal form of divine ecstasy). [2]These divine lotus feet are lovingly worshipped and served by the sakhis and are loved by Shri Krishna throughout all eight quarters of the day. Shri Shyamdas says, “The lotus feet of Shri Radha are my Ishta Deva (worshipful deity), transcending the realms of the three worlds and surpassing even the Vedas.” [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dasan Khandit Viri Ruchir Daihain Nikat Bulaay - Shri Madhuri Das, Utkantha Madhuri (149)
hindi_text: Dasan Khandit Viri Ruchir, Daihain Nikat Bulaay.Kunvari Aapne Kanth Ko, Haar Kanth Pahraay.- Shri Madhuri Das, Utkantha Madhuri (149)It is my heartfelt desire that ever-youthful Shri Radha calls me to her side, offers me the betel leaf she has chewed with her tender hands, and places the garland from her own neck around mine.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hamarain Inake Vachan Praman - Shri Kishori Ali
hindi_text: Hamaarain Inake Vachan Praman.Shri Harivansh Gusain, Shri Haridas Kiye Je Gaan. [1]Vyas Saman Vyas Hain Mere, Dhruv Dhruvpad Ke Vakta.Vitthalvipul Biharinidasi, Rahasikeli Anurakta. [2]Yahi Tatv Hiy Dhar Chhod Ab Nana Mat Vyabhichaare.Gahi Anany Mat Sei 'Kishori', Nirkhau Jugal Vihaare. [3]- Shri Kishori AliThe Vanis (words) of these great Rasikas are my guiding authority. The divine rasa sung by Goswami Shri Hit Harivansh Ji and Swami Shri Haridas Ji forms the foundation of my life. [1]Shri Hariram Vyas Ji stands as my Ved Vyasa, while Shri Hit Dhruvdas Ji is the masterful orator of Dhruvapada.  Shri Vitthalvipul Dev Ji and Shri Biharindev Ji are perpetually immersed in the eternal Keli plays of the divine couple, Sri Radha and Krishna. [2]Shri Kishori Ali says, ‘O mind, accept the supreme essence glorified by these Rasikas, and abandon the contamination of various other beliefs. Embrace singular devotion, serve the lotus feet of Shri Radha, and behold the divine couple's Nitya Vihara (love-play).’ [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pyari Pritam Ke Sada Ras Hi Mein Aasakt - Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Rasik Pacchisi (21)
hindi_text: Pyaari Preetam Ke Sada, Ras Hi Mein Aasakt.Roop Madhuri Sam Ginai, Nindan Vandan Jakta.- Shri Roopmadhuri, Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Rasik Pacchisi (21)The true Rasika is one who remains perpetually absorbed in the nectar of the divine couple, Sri Shyama Shyam, and remains indifferent to both praise and criticism.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Re Man Kyon Chate Jag Dhur - Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Vinay (33)
hindi_text: (Raag Yogiya Kalingada)Re Man Kyon Chate Jag Dhur.Dhan Joban Yon Jay Hath Tein, Ja Vidhi Udat Kapoor. [1]Maat Taat Bhrata Sut Dara, Yah Nate Sab Koor.Lalit Ladaiti Bas Vrindavan, Brajaraj Mil Hvai Choor. [2]- Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Vinay (33)Oh mind, why cling to the transient dust of this world? Wealth and youth vanish as swiftly as camphor in the air. [1]Relations like parents, siblings, sons, and spouses are all fleeting ties and filled with selfishness. Sri Lalit Ladaiti says, “Find refuge in Vrindavan and merge with the divine dust of Braj, for only then will your life attain true meaning.” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrindavan Ki Rajani Mein Sovat Paun Pasari - Shri Ananya Ali
hindi_text: Vrindavan Ki Rajani Mein Sovat Pain Pasari.Aur Thaur Ke Bhajan Gan Lajat Hot Balihari.- Shri Ananya Ali, Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.53)In the sacred realm of Vrindavan, even resting with outstretched legs under the refuge of Shri Radha Maharani embodies the highest devotion. The exalted practices of devotion elsewhere pale and bow in reverence to this.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pahne Yah Kundal Yonhi Raho - Braj Ke Sawaiya
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Pahne Yah Kundal Yonhi Raho, Alkalvi Yonhi Sanware Raho. [1]Adharamrit Paan Karate Huye, Murli Kar-Kanj Mein Dhare Raho. [2]Nahin Aur Vishesh Karo Kuch To, Aniyare Drigon Se Nihare Raho. [3]Kahin Jao Na Mohan Chhod Humein, Bane Jeevanpraan Hamare Raho. [4]- Braj Ke SawaiyaO Manamohana, let Your beautiful earrings remain just as they are,And may Your lovely curls stay gracefully adorned. [1]As You offer the sweet nectar of Your lips,Keep the flute steady in Your lotus-like hands. [2]If You choose to do nothing more,Let Your playful sidelong glances rest lovingly upon me. [3]Please don't leave me, O Manamohana—Stay with me, like the soul of my life. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Yah Agadh Nidhi Madhur Ras - Shri Rasik Govind, Shri Yugal Ras Madhuri, Doha (1)
hindi_text: Yah Agadh Nidhi Madhur Ras, Chhavi Kachu Kahi Na Jai.Chatak Chehe Sab Hi Piyo, Pai Ik Boond Samai.- Shri Rasik Govind, Shri Yugal Ras Madhuri, Doha (1)The beauty of the boundless treasure of this sweetest nectar of the divine couple cannot be described in words. Though the bird-like heart longs to drink it all, even one drop fills it with bliss.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aisen Aarati Karau - Shri Anandghan Ji, Shri Ghanananda Granthavali, Padavali (240)
hindi_text: (Raag Gandhar)Aisen Aarati Karau.Suthir Thar Hiy Bisad Beech Lai Prem-Pradeep Dharau. [1]Ujjal Dasa Saneh-Sanjoi Joti Jagai Dharau.Bhav-Puhup Pratiti Son Sanjut Baarani Or Arau. [2]Mohan-Mukh Jagamagni Pani Pai Nirkhat Harash Bharau.Anandghan Umaah Aarati Kaun Harihi Badai Harau. [3]- Shri Anandghan Ji, Shri Ghanananda Granthavali, Padavali (240)If you wish to perform the Lord’s aarti, do it this way: let your heart be the vast plate, and place within it the lamp of love. [1]Light a pure flame of affection, and turn your mind and soul toward the Lord. Present the flowers of your innermost emotions at His feet with faith and reverence. [2]As the divine radiance of Shri Krishna’s face begins to illuminate your inner being, fill your heart with supreme bliss. Shri Anandghan says, “An aarti performed with true love and devotion will captivate even the heart of the Lord.” [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Barsane Vasinu Kain Shri Radha Aadhar - Shri Hita Parmanand Das
hindi_text: Barsane Vaasinu Kain, Shri Radha Aadhaar.Radha Ke Pyaare Sabai, Radha Hi Soun Pyaar.- Shri Hita Parmanand DasThe very source of life for the residents of Barsana is none other than Sri Radha. All the Barsana Wasis are deeply loved by Radha, and they are exclusively absorbed in loving her.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: (Shri) Radhavallabhkau Hau Bhanvatau Cherau - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardh (133)
hindi_text: (Shri) Radhavallabhkau Hau Bhanvatau Cherau.Radhavallabh Kahat Sunathi, Man Na Naim Jam Kerau. [1]Radhavallabh Vastu Bhooli Hoon, Kiyau Anat Nahin Pherau.Radhavallabh Vyasdaskai Sunahun Shravan Dai Terau. [2]- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardh (133)I am the beloved servant of the divine couple, Shri Radhavallabh Ji. The mere utterance or hearing of the name “Radhavallabh” elevates my heart beyond all restraints and observances. [1]I will never, even by mistake, turn elsewhere, leaving Shri Radhavallabh Ji. Shri Hariram Vyas says, ‘O Shri Radhavallabh, please hear this servant’s call.’ [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Rakhyo Kahat Na Main Kachu - Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (220)
hindi_text: Rakhyo Kahat Na Main Kachu, Tokon Sarvasu Saar.Shreekunjbiharini Kau Bhajan, Jeevan Ahaar Bihar.- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (220)The sweet, nectar-filled ‘Nitya Vihara’ of Bihariniju (Sri Radha) is the very sustenance of our lives. This ultimate truth, the essence of all essences, I have revealed to you fully, with nothing concealed.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aaju Badhai Hai Barsane -  Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Uttarardh (355)
hindi_text: (Raag Jayatishri / Devgandhar)Aaju Badhai Hai Barsanain. Kunwari Kisori Janam Layo, Sab Lok Baje Sahdanain. [1]Kahat Nand Vrishbhanaray Saun, Aur Baat Ko Janain. Aaju Bhaiya Ham Sab Vrajvasi, Tere Hi Haath Bikanain. [2]Ya Kanya Ke Aage Kotic, Betanin Kau Ab Maanain. Tere Bhalain, Bhalau Sabhi Kau, Anand Kaun Bakhanain. [3]Chhail Chhabile Gwal Rangeele, Harad, Dahi Laptaanain. Bhushan Vasan Vividh Pahire, Tan Ganat Na Raja Raanain. [4]Naachat Gaavat Pramudit Hvai Nar, Narin Ko Pehichanain. Vyas Rasik Sab Tan Man Poole, Neeras Sabai Khisanain. [5]- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Uttarardh (355)Today, the town of Barsana is filled with joy and celebration, for in the house of Vrishbhanu Ji, Kishori Shri Radha has descended, and auspicious blessings are resounding throughout all the worlds. [1]Nand Ji says to Vrishbhanu Maharaj — “Apart from Shri Radha, nothing else remains worthy of discussion. Today, all of us Vrajvasis are completely surrendered into your hands.” [2]In front of this divine daughter, even the honor of millions of sons appears insignificant. Truly, she is not only your blessing, but the very redeemer of the world. Who can put this transcendental happiness into words? [3]The charming cowherd boys have anointed their bodies with turmeric and curd. They have adorned themselves with various ornaments and beautiful garments — and in their splendor, even kings and queens appear dim. [4]All of Braj, male and female alike, are absorbed in the ecstatic bliss, lost in dance and song. Shri Hariram Vyas says that on Radhashtami, all Rasikas are overjoyed as their bodies and minds are immersed in nectar, while monotonous jivas (without rasa) have fled into the corners in embarrassment. [5]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bakhanat Prem Pratap Mahaatam - Shri Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (28)
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Bakhanat Prem Pratap Mahaatam Sanch Na Svang Kasai Kasi Kaanchi. [1]Sadhik Siddh Bhayo To Kaha Kunvari Kishori Kripa Nahin Jaanchi. [2]Shriguru Prem Prasann Biharanidasi Shrinagari Ke Rang Raachi. [3]Re Buddhi Bivek Bichari Ihai Ju Kahai Su Lahai To Karai Sab Saanchi. [4]- Shri Nagri Dev, Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (28)Śrī Nāgarideva Jī advises—O brother, you speak of love, but you mix it with grandeur and splendor. This exposes your claim to being a true rasika (connoisseur of divine love) as false, exposing its immaturity upon closer examination. [1]Unless you sincerely seek the exclusive grace of Nitya Bihāriṇījū (Śrī Rādhā), any spiritual accomplishment you attain will still leave you devoid of Svāminī Jī's (Śrī Rādhā's) supremely divine nectar. [2]Our beloved Gurudeva, Śrī Bihārīdeva, is ever immersed in the bliss of His Guru's love, remaining deeply absorbed in the love of Kiśorī Śrī Rādhā. [3]Reflect deeply with wisdom and be determined to follow your Gurudeva's teachings to the very word. By doing so, you will achieve true spiritual realization. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Tanak Hansi Chitvau Hamari Aor - Shri Krishnpriya Ji
hindi_text: Tanak Hansi Chitvau Hamari Aor.Mero To Mohan Ik Tumhi, Tumkoun Laakh Karor. [1]Kabki Main Thadi Araj Karat Houn, Suniyo Nandkishor.‘Krishnapriya’ Ke Praan Jivandhan, Karunanidhi Chitchor. [2]- Shri Krishnpriya JiO Shyamsundar!  Cast your glance upon me with a smile, even for a moment. You have countless devotees, but I have no one but you, O Manmohan! [1]I have been standing and pleading with you for so long, but now, O Nandkishor, kindly hear my prayers! Shri Krishnapriya Ji proclaims, “My life’s only treasure is the ocean of mercy, Shri Krishna, the one who steals all hearts.” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Koti Paap Chhin Mein Tare Lehi Vrindavan Nama - Goswami Shri Harirai Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (74)
hindi_text: Koti Paap Chhin Mein Tare, Lehi Vrindavan Naam.Teen Lok Par Gajiye, Sukhanidhi Gokul Gaam.- Goswami Shri Harirai Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (74)Countless sins are instantly wiped out by chanting the name of Vrindavan. The glory of Gokul village, the treasure trove of bliss, resonates across the three worlds.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Radhe Bhayi Aapu Ghansyam - Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali
hindi_text: Radhe Bhayi Aapu Ghansyam.Aapun Kau Gobind Kahat Hai, Chhadi Radhika Naam. [1]Vaisei Jhuki Jhuki Kai Kunjan Mein, Kabahunk Benu Bajaavai.Kabahoon Apanau Naam Lei Kai, Radha Radha Gaavai. [2]Kabahaun Maun Gahi Rahat Dhyan Kari, Mundi Rahat Dou Nain.'Harichand' Mohan Binu Vyakul, Naiku Nahin Chit Chain. [3]- Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu GranthawaliToday, Sri Radha transformed into Krishna, adorning herself in His attire and calling herself Govind, leaving Her name Radhika. [1]Like Krishna, she sometimes plays the flute, bending gracefully within the bowers. At other times, she chants her own name, “Radha Radha.” [2]Occasionally, she sits silently in meditation, her eyes closed. Shri Harichand says, “She is restless for Krishna and finds no respite without Him, even for a moment.” [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Chal Man Vrindavan Chal Rahiye - Shri Shyamdas
hindi_text: Chal Man Vrindavan Chal Rahiye.Param Puneet So Braj Ki Dharani, Raj Dhari Sheesh Janam-Phal Lahiye. [1]Manjul Saghan Pulin Yamunatat, Sundar Parn-Kuti Chali Chhaiye.Sant Took Lahi Paay Yamuna Jal, Mili Rasikan Radhagun Gaiye. [2] Viharat Aavahin Yugalalal Jab, Man Ki Vyatha Katha Sab Kahiye. 'Shyam' Kripa Aisi Kab Kariho, Chali Vrindavan Laut Na Aiye. [3]- Shri ShyamdasO mind, reside eternally in Vrindavan, where the  land is supremely sanctified by the lotus feet of Sri Shyama Shyam. Adorn your forehead with this dust to attain the fruits of countless lifetimes. [1]In that forest adorned with dense, beautiful trees on the banks of the Yamuna, build a charming leaf hut and dwell there. Sustaining ourselves with the remnants of saints and the water of the Yamuna, let us sing the glories of Shri Radha in the company of rasik devotees. [2]When the youthful couple, Sri Shyama Shyam, come wandering through the groves, pour out all your heart to them. O Sri Shyama Shyam, when will you grace me such that I may never have to return from Vrindavan? [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Yah Jori Avichal Raho Ye Aashish Hamaari - Shri Malook Das
hindi_text: Yeh Jori Avichal Raho, Ye Aashish Hamaari.Dulha Shripati Sanvaro, Dulahin Radha Pyari.- Shri Malook DasMay the divine couple, dark-complexioned Shri Krishna, the charming groom, and radiant Shri Radha, the graceful bride, remain ever-eternal. This is our heartfelt blessing.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Yamuna Pulin Subhag Vrindavan - Shri Nanddas, Nanddas Granthwali
hindi_text: (Raag Sarang)Yamuna Pulin Subhag Vrindavan,Naval Lal Shrigovardhan Dhari. [1]Naval Kunj Naval Van Kusumit,Naval Naval Vrishbhanu Dulari. [2]Naval Haas Naval Chhabi Kridat,Naval Hulaas Karat Sukhkari. [3]Naval Shri Viththalnath Kripabal,Nandadas Nirakhat Balihari. [4]- Shri Nanddas, Nanddas GranthwaliThe ever-fresh Yamuna bank of the beautiful Shri Vrindavan Dham is extremely enchanting, where the newly adorned Shyamasundar, the lifter of Govardhan, resides. [1]The groves too are ever-new, covered with forest blossoms, where the ever-youthful daughter of Vrishabhanu, Shri Radha, is gracefully seated. [2]The ever-fresh sights of their sweet laughter, loving teasing, and playful pastimes captivate the mind. The Divine Couple is immersed in nectar-filled love-plays, showering bliss in all directions. [3]Ever-fresh too is Shri Vitthalnath Ji seated there; and by his grace, Shri Nanddas Ji beholds the Divine Couple and, relishing this wondrous rasa, offers himself again and again in surrender. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kshan Bhangur Jeevan Ki Kalika - Braj Ke Sawaiya
hindi_text: Kshan Bhangur Jeevan Ki Kalika, Kal Prat Ko Jaane Khili Na Khili.Malayachal Ki Sheetal Aru Mand, Sugandh Sameer Chali Na Chali. [1]Kali Kaal Kuthaar Liye Phirta, Tan Namr Hai Chot Jhili Na Jhili. Le Le Harinaam Meri Rasana, Phir Ant Samay Ye Hili Na Hili. [2]- Braj Ke SawaiyaThe blossom of this fleeting life may or may not bloom tomorrow morning. The cool, fragrant breeze from the Himālaya may or may not be felt. [1]Kaliyug keeps its axe sharpened to strike down the human body. So let my tongue constantly chant the holy name of Hari, for this opportunity may not return. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dukh Taji Sukh Ki Chah Nahin - Shri Dayabai (a disciple of Shri Charan Das Ji of the Shuk sect.)
hindi_text: Dukh Taji Sukh Ki Chah Nahin, Nahin Vaikunth Vevan.Charan Kamal Chit Chahat Haun, Mohi Tumhari Aan.- Shri Dayabai (a disciple of Shri Charan Das Ji of the Shuk sect.)Dayabai says, “O Lord, I swear by You—let me be immersed in sorrow forever, I do not long for happiness, nor do I desire even Vaikuntha. I only wish that my mind may remain constantly and solely fixed on Your lotus feet.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pyaro Pyari Jhoole Kadam Ki Dariyan - Sri Purushottam Ji
hindi_text: Pyaro Pyari Jhoole Kadam Ki Dariyan.Ghanaj Garaje Damini Damke, Chahoon Dish Gop Kumariyan. [1]Gaur Shyam Mukhchand Paraspaar, Rahat Nihar Nihariyan.‘Purushottam’ Prabhuki Chhabi Nirakhat, Chhabi Par Balhaariyan. [2]- Sri Purushottam JiBoth beloveds, Sri Radha Krishna, swing together on the branches of the Kadamba trees. Thunder roars, lightning flashes in the sky, and all around, the young gopis gather in joy. [1]The fair and dark faces of the divine couple gaze at each other lovingly. The gopis, enchanted by their supreme beauty, offer themselves again and again upon that divine vision. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Gaurangi Gunanidhi Priya Sakal Kala Ki Khaan - Shri Kishori Ali, Radha Namavali (10)
hindi_text: Gaurangi Gunanidhi Priya, Sakal Kala Ki Khaan.Garbeeli Gaj Gamini, Vidyagaan Nidan.- Shri Kishori Ali, Radha Namavali (10)Fair-complexioned Shri Radha is the treasure of all divine virtues and the source of all arts. Her majestic gait resembles that of a proud, graceful elephant, and she is the very origin of all knowledge and divine music.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Raksha Kari Na Jeev Ki Diyo Na Aadar Daan - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (78)
hindi_text: Raksha Kari Na Jeev Ki, Diyo Na Aadar Daan. Narayan Ta Purush Son, Rookh Bhalo Phalvaan.- Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (78)One who neither respects nor shelters another living being is worse than a tree—for even a tree selflessly gives shade and bears fruit for others.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kavadhau Sevakunj Mein - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (56)
hindi_text: Kavadhau Sevakunj Mein, Hvaihon Shyamatamal.Latika Kargahi Viramihain, Lalit Ladaitilal.- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (56)When will I become a dark Tamal tree in the sacred Seva Kunj of Shri Vrindavan, so that the Divine Couple, Shri Shyama-Shyam, may rest while holding my tender vines during their love-filled leelas?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Kunjbihari Kau Jas Neeko - Shri Radha Prasad Dev Ju
hindi_text: Shri Kunjbihari Kau Jas Neeko,Jasu Naam Jag Bhakti Kalpataru, Sada Sukhad Sabhi Kau.Syama Syam Sneh Sachoti, Aur Jagat Sab Feeko.Shri Radha Prasad (Beg) Lejai Ab, Saran Ladili Ji Kau.- Shri Radha Prasad Dev JuThe glory of Shri Kunj Bihari is supremely enchanting. His name is like a wish-fulfilling tree of devotion in this world, always bestowing joy to all. [1]The divine love of Shyama-Shyam is the ultimate truth; everything else pales in comparison. Therefore, Shri Radha Prasad says, “Seek the shelter of Shri Radha’s lotus feet without delay.” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pran Diyai Yah Prem Na Paiyai - Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (98)
hindi_text: (Raag Kanharau)Pran Diyai Yah Prem Na Paiyai,Aisau Mahangau Ahi Sakhi Ree, Kahi Dhoon So Kaisai Kain Laiyai.Laal-Laadilee Kau Yah Sarvasu, Tihin Ras Kau Lalachaiyai.Adbhut Chhavi Vivi Ras Ki Dhara, ‘Dhruv’ Man Tahan Nhavaiyai.- Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (98)O dear friend! Even by offering one’s very life, this supreme love for Ladilī Lāl (Shri Radha-Krishna) is not attained. Such is the extraordinary and priceless nature of this divine love. So, O friend! You tell me—how can such love be obtained? [1]This selfless ‘Tatsukhmaya’ (giving happiness to the beloved) love is the highest treasure and the very source of life of Sri Radha Krishn themselves. In truth, there is no method or discipline by which it can be achieved—it is only through a deep longing (lolasā) for this divine rasa that one begins to qualify. Shri Dhruv Das ji says that a seeker, therefore, must develop detachment from all else and fully immerse the mind in the wondrous stream of rasa flowing from the divine form of the Divine Couple. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kain Tuv Kaan Pare Nahin Deenbandhu Mam Ter - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Kain Tuv Kaan Paree Nahin, Deenbandhu Mam Ter.Chaar Jugan Suni Chaar Bhuj, Lagi Na Etee Der.- Braj Ke DoheO friend of the destitute, O Shri Krishna! It seems my call has not reached Your ears—for in the four ages, you have never delayed in rescuing the fallen. Had you truly heard me, surely by now you would have delivered me, as always before. Perhaps the fault lies within me—I have not yet truly recognized myself as destitute, nor cried out to You from the depths of my heart.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Vipin Raj Maharaj Pranat Palan - Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri,  Shri Vrindavan Ju Ki Vinay Patrika (25)
hindi_text: Shri Vipin Raj Maharaj Pranat Palan Yah Naam Tiharau Hai.Jaan Ajaan Sharan Ko Jaise Balak Maatu Dulaarau Hai.Manvaan Chhit Phaladeya Sabhan Ko Kotik Surataru Waraau Hai.Prem Pravah Rasikjan Pyaare, Tinkau Praan Pyaarau Hai.Aleemadhuri Ke Jeevandhan Aadi Ant Rakhwaarau Hai.- Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Shri Vrindavan Ju Ki Vinay Patrika (25)O King of Forests, O supremely divine Shri Vrindavan Dham! You are known as “Pranatapal”—the Protector of the Surrendered. [1]Just like a mother embraces her child with unconditional love, whether the child understands it or not, You too shower grace upon all, whether they know you deeply or not. [2]You fulfill every desire of everyone and are more precious than millions of wish-fulfilling trees (Kalpatarus). [3]You are the source of life for the loving rasik devotees who are immersed in the stream of divine love (prema pravāha) because of you. [4]Shri Ali Madhuri Ji says: O sweet Vrindavan Dham! You are my entire life-wealth, and the only eternal protector, from beginning to end. [5]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Net Net Kahi Nigam Puni Jaahi Sakai Nahin Jaan - Shri Rasnidhi
hindi_text: Net Net Kahi Nigam Puni, Jaahi Sakai Nahin Jaan.Bhayo Manohar Aai Braj, Vahi So Hari Har Aan.- Shri RasnidhiThe Supreme Brahman, whom the Vedas describe with the words “neti neti,” beyond the reach, appeared in Braj as the all-attractive Lord Shri Krishna.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mulaprakrritirupam Tvam Bhajamah - Devi Bhagwat (9.50.50)
hindi_text: Mulaprakrritirupam Tvam Bhajamah Karunarnavam.Samsarasagaradasmanuddharamba Dayam Kuru.- Devi Bhagwat (9.50.50) [Sri Radha Namaskar Stotram (5)]I worship You, O fathomless ocean of compassion, Sri Radha, the very form of the primordial nature (Mūla Prakṛti). Please lift us out of this ocean of worldly existence—have mercy on us, O Mother!
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Banai Bane Tumhari Baat - Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
hindi_text: Banai Bane Tumhari Baat.Shri Vrishabhanu Ray Ki Beti Yah Yash Jag Vikhyat. [1]Bina Hukam Tumhare Bajrani Toote Na Taru Paat.Purusharth Jete Sab Jhoothe Karo Kou Dinraat. [2]Neek Nazar Karunakara Dekhat Dukhi Sukhi Hojat.Sarasamadhuri Seva Ko Sukh Vilse Bib Gun Gaat. [3]- Shri Saras MadhuriO Kishori Radhe! Only through Your grace can the misfortune of a soul be rectified. O daughter of Shri Vrishabhanu, this glory of Yours is renowned throughout the world. [1]O Queen of Vraja! Without your command, not even a single leaf from a tree can fall. No matter how much a person strives day and night, without your grace, all efforts remain fruitless. [2]With just one merciful glance from You, even the most fallen attain supreme bliss. Sarasa Madhuri sings Your divine glories and prays to relish the bliss of serving You. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Swami Haridas Ko Dharm Sumer Saman - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (317)
hindi_text: Shri Swami Haridas Ko, Dharma Sumer Samaan.Aur Dharma Sab Doongri, Yahi Baat Parmaan.- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (317)The supreme love-dharma of Swami Sri Haridas ji, the continuous and exclusive devotion to the eternal love-plays (nitya-vihara-rasa) of the Divine Couple (Sri Radha Krishn), stands like a Mount Sumeru. In comparison to this, all other various practices appear as insignificant as small hills.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jugulalaal Tori Paiyan Parata Haun - Shri Lalit Madhuri
hindi_text: (Raag Ghaton)Jugulalal Tori Paiyan Parata Haun Mo Tan Nek Niharau.Shreevanwas Daan Kin Deejai Chhinchhin Hot Khisaaro.Ausar Nahi Ausar Karanako Kalou Kaal Vistaaro.Lalitmadhuri Nitt Lahau Ras Charankamal Piy Pyaro.- Shri Lalit MadhuriO Divine Couple! I bow down at Your lotus feet—please cast just a little merciful glance upon me. Grant me the boon of residing in Shri Vrindavan Dham, for every moment wasted outside Vrindavan is a loss beyond measure. [1]There is no certainty of another opportunity as time is fleeting, and there is no reason to delay as the influence of Kali Yuga is growing stronger with each passing day.  Lalit Madhuri prays — “May I daily relish the divine nectar flowing from the lotus feet of my beloved Priya-Priyatam (divine couple).” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Koau Kaami Krodhi Kaho Kou Lobhi Kaho Naun  - Shri Hita Damodar Das, Nem Battisi (9)
hindi_text: Koau Kaami Krodhi Kahau, Koau Lobhii Kaho Naaun.Shri Vrindavan Chhaandi Kai, Ant Na Kit Hun Jaaun.- Shri Hita Damodar Das, Nem Battisi (9)Some may call me lustful, others wrathful, and some may label me greedy—let them say what they wish. But I shall never leave Shri Vrindavan, no matter how much anyone may criticize me.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Lage Jo Shree Ballabh Pad Rang - Goswami Shri Harirai Ji
hindi_text: (Raag Vihag)Lage Jo Shree Ballabh Pad Rang.Taakon Dushang Naik Nahi Vyapai, Aai Mile Satsang. [1]Shree Gobardhanadharan Dheer Ko, Dhyan Dharat Ang-Ang.‘Rasik’ Preetam Ki Baanik Upar, Baaron Koti Anang. [2]- Goswami Shri Harirai JiWhoever immerses themselves in the divine hue of Shri Vallabh’s (Lord Krishna or Shri Vallabhacharya) lotus feet remains untouched by bad association and naturally attains the company of saints. [1]He remains ever absorbed in meditating upon the beautiful limbs of Sri Giridhar Lal, the lifter of Govardhan. Goswami Shri Hariray Ji declares, “Even millions of Kamadevas pale before  the charm of Lord Krishna’s form.” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jo Man Arujhyo Roop Hain - Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Savant Singh Ji) Ji Ki Vani, Manorath Manjari (30)
hindi_text: Jo Man Arujhyo Roop Hain, Kyon Hoo Kath Banain Na.Rasna Kain To Man Nahi, Man Kain Rasna Hain Na.- Shri Nagridas Ji, Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Manorath Manjari (30)The state of mind, entangled in the divine beauty (form) of Shyama Shyam, cannot be expressed in words, for the tongue has no mind, and the mind has no tongue to express itself.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhajan Bin Hai Chola Bekam - Sri Roop Kunwari Ji
hindi_text: (Raag Peelu - Taal Titala)Bhajan Bin Hai Chola Bekam.Mal Aru Mutra Bharo Nar Sab Tan, Hai Nishfal Yah Cham. [1]Bin Hari Bhajan Pavitra Na Hwaihai, Dhovau Aathau Yam.Kaaya Chhod Hans Udi Jaihai, Pado Rahai Dhan Dham. [2]Apno Sut Mukh Loo Dhar Dehai, Soch Lehu Parinam.‘Roopkunwari’ Sab Chhod Basahu Braj, Bhajiye Shyama Shyam. [3]- Sri Roop Kunwari JiWithout devotion to God, this body is useless — it is merely filled with filth like excrement and urine, and without bhajan (devotional worship), this fleshly form becomes completely fruitless. [1]Without Hari’s bhajan, no one can become truly pure, even if they cleanse themselves eight times a day.Ultimately, like a swan departing its lake, the soul will flee, leaving behind all wealth and kin. [2]One’s very own son will light the funeral pyre—ponder deeply over this truth. Sri Rupkunwari says: True fulfillment lies in abandoning everything, dwelling in Braj, and lovingly worshiping Shri Shyama-Shyam! [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Prem Diwane Jo Bhaye Jati Baran Gayi Chhuta - Sri Sahjobai
hindi_text: Prem Diwane Jo Bhaye, Jati Baran Gayi Chhoot.Sahjo Jag Baura Kahe, Log Gaye Sab Phoot.- Sri SahjobaiThose intoxicated with the divine love of God no longer recognize distinctions of caste, status, or high and low. Sahjobai says—the world may call them mad, but they have transcended the boundaries of society and scripture.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aaj Kaal Kalp Jo Pai Baraah Barat Rahyo - Shri Chhabile Vallabh Goswami
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Aaj Kaal Kalp Jo Pai Baaraah Barat Rahyo,Jaake Or Chor Aadi Hi Son Je Paran Hain. [1]Jaa Hi Kaaranai Jaako Naam Akhatij Paryo,Aksh Hot Tushy Savai Ya Son Karan Hain. [2]Aaj Din Jhaanki Jo Nihaare Shri Bihari Ju Ki,Aap Hi Yamraaj Taaki Let Ye Sharan Hain. [3]Sevai Haridaas Roop Raashi Mein ‘Chhabeelay’ Ramy,Bhakt Man Bhaavate Bihari Ke Charan Hain. [4]- Shri Chhabile Vallabh GoswamiToday, on Akshaya Tritiya, unfolds a Kalpa‑worthy day whose fruit endures through eternity, whose beginning and end are connected to the eternal. [1]This is why it is called ‘Akhatīja’ — for all auspicious deeds performed today become inexhaustible and yield eternal blessings. [2]Whoever beholds the divine form (Jhānki) of Śrī Bihārījī today — even Yamarāj (the god of death), who seeks His lotus feet, does them no harm. [3]The lotus feet of Bihārījī, an ocean of nectarean beauty, lovingly served by Svāmī Haridās, forever delight the hearts of rasik devotees, says Śrī Chhabīle Vallabh Goswāmījī. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Lakh Ang Hari Bhakti Ke Chausath Maha Prakas -  Shri Priyadas Ji, Rasik Mohini (4)
hindi_text: Lakh Ang Hari Bhakti Ke, Chausath Maha Prakas.Tahu Mein Puni Paach Kahi, Kahyo Ek Vanvaas.- Shri Priyadas Ji, Rasik Mohini (4)Among the hundred thousand aspects of devotion to Shri Hari, the rasik saints have specially emphasized sixty-four as most significant. Among these, five are especially glorified — and above all, one is supreme: residing in the forest of Vrindavan.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jinke Deh Neh Ras Bhine - Shri Hita Roop Lal
hindi_text: Jinke Deh Neh Ras Bheene,Tinke Nayan Prem Madmaate, Naate Jag Ke Neku Na Cheene. [1]Ved Bhed Taji Nem Shrinkhala, Vihansi Bhaye Priyatam Soun Leene.Jai Shri Roopalal Hit Gati Mati Nyaari, Kahi Na Jaat Jaise Jal Meene. [2]- Shri Hita Roop LalThose rare, most fortunate souls who are drenched in the nectar of divine love (prema-rasa) of God, their eyes remain intoxicated with love. Under the influence of that divine love, they lose all awareness of worldly relationships. [1]They joyfully cast off the shackles of Vedas, scriptures, and social conventions, absorbed entirely in loving devotion. Shri Hit Rupalal Ji says: such rasika lovers attain a state of consciousness so unique and unfathomable that words fail to capture it. Their union with the beloved Lord is like that of a fish with water—inseparable. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Praan Ik Dvai Khinhe Bhakti-Preeti-Prakaas - Shri Surdas, Sura Sagara
hindi_text: Praan Ik Dvai Khinhe, Bhakti-Preeti-Prakaas!Soor Swaami Swaamini Mili, Karat Rang-Vilaas.- Shri Surdas, Sura SagaraTheir soul is one, but they have assumed two forms only to spread and illuminate devotion and love. Sri Surdas says, “My beloved divine couple, Shri Radha Krishna, remain ever united and shower the nectar of divine love-plays (nitya vihār rasa).”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Chhabili Radhe Kab Darasan Daiho - Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Braj Nidhi Pad Sangrah (25)
hindi_text: (Raag Dhanashri)Chhabeeli Radhe Kab Darasan Daihau.Tuv-Mukh-Chand-Chakori Ankhiyani, Roop-Sudha Achvaihau. [1]Yah Aasa Laagi Rahai Nis-Din, Kab Man Tapat Bujhaihau.Karikai Kripa Kahau “Brajanidhi” Ko, Kab Apanau Kari Laihau. [2]- Shri Braj Nidhi Ji, Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Braj Nidhi Pad Sangrah (25)O Charming Radha, when will you grant me Your darshan? Like the chakori bird thirsting for the moon, my eyes long for the nectar of Your form. [1]Only the hope of beholding You sustains me day and night—when will the burning in my heart be soothed? Sri Braj Nidhi says, “When will You bless me by accepting me as Your own? Please answer, O treasure of Braj, Sri Radhey!” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jugalvar Jaanat Ho Sab Baat - Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (100)
hindi_text: (Raag Todi)Jugalvar Jaanat Ho Sab Baat.Vrindaavan Mein Vaas Dehum Mohe, Aur Kachu Nahin Bhat. [1]Braj Raj Mein Lotun Nit Prati Main, Ab To Yahi Suhaat.Naam Ratun Tumaro Nishi Baasar, Yahi Sadaa Man Aat. [2]Darshan Kar Tumare Daasan Ke, Hiy Aanand Sarasaat.‘Roopmaadhuri’ Kripa Karo Ab, Ye Din Beete Jaat. [3]- Shri Roop Madhuri, Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (100)O Divine Couple, You know everything. Please grant me residence in Vrindavan, for nothing else pleases my heart. [1]There, I shall roll in the dust of Braj each day—this alone brings me joy. I will chant Your names day and night; this is the constant desire of my heart. [2]I shall behold the darshan of Your devotees, which will fill my heart with bliss. Roopmadhuri says, “Please shower Your mercy, for the precious days of my life are slipping away without Vrindavan.” [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pritam Mera Ek Tu Sundar Aur Na Koi - Shri Sundar Ji
hindi_text: Preetam Mera Ek Tu, ‘Sundar’ Aur Na Koi.Gupt Bhaya Kis Kaaraaj, Kaahi Na Pargat Hoi.- Shri Sundar JiO, my dearest Lord! You alone are my beloved. For what reason are you hidden from me? Why do you not now reveal Yourself and grant me Your vision?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jab Jab Murli Kaanh Bajavat - Shri Surdas, Sura Sagara
hindi_text: Jab Jab Murli Kaanh Bajaavat,Tab-Tab Radha Naam Uchaaraat, Baarambaar Rijhaavat. [1]Tum Ramani Vah Raman Tumhaare, Vaisehin Mohin Janaavat.Murli Bhai Sauti Jo Maai, Teri Tahal Karaavat. [2]Vah Daasi Tum Hari-Ardhangini, Yah Merai Man Aavat.Soor Pragat Tahi Soun Kahi-Kahi, Tumkau Shyaam Bulaavat. [3]- Shri Surdas, Sura SagaraSaint Surdas, adopting the mood of a sakhī (female companion), speaks to Shri Radha:Whenever Shri Krishna plays His flute, again and again He utters the name “Radha,” trying to please You. [1]You, Radha, are the beloved, and He is your devoted lover. He always conveys to me that He belongs entirely to you. The flute has become like your co-wife, yet she only serves you. [2]A thought arises in my mind — the flute is Your maidservant, and You are Hari’s ardhāṃgini (the very half of Hari’s being). Surdas says, “Again and again, O Radhe! Shyamasundar is calling out to you through that flute.” [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jai Jai Jai Nandju Ke Nandan - Braj Ke Kavitt
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Jai Jai Jai Nandju Ke Nandan Naval Laal,Jai Jai Jai Shri Radheju Bhaanu Ki Dulaari Ki. [1]Jai Jai Jasodaju Ke Baare Brajchandju Ki,Jai Jai Hamaari Pyaari Keerti Kumari Ki. [2]Gokul Jubaraaj Gokules-Kulsekhar Ki,Shrivan Ki Rani Radhe Barsaanewari Ki. [3]Gopijan Vallabh Govind Shri Shyama-Shyaam,Bolo Sab Mili Radha Vallabh Bihari Ki. [4]- Braj Ke Kavitt Glory, glory to the ever‑youthful son of Nanda Mahārāj!Glory, glory to Śrī Rādhā, the beloved daughter of King Vṛṣabhānu. [1]Glory to the darling son of Yashodā, the moon of Braj,Glory to our beloved Pyārījū, the charming daughter of Kīrtijī. [2]Glory to the prince of Gokul, the Lord of Gokul, the crown jewel of His dynasty — Śrī Kṛṣṇa!Glory to Rādhā, the queen of Vṛndāvan and the darling of Barsaṇā. [3]Glory to the beloved of the cowherds, Govinda,Glory to Śrī Śyāma‑Śyām! Let us all proclaim victory to the divine couple, Śrī Rādhā Vallabh Bihārī! [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ek Akhandit Ekras Niravadhi Rati Jo Hoi - Shri Rasik Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (4)
hindi_text: Ek Akhandit Ekras, Niravadhi Rati Jo Hoi.Milat Milat Virah Na Ghatai, Prem Kahat Hain Soi.- Shri Rasik Dev, Shri Rasik Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (4)That love which is uninterrupted, unwavering, and endless, where even in union, the longing does not diminish but continually increases, that alone is called pure love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Rahay Ang Sang Anang Harain Manu - Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Ras Ke Sewaiya (30)
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Rahay Ang Sang Anang Harain Manu Neerad Neel Daamini Damkain. [1]Barni Na Parai Chhavi Kou Kavi Tai Sat Sesh Mahesh Ki Buddhi Samkain. [2]Shri Bihaari-Biharini Daasi Nikunjan Nirkhat Hi Sukh Prem Ramkain. [3]Chitai Var Raaj Biharini Nitt Adbhut Jyoti Chibuk Chamakain. [4]- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Ras Ke Sewaiya (30)They remain constantly together, their beauty stealing the heart of Kāmadeva (Cupid). Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s form is like a fresh raincloud, while Śrī Rādhā shines like a brilliant lightning streak. [1]No poet or sage, not even those blessed with the highest intellect—like Śeṣanāga with his hundred mouths or Maheśa (Lord Śiva)—can fully describe their enchanting beauty. [2]Śrī Bihārin Dās, the servant of Bihārī-Bihāriṇī, revels in divine love-bliss, beholding Their love-plays in the ever-fresh bowers (nikunjas). [3]Vihāriṇī Rānī, Śrī Rādhā, reigns forever over my heart, whose divine radiance shines most wondrously. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrindaban Raajain Duvau Saajai Sukh Ke Saaj - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Vrindaban Raajain Duvau, Saajai Sukh Ke Saaj.Maharani Radha Utai, Maharaj Brajraj.- Braj Ke DoheIn Vrindavan, divine arrangements for bliss are beautifully adorned, where the ever youthful divine couple shines in full splendor. On one side, Lord Shri Krishna is enthroned; on the other, the Queen of Vrindavan, Shri Radhika, adorns the scene with her matchless radiance.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ras Jas Suni Shri Vipin Ke -  Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.71)
hindi_text: Ras Jas Suni Shri Vipin Ke, Gun Gan Karo Su Gaan.Loto Raj Mein Magan Hvai, Ihi Sam Sukh Nahi Aan. - Shri Ananya Ali, Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.71)Hearing the divine glories and virtues of the nectar of Vrindavan, joyfully sing its praises. Immerse and roil in the sacred dust of Vrindavan, for there is no other rasa greater bliss than this.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Radha Ko Vrindavan Rasamay - Shri Hita Vrindavan Das
hindi_text: (Shri) Radha Ko Vrindavan Rasamay, Mohan Ko Pyaro Lagai Ati Hai. [1]Paind Ek Kari Tajat Na Seenwa, Pritam Ki Aisi Bhai Gati Hai. [2]Yaaten Gahyo Ananyani Dhrid Kari, Man Kram Bach Badi Nirmal Rati Hai. [3]‘Vrindavan Hit’ Roop Dham Yah Jahan Badhati Dampati Sampati Hai. [4]- Chacha Hita Vrindavan DasShri Radha’s Vrindavan is filled with supremely divine nectar and is exceedingly dear to the enchanter, Shri Krishna. [1]So deep is Shri Krishna’s love towards Vrindavan that He does not place even a single step beyond its boundaries. [2]For this reason, the rasik devotees maintain an unwavering commitment to Vrindavan with their mind, actions, and speech. Their pure love continues to increase day by day. [3]Chacha Vrindavan Das says, This Vrindavan is the abode of pure love, where, simply by residing without offense, the divine wealth of the divine couple (Shri Radha-Krishna) keeps expanding endlessly. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Brajban Leela Maadhuri - Shri Anandghan Ji, Ghananand Granthawali, Anubhav Chandrika (54)
hindi_text: Brajban-Leela-Maadhuri, Niravidhi Ras Kau Saar.Rasik-Mukutmani Kripa Ten, Paayau Prem-Aadhaar.- Shri Anandghan Ji, Shri Ghanananda Granthavali, Anubhav Chandrika (54)The sweetness of leelas within the forests of Braj is the very source of endless rasa. By the grace of the crown jewel of Rasikas (Radha-Krishna), I have attained the essence of divine love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pyari Ladili Padaravind Nain - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (93)
hindi_text: (Doha)Bhramat Rahat Nisidin Chhina, Chhake Adhik Ras Neh.Pyari Tuv Pad Kanj Par, Mo Drig Madhukar Eah.(Pad)Pyari Ladilee Padaravind Nain Madhukar Mere.Bhramat Rahat Nisidina Chhaki Chhinchhina Adhikere. [1]Koti Jatan Karahu Kou Phirat Naahi Phere.Shriharipriya Sahaj Subhaav Gahi Rahe Anere. [2]- Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (93)(Doha)Shri Krishna says, “O Radhe! My eyes, like enchanted bees, are so intoxicated by the nectar of love at Your lotus feet that they hover around them without pause, day and night.”(Pada)O beloved Ladiliju! Even though my eyes, like bees, remain drenched in the sweet love of Your lotus feet, still they continue to circle them ceaselessly, day and night. Their restlessness increases with every passing moment. [1]No matter how hard one tries to restrain them, they do not stop. O Haripriya Sakhi! Not only do they draw near, but even from afar, my eye-like bumblebees remain firmly fixed upon the lotus feet of my dearest Priyaju (Sri Radha). [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Houn Rusongi Kunwari Son Kunwari Manave Mohi - Shri Vanshi Ali, Hriday Sarvasv (39)
hindi_text: Houn Rusongi Kunwari Son, Kunwari Manavai Mohi.Kunwari Jo Mo Saun Rusi Hai, Hon Paayini Paron Nihohi.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Hriday Sarvasv (39)If ever I sulk in love with ever-youthful Shri Radha, She is the one who sweetly consoles me. But if She ever turns away in sulking love, I would fall at Her lotus feet, doing all I can to pacify and bring back Her smile.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: E Dou Rajata Ramga Bhare Ri - Shri Albeli Ali, Samay Prabandh (166)
hindi_text: (Raga Purabi)E Dou Rajata Ramga Bhare Ri. Bhuja Jorem Samvala Tana Gorem, Gahi Druma Dari Khare Ri. [1] Pulakata Amga Anamga Chake Chavi, Batana Ranga Dhere Ri. Pana Bhare Mukha Sukha Sarasane, Arujhane Drriga Pala Visare Ri. [2] Navala Chaila Chitavata Pritama Tana, Hansi Hansi Prana Hare Ri. Alabeli Ali Rupa Taramgani, Naina Mina Pare Ri. [3]- Shri Albeli Ali, Samay Prabandh (166)The duo, fair-complexioned Shri Radha and dark-complexioned Shri Krishna, stand resplendent in hues of divine love, with arms around each other’s necks, holding onto a tree branch. [1]Their bodies are thrilled, completely intoxicated in divine love’s ecstasy; every word exchanged between them is drenched in the colors of love. Their mouths, filled with red betel leaves, overflow with sweetness; their eyes remain lovingly fixed on one another, forgetting even to blink. [2]The ever-fresh and most charming Shri Radha gazes at her beloved, and with enchanting smiles, steals away His very life-breath. Albeli Aliji is swaying in the waves of beauty showered by the divine couple, her eyes caught like a fish in their divine glances. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mo Nirdhan Ki Lalita Sampati - Shri Vanshi Ali, Siddhant Ke Pad (34)
hindi_text: Mo Nirdhan Ki Lalita Sampati.Chhin Na Sakat Bisraay Jeey Te, Mohi Lataki Laagat Pal Jhampati. [1]Jaay Nirkhi Pyari Gad-Gad Hwai, Ank Lagani Pulakit Tan Kampati.Jai Shri Vanshi Ali Shri Radha Bali Nit Prati Chaahat Nit Charanan Ko Champati. [2]- Shri Vanshi Ali, Siddhant Ke Pad (34)Lalita Sakhi is the sole treasure of this destitute soul (me). My heart cannot forget Her even for a moment, for it remains bound to Her, swaying with Her every moment. [1]Whenever Lalitaji beholds Pyariju (Sri Radha), waves of ecstasy arise within Her, and when Radha embraces Her, Her limbs tremble with divine love-bliss. Shri Vanshi Ali says, “Lalita Ji endlessly sacrifices Herself for Sri Radha, ever yearning to serve Her lotus feet lovingly.” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Tan Vrindavan Vas Kar - Shri Ramray, Geet Govind Braj Bhasha, Doha (84)
hindi_text: Tan Vrindavan Vaas Kar, Dhan Vrindavan Vaas.Man Vrindavan Leen Kar, Vrindavan Rasraas.- Shri Ramray, Geet Govind Braj Bhasha, Doha (84)One must physically reside in Vrindavan, for residing in Vrindavan is the most priceless treasure of this life. The mind, too, must dwell in Vrindavan, constantly contemplating the rasa-filled pastimes of the divine couple, Shri Radha Krishna, that occur in this sacred land.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kanchan Ki Yah Bhoomi Hai - Shri Charandas, Bhakti Sagar
hindi_text: Kanchan Ki Yah Bhoomi Hai, Dhare Satogun Bekh.Charandas Bali Bali Gayau, Divyadrishti Kardekh.- Shri Charandas, Bhakti SagarThis land of Shri Dham Vrindavan shines like gold, adorned with the jewel of pure goodness. Shri Charandas offers himself in full surrender, for it can be seen only through the divine eyes.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sada Sakhi Sun Vraj Hi Mein Rahno - Shri Dwarkesh Ji
hindi_text: (Raag Vihag)Sada Sakhi Sun Vraj Hi Mein Rahno.Man Ki Vyatha Kunjkunjan Mein, Lata Pataa Prati Kahnno. [1]Oran Son Kahaa Kaaj Hamen Ab, Aan Pare So Sahnno.Yugal Kishor Keli Ras Sangam, Smaran Karat Man Dahnno. [2]Rasikan Sang Hilmil Priya Sajani, Kachhukh Goodh Ras Gahnno.‘Dwarkesh’ Antar Ras Sangam, Ubhay Udadhi Mein Bahanno. [3]- Shri Dwarkesh JiListen, O friend, let us always dwell in Vraj alone. There, I will express the pain of my heart to each vine and leaf within the forest bowers. [1]I have no concern with others now—whatever comes, I will quietly endure. As I remember the divine love-play of the youthful couple, my heart yearns with longing. [2]In the company of rasik devotees, I will grasp some very hidden rasa there. Sri Dwarkesh says, let us flow in the internal union of divine rasa in the ocean of both (Radha and Krishna). [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ab Rahihaun Brajbhumi Ki Hvai Pagmarag Dhuri -  Nanddas Granthwali, Bhanwar Geet (66.2)
hindi_text: Ab Rahihaun Brajbhoomi Ki, Hvai Pagmarag Dhuri.Vicharat Pad Mopai Parai, Sab Sukh Jeevan Muri.- Shri Nanddas, Nanddas Granthwali, Bhanwar Geet (66.2)The self-realized Uddhava says—“O Lord! My only wish now is to forever reside in Braj, becoming one with the dust of this sacred land, so that when the maidens of Braj, the pinnacle of divine love, wander through these sacred paths, may the dust of their feet fall upon me. In that moment, I shall feel truly fulfilled. This alone is the supreme purpose of my life.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Maai Moko Jugalnaam Nidhi Bhaai - Shri Yugal Priya
hindi_text: (Raag Ramkali, Taal Titāla)Maai Moko Jugalnaam Nidhi Bhaai.Sukh-Sampada Jagat Ki Jhoothi, Aai Sang Na Jaai. [1]Lobhi Ko Dhan Kaam Na Aavai, Antakaal Dukhdaai.Jo Jorai Dhan Adham Karam Ten, Sarbas Chhalai Nasāi. [2]Kul Ke Dharam Kahaa Lai Keejai, Bhakti Na Man Mein Aai.‘Jugalpriya’ Sab Tajau Bhajau Hari, Charan Kamal Man Laai. [3]- Shri Yugal PriyaO friend! My heart has found its true treasure in the divine names of the Divine Couple. All the pleasures and riches of this world are false—they do not accompany the soul at the time of death. [1]Even a miser’s wealth cannot help him; instead, it becomes a source of suffering in the end. Wealth earned through impure means ultimately leads to the ruin of the future. [2]What is the value of social position, family reputation, or religious practices if love for the Lord does not grow? Shri Yugal Priya says: The true purpose of life lies in surrendering the mind at the lotus feet of Shri Hari through pure, selfless devotion. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kouka Anga Bibhuti Lagavata - Shri Sundar Ji
hindi_text: (Savaiya)Kouka Amga Bibhuti Lagavata, Kouka Hota Nirata Digambara. [1]Kouka Sveta Kashaika Audhata, Kouka Katha Ramgai Bahu Ambara. [2]Kouka Balkala Shisha Jata Nakha, Kouka Audhata Haim Ju Baghambara. [3]Sundara Eka Aj~nana Gaye Binu, Ye Saba Disata Ahi Adambara. [4]- Shri Sundardas JiSome smear ashes on their bodies, some go completely naked as digambaras. [1]Some wear white ascetic robes, some dye garments made of wood fiber in various colors. [2]Some keep matted hair atop their heads, wear bark garments, and grow long nails. Some dress in tiger skins to appear fierce and detached. [3]Sundar Jī says—without true knowledge of the Supreme and sincere devotion in the heart, all these outward practices are nothing but pretense and show. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sab Lokan Kau Mukutmani Barsanau Kamaniy - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Sab Lokan Kau Mukutmani, Barsanau Kamaniy.Radha Pad Ankit Bhai, Jahaan Lalit Avaniy.- Braj Ke DoheBarsana, the most charming abode, stands as the crown jewel among all the worlds, for its sacred land is touched by the lotus feet of Shri Radha Maharani and bears Her divine footprints.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Piya Piyari Seja Banai Aaj -  Shri Lalitmohini Dev, Ras Ke Pad (47)
hindi_text: Piya Piyari Seja Banai Aaj.Piyari Jhalaka, Chamaka Saba Piyare, Piyare Basana Bane Saba Kaja. [1] Piyare Phula Bane Saba Tana Mem, Piyari Sobha Sahaja Samaja. Shrilalitamohini Yaha Sukha Dekhata, Syama Tanaim Piyare Saba Saja. [2]- Shri Lalit Mohini Dev, Lalit Mohini Dev Ju Ki Vaani, Ras Ke Pad (47)Today, the Beloved has decorated a yellow bed; everything around glows with golden-yellow brilliance. He has also adorned His body with yellow garments. [1]His entire form is decorated with yellow-colored flowers made of sandalwood, saffron, and other fragrant substances. Gazing upon each limb of Shri Shyamasundar, adorned with the golden radiance of Shri Radha, whose natural hue is golden-yellow, is my soul’s greatest bliss, says Lalitmohini. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Harivansh Sarana Je Aye - Sri Neh Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant (136)
hindi_text: (Raga Gauri)Shri Harivansha Sarana Je Aye. Shri Vrishabhanukumari Namdanandana, Nijakara Apani Chitthi Chadhaaye. [1]Diye Mukaraya Kachu Nahi Goyau, Kiye Manoratha Mana Ke Bhaye. Shrivyasa Suvana Charanana Raja Parasata, ‘Nagaridasa’ Se Ranka Jivaye. [2]- Shri Neh Nagridas, Sri Neh Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant (136)Whoever sought the shelter of Shri Harivansh Mahaprabhu Ji, their name was personally written by the Divine Couple, Shri Radha-Krishna, in the register of their own devotees. [1]They unveiled every divine secret to him, concealing nothing, and fulfilling their every desire. Shri Nagaridas Ji says, “Even a fallen soul like me was revived with new life. I bow and place the dust of Vyasji's son Shri Harivansh Mahaprabhu Ji’s lotus feet upon my head.” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Biharidas Man Son Kahai - Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (265)
hindi_text: Shri Biharidas Man Soun Kahai, Ab Na Lagaun Tohi.Jas Gaaun Haridas Kau, Tain Sukh Deenon Mohi.- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (265)Shri Biharindev instructs his mind—“Now, completely isolate yourself from all directions and firmly fix yourself in the rasa-glory of Swami Shri Haridas, for the bliss found in the uninterrupted, eternal Akhand Nitya-Vihar rasa of the Divine Couple (Shri Shyama Kunjbihari) is not found anywhere else.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Deh Dhare Ko Ab Phal Paayo - Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh) Ki Vani, Chootak Pad (121)
hindi_text: Deh Dhare Ko Ab Phal Paayo.Beete Bahut Divas Asamajhas, Maya Naach Nachaayo.Thoharban Tai Mohi Kaadhi Thir, Vrindaavipun Basaayo.Kaun Kripa Anayaas Bhaee Haun, Nij Man Heri Hiraayo.Nisadin Pahar Ghari Chin Chin Pal, Nit Anand Rahai Sarasayo.Nagaridas Daas Hvai Kai Jo, Yahaan Na Aayo So Pachhitaayo.- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Chootak Pad (121)At last, the true purpose of this human life has been fulfilled. For so long, Maya led me astray, making me dance helplessly to her illusion. [1]But by the causeless grace of the Lord, I was rescued from that barren forest of worldly existence and brought to rest in the divine land of Sri Dham Vrindavan. What sudden mercy has descended! As I look within, my heart is filled with wonder. [2]Day and night, every moment overflows with an unending stream of bliss. Shri Nagari Das warns: Whoever is a servant of the Lord, yet fails to take shelter in Vrindavan, will one day weep with regret. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vyas Radhika Ravan Binu - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (31)
hindi_text: Vyas Radhika-Ravan Binu, Kahun Na Paayau Sukh.Daarani-Daarani Main Phiryau, Paatani-Paatani Dukh.- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (31)Without my divine couple, Sri Radhika Raman, who are the source of all, says Hariram Vyas, I have found no joy anywhere. Wandering from branch to branch, I have become entangled, and every leaf brings nothing but sorrow.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Radha Pati Gati Ek Tum Mokao Aur Na Thaun - Shri Vrindavan Das Chacha Ji, Vivek Lakshan Beli (107)
hindi_text: Radha Pati Gati Ek Tum, Mokaun Aur Na Thaun.‘Vrindaavan Hit’ Raavari, Tahal Dehu Bali Jaun.- Shri Vrindavan Das Chacha Ji, Vivek Lakshan Beli (107)O beloved of Radha (Shri Krishna)! You are my one and only refuge—there is no other shelter for me. Shri Hit Vrindavan Das says: “I sacrifice myself to You, kindly bestow upon me the fortune of serving in the ever-new groves (nikunjas) of Your sacred Shri Vrindavan Dham.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pankaj Vishdhar Meen Mrig - Shri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Maan Leela Dohavali (94)
hindi_text: Pankaj Vishdhar Meen Mrig, Sar Khanjan Baadaam.Pyaari Tere Drigan Ke, Yah Bin Daam Gulaam.- Shri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Maan Leela Dohavali (94)O Pyari Ju (Shri Radha)! The lotus, serpent, fish, deer, arrow, wagtail bird, and even almonds—all have become sold servants to Your eyes without any price, for the enchanting beauty of Your eyes leaves their charms meaningless.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hari Ji Baanh Gaho Ab Meri - Shri Guru Chhauna Ji Maharaj
hindi_text: Hari Ji Baanh Gaho Ab Meri, Bhav Saagar Son Kaadho.Ya Jag Mein Koi Hitoo Na Mera, Phand Paryau Hai Gaadho. [1]Paancho Chor Base Ghat Bheetar, Mamat Daari Faansi.‘Guruchhauna’ Ko Apna Karkai, Raakho Charann Paasi. [2]- Shri Guruchauna Ji Maharaj, Vinah Ki MaanjhHari Ji, please now take hold of my arm and lift me out of this ocean of material existence.In this world, I have no true well-wisher, instead, I am trapped in a web of worldly entanglements. [1]The five thieves (lust, anger, greed, attachment, and ego) have taken residence within my heart, and attachment has placed a noose around my neck.Please accept me as your own, O Lord Krishn, and keep me near your lotus feet (i.e., Sri Vrindavan) — this is the humble plea of your servant, Sri Guruchhauna. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aay Sakat Nahin Gira Mein Sampradaay Mam Reet - Shri Charan Das
hindi_text: Aay Sakat Nahin Gira Mein, Sampradaay Mam Reet.Prem Sampradaay Naam Hai, Kathyo Kachhuk Lakhai Preet.- Shri Charan DasThe nature of my tradition cannot be described through mere words. It is called the Path of Love (Prem Sampraday), and even a slight experience or expression of it is possible only through love itself.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Moson Nahin Kachhuk Baniaayi - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (73)
hindi_text: (Raag Malkaus)Moson Nahin Kachhuk Baniaayi.Hon Sadaiv Augunki Bhaajan, Kooti Kooti Kari Bhari Burayi. [1]Haha Kripakaraun Swamini Ab, Tuv Padapankaj Mein Shir Nayi.Lalitkishori Braj Darasavo, Dekho Nijagun Maana Badhayi. [2]- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (73)O Shri Radha! Nothing I do ever turns out right. I have always been full of faults — wickedness is deeply rooted within me. [1]O Swamini! Alas, please have mercy on me now—I bow my head at Your lotus feet. Shri Lalit Kishori humbly prays — “O supremely compassionate Kishori Ji! Please glance upon your causeless merciful nature, and bless this destitute soul with the darshan of your holy land of Braj.” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Va Mukh Dekhan Ko Kaho - Shri Madhuri Das, Utkantha Madhuri (24)
hindi_text: Va Mukh Dekhan Ko Kaho, Keeje Kaun Upaay. Kaha Karaun Kaason Kahon, Pari Kathin Ati Aay.- Shri Madhuri Das, Utkantha Madhuri (24)What means shall I adopt so that I may behold the lotus faces of the Divine Couple, Shri Shyama-Shyam? What shall I do? Whom shall I turn to? This pain has now become utterly unbearable.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrindavan Kyon Na Bhaye Ham Mor - Shri Parmanand Das, Parmanand Sagar (1375)
hindi_text: (Raag Malar)Vrindaavan Kyon Na Bhaye Ham Mor,Karat Nivaas Govardhan Upar, Nirakhat Nandkishor. [1]Kyon Na Bhaye Bansi Kul Sajani, Adhar Peebat Ghan Ghor.Kyon Na Bhaye Gunja Banaveli, Rahat Shyaam Ju Ki Or. [2]Kyon Na Bhaye Makaraakrit Kundal, Shyaam Shravan Jhakhajhor.Parmaanand Daas Ko Thaakur, Gopin Ke Chittachor. [3]- Shri Parmanand Das, Parmanand Sagar (1375)O creator! Why was I not born as a peacock in Vrindavan?There, I would dwell atop Govardhan, forever gazing at the enchanting son of Nanda, Shri Krishna. [1]O Sakhi, why was I not born as a flute resting upon Krishna’s lips, tasting His divine nectar? Why not a vine of wild gunja berries, always twining close to Shyam’s form? [2]Why not a makara-kundal (crocodile-shaped earring), adorning and gently swaying in Shri Shyamsundar’s ears?Says Paramananda Das—my beloved Thakur is none other than the thief of the gopis’ hearts, Lord Shri Krishna. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Gyan Karam Ru Upasana Sab Ahamiti Ko Mool - Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (12)
hindi_text: Gyan Karam Ru Upasana, Sab Ahamiti Ko Mool.Dridh Nischay Nahin Hot Bin, Kiye Prem Anukool.- Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (12)Knowledge, actions, and even devotional practices — all of these are rooted in ego. Unshakable faith in the Lord awakens only when one aligns oneself fully with the path of love (prema marga).
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Radha Pad Pankaj Gahe Chhut Jaat Jag Dvand - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Shri Radha Pad Pankaj Gahe, Chhoot Jaat Jag-Dwand.Shri Radha Naam Adhaar Te, Vinashat Hain Yam-Phand.- Braj Ke DoheWhoever firmly holds the lotus feet of Shri Radha is released from all worldly sorrows and conflicts. One who performs bhajan of Shri Radha’s name destroys even the noose of Yamaraj (the god of death) and is taken directly to Her eternal abode.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jay Gahavar Kunj Nikunjan Ki - Braj Ke Sawaiya
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Jay Gahavar Kunj Nikunjan Ki,Ras Prem Prakashini Shyama Ki Jay Jay. [1]Jay Daan Aur Maan Vilas Gadhi,Gahavar Van Rasik Samaj Ki Jay Jay. [2] Rasikeshvar Jahan Sakhi Bhesh Dharain,Un Mor Biharini Shyama Ki Jay Jay. [3]Ras Prem Ki Moorati Gopi Basen,Shridham Sadan Barsane Ki Jay Jay. [4]- Braj Ke SawaiyaGlory to the kuñjas and nikunjas of Gahvara vana in Barsanā, Glory to Śrī Rādhā, the illuminator of divine rasa and prema. [1]Glory to Dāṅgarh, Māṅgarh, and Vilāsgarh. Glory to the blissful gathering of rasikas in the Gahvara forest. [2]Glory to Mor Kuṭī, where Rasikeśvara Śrī Kṛṣṇa assumes the form of a sakhi (female companion), to please Mor Bihāriṇī Śrī Śyāmā Jū. [3]Where dwell the gopīs, embodiments of divine love and rasa—Endless glory to the sacred land of Barsānā. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhoole Tain Kartaar Ke Raag Na Aavai Raas - Shri Rasnidhi
hindi_text: Bhoole Tain Kartaar Ke, Raag Na Aavai Raas.Yahi Samujh Kai Raakh Tu, Man Kartaarain Paas.- Shri RasnidhiIf a singer forgets the khartal, the rhythm of the raga collapses. Similarly, if the mind is disconnected from God and only the senses are engaged, bhakti loses its essence, and spiritual rasa cannot arise.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jamuna Tat Syam Ghatani Ki Paanti - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (28)
hindi_text: (Raag Malar)Jamuna Tat Syam Ghatani Ki Paanti.Harit Bhoomi Ban, Harit Sikhandi, Bolat Ati Ras Maanti. [1]Surang Choonari Ki Chhavi Dulahin, Abharan Nana Bhanti.Shribithalvipul Binod Bihari Son, Mili Vilasati Kilkaanti. [2] - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (28)Describing the charm of the monsoon season, Shrivipulbiharinidasi Ji says that dark rainclouds beautifully adorn the skies along the banks of Shri Yamuna Ji. The land and forest of Vrindavan have turned lush green, and peacocks sing joyfully, intoxicated by the rasa of the season. [1]The Eternal Bride, Shri Radha, is adorned with gorgeous colored chunari and various ornaments. Sri Vitthal Vipul Dev says, enchanted by the sweetness of the monsoon rasa, Sri Radha delights in playful pastimes with Her Beloved, Banke Bihariji, and revels in joyful, playful words. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Re Chitta Chintaya Chiram Vrishbhanuputrim - Shri Vagish Shastriji, Shri Radha Saptashati (7.67)
hindi_text: Re Chitta Chintaya Chiram Vrishbhanuputrim No Vismar Kshanamapiti Mamabhilashah.Radheti Naam Jap Bho Rasne Mamang Radhavane Vasa Tadangghrirjo Bhiliptam.- Shri Vagish Shastriji, Shri Radha Saptashati (7.67)O mind! Always contemplate Shri Radha, and never forget Her, not even for a moment. This is my heartfelt desire. O tongue! Keep chanting the sweet, nectar-like name “Radha.” O body! Be adorned with the sacred dust of Shri Radha’s lotus feet, and dwell forever in Her divine forest named Shri Vrindavan.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Man Rati Vrindavan Sau Keejai - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardh (24)
hindi_text: Man Rati Vrindavan Sau Keejai.Khaayau Piyau Bharyau Bhoonjyau, Ab Jeevan Kau Phal Leejai. [1]Kaaj Akaash Jaani Sab Aapunau, Dau Sanvarau Deejai.Dekhi Dhenu Suni Bainu Rainu Taji, Dhrik-Dhrik Jag Jau Jeejai. [2]Jamuna Tat Vansivat Nikat, Rahat Joo Yah Tan Chhaijai.Varshat Shyamasyam Ras Ras, Vyas Nainan Bhari Peejai. [3]- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardh (24)Let your mind be lovingly immersed in Vrindavan. After satisfying worldly desires—eating, drinking, wandering, and enjoying—now receive life’s true fruit. [1]Understand what is truly meaningful and what is not, and now rectify your misfortune.Gaze upon the cows, hear the flute, feel the sacred dust of Vrindavan, and abandon all ties to the deceptive world. Live only for this divine purpose. [2]Reside near the bank of Yamuna at Vanshivat, and let this body perish there alone. The nectar of the maharaas of the divine couple, Sri Shyama Shyam, showers ceaselessly in Vrindavan. One may drink it fully with eyes immersed in love, says Hariram Vyas. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Uttam Kare So Ladili - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (107)
hindi_text: Uttam Karai So Ladili, Madhyam Ham Saun Hoi.Ihi Baat Nishchay Kari, Hari Ke Pyare Soi.- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (107)Whatever Shri Radha does is perfect and for the highest welfare of the soul, while we, with our limited intellect, are capable only of average or selfish acts. The one who realizes this truth in every circumstance and makes Shri Radha’s wish his own in complete surrender becomes truly dear to Shri Hari.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jab Son Nihaarau Roop - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Vipralabdha (4)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Jab Son Nihaarau Roop Baarau Nand Kau Dularau,Tab Ten Hamaari Kul Kaan Baani Sataki. [1]Mand Mand Aavan Ki Pat Phaharavan Ki,Lalit Rasili Chhabi Madhuri Lakut Ki. [2]Lal Balbir Ju Ki Bansuri Bajaavan Ki, Drigan Milavan Ki Bhrikuti Bikat Ki. [3]Mand Musikyavan Ki Jheenain Sur Gaavan Ki,Basi Chhabi Aan Ur Mor Ke Mukat Ki. [4]- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Vipralabdha (4)From the moment I beheld the divine beauty of Nanda’s beloved son, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, worldly decorum, family pride, and social honor all slipped away from me. [1]With the gentle approach of Kṛṣṇa’s footsteps, the fluttering of His yellow garments, His incomparable beauty, and the tender charm of His stick, my heart was captured. [2]Śrī Lāl Balbir says — the sweet melody of His flute, the playful glance of His eyes, and the dancing play of His brows have utterly enchanted me. [3]His tender smile, His soft and sweet singing, and the sight of His peacock feather crown are forever etched into my heart. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kripa-Kripa Sabahi Kahain Kripa Patra Nahin Koy - Shri Ladalidas
hindi_text: Kripa-Kripa Sabahi Kahain, Kripa Patra Nahin Koy.Kripa Patra So Jaaniye, Jo Agyavarti Hoy.- Shri LadalidasEveryone speaks of grace, but rarely is there a true disciple who is worthy of receiving it. The one truly worthy is he who sincerely follows the instructions of his Guru.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Saadhan Dharm Na Bhatakna - Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Shri Radha Ras Siddhant (6)
hindi_text: Saadhan Dharm Na Bhatakna, Ant Na Paave Koy.Shyama Ju Ki Kripa Saun, Jo Kachhu Hoy So Hoy.- Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Shri Radha Ras Siddhant (6)No matter how many rituals, righteous acts, or spiritual practices a soul may perform, its wandering never ends, nor can it attain the ultimate goal. Only by the grace of Shri Radharani can the supreme destination be reached.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Tiharo Mohi Bal Vrishbhanu Dulari - Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
hindi_text: (Raag Paraj)Tiharo Mohi Bal Vrishbhanu Dulari. Yadyapi Hoon Gunheen Deen Main, Tadyapi Sharan Tumhari. [1]Asharan Sharan Adham Uddhaaran, Virad Raavaro Bhaari.Yaahi Ke Vishvas Bharose, Jeevat Jakt Manjhaari. [2]Nissadhan Sharnagat Paalak, Ho Swamini Hamaari.‘Sarasmadhuri’ Si Bahu Sahachari, Bhavsagar Son Taari. [3]- Shri Saras MadhuriO Daughter of Vrishabhanu, O Shri Radha! You are my only strength. Though I am devoid of all virtues and utterly destitute, I still seek shelter at Your feet alone. [1]You are the refuge of the refuge-less, the deliverer of the downtrodden. Your compassion is immeasurable. It is only by the strength of this belief that I continue to survive in the midstream of worldly existence. [2]O Swamini! One who has no means of their own, who surrenders completely unto You, You alone become their sole protector!Shri Sarasamādhurī says: “O Shri Radha! You have delivered countless Sahcharis like me. Please cast your merciful glance upon me as well.” [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jog Jagya Jap Tap Barat - Shri Dayabai (a disciple of Shri Charan Das Ji of the Shuk sect.)
hindi_text: Jog Jagya Jap Tap Barat, Teerath Nem Achaar.Chaar Bed Shat Shaastra Prabhu, Tum Kirpa Ki Laar.- Shri Dayabai (a disciple of Shri Charan Das Ji of the Shuk sect.)One may perform yoga, sacrifices, japa, penance, vows, and pilgrimages, follow discipline and good conduct, and even master the four Vedas and six scriptures—yet, O Lord, without Your grace, nothing is truly fruitful.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sakhi Sundar Syam Salauna - Shri Lalit Madhuri
hindi_text: Sakhi Sundar Syam Salauna.Koyan Chitai Bihansi Muskanyau, Chitvanmein Kachhu Kar Gayo Tona. [1]Jab Te Dekhi “Lalit Madhuri”, Sab Ras Lagat Alona.Man To Ab Chitachor Son Atakyo, Honi Hoy So Hona. [2]- Shri Lalit MadhuriO friend! Beautiful is that charming Shyamsundara. He glanced with a gentle smile — it felt as if His eyes cast a spell. [1]Shri Lalit Madhuri Ji says, "Since the moment I beheld the incomparable beauty of Shri Krishna, all worldly pleasures have lost their charm. My heart is forever bound to the heart-stealer, Shri Shyamsundar — whatever is meant to happen, let it be." [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Virndavan Ke Vaas Ki - Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Madhurya Ras Dohavali (9)
hindi_text: Virndavan Ke Vaas Ki, Sada Rahi Man Aas.Nirakhat Dampati Chhabi Drigan, Kunjan Raas Vilas.- Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Madhurya Ras Dohavali (9)My heart yearns to constantly reside in Shri Vrindavan, where I may behold the enchanting form of the divine couple Shyama-Shyam and witness their blissful rasa pastimes in the secluded groves.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Yah Gati Nanchi-Nanchi Layi - Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki Vani
hindi_text: Yah Gati Nanchi-Nanchi Layi.Vrindavanmein Raas-Vilas, Sukh Baadhat Sayi. [1]Bhanti-Bhanti Raag Gavat, Sur Alaapat Kayi.Urap-Tirap Maan Let, Tata - Tat - Thayi. [2] Syam Sundar Karat Krida, Prem-Chhata Chhayi.Kumbhandas Prabhu Giradhar, Chhinu-Chhinu Preeti Nayi. [3]- Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki VaniI have attained this state of divine love through dancing. In Vrindavan’s rasa play, bliss is ever-increasing. [1]The sakhis sing sweetly in various ragas, gracefully performing musical notes (alap). The divine couple, Shri Shyama-Shyam, synchronize their dance movements to these melodies. The rhythmic syllables “tat-tat-thei”, uttered by the sakhis, add graceful momentum to the dance. [2]Shri Shyamsundar engages in playful pastimes, immersing the entire atmosphere in the colors of divine love. Shri Kumbhandas says, Lord Giridhar Lal showers fresh waves of love with every passing moment. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Vrindavan Ke Daras Te - Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (71)
hindi_text: Shri Vrindavan Ke Daras Te, Bhaye Jeev Anukool.Bhavsagar Athaah Jal, Utaran Ko Yah Tool.- Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (71)Through the darshan of Shri Vrindavan Dham, the soul becomes favorably inclined toward the divine path of God. The world is like an infinite ocean, and Shri Vrindavan is the supreme means of deliverance.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jug Beet Gaye Bichhure Se Mile – Shri Dhruv Ali Sharan Ji (Vrindavan)
hindi_text: (Savaiya)Jug Beet Gaye Bichhure Se Mile, Din Yon Hi Gaye Sab Thallav Ke. [1] Apanon–Apanon Sabahin Ne Kahyo, Sapanon So Bhayo Sab Gallabh Ke. [2]Abaki Bani Baanik Khoob Gayau, Sharnagat Shri Pad Pallabh Ke. [3]‘Dhruv’ Dhany Bhayo Brajvasin Ke, Mukh Te Sun Radhikavalabh Ke.[4]- Shri Dhruv Ali Sharan Ji (Vrindavan)O Lord (Śrī Rādhā Kṛṣṇa), countless ages have passed since separation from You—the days have slipped by in fruitless wandering. [1]All who claimed to be "mine" turned out to be false like fleeting dreams, their promises nothing but hollow words. [2]But this time, fortune favored me—I have come into the shelter of Your lotus feet. [3]Dhruv Alī Śaraṇ says he is truly blessed to have heard the glories of Śrī Rādhikā Vallabha from the mouths of the Brajavāsīs (residents of Braj). [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sun Barsane Vari Gulam Tero Banvari - Braj Ke Lokgeet
hindi_text: Sun Barsane Vari, Gulam Tero Banvari.Teri Paayaliya Pai Baaje Muraliya, Chham Chham Naache Murari. [1]Bade Bade Dev Dvarpe Thaadhe, Baat Taakat Giridhari.Vrindavan Ke Raja Hokar, Chhaachhpai Naache Murari. [2]Vrindavan Ki Kunj Galin Mein, Raas Rachyo Giridhari.Kadamb Ki Daarpai Jhoola Parayo Hai, Jhota Deve Bihari. [3]Bade Bade Nainnon Mein Jheena Jheena Kajara, Ghayal Kunjbihari.Barsane Ki Khor Saankri, Mangat Daan Bihari. [4]- Braj Ke LokgeetO one who resides in Barsana, Shri Radha, listen! Banwari Shri Krishna is truly Your servant.To the jingling of Your anklets, He plays His flute and dances in rhythm. [1]O Radhe!
