[4]- Shri Sundardas JiOne who harbors neither lust nor anger, neither greed nor attachment, neither pride nor envy, and remains untouched by every stain of impurity. [1]One who makes no distinction between joy and sorrow, nor between sin and virtue; who neither rejoices nor grieves, and is free from bodily awareness. [2]One who is beyond both praise and blame, free from attachment and aversion; who seeks no give‑and‑take and accumulates nothing in this material world. [3]Sundar Dās says, the state of such a saint is immeasurable and unfathomable; such a rare saint is dearer than life to Lord Śrī Rām Himself. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Gaanthi Satt Kupeen Mein Sada Phire Nissank - Shri Malook Das
hindi_text: Gaanthi Satt Kupeen Mein, Sada Phire Nissank.Naam Amal Mata Rahai, Ginai Indra Ko Rank.- Shri Malook DasEven with a loincloth tied in seven knots, he roams fearlessly, perpetually immersed in the nectar of Shri Hari’s divine name. For such a great soul, even Indra, the ruler of heaven, seems no more than a beggar.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jay Jay Shri Ghanshyam Vapu - Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Venu Geet (1)
hindi_text: Jay Jay Shri Ghanshyam Vapu, Jay Shri Radha Vaam.Jay Jay Sab Braj-Sundari, Jay Jay Vrindavan Dham.- Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Venu Geet (1)Glory to Sri Krishn, whose form is as enchanting as a dark raincloud. Glory to Shri Radha, who forever resides on His left side. Glory to all the sakhis of the Braj! Glory to the sacred land of Shri Vrindavan Dham!
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shrikunjbiharini Lalit Ladili - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (4)
hindi_text: Shrikunjbiharini Lalit Ladili,Adbhut Roop Rasala. [1]Hansani Lasani Musakani Ras Barasat,Lalai Karati Nihala. [2]Umangi Umangi Dou Madan Ladaavat,Dou Doun Urmala. [3]Shrilalitkisori Ke Hita Viharat,Jaani Maha Niju Hala. [4]- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (4)The forest-bower queen, Kuñjabihāriṇī (Śrī Rādhā), is a treasure house of divine beauty and rasa. [1]Her gentle smile is full of nectar of love, which continually enchants Kuṃjabihārī (Śrī Kṛṣṇa).  [2]Both, immersed in the ecstasy of love, are entwined with each other as if each were the garland of the other. [3] Shri Lalita Kishori says that to fulfill the innermost feelings of her intimate sakhis, Shri Radha always showers Nitya Vihara rasa with Kunja Bihari. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kou Chaahai Sir Kamalkar - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Kou Chaahai Sir Kamalkar, Kou Nirkhai Mukh Math.Haun To Radha Pad Kamal, Sirdhari Hou Sanath.- Braj Ke DoheSome long to place upon their heads the lotus hands of their worshipful Lord; others yearn to behold the lotus face of their deity. But I desire only this — to rest the lotus feet of Shri Radha upon my head and find my eternal refuge there.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Radhe Albeli Sarkar - Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (115)
hindi_text: (Raag Bhupali, Trital)Radhe Albeli Sarkar.Vanrani Rasikan Ki Pyari, Ati Udar Sukamar. [1]Jaake Pag Nupur Rav Son Hi, Koti Brahm Avatar.Raas Viharin Kunj Viharin, Mahima Amit Apaar. [2]Nav-Nikunj Ki Nav Nidhi Radhe, Karati Nitt Bihar.Shrigopalhita Naval Priya Pai, Bar-Bar Balihar. [3]- Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (115)Shri Radharani is the enchanting sovereign — the supreme queen of Vrindavan, the very life and soul of the rasikas, endlessly generous and extremely tender. [1]From the sweet jingling of the anklets on her lotus feet, countless Brahmas arise; she is that very Shri Radha, the one who delights in the rasa dance within the bowers of Vrindavan, whose glory is beyond measure. [2]Shri Radha is the ever-fresh treasure of the eternal nikunjas, always absorbed in ‘Nitya Vihara’ rasa. Shri Hit Gopal Ji says — upon such Shri Radha, I sacrifice myself again and again. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Swami Haridas Ke Charan Kamal Chit Lau - Shri Kant Kishor, Kant Rasik Ji Ki Vani, Doha (1)
hindi_text: Shri Swami Haridas Ke, Charan Kamal Chit Lau.Kant Rasik Ras-Madhuri, Lakhai Na Aur Upau.- Shri Kant Kishor, Kant Rasik Ji Ki Vani, Doha (1)Shri Kant Rasik says, I place my mind at the supremely sacred lotus feet of Shri Swami Haridas Ji, for there is no greater means to behold and experience the sweetness of the rasa leelas of the divine couple, Sri Shyama Shyam.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrindavane Sthiracharaatmak Keet-Durva - Sri Kuresh Swami
hindi_text: Vrindavane Sthiracharaatmak Keet-Durva-Paryant Jantu Nichayebataetadaanim.Naivalabhaamahijanimahatkaastaete, Papa Padam Tab Kada Punarashrayamah.- Sri Kuresh SwamiNot even as a tree, a blade of grass, or the tiniest insect in Vrindavan did we take birth. Alas! Such great sinners we are! O Lord, when shall we again take shelter in Your holy abode?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hamaari Brindavan Rajdhani - Shri Braj Nidhi Ji, Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Braj Nidhi Muktavali (9)
hindi_text: (Raag Sarang, Titala)Hamaari Brindavan Rajdhani.Nidhi Ban Maharaj Brajraj Laadilo, Shriradha Patarani. [1]Nidhi Ban Seva Kunj Pulin, Bansivat Sukh-Dhani.Brajnidhi Brajras Saun Man Atkyau, Nidhi Payi Manmaani. [2]- Shri Braj Nidhi Ji, Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Braj Nidhi Muktavali (9)Shri Vrindavan is the crown jewel of all holy places, the capital of the rasikas, where the Lord of Nidhivan, the beloved Prince of Braj, Shri Krishna, eternally resides, and where Queen Shri Radharani, His supremely loving consort, forever remains in her divine form beside Him. [1]Within Vrindavan, sacred leela sites such as Nidhivan, Seva Kunja, the banks of the Yamuna, and Vanshivat grant unparalleled bliss to all beings. Shri Brajanidhi Ji says: “My mind is captivated by the nectar of Braj, and I have thus attained the treasure I longed for.” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bipul Biharinidasi Tain Ab Chhin Chhin Man Anand - Sri Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (19)
hindi_text: Bipul Biharinidasi Tain, Ab Chhin Chhin Man Anand.Yaun Nirkhat Nagridas Nit, Dulahu Dulahini Makarand.- Shri Nagri Dev, Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (19)Through the company of Shri Beethalvipuldev Ji and Shri Biharindev Ji, my heart remains drenched in streams of rasa. By their grace alone, I constantly behold the sweet and playful lilas of the eternal Bride and Bridegroom, Shri Radha Krishn.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bansari Bajaavai Nand Ju Kau Lal - Shri Guruchauna Ji Maharaj, Raas Mahotsav Ke Pada (103)
hindi_text: (Raag Shyam Kalyan)Bansari Bajaavai Nand Ju Kau Lal.Jamana Tat Bansivat Thaadau, Sundar Rooprasaal. [1]Mor Mukut Peetambar Sohai, Chanchal Nain Vishal.Kaanan Kundal Gal Bich Mala, Shritilak Diye Bhaal. [2]Vrindavan Mein Raas Rachyau Hai, Radha Phirat Khushaal.Guruchauna Ke Hiye Base Nita, Darasan Karat Nihal. [3]- Shri Guruchauna Ji Maharaj, Raas Mahotsav Ke Pada (103)The charming son of Nanda, Shri Krishna plays His sweet flute on the banks of the Yamuna, beneath the shade of Vanshivat. His form is overflowing with rasa and supremely enchanting. [1]A peacock feather crown adorns His head, and a yellow garment graces His divine form. His eyes are playful and large, earrings sway upon His ears, a garland of flowers graces His neck, and a tilak glows upon His forehead. [2]In Vrindavan, during the grand festival of Maha-Rasa, Shri Radha dances in bliss, immersed in love-bliss. Shri Guru Chhauna declares — Shyama-Shyam dwell forever in my heart, and their vision alone completes my life. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Lakshmya Yasch Na Gocharibhavati Yannapuh - Shri Hita Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (239)
hindi_text: Lakshmya Yasch Na Gocharibhavati Yannapuh Sakhayah Prabhoh. Sambhavyopi Viranchinaradashivswayambhuvadyairn Yah.Yo Vrindavannagaripashupatistribhavalabhyah Katham Radhamadhavyormamastu Sa Raho Dasyadhikarotsavah.- Shri Hita Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (239)That intimate service, unattainable even by Lakṣmī, denied to the Lord’s closest companions like Sridama, and far beyond the reach of great personalities like Brahmā, Nārada, Śiva, and the Sanaka sages, the treasure which only the gopīs of Vṛndāvana like Lalitā attains through the mood of a sakhi — how shall I ever attain that most confidential festival of serving Śrī Rādhā Mādhava in their secret pastimes?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jhoolat Ye Dou Roop Apaar - Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Van Kunjan Jhoolan Leela (25)
hindi_text: (Raag Malhar Va Kinnari)Jhoolat Ye Dou Roop Apaar.Bhanu Kishori Gori Bhori, Chhavi Nidhi Nand Kumar. [1]Ghan Damini Deenen Galbaahin, Chhin-Chhin Baadhat Pyar.Lalit Ladaiti Ya Sukh Oopar, Sarbas Deejai Vaar. [2]- Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Van Kunjan Jhoolan Leela (25)The abode of all beauty, the divine couple, Sri Shyama Shyam, swing together on a charming swing. Vrisabhanu’s daughter, Shri Radha, is fair and supremely innocent, while Nand’s son, Sri Krishn, is the very treasure of incomparable charm. [1]Shri Krishna is dark like a raincloud, and Shri Radha shines like lightning. With arms entwined around each other, their love grows deeper with every passing moment. Shri Lalit Ladaiti Ji says — this swing pastime is so wondrously sweet that one should offer everything upon it. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jo Kreeda Vrindavan Kini Radhe Sundarshyam - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Vishisht Doha (33)
hindi_text: Jo Kreeda Vrindavan Kini, Radhe Sundarshyam.Rooprasik’ Rasikan Ki Jeevan, Ek Vastu Dvai Naam.- Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Vishisht Doha (33)The lilas of the Divine Couple in Vrindavan are the very source of life for the Rasikas. Though they appear as two, “Radha” and “Shyam”, their soul, their essence, is one — the eternal stream of rasa born of their love-play, known as “Nitya Vihara Rasa.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nandnandan Hindore Jhoolen Mayi Ri - Shri Chaturbhuj Das
hindi_text: (Raag Kaanarau)Nandnandan Hindore Jhoolen Mayi Ri.Sang Vrishbhanu-Suta Ati Sohai, Rimjhim Rimjhim Boond Suhayi Ri. [1]Gaavati Savan Geet Baanik Bani, Vraj Vanita Piy Jiy Bhayi Ri. 'Chatrubhuj' Prabhu Nab Chhabili Chhabi Nirkhein, Reejhi Reejhi Sab Ur Layi Ri. [2]- Shri Chaturbhuj DasNandalal Shri Krishna swings on a beautiful swing, and beside Him, Vrishabhanu’s beloved daughter, Shri Radha, sits with unparalleled charm. The monsoon rain falls gently in the forest all around. [1]The maidens of Braj are immersed in love, lovingly singing the songs of Sāvana. Shri Chaturbhujdas Ji says — beholding the ever-fresh, enchanting beauty of the Lord, all the sakhis are spellbound, keeping that darśana forever in their hearts. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Parmanand Swarupini Manharni Sukh Raas - Shri Kishori Ali, Radha Namavali (23)
hindi_text: Parmanand Swarupini, Manharni Sukh Raas.Piy Hiy Ur Kullolini, Preetam Hiye Nivas.- Shri Kishori Ali, Radha Namavali (23)Shri Radha is the embodiment of supreme bliss, the stealer of the heart, and the abode of divine happiness. She creates surging waves of rasa in the heart of her beloved Lord Krishn and forever dwells within His heart.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pavitra Shobhit Paat Puneet - Shri Hit Kishori Lal
hindi_text: Pavitra Shobhit Paat Puneet.Pyari Ur Lasai Arun Sosani, Mohan Ur Lasai Peet. [1]Sahchari Been Mridang Bajaavat, Gaavat Mangal Geet. Jay Shri Kishorilal Hita Roop Hindore, Jhoolat Badhat Sameet. [2]- Shri Hit Kishori LalA pure silk pavitra (sacred thread) adorns the neck of the divine couple, Shri Shyama-Shyam. Upon Shri Radha’s chest lies a pavitra of red and blue, while on Shri Krishna’s chest gleams a yellow pavitra. [1]The sakhis play the veena and mridanga, singing songs of auspicious joy. Shri Kishori Lal Ji says — the divine Couple swings upon the jhoola, their love growing ever deeper with every moment. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sukh Ki Dampati Rashihain - Shri Saras Madhuri
hindi_text: Sukh Ki Dampati Rashihain, Tinso Prem Badhav. ‘Sarasmadhuri’ Tahal Ko, Nit Prati Rakh Chitchav.- Shri Saras MadhuriThe Divine Couple, Shri Radha Krishna, are an endless treasure of bliss; therefore, keep increasing your love for them. Shri Saras Madhuri says, always maintain your eagerness and desire to serve them selflessly.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Apne Vash Mein Vrajaraj Kiye - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Apne Vash Mein Vrajaraj Kiye, Kahke Vachanamrit Aadhe Ki Jai Jai.Sur Kinnar Karaj Sadhe Ki Jai, Vrajjeevan Prem Samadhe Ki Jai Jai. [1]Ras Raseshwari Ki Sada Jai Ho, Harekrishn! Sada Bhavvaadhe Ki Jai Jai.Ati Sundar Roop Agaadhe Ki Jai, Vrishbhanu Kishori Shri Radhe Ki Jai Jai. [2]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’Glory to Śrī Rādhā, who, with the nectar of just half of Her words, has brought Vrajarāja Śrī Kṛṣṇa under Her control. Glory to Her, the embodiment of divine love, the very life of Braj, by whose grace even the endeavours of gods and celestial beings are fulfilled! [1]Repeated salutations to Śrī Rādhā, the presiding deity of the rāsa pastimes, the ocean of compassion, and the destroyer of all worldly obstacles. Glory, glory to the enchanting daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, Śrī Rādhikā, whose charm is matchless and unfathomable. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dhanya Dhanya Vrindavani - Shri Priya Sakhi (Sri Brahm Gopal Goswami), Shri Hari Leela (55)
hindi_text: Dhanya Dhanya Vrindavani, Lata Lalit Vistaar.Dhanya Radhika Madhavi Moorati, Dhanya Vihaar.- Shri Priya Sakhi (Sri Brahm Gopal Goswami), Shri Hari Leela (55)Blessed is Vrindavan, adorned with the graceful spread of charming creepers. Blessed is the enchanting form of the divine couple, Sri Radha Madhav, and their love-play in this sacred grove.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pyari Tu Gunani Rai Sirmaur - Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (65)
hindi_text: (Raag Sarang)Pyari Tu Gunani Rai Sirmaur.Gati Mein Gati Upjati Nana Raag Raagini, Taar Mandar Sur Ghor. [1]Kahu Kachu Liyau Rekh Chhaya, Tau Kaha Bhayo Jhoothi Daur.Kahin Shri Haridas Let Pyari Joo Ke, Tirap Lagni Mein Kisore. [2]- Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (65)O Kunja-biharini Shri Radhe! You are the crest jewel among the kings of fine arts. In dance and music, You are unmatched. From You, countless ragas and raginis spring forth, their sweet notes resonating in both high and low tones. [1]If anyone claims to have mastered even a slight portion of the shadow of Your artistry, such words are hollow and false. Swami Shri Haridas Ji declares that ever-youthful Shyamsundara, following your hand gestures, dances in the same rhythm in divine love-bliss. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Garjani Ghan Aru Damini - Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (68)
hindi_text: (Raag Malar)Garjani Ghan Aru Damini, Chaatik Pik Suk Bolati Morani.Syam Ghata Kaajar Hoon Ten Kaari, Umadi-Umadi Aayi Chahun Orani. [1]Naanhi-Naanhi Bundani Barshani Laagyo, Taisiyai Rochak Pavan Jhakorani.'Hita Dhruv' Pyari Pyar Saun Jhoolat, Piyhi Jhulaavati Nainani Korani. [2]- Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (68)With the arrival of the rainy season, the rumble of clouds, flashes of lightning, and the sweet melodies of the chataka bird, cuckoo, parrots, and peacocks bring immense pleasure. Clouds darker than kohl gather all around. [1]Gentle raindrops begin to fall as cool breezes blow through, filling the air with serenity. Shri Hit Dhruvdas Ji says—upon beholding this enchanting scene, Shri Radha sways on the swing of love and, with the tender corners of Her eyes, swings Her beloved Krishna in love-bliss. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hit Ahlaad Swaroopini Mohani-Mohan Vaam - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Hit Ahlaad Swaroopini, Mohani-Mohan Vaam.Nit Araadhan Karat Hari, Yaatai Radha Naam.- Braj Ke DoheShe brings delight to every heart, the enchantress who captivates even the enchanter, Shri Krishna Himself, and forever resides on His left side. Shri Hari constantly worships her; thus, she is known as “Radha.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sunihun Na Dekhi Aisi Jori Jugal Kisor Kisori - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (56)
hindi_text: (Doha)Ang Ang Sobha Ju Par, Varaun Kaam Karori. Suni Na Hun Dekhi Kahun, Aisi Adbhut Jori. (Pad)Sunihun Na Dekhi Aisi Jori Jugal Kisor Kisori. Ang Ang Sobha Par Sajani Varaun Kaam Karori. [1]Nahin Upama Patatar Deebe Kon Dekhi Thaki Mati Mori.Shriharipriya Adbhut Kalavali Maanahu Kaadhi Kori. [2]- Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (56)(Doha)Millions of Cupids should be offered to the unparalleled beauty residing in the limbs of this divine couple. Such a divine couple (Shri Radha Krishn) is neither heard nor seen anywhere else.(Pada)An ever-youthful couple like this ‘Yugala Kishor’ (Shri Radha-Krishna) has neither ever been seen nor even heard of anywhere. The beauty of each of their limbs is so astonishing that even millions of Cupids could be sacrificed upon it. [1]Despite my best efforts to find a worthy comparison for them, even my intellect gave up in exhaustion. I surrender myself to them completely — the divine arts of love in Shri Hari and Shri Radha are absolutely astonishing. In awe, I wonder who could possibly have created such divine artistry. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Lok Laaj Kul Ved Chhoote Sabe Vivek Bal - Shri Dayaram Ji
hindi_text: Lok Laaj Kul Ved, Chhoote Sabe Vivek Bal.Pare Hriday Jab Chhed, Dusah Prem Ke Banako.- Shri Dayaram JiWhen the unbearable arrows of divine love pierce the heart, all boundaries—such as social shame, family honor, scriptural bindings, Vedic rules, and rational thoughts are left behind.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Roop Hu Ke Roop Tai Anoop Roop Pyari Ko - Shri Kishori Ali Ji, Vinay Ke Pad (8)
hindi_text: (Raag Gaud)Roop Hu Ke Roop Tai Anoop Roop Pyari Ko.Jag Ujiyaari Jag Jeevan Ki Maharani, Anand Na Bhaavai Ang Lochan Nihari Ko. [1]Paavak Prakash Chand Damini Ki Kaha Chami, Ghata Duri Jaat Aiso Neelo Rang Saari Ko.Kishori Swamini Hiye Mein Basau, Achal Suhag Thakurain Hamari Ko. [2]- Shri Kishori Ali Ji, Vinay Ke Pad (8)Shri Radha’s divine beauty is such that even personified beauty itself appears pale in comparison to her matchless form. She is the one who illuminates the entire world and is the queen of the life of the universe, Lord Shri Krishna Himself. Her beauty increases every moment, and the eyes can never be satisfied gazing upon her limbs. [1]The light of fire, the radiance of the moon, and the flash of lightning — none can describe the fair glow of her form adorned in a blue sari. Shri Kishori Ali says — O Swamini! Reside in my heart forever, for you alone have the eternal wedded fortune, you alone are my Thakurani. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: He Swamini Shri Kunj Viharini - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (122)
hindi_text: (Raag Khammach)He Swamini Shri Kunj Viharini, Vegi Khavari Meri Leejai.Seva Reet Kachu Nahi Jaanau, Chook Chhima Kari Deejai. [1]Ati Adheen Deen Rati Tero, Chitt Dai Yah Suni Leejai.Lalit Kishori Kunj Nikunjan, Raj Adhikari Keejai. [2]- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (122)O Swamini, Shri Kunj Viharini (Sri Radha)! Kindly take heed of me quickly. I know nothing of the mode of your service, so please forgive my faults. [1]In utter surrender and humility, I call upon your name — please hear the cry of my heart. O charming Kishori! Bestow such grace that I may also become worthy of serving the dust of the bowers and groves of Shri Dham Vrindavan. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shribiharidas Braj Mein Basat Mile Saprasi Shyam- Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (365)
hindi_text: Shribiharidas Braj Mein Basat, Mile Saparasi Shyam.Paras Na Pavai Prem Binu, Aparas Dukhi Sakam.- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (365)By residing in the abode of love, Vraja Mandal, we have attained such Shri Banke Bihari Ji Maharaj, who embraces only those premi devotees that love Him selflessly. Those devoid of pure love, entangled in external saparasa and aparasa, remain forever distant from Him and thus dwell in constant sorrow.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Braj-Vasi-Patatar Kou Naahin - Shri Surdas, Sura Sagara
hindi_text: Braj-Vasi-Patatar Kou Naahin.Brahm, Sanak, Siv, Dhyan Na Paavat,Inaki Joothan Lai Lai Khaahin. [1]Haldhar Kahyo, Chhaak Jaivat Sang,Meethau Lagat Saraahat Jaahin.'Surdas' Prabhu Jo Visvambhar,So Gvalanke Kaur Aghaahin. [2]- Shri Surdas, Sura SagaraNo one can be compared to the residents of Braj. Supreme Lord Shri Krishna whom Brahma, Shiva, the Sanaka sages, and others cannot attain even in deep meditation, that same Krishna, out of love, eats from the leftover plates of the Brajvasis. [1]Balram says that when He drinks buttermilk with them, it tastes as sweet as nectar, and He praises it. Shri Surdas Ji says — He who sustains the entire universe, the all-nourishing Vishwambhar, longs to eat the remnants of the Braj cowherd boys. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Panchhi Barsane Jite Pashu Aru Gopi-Gop - Shri Hita Parmanand Das
hindi_text: Panchhi Barsane Jite, Pashu Aru Gopi-Gop.Sabke Hiy Jiy Radhika, Radha Deeni Op.- Shri Hita Parmanand DasFor every bird, animal, gopi, and gopa in Barsana, Shri Radhika is the very essence of life, and her divine radiance forever resides in their hearts.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Komalta Kanj Te Gulab Te Sugandh Laiken - Shri Thakur Ji
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Komalta Kanj Te, Gulab Te Sugandh Laiken, Chandr Saun Prakash Laiken, Udit Ujerau Hai. [1]Roop Rati Aanan Saun, Chaaturi Sujaanan Saun, Neer Nirvanan Son, Kautuk Niberau Hai. [2]Thakur Vichari Kai, Banayau Vidhi Karigar, Rachna Nihaari Kaanh, Hot Chir Cherau Hai. [3]Saune Sau Surang Le, Sabad Lai Sudha Kau, Vasudha-Sukh Looti Kain, Banaayau Mukh Terau Hai. [4]- Shri Thakur JiWith the tenderness of the lotus, the fragrance of the rose, and the cool radiance of the moon, O Śrī Rādhā, Your unparalleled form has emerged. [1]Your face is as charming as the goddess of love, Your wisdom as exalted as the nobles, and Your purity is as spotless as crystal water — all woven into a wondrous beauty. [2]Thākurjī says — as a master craftsman fashions a matchless creation with delicate care, so has the Creator formed Your divine form, upon which Śrī Kṛṣṇa gazes with unending love. [3]With a glow like molten gold, as sweet as nectar, and the bliss of all the worlds combined, O Śrī Rādhā, Your face stands unmatched. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधा राधा नाम ही सों काम राख आठौं जाम
hindi_text:
"राधा राधा नाम ही सों काम राख आठौं जाम"
-  श्री लाल बलबीर

श्री लाल बलबीर जी कहते हैं "अपना एकमात्र काम दिन-रात "राधा राधा" नाम से ही रखो।
english_text:
"Radha Radha Naam Hi Son Kaam Raakh Aathaun Jaam"
- Shri Lal Balbir

Shri Lal Balbir says that Your only concern should be from the name "Radha Radha" day and night, every moment.
english_translation:
"Radha Radha Naam Hi Son Kaam Raakh Aathaun Jaam"
- Shri Lal Balbir

Shri Lal Balbir says that Your only concern should be from the name "Radha Radha" day and night, every moment.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Atki Naav Kuthaur Mein Padi Bhaunroo Bich Aay - Shri Ramswaroop Ji
hindi_text: Atki Naav Kuthaur Mein, Padi Bhaunroo Bich Aay.Aho Lali Vrishabhaan Ki, Tum Bin Kaun Sahaay.- Shri Ramswaroop Ji The boat of my life is trapped in the midst of a fierce whirlpool, on the verge of sinking. O charming daughter of Vrishbhanu, Shri Radhey! If You do not grant shelter, who else can save me?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Syama Chalahu  Ladaiti Priya - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (11)
hindi_text: (Raag Bilaval)Syama Chalahu, Ladaiti Priya,Kunjani Karahu, Keli.Syam-Tamal-Lal Naval Kisori Bal Tum,Ju Naval Nav Kanak-Beli. [1]Bividh Kusum-Ghan-Rachit Shree Vrindavan,Bolat Suhaye Pik-Madhup Rahe Jheli.Shree Beethal Vipul Ras Bihari Tihare Bas,Jamuna Ke Teer Sukh Bisad Bilas Kheli. [2]- Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (11)Shrivipul Biharini Dasi Ji, revealing her heart’s desire, prays to her beloved soul-friend, Shri Radha:O dear Śyāmā Jū ! Please come to the Nikunj bower and be immersed in the colors of Keli love-plays. My body, mind, and very life are restless to fondly serve you in this rasa. O youthful maiden! Embrace dark Shyamasundara as a golden vine entwines the dark Tamal tree. [1]Shri Vrindavan is adorned with flowers rich in varied fragrances, where cuckoos sing melodiously and bumblebees hum in delight. On the banks of Shri Yamuna, shower your intimate play of love with your beloved Kunj Bihari, for He is entirely under your control. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shat Mukti Ki Chaha Taji - Shri Guruchauna Ji Maharaj
hindi_text: Shat Mukti Ki Chaha Taji, Sahaja Bhae Nirvaas.Janachauna Nija Bhava Rata, Nirakhai Yugala Vilaas.- Shri Guruchauna Ji MaharajDevotees of Yugala Rasa renounce not only worldly pleasures but also the six types of liberation (Sālokya, Sāmīpya, Sārūpya, Sāyujya, Sārṣṭi, and Kaivalya). Immersed in selfless love for the Divine Couple, they become free from the cycle of birth and death effortlessly, gaining the supreme fortune of serving Them in Their eternal realm. Such devotees behold the love plays of the divine couple, with their eyes filled with devotion.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Tarani Tanaiya Teer Santani Ki Rahai Bheer - Shri Vrindavan Das Chacha Ji
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Tarani Tanaiya Teer, Santani Ki Rahai Bheer,Keki Keer Aisi, Radha Ju Kau Dham Hai. [1]Kunjan Ke Kaune Baithe, Rahain Anurag Chhake,Aracha Aur Charcha Mein, Bitein Sab Jaam Hain. [2]Hiye Prem Rahai Suchi, Maansik Sewa Ruchi,Piye Ju Alaukik, Khilauna Shyamashyam Hai. [3]Bali Hitaroop Aise, Rasikan Sang Sada,Vrindavan Hita Bhayi, Mati Abhiram Hai. [4]- Shri Vrindavan Das Chacha JiOn the sacred banks of Śrī Yamunā within the realm of Śrī Dham Vṛndāvan, the group of saints forever remains present; peacocks dance, and parrots with their melodious voice fill the air with rasa. This is the most intimate personal abode of Śrī Rādhājū. [1]Saints, seated in the secluded bowers of Vṛndāvan, remain immersed in the loving devotion of the divine couple, Śyāma Śyām; they dedicate their entire time to devotion, listening, and singing their rasa‑filled pastimes, thereby making their lives truly meaningful. [2]The hearts of rasika saints overflow with divine love, and they remain engaged in ‘mānasī sevā’ (serving Śrī Śyāma Śyām through the mind). The divine couple, like wondrous toys of love, always keep their hearts soaked in the nectar of rasa. [3]Śrī Hit Vṛndāvandās Jī says, I offer myself at the lotus feet of such rasika saints, for through their association, the mind becomes forever immersed in the divine ocean of Vṛndāvan’s prema‑ānanda (bliss of divine love). [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shrivrindavan Raj Paras - Shri Ramray, Geet Govind Braj Bhasha, Doha (78)
hindi_text: Shrivrindavan Raj Paras, Saras Haras Sukhmool.Shrivrindavan Vaas Kari, Shriyamuna Ke Kool.- Shri Ramray, Geet Govind Braj Bhasha, Doha (78)Just the touch of Vrindavan’s sacred dust brings sweetness, fills the heart with joy, and is the very source of all happiness. Thus, residing on the Yamuna’s banks in Vrindavan is the highest fulfillment of life.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shriradhe Ab Beg Samharau - Shri Premdas Ji Ki Vani (97)
hindi_text: Shriradhe Ab Beg Samharau.Aho Naagri Jher Na Keejai, Apani Cheri Jaan Niharau. [1]Sanshay Harau Dharau Nij Parikar, Yah Abhilakh Hamarau. Premsakhi Ki Aho Swamini, Yah Sandeh Nivarau. [2]- Shri Premdas Ji [Brother of Shri Lal Balbir Ji], Shri Premdas Ji Ki Vani (97)O Shri Radha! Please bestow Your grace upon me. O Most Skillful One! delay no longer, considering as Your own maidservant. [1]Dispelling all my doubts, kindly include me among Your close-knit circle of sakhis. This alone is my heart’s sole longing. O beloved Swamini of all rasika maidens! Kindly dispel this hesitation once and for all. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Preetam Kunwari Charan Binu Ko Hai - Shri Vanshi Ali, Siddhant Ke Pad (24)
hindi_text: Preetam Kunwari Charan Binu Ko Hai.Ap Apne Swārath Jag Atakyo, Tāsōn Ko Sukh To Hai. [1]Eho Param Udār Kripānidhi, Swāmin Bhajat Sakal Sukh Yo Hai.Jayashree Bansi Ali An Raj Nis Nahin, Taj Bhajan Nit Sohai. [2]- Shri Vanshi Ali, Siddhant Ke Pad (24)An intimate Sahchari, firmly absorbed in the supreme exclusivity (ananyatā) of Shri Radha, declares—Who else can be my beloved (worthy of my love and affection), apart from Kishori Ji’s lotus feet? The entire world is busy fulfilling its own selfish motives. There is not even a trace of true love here, nor does this false world contain the real happiness that one finds at the feet of Shri Radha. [1]My Swamini, Shri Radha, is immensely generous and the very embodiment of compassion. Whoever worships her attains all kinds of happiness with ease. The one who, day and night, holds the dust of Shri Radha’s lotus feet in the highest reverence— that devotee forever shines on the path of eternal loving service (nitya-vihār), on the ever-blissful path of divine bhajan. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kaik Swang Banaike Nacho Bahu Vidhi Naach - Shri Rasnidhi
hindi_text: Kaik Swang Banaike, Nacho Bahu Vidhi Naach.Reejhat Nahin Rijhwar Vah, Bina Hiye Ke Saanch.- Shri RasnidhiSri Rasanidhi says — No matter how many disguises or outward dances one performs, unless the heart is pure and honest, Lord Shri Krishna will not be pleased. External displays like wearing saffron robes, shaving the head, or growing matted locks are all meaningless without sincere, loving devotion free from deceit and hypocrisy.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jayati Jay Jayati Lalitadi Var Bhamini - Sri Ramsakhiji Maharaj, Shri Bhaktiras Manjari
hindi_text: Jayati Jay Jayati Lalitaadi Var Bhaamini,Traahi Bali Kripaa Kari Khabari Kari Deejie,Dharo Pad Kamal Mam Sheesh Mein Swaamini. [1]Tumahi Taji Kaun Soon Karoon Vinati Aho Milai,Kachhu Tahal Mohi Gunan Abhiraamini. [2]Sujasvar Aapko Sakal Lokan Vidit,Karati Tum Kaho Shri Radhika Bhaamini. [3]Raamsakhi Deen Jalahin Jyon Meen Hai,Vegikarunaa Karo Karunaaras Gaamini. [4]- Sri Ramsakhiji Maharaj, Shri Bhaktiras ManjariGlory to Shri Radharani, the crown jewel among all the all-skillful sakhis like Lalita. O my Swamini! Please show your mercy and pay me heed — kindly place your lotus feet upon my head. [1]O my most merciful Swaminiju! Who else can I turn to with my heartfelt cries, if not you? Please bless me with the fortune of contributing even a small service in your divine palace. [2]Your divine glories spread through all the worlds. Please tell me — what service can I perform for you, O Radhika Bhāmini? [3]Your humble maidservant, Rāmsakhi, is restless like a fish without water. Kindly shower your mercy upon me without delay. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Braj Mein Hot Kulahal Bhaari - Shri Parmanand Das Ji
hindi_text: (Raag Maaru)Braj Mein Hot Kulahal Bhaari,Aanand Magan Gwaal Sab Naachat,Det Paraspar Taari. [1]Nandaray Ke Bhavan Mein Aavat,Aanandit Brajnaari.Putra Janam Suni Harash Bhayo Hai,‘Parmanand’ Balihaari. [2]- Shri Parmanand Das JiThere is a great celebration in the land of Braj due to the birth of Lord Krishn. The cowherd boys, immersed in joy, are dancing and clapping to congratulate each other. [1]The women of Braj are joyfully arriving at Nanda ji’s home. Overjoyed by the auspicious news of Shri Krishna’s birth, they are offering themselves in adoration, says Sri Parmanand Das. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Uddho Sudho Hai Gayo Suni Gopin Ke Bol - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Uddho Sudho Hai Gayau, Suni Gopin Ke Bol.Gyan Bajayi Dugdugi, Prem Bajayo Dhol.- Braj Ke DoheUddhav stepped into Braj with the intention of teaching jñāna (knowledge) to the gopīs, but he ended up being transformed in the path of love by hearing their love-filled conversations. He had arrived beating the ‘ḍugḍugī’ (a small handheld drum) of jñāna, but in Braj, the ‘ḍhol’ (the grand drum) of prema (divine love) was being played everywhere.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Besar Kaun Ki Ati Niki - Shri Hita Damodar Das
hindi_text: (Raag Adano and Dhanashree)Besar Kaun Ki Ati Niki.Hodpari Laalan Aru Lalna Chaump Badhi Ati Jee Ki. [1]Nyay Paryo Lalita Ke Aagein, Kaun Lalit Kaun Phiki.Jai Shridamodar hit Vilag Na Manon, Jhukan Jhuki Pyari Ju Ki. [2]- Shri Hita Damodar DasWhose nose-ring (beṣar) is more beautiful? This question sparked a playful rivalry between Sri Radha and Sri Krishna, intensifying the emotional excitement in their hearts. [1]Seeking a verdict, they turned to Shri Lalita Ji. Lalita Ji gently declares, “Please don’t mind, but Pyariju’s (Sri Radha’s) tilted beṣar holds a charm that cannot be surpassed.” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aho Doun Ke Mukh Chand Lasai - Braj Ke Sawaiya
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Aho! Doun Ke Mukh Chand Lasai,Aru Doun Ke Drig Chaaru Chakori.Pat Shyaamal Shyaam Lakhau Pahine,Patpeet Kase Kati Radhika Gori. [1]Aji Preeti Ki Reeti Ki Kaun Kahai?Vipareet Bani Ati Adbhut Jori!Sakhi! Sundar Kaun Kahau Inmein,Vrishbhanu Dulare Ki Nand Kishori. [2]- Braj Ke SawaiyaO dear sakhi! Both Śrī Rādhā and Śrī Kṛṣṇa have faces radiant like the full moon, and each is the cakōrī (moon-lover bird) to the other’s moon-like face. Śyāmasundara, with His dark complexion, is adorned in dark-colored garments, while fair-complexioned Rādhikā is adorned in golden-yellow attire tied gracefully around Her waist. [1]What a wondrous play of love this is, difficult to understand, for today this Divine Couple seems to be appearing in contrast to each other’s usual forms. So, O sakhi, now you tell me—who appears more beautiful today: Rādhā, the darling daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, or Kṛṣṇa, the lovely son of Nanda? [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Do Man Ik Hote Sunyo - Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (34)
hindi_text: Do Man Ik Hote Sunyo, Pai Vah Prem Na Aahi.Hoi Jabai Dvai Tanahu Ik, Soi Prem Kahahi.- Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (34)True love is not merely the union of two minds. Only when both the minds and the bodies unite completely, can it be truly called the highest form of love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shyam Rang Shyama Rangi Shyama Ke Rang Shyam - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Shyam Rang Shyama Rangi, Shyama Ke Rang Shyam.Ek Praan Tan Man Sahaj, Kahive Ko Dou Naam.- Braj Ke DoheShri Radha is imbued with the hue of dark-complexioned Shri Krishna, and Shri Krishna is imbued with the hue of fair-complexioned Shri Radha. Their bodies, minds, and very source of life are one. For the sake of loving pastimes, they are referred to as two — Radha and Krishna — but in truth, they are eternally inseparable and non-different.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Meri Swamini Prasann Badan - Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Ras Ke Pada (20)
hindi_text: Meri Swamini Prasann Badan, Sanvarau Sukha-Raasi.Inhin Ladaau Anudin Chhin-Chhin, Lahon Syaabasi. [1]Phooli Phooli Tahal Karon, Man Ke Manan Hulaasi.Ananya Shri Haridaas, Bipul Bali-Bali Biharinidaasi. [2]- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Ras Ke Pada (20)My Swamini, Shri Radha Ju, has a joyful and blooming face, and My Shri Krishna is the embodiment of all happiness. May I forever, night and day, lovingly fondle and playfully adore this Divine Couple, always receiving their affection. [1]May I joyfully, with a heart overflowing in divine love, be absorbed in their personal service (mahala-ṭahala). Shri Biharindev Ji says — adopting the path of exclusive devotion (ananyatā) shown by my Gurudev, Shri Haridas Ji, and Shri Vitthalvipul Dev Ji, I offer myself again and again, in total surrender. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Rasasvarupah Shrikrrishnah - Shri Vagish Shastriji, Sri Radha Naam Sudha (6)
hindi_text: Rasasvarupah Shrikrrishnah Rasikastu Yaya KrritahReme Taya Chatmaratah Atma Ramopyakhanditah.Taveti Trritiya Hetau-budhairsaya ShukoktitahBhaktamshcha Premadanena Karoti Rasabhoginah. - Shri Vagish Shastriji, Sri Radha Naam Sudha (6)The Śrutis (Vedas) describe the Supreme Lord as Ānanda-svarūpa (embodiment of bliss), not as rasa-bhoktā (enjoyer of rasa). It is Shri Radha who makes Him a rasika, a connoisseur of divine love. In Bhāgavatam, Shri Shukadeva calls Krishna ātmārāma (self-satisfied) and ātmarata (rejoicing in the Self), yet Radha engages Him in loving pastimes, making Him Rādhā-Ramaṇa. The word “tayā” in the verse, in instrumental case, is interpreted as “by her,” i.e., by Radha. Similarly, Radha grants divine love to devotees, making them Rasikas, capable of relishing the bliss of love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pyari-Mukh-Mayank Nishi-Bhor - Shri Kalyan Pujari Ji, Shri Hita Kalyan Pujari Ji Ki Vani (58)
hindi_text: Pyari-Mukh-Mayank Nishi-Bhor,Shodash Kala Roop-Gun Sevat, Eeshad Haas Kiran Sab Or. [1]Adhar-Sudha-Maadhuri Manohar, Peewat Piya Anuraag Chakor.Tripit Na ‘Kali Ali’ Din Dekhat, Sukh-Saagar Naagari-Kishor. [2]- Shri Kalyan Pujari Ji, Shri Hita Kalyan Pujari Ji Ki Vani (58)Shri Radhaju’s face glows like the full moon, resplendent with all sixteen divine qualities (kalās) of beauty and virtue. The gentle radiance of her subtle smile spreads divine bliss in all directions. [1]The sweetness of the nectar of her lips is so enchanting that Shri Krishna, like a love-filled chakor bird, constantly drinks it lovingly.  The sakhis gaze at her ever-blissful face all day long, yet their eyes remain unsatisfied and yearn ever more. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Tan Man Vachanan Ladili - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (650)
hindi_text: Tana Mana Vachanan Laadili, Meri Jeevan Pran,Lalit Keli Ang Sang Sada, Biharat Rasik Sujaan.- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (650)Within my body, mind, and speech, only Shri Radha dwells completely, for She is the very source of my life. She is forever immersed in the eternal Kelī sports of Nitya-Vihār with Kunja Bihārī.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Main Kahan Janun Kunjbihari- Shri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Sambhram-Manalila (10)
hindi_text: (Raag Kalingada)Main Kahaan Jaanoon Kunjbihari.Kihi Kaaran Roothi Hai Tum Son, Chandramukhi Vrishabhaankumaari. [1]Jab Te Uthi Priya Sovat Ten, Tabhi Son Man Mein Ris Bhaari.Na Jaanoon Kachhu Sapne Mein Un, Dekhi Hai Kartooti Tihaari. [2]Thaade Rahau Bheetar Mati Jaavau, Preetam Maano Kahi Hamaari.Naaraayan Jo Bhuj Gahi Rookoon, Phir Kahaan Baat Rahe Giridhaari. [3]- Shri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Sambhram-Manalila (10)A Sakhi says to Krishna -O Kunja-Bihari! I don’t know for what reason the moon-faced daughter of King Vrishabhanu, Shri Radha, is upset with You. [1]Ever since she woke up from sleep, she has been visibly annoyed. Perhaps she saw something in a dream, maybe one of Your mischiefs, or if something else is the matter, I am not very sure. [2]Now, stay right here; do not go inside. O Beloved! Please listen to me. If you try to step in, I will hold your arm and stop you, and remember that won’t go well for you, O Giridhari! [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Daas Kain To Raavari Ye - Shri Ratan Ali
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Daas Kain To Raavari Ye Aas Bisvaas Driddh,Kaun Ke Bharosain Tum Hai Udaas Rahe Maun.Aeho Shyaam Bhaarat Pukaarat Hūn Baar-Baar,Tārat Sune Ho Aage Kari, Kahi Dūr Gaun.Biradain Vichaar Nirday Na Hou Hirdai Mein,Dardai Pichhaanin Amain Baradain Na Hou Toin.Hansi Kī Na Baat Ab To Hūn Dūbiyo Jaat,Thāre Dekhat Kahaa Meri Naav Paar Karo Kyoon Na?- Shri Ratan AliO Śyāmsundara! This servant has firm hope and trust only in You; I have no refuge except Yours. Then why do You remain silent and upset? [1]O Lord! I am repeatedly calling out to You with deep anguish. You have always rescued the distressed the moment they cried to You — then why have You turned Your face away from me? [2]O Lord! The Vedas, scriptures, and all saints declare that You are the shelter of the shelterless and an ocean of compassion. Please remember these divine titles of Yours and don’t be so harsh with me. Recognize my pain — no one grants blessings greater than You. [3]This is no longer a laughing matter — I am drowning! Why do You simply stand there watching? Why don’t You help my boat cross to the shore? [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Na Lokachcha Bhayam Kimchita Na - Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (99)
hindi_text: Na Lokachcha Bhayam Kimchita Na Cha Nigamatah Kimchita. Na Sprriha Samprada‌yadervayam Radhapadepsava.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (99)The devotion to Shri Radha’s feet is so miraculous that there remains no fear of the world, nor of the bindings of the Vedas and scriptures. Moreover, the exclusive devotee of Her lotus feet holds no desire to adopt any particular sampradāya (sect); he has only one longing — to selflessly serve the lotus feet of Shri Radha with exclusive loving sentiment.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sharan Shri Vrindavan Ki Jaiye - Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
hindi_text: (Raag Gaud Saarang)Sharan Shri Vrindavan Ki Jaiye.Yugal Bihari Charan Kamal Son, Nish Din Neh Lagaiye. [1]Seva Kunj Sameep Baithke, Dampati Dhyaan Samaiye.Hoy Bhaavna Siddh Sahaj Hi, Nirakhi Nayan Hulasaiye. [2]Lele Seet Rasik Santan Ki, Baadha Bhookh Bhagaiye.Sheetal Sundar Jal Yamuna Ko, Pee Pee Pyaas Mitaiye. [3]Radhe Shyaam Naam Rat Rasna, Aansoo Drigan Bahaiye.Sarasamadhuri Piy Pyari Ke, Prem Pulak Gun Gaiye. [4]- Shri Saras MadhuriSeek refuge in Shri Vrindavan. Day and night, love the lotus feet of the Yugala Bihari (Shri Radha-Krishna). [1] Sit near Seva Kunj and meditate upon the divine couple, where bhāva is naturally accomplished, and the eyes become joyous upon beholding their form. [2] Satisfy the hunger by accepting the leftovers of rasik saints, and quench your thirst by drinking the cool waters of Shri Yamuna. [3] While chanting the names of “Radhe Shyam”, shed tears of love from your eyes. Shri Saras Madhuri says — be immersed in the nectar of the divine couple and sing their glories, filled with pure love. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sadhu Sang Mein Sukh Bado Jo Kari Janai Koy - Shri Dayabai
hindi_text: Sadhu Sang Mein Sukh Bado, Jo Kari Janai Koy. Aadho Cheen Satsang Ko, Kalamakh Darai Khoy. - Shri DayabaiOnly one who truly engages in the association of saints knows the immense bliss it bestows. It is so precious that even half a moment spent in their association is enough to destroy all sins.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Radharaman Nukile Nain - Shri Gunmanjari Das
hindi_text: Shri Radharaman Nukile Nain.Vedhe Braj Yuvatin Man Manik, Kahat Bane Nahi Bain. [1]Kal Na Parat Pal Meri Sajni, Kaha Divas Kaha Rain. Gun Manjari Bade Chanchal Hain, Anchal Son Karen Sain. [2]- Shri Gunmanjari DasThe eyes of Shri Radharaman are extremely sharp, piercing the gem-like hearts of the young maidens of Braj. Such is the power of His gaze that words fail to describe it. [1]O dear sakhi! Ever since His eyes struck me, I have found no peace, not even for a moment—the distinction between day and night has vanished. Shri Gunmanjari Das says: His large, restless eyes are constantly making gestures of divine love-bliss with their unique expressions. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhajaum To Gupala Hi Kaum - Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Vinay Prem Pachasa (21)
hindi_text: (Kavitta)Bhajaum To Gupala Hi Kaum Sevaum To Gupalai Eka,Mero Mana Lagyo Saba Bha.nti Namdalala Som. [1]Mere Deva Devi Guru Mata Pita Bamdhu Ishta, Mitra Sakha Hari Nato Eka Gopabala Som. [2]'Harichamda' Aura Som Na Mero Sambamdha Kachu, Asaro Sadaiva Eka Lochana Visala Som. [3]Mangom To Gupala Som Na Ma.ngom To Gupala Hi Som, Rijhaum To Gupala Pai Au Khijhaum To Gupala Som. [4]- Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Vinay Prem Pachasa (21)If I worship, it is only Gopāl; if I serve, it is Gopāl alone — my mind is wholly attached to Nandalāl. [1]My god, goddess, guru, mother, father, kinsmen, worshipful deity, or friend — every relation is with that cowherd boy, Lord Krishn. [2]Harichand declares, I know no other; my eternal shelter lies with that Lotus‑eyed Lord. [3]If I ask, it is from Gopāl; if I don’t ask, still I will love Gopāl; if pleased, it is with Gopāl, and even when I am annoyed, it is with Him alone — everything begins and ends with Him. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nek Viloki Ri Ik Vaar - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya
hindi_text: Nek Viloki Ri! Ik Vaar,Jo Toon Preeti Karan Ki Gaahak, Mohan Hain Rijhwaar. [1]Maha Roop Ki Raasi Naagari, Naagar Nandkumar,Haav Bhaav Leela Lalchohin, Laalan Naval Vihaar. [2]Mohi Bharoso ShyamSundar Kau, Kari Raakhyo Niradhaar,Nek Ek Pal Jo Abhilaasen, Rooprasik Balihaar. [3]- Shri Roop Rasik DevacharyaO friend, look closely just once; if you truly seek love, know that Sri Krishn is the one who charms every heart. [1]Shri Radha is the treasury of supreme beauty, and Nanda’s son is a connoisseur of love; their gestures, moods, and pastimes awaken desire - the Beloved’s sports are ever fresh. [2]I place all my trust in Shyamasundar, for He is the true shelter of shelterless like me. Whoever yearns sincerely even for a single moment—on such a one, says “Ruparasik,” I am wholly sacrificed. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sabhin Bhumi Gopal Ki Ya Mein Atak Kahan - Taj Begam
hindi_text: Sabhin Bhoomi Gopal Ki, Ya Mein Atak Kaha.Ja Ke Mann Mein Atak Hai, Soi Atak Raha.- Taj Begam (Taj Bibi)The entire land belongs to Lord Shri Krishna, who dwells in every particle. The world itself holds no obstacle—it’s the soul’s mind, entangled in attachment and hatred, that binds. When the mind is absorbed in the Lord’s bhajana, all entanglements vanish, and supreme fearlessness is attained.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dampati Dou Rajat Kunj Bhavan - Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki Vani (385)
hindi_text: (Raag Hameer).Dampati Dou Rajat Kunj Bhavan.Peet Kulhai Sir, Kati Piyarau Pat, Kundal Lalit Shravan. [1]Vijna-Biyar Dhorati Sakhi Niyare, Sheetal Lagat Pavan.Kumbhandas Govardhan-Dhar, Rijhavat Pyari Radha Ravan. [2]- Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki Vani (385)In the fragrant bower-palace, the Divine Couple, Shri Radha Krishna, sit gracefully. Krishna wears a golden pagaḍī (turban) upon His head, a yellow cloth around His waist, and dazzling earrings swing from His ears. [1]Nearby, a sakhi lovingly waves a fan, and its gentle breeze offers comfort to Prītama Pyārī. Shri Kumbhandas says: Shri Krishna, the lifter of the Govardhana Mountain, is delighting Radha Pyari with His sweet pastimes. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrindavan Ki Bhakti Ko Marm Na Jane Koy - Shri Tulsidas Ji Maharaj
hindi_text: Vrindavan Ki Bhakti Ko, Maram Na Jane Koy.Daar-Daar Paat-Paat Pe, Radhey Radhey Hoy.- Goswami Shri TulsidasUpon arriving in the divine land of Vrindavan, Goswami Shri Tulsidas was astonished to see the rasopāsanā bhakti (rasa worship) here. He said that no one can fully understand the secret of this rasopasana bhakti of Vrindavan. In Vrindavan, on every tree, every branch, and every leaf, the divine name “Radhey-Radhey” resounds constantly.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ham Janma Tasu Sikatasu - Sri Kuresh Swami (c. 1010 CE,  disciple of Sri Ramanujacharya)
hindi_text: Ham Janma Tasu Sikatasu Maya Na Labdham, Rase Tvaya Virahita Kila Gopa Kanya.Yastavaki Na Padapanaktijusho Jushantu, Nikshipya Tatra Nijama~ngamanataptama.- Sri Kuresh Swami (c. 1010 CE,  disciple of Sri Ramanujacharya)O Śyāmasundara! Alas! I was not even blessed to be born as a single dust-grain of Vṛndāvana’s sacred soil. What disfavor of Yours is this? When, during the Rāsa dance, the gopīs were burned by the fire of separation from You, they found relief by touching that very dust— dust sanctified by the traces of Your lotus footprints. O Lord, by the touch of those particles alone, the torment of longing is soothed, and the burning heart finds peace.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Chirjivao Vrishbhanu Dulari - Sri Ladili Lal
hindi_text: Chirjeevau Vrishbhanu Dulari. [1]Agam Nigam Puran Kahat Hain, Vidhi Ki Srishtin Ten Yah Nyari. [2]Keerti Kookh Kalpataruvar Bhai, Manvanchhit Phal Det Hain Pyari. [3]‘Ladili-Lal’ Janm Radhe Kau, Sab Braj Baji Hai Vadhai Mairi. [4]- Sri Ladili LalMay Sri Radha, the darling daughter of King Vrishbhanu, live forever — this is the auspicious prayer. The Vedas and scriptures declare that she is unparalleled beyond Brahma’s ordinary creation. [1]Born from Mother Kirti’s womb, she is like the supreme wish-fulfilling tree, granting everyone their heart’s desire. Shri Ladili Lala Ji says that on the birth festival of Shri Radha, the whole of Braj reverberated with celebration, saying, “Congratulations, O Sakhi!” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Janam Sunyo Shrikumari Ko Bhikshuk Aaye Dhay - Vraja Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Janama Sunyaum Shrikumari Kaum, Bhikshuka Aye Dhaya.Desha Desha Tem Guna Apa Apane, Aye Bhemta Banaya.- Vraja Ke DoheAs soon as the auspicious news of Shri Radha’s birth spread, mendicants and saintly souls rushed to Barsana. From distant lands and regions, people arrived with offerings, tokens of love humbly laid at Her lotus feet.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Badhai Aaj Shri Vrishbhanu Ke Dvar - Shri Rasik Govind
hindi_text: Badhai Aaj Shri Vrishbhanu Ke Dwaar. Nar Naari Sab Gaavain Bajavain, Naachat De-De Taar. [1]Pragati Kunwari Kishori Radha, Tribhuvan Ki Sirdar. Rasik Govind Abhiram Shyam Ki, Jeevani Praan Adhar. [2]- Shri Rasik GovindToday, there is a great celebration at the door of Shri Vrishbhanu. Men and women are singing, playing instruments, and dancing with joy. [1]Sri Rasik Govind says, She, the sovereign of the three worlds,  the very life and soul of the charming Shyamsundar, Kishori Radha, has appeared. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrishbhanu Bhavan Ko Bhaag Ri Barsane Ko Bhaag - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Vrishbhaanu Bhavan Ko Bhaag Ri, Barsane Ko Bhaag.Chir-Chirajiyon Laadli, Braj Jan Ko Anuraag.- Braj Ke DoheBlessed is the house of Vrishabhanu, Blessed, Blessed is the divine land of Barsana, where our beloved Ladliji manifested. May the source of life of the devotees of Braj, Sri Radha, live forever happy; this is our heartfelt blessing.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aaj Barsane Mangal Gai - Shri Bani Thani Ji
hindi_text: Aaj Barsane Mangal Gai. Kunwar Lali Ko Janm Bhayo Hai, Ghar Ghar Bajat Badhai. [1]Motin Chauk Puraavo, Gaavo Dehu Aasis Suhai. Rasik Bihari Ki Yah Jeevani, Pragat Bhai Sukhdai. [2]- Shri Bani Thani JiAuspicious songs are sung in Barsana today. Ladli Shri Radha is manifested today, and every home is filled with joyous celebrations. [1]The courtyards are beautifully decorated with pearls, and everyone is singing songs to offer their blessings. Shri Bani Thani Ji says that the appearance of Shri Radha, who is the life-treasure of the Rasikas and Lord Shri Krishna, is supremely blissful for all. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ab Kou Kaho Koor Kutil Yah - Sri Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (16)
hindi_text: Ab Kou Kaho Koor Kutil Yah, Kaami Kripan Kaho Kou Mauni.Yaun Kautik Kripa Nirakhai Nitya, Shrinagridasi Liyein Ras Thauni.- Shri Nagri Dev, Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (16)O brother! Let people call us cruel, miserly, cunning, lustful, or even mute — we no longer concern ourselves with such worldly opinions. By the divine grace of Shri Swami Haridas Ji, we remain absorbed in lovingly beholding the eternal Nitya-Vihār (love-plays) of the divine couple uninterruptedly, like one who drinks milk straight from the udder of a cow with undivided focus.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Radhe Dai Vrindavan-Vaas - Shri Anandghan Ji, Shri Ghanananda Granthavali, Padavali (372)
hindi_text: (Raag Sarang Chautala)Radhe Dai Vrindavan-Vaas,Tero Hvai Man Panihi Pari Rahai, Tanhun Taahi Paas. [1]Mahaa Madhur Ras Keli-Maadhuri, Phurai Hiyai Anayaas,Hari Khari Sukh Bhari Nikunjai, Nau Nau Rang-Vikaas. [2]Jamuna-Teer Lalit Bansi-Dhuni, Adbhut Ami-Nivaas,Kripa-Ramand Ghamandani Aanandghan, Begi Puriyai Aas. [3]- Shri Anandghan Ji, Shri Ghanananda Granthavali, Padavali (372)O Sri Radhe, please grant me residence in Vrindavan! Let my mind become yours and remain surrendered like a water-carrier’s pot balanced on the head; let even my body stay close in your service in Vrindavan. [1]In the heart, may the sweetness of the divine love-sports (ras-keli) of the Yugal (Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa) arise effortlessly. In the intimate groves (nikunja), each day brings forth newer and newer colorful expressions of bliss. [2]On the banks of Yamuna, with the enchanting melody of Kṛṣṇa’s flute, dwells an extraordinary nectar-filled abode. O Shri Radhe! Please shower your mercy swiftly and fulfill this deep yearning of mine by granting me residence in that eternal Vrindavan. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Barsane Vrishabhana Gopa Ghar - Shri Kalyan Das
hindi_text: Barsane Vrishabhana Gopa Ghar, Sobha Ki Nidhi Ai Ri.Dhani-Dhani Kukha Mahari Kirati Ki, Jina Yaha Kanya Jai Ri. [1]Akhila Loka Bhuva Naga Loka Mein, Dekhi Suni Na Nikai Ri.Sindhusuta Girisuta Sachi Rati, Nahin Samana Kou Pai Ri. [2]Anamda Mudita Jasoda Rani, Kanhara Ki Karaum Sagai Ri.Prabhu Kalyana Giradhara Ki Jori, Vidhana Yahai Banai Ri. [3]- Shri Kalyan DasIn Barsana, at the house of King Vrishbhanu, the treasure of beauty, Sri Radha, has appeared. Blessed is the womb of Queen Kirti, who has given birth to such a daughter. [1]In all three worlds, no one has ever seen or heard of such beauty. Not even Lakshmi, Parvati, Indrani, or Rati (the wife of Kamadeva) can compare to this daughter. [2]On hearing the news of this girl’s birth, Yashoda Rani became overjoyed and thought to herself, “I will arrange the engagement of my Krishna with this daughter.” Kalyan Prabhu says that Brahma himself has destined Giridhar for this very match. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Yah Sukh Samujhan Ko Kachhu - Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Premavali (49)
hindi_text: Yah Sukh Samujhan Kaun Kachhu, Nahin Aan Upai.Prem Dareechi Jau Kabhun, Sahaj Kripa Khuli Jaai.- Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Premavali (49)The experience of this rasa of Vrindavan cannot be attained by any practice or method; it opens only through the causeless grace of Shri Radha. When, by Her mercy, the window of divine love opens, only then does the direct experience of this rasa become possible.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Koi Kahai Baikuntha - Shri Lalitkishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhaant Ki Saakhi (346)
hindi_text: Koi Kahai Baikuntha, Koi Kahai Brahma Hai.Koi Kahai Iha Rama, Koi Kahai Krishna Hai. [1]Koi Kahai Yaha Kunjani-Kunjani, Raas Kiyau Niradhara Hai.Hari Haan, Sabai Tajau Janjala, Bhajau Haridasa Kahyau Sukhasara Hai. [2]- Shri Lalitkishori Dev, Shri Lalitkishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhaant Ki Saakhi (346)Some describe Lord’s form as Vaikunthanath, some despicable Him as ‘Brahma’ (impersonal). Others describe Him as Lord of Ayodhya, Shri Ram, while some proclaim Him as Lord Shri Krishna. [1]Some describe Him as the One who performs Rāsa-vilās in the groves (kuṃjas). Shri Lalit Kishori Dev says — cast away all these confusions, and worship that Nitya Vihāra (eternal love-play) of the divine couple, which is the very essence of all nectars, worshipped by the crest-jewel of all, Swami Sri Haridas Ji Maharaj. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Basathi Vrindavipin Mein -  Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.49)
hindi_text: Basathi Vrindavipin Mein, Antar Karai Ju Koi.Tinkaun Ripu Badha Janiuaun, Takau Mukh Jin Joi.- Shri Ananya Ali, Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.49)One who creates an obstacle in residing in Shri Vrindavan Dham should be considered one’s greatest enemy, and one should not even glance at the face of such a wretched being.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Gun Gaavai Gopal Ke Bhari Laavai Drig Neer - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (171)
hindi_text: Gun Gaavai Gopal Ke, Bhari Laavai Drig Neer.Narayan Nahi Kal Parai, Bin Dekhe Balbeer. - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (171)Sing the glories of Gopal, and let your eyes overflow with tears. Shri Narayan Swami says that until he beholds Shri Krishna, the brother of Balram, his heart cannot find peace even for a single moment.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Tere Charanan Mein Bali Jaaun - Sri Bholi Gopi
hindi_text: Tere Charanan Mein Bali Jaaun. He Manmohan Shri Banwari, Darshan Se Sukh Paun. [1]Makhan Mishri Modak Meva, Prem Se Tohe Khilaun. Rom Rom Mein Teri Soorat, Ik Pal Bhool Na Paun. [2]Nand Gaon Gokul Govardhan, Braj Taj Anat Na Jaaun. ‘Bholi-Gopi’ Charanan Daasi, Jag Mein Teri Kahaun. [3]- Sri Bholi GopiI lay my life at your feet, O enchantingly sweet Lord Krishn; your darshana fills my heart with joy. [1]With love, I offer you butter, sugar candies, sweets, and dry fruits. Your form dwells in every pore of me; I cannot forget you for even a moment. [2]I will never leave Nand Gaun, Gokul, Govardhan, or the sacred land of Braj. Says Bholi-Gopi, I wish to be known in this world only as a humble servant at Your feet. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Praan Jeevan Ke Neh Mein Tan Mann Se Rahe Chur - Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Rasik Pacchisi (10)
hindi_text: Praan Jeevan Ke Neh Mein, Tan Man Se Rahe Choor,Ghar Men Kai Ban Men Rahen, Soi Rasikjan Soor.- Shri Roopmadhuri, Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Rasik Pacchisi (10)One whose body and mind remain immersed in the love of his Beloved Lord is the true (courageous) rasika. Whether He stays in a household or the forest, his heart remains forever absorbed in that divine love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Bishok Nandini Binu Kau Hai - Shri Vanshi Ali, Siddhant Ke Pad (37)
hindi_text: Shri Bishok Nandini Binu Kau Hai,Ham Se Adham Aur Nirbahak, Yah Jas Aur Ko Sohai. [1]Jaako Man In Pad Ras Lagyau, So Kyon Sakai Ik Chhin Kavi Chhohai.Jai Shri Bansi Ali Shri Radha, Jeevan Dhan Jako Badan Kunwari Nit Jauhai. [2]- Shri Vanshi Ali, Siddhant Ke Pad (37)Who, other than Shri Bishok Nandini (Shri Lalita Sakhi), could uplift and sustain a fallen soul like me? Such unparalleled mercy and divine glory befit only her, for no one else could carry such grace. [1]One whose heart is deeply immersed in the nectar of Shri Lalita Sakhi’s lotus feet can never be deprived of her grace, even for a moment—because she is the living embodiment of Radha-prem, the divine love for Shri Radharani. Shri Vamshi Ali Ji says—“All glories to Shri Lalita Sakhi, for whose soul, very breath, and all wealth of life, Shri Radharani alone is everything. It is her lotus face that ever-youthful Sri Radha constantly beholds with love.” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Gati Garaveeli Dekhi Ke Maanat Man Mein Laaj - Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket Lata (92)
hindi_text: Gati Garaveeli Dekhi Ke, Maanat Man Mein Laaj,Yaahi Te Lai Dhoori Nij, Shir Daarat Gajaraj.- Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket Lata (92)Upon seeing the graceful and majestic gait of Shri Radharani, even the mighty king of elephants feels ashamed within himself. So subdued is he that he humbly bows down, takes the dust of Her feet, and places it upon his head—honoring the Queen of Vrindavan with all his pride cast aside.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Radha Mohan Isht Nij Misht Na Tin Sam Aur - Shri Charan Das
hindi_text: Radha Mohan Isht Nij, Misht Na Tin Sam Aur.Avtaran Avtaari Jo, Sabhin Ken Sirmaur.- Shri Charan DasThe divine couple, Sri Radha Krishn are my beloved worshipful deities; None is sweeter or dearer than them. They are the origin of all divine incarnations— The crown jewel, the supreme of all.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Lochan Bhaye Syam Ke Chere - Shri Surdas, Sura Sagara
hindi_text: (Raag Ramkali)Lochan Bhaye Shyam Ke Chere,Aite Pai Sukh Paavat Kotik, Motan Pheri Na Here. [1]Haaha Karat Parat Hari Charanani, Aise Bas Bhaye Unhi,Unko Badan Vilokat Nisi-Din, Merau Kahyo Na Sunhi. [2]Lalit Tribhangi Chhavi Par Atke, Phatke Moson Tori,‘Sur’ Dasa Yah Meri Kinhī, Aapun Hari Saun Jori. [3]- Shri Surdas, Sura SagaraMy eyes have become servants of the enchanting form of Shyamasundar. In this sweet bondage, they find such joy that they no longer even glance back at me. [1]I begged them, prayed at the Lord’s lotus feet, but they remain forever lost in His darshan, deaf to my voice. [2]So enchanted are they by His elegant ‘tribhangi’  (threefold-curved) form that they’ve broken all ties with me. Shri Surdas says: These eyes, devoted only to Him, have left me utterly helpless. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mo Sam Kaun Kutil Avichari - Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Vinay (11)
hindi_text: (Raag Paraj Va Khmmach)Mo Sam Kaun Kutil Avichaari,Jihin Rasna Ras Naam Tyaag Ke, Nishidin Baatein Bakat Labaari. [1]Je Akhiyaan Taj Yugal Roop Ras, Chhaki Rahat Nit Neh Sut-Naari, Je Kar Dampati Charan Palotat, Lage Haran Pardhan Dukh Bhaari. [2]Nishidin Aas Vaas Vrindavan, Roop Sudhaaras Peevau Pyaari,Kripa Drishti Dukh Hero Mo Tan, Lalit Ladeti Sharan Tihari. [3]- Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Vinay (11)Who could be more wicked and thoughtless than me, who abandoned the nectar-like name from the tongue and instead wastes day and night in meaningless chatter? [1]These eyes, meant for beholding the nectarine beauty of the Divine Couple, are instead intoxicated by worldly attachments of sons and wife. These hands, which were meant to serve the lotus feet of the couple lovingly, are instead used to grasp the wealth of others, becoming burdened with sin. [2]Now my only hope is to reside in Shri Vrindavan and drink the beauty of Pyariju (Sri Radha) with every breath. Shri Lalit Ladaiti cries, “O sweet Radha, I am surrendered unto You—please grace me with Your merciful glance and dispel all my sorrows.” [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Rangili Galin Bich Ho Ho Hori - Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Utsav Mala (143)
hindi_text: Rangili Galin Bich Ho Ho Hori.It Nandanandan Rasik Ladilo, Ut Vrishbhan Kisori. [1]Udat Gulal Kachhu Nahin Soojhat, Jhakjhoro Jhakjhori.Nagaridas Paraspar Dharat, Bhar Bhar Kanak Kamori. [2]- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh Ji), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Utsav Mala (143)In the Raṇgīlī galī of Barsānā, the festival of Holī is being celebrated with boundless joy. On one side stands the charming son of Nanda, the rasika Śrī Kṛṣṇa; on the other side is Vṛṣabhānu’s beloved daughter, Śrī Rādhā, standing amidst Her sakhīs. [1]Crimson clouds of gulāl rise in all four directions, spreading such a hue that nothing remains clearly visible. Gentle laughter, playful teasing, lively gestures, and love-filled exchanges transform the entire atmosphere into sweetness itself. Śrī Nāgarīdāsa describes how the divine couple, Rādhā Kṛṣṇa, fill golden vessels with colors and pour them upon one another in loving sport, making this Holī truly unparalleled and wondrous. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Priya Piy Chhabi Lakhi Chhakani Chhakayi - Shri Sarasmadhuri
hindi_text: (Raag Vihag)Priya Piy Chhabi Lakhi Chhakani Chhakayi.Phaag Khel Khilavaar Paraspar, Tanaman Mudit Mahayi. [1]Yugmachand Sahchari Chakori, Prem Preeti Pragatayi.Sarasmadhuri Saanvri Gori, Jori Drigan Basayi. [2]- Shri SarasmadhuriŚrī Priyā (Rādhā) and Her beloved Priyatama (Kṛṣṇa) gaze upon one another’s beauty and are utterly intoxicated in love. Absorbed in the playful sport of Holī, Their bodies and hearts are immersed in the nectar of this divine festival. [1]Just as the chakora bird fixes its longing gaze upon the moon, so the sakhīs, like devoted chakorīs, behold this divine Yugala-chandra (Śrī Rādhā Kṛṣṇa) lovingly. Śrī Sarasamādhurī declares that this unparalleled pair of dark and fair complexion has permanently enshrined within his eyes. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Naam Liyain Patik Katein - Shri Guruchauna Ji Maharaj
hindi_text: Naam Liyain Patik Katen, Pahunchai Hari Ke Des.‘Chhauna’ Ke Girahi Japau, Kai Ateet Ke Bhes.- Shri Guruchauna Ji MaharajThrough chanting the Holy Name of the Lord, all sins are destroyed, and the soul ultimately reaches the sacred abode of Hari. Śrī Chaunā Jī Mahārāja teaches that whether one is a householder or a renunciate, the fruit of the Name is the same. External form or attire has no real importance; the essence lies entirely in sincere remembrance of the Divine Name.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hai Hari Te Harinam Badero - Shri Gadadhar Bhatt Ji Ki Vani (15)
hindi_text: Hai Hari Ten Harinam Badero, Tako Moodh Karat Kat Jhero.Pragat Daras Muchukundahi Deenho, Tahu Ayusu Bho Tap Kero.Sut-Hit Naam Ajamila Leeno, Ya Bhav Mein Na Kiyo Phiri Phero. [1]Par-Apavad Svad Jiyo Rachyo, Vritha Karat Bakvad Ghanero.Tako Dasyo Ans ‘Gadadhar’, Hari Hari Kahat Jat Kaha Tero. [2]- Shri Gadadhar Bhatt Ji, Shri Gadadhar Bhatt Ji Ki Vani (15)The Holy Name of Lord Hari is even greater than Hari Himself. O foolish one, why do you hesitate to accept this truth? Consider the evidence—King Mucakuṇda was granted direct darśana of the Lord, yet he was instructed to continue his austerities. However, the sinful Ajāmila merely called out the name “Nārāyaṇa” while addressing his son, and by the power of that very Name, the attendants of Viṣṇu came to protect him. Thereafter, engaging in devotion, he became forever freed from the cycle of birth and death. Thus, the merciful Name of the Lord was the guiding mentor in his redemption. [1]Why do you waste your time in meaningless talk and worldly gossip? Śrī Gadādhara Jī says: Of the time you waste in meaningless talks, if even one-tenth were spent chanting “Hari, Hari,” what harm would come to you? Even a slight effort in this direction would secure your highest good. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Chal Na Sakai Nij Thaur Tain Je Tan Hum Abhiram - Shri Rasnidhi
hindi_text: Chal Na Sakai Nij Thaur Tain, Je Tan Drum Abhiram.Tahan Aai Ras Varasivau, Lajim Tuhi Ghanasyam.- Shri RasnidhiO Cloud! Just as the trees stand helpless, unable to walk toward water, it is your duty to bring rain to them. Similarly, when a soul becomes tired of wandering through countless lives and fully surrenders, Lord Ghanshyam Himself draws near, shelters that soul, and showers it with divine nectarous grace.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Namo Namo Ju Bhakti Rijhvaar - Shri Vrindavan Das Ji
hindi_text: Namo Namo Ju Bhakti Rijhvaar.Naam Vidit Gopeshwar Jinkau,Te Vrinda Kanan Kutuvaar. [1]Yaatra Sufal Hot Bas Jabahin,Jo Raj Vandai In Darbaar.‘Vrindavan Hit’ Roop Sakhi Vapu,Sevat Dampati Nitya Vihaar. [2]- Shri Hita Vrindavan DasI bow again and again to that Lord Śiva who is pleased solely by ‘Bhakti’ (devotion). Renowned throughout the world as Gopeśvara — the Lord of the gopīs — He stands as the guardian and protector of Vṛndāvana. [1]A pilgrimage to Braj is considered truly successful only when one comes before Gopeśvara, beholds His darśana, and places upon one’s head the sacred dust of this holy place. Śrī Hita Vṛndāvana Dāsa declares that Gopeśvara Mahādeva assumes the form of a sakhī within the forest bowers, where he serves the divine couple, Śrī Rādhā Kṛṣṇa, and drinks the nectar of Their eternal Nitya Vihāra Rasa. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vamukh Ki Aasha Lagi - Shri Madhuri Das, Utkantha Madhuri (28)
hindi_text: Vamukh Ki Aasha Lagi, Taji Aas Sab Jog.Ab Swasa Hu Tajegi, Jo Na Bane Sanjog.- Shri Madhuri Das, Utkantha Madhuri (28)My longing is solely for the darśana of the lotus-like faces of the divine couple, Śrī Rādhā–Kṛṣṇa. I have abandoned all other paths, including yogic practices. If their union is not bestowed upon me soon, these very breaths of life will depart.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Brindaban Khelat Hari Hori - Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar
hindi_text: (Raag Kalyan)Brindaban Khelat Hari Hori.Bajat Taal Mridang Jhanjh Daf, Nand Lala Vrishbhanu Kishori. [1]Haun Apnai Grih Tain Nikasi Sakhi, Saas Ki Traas Nanad Ki Chori.Aur Sakhi Sab Chhandi Syaam Mo, Kar Marori Pahunchi Gahi Tori. [2]Syaam Baran Ati Sundar Sanwaro, Kanak Badan Radhe Tanu Gori.Surdas Ke Prabhu Doou Raajat, Paaras Kanchan Ki Si Jori. [3]- Sri Surdas, Soor SagarIn Vṛndāvana, Lord Hari (Śrī Kṛṣṇa)  is joyfully playing Holī. The rhythms of tāla, mṛdaṅga (a double-sided drum), jhāñjha (cymbals), and ḍapha (tambourine) are being played in every direction, as Nandalāla (Kṛṣṇa) and Vṛṣabhānu-kiśorī (Rādhā) together celebrate the festival in delight. [1]O sakhī! With great difficulty, I escaped my house, avoiding the watchful eyes of my mother-in-law and sister-in-law. There, Śyāmsundara left aside all the other sakhīs and grabbed only my hand, gently twisting it in loving mischief. [2]Sūradāsa says: the dark handsome Kṛṣṇa and molten gold like Rādhā, shine together like the touchstone and gold paired as one. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ved Bhed Paayo Nahin - Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Bhakta Sarvasva (8)
hindi_text: Ved Bhed Paayo Nahin, Bhae Puran Puran.Smritihu Ki Sab Smriti Gai, Pai Na Mile Bhagwan.- Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Bhakta Sarvasva (8)The Vedas failed to grasp His mystery, and the Purāṇas grew ancient in their search, yet could not fathom His depth. The Smṛtis lost all consciousness attempting to comprehend Him. The essence is that the realization of God is possible only through selfless love and complete surrender (śaraṇāgati).
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sakhi Sab Hve Gaye Laalhi Laal - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Hori Madhuri (24)
hindi_text: Sakhi! Sab, Hvai Gaye Laalhin Laal.Aiso Rang Chalyo Pichkarin, Aiso Udayo Gulaal. [1]Laali Laal, Laal Bhaye Laalhun, Laal Bhain Brajbaal.Taruwar Laal, Laal Bhaye Sarwar, Shuk, Pik Laal Maraal. [2]Dhenu Laal Brajrenu Laal Bhai, Laal Bhaye Sab Gwaal.Baahar Laal ‘Kripalu’ Faag Ko, Bheetar Laal Gupaal. [3]- Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Hori Madhuri (24)A sakhī, describing the Holī festival of Vṛndāvana to her intimate companion, says: “O friend! In the Holī of the divine couple, such streams of colored water were sprayed from waterguns, and such clouds of crimson powder arose, that everything was dyed red.” [1]Śyāmasundara became red, Kiśorī Jī too became red, the maidens of Braja were colored alike, and even the trees and lakes were covered in red. Parrots, cuckoos, and swans — all were transformed into the same hue. [2]All the cows and even the sacred dust of Braja were reddened, and every cowherd boy was covered in that same color. Jagadguru Śrī Kṛpālu Jī Mahārāja explains that outwardly all were colored by the red of Holī, yet inwardly every heart was drenched in loving devotion of Lāḍilī–Lāla. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Radhe Ju Ke Bhal Pe Bendi Ati Chhabi Dey - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Radhe Ju Ke Bhaal Pai, Vendi Ati Chhabi Dey.Maanau Phooli Ketaki, Bhamar Baas Tahan Ley.- Braj Ke DoheThe bindi adorning Rādhā’s forehead shines with exceptional beauty. It appears like a love-intoxicated bee gently relishing the sweet fragrance of a freshly blossomed ketakī flower.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kab In Nainani Te Lakhu Vrindavan Ki Dhuri - Shri Prabhudutt Brahmachari, Sri Vrindavan Mahatmya (2)
hindi_text: Kab In Nayananitai Lakhun, Vrindavan Ki Dhoori.Jo Rasikaniki Param Priya, Paavan Jeevan Moori.- Shri Prabhudutt Brahmachari, Sri Vrindavan Mahatmya (2)When shall I, with these very eyes, behold that supremely sacred ‘raja’ (sand) of Vṛndāvana — the raja that is supremely dear to the rasikas and the very source of their lives?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Khelat Faag Lakhyo Piy Pyari Ko - Shri Raskhan, Raskhan Ratnavali
hindi_text: (Savaiya)Khelat Faag Lakhyo Piy Pyari Ko, Ta Mukh Ki Upma Kihin Dijiye.Dekhat Hi Bani Aavai Bhalai, Rasikhan Kaha Hai Jo Baar Na Kijiye. [1]Jyaun Jyaun Chhabili Kahai Pichkari Lai, Ek Lai Yah Doosri Leejai.Tyaun Tyaun Chhabilo Chhke Chhabi Chaak So, Here Hanse Na Tare Kharo Bhije. [2]- Shri Raskhan, Raskhan RatnawaliA sakhī, describing the Phāg Līlā to her sakhi, says: “O friend! I have witnessed Kṛṣṇa and His beloved Rādhā playing Holī. How can one even attempt to compare the beauty of their faces? That vision alone is enough to captivate the heart; what object in the world could not be offered in reverence before such a sight?” [1]As the playful Śrī Rādhā wields Her water-gun, saying, “Take this one, and now take this other,” the charming Śyāmasundara becomes ever more intoxicated with the nectar of Her unparalleled beauty. He gazes upon Her ceaselessly, smiling, and does not move away, but stands fully drenched as though immersed in the very hues of Rādhā’s love. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shyam Roop Shri Radhika - Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Shrinikunj Prakash Ashtayam Mansi Sewa
hindi_text: Shyam Roop Shri Radhika, Radha Shyam Swaroop.Darshan Ko Ye Doy Hain, Ekai Roop Anoop.- Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli MadhuriŚrī Rādhā is the very form of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and Śrī Kṛṣṇa is in the very form of Śrī Rādhā. For the sake of darśana and līlā, they may appear as two; however, they are eternally one.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aaj Sakhi Van Ki Sobha Dekhi - Sri Thakur Das Ju Ki Vani, Pad (3)
hindi_text: Aaj Sakhi Van Ki Sobha Dekhi.Vimal Kamal Rang Ati Phule, Jamuna Jalhi Visekhi. [1]Saras Hans Paraspar Naachat, Kok Paphahiya Pekhi.Mor Chakor Sor Pik Bhavai, Gaavat Ati Ras Rekhi. [2]Lata Lalit Chahun Disi Ras Jhoomin, Inki Taraf Nirekhi.Thakur Sakhi Ya Chhabi Ko Dekhat, Shri Haridas Samekhi. [3]- Shri Thakur Das, Sri Thakur Das Ju Ki Vani, Pad (3)A sakhī tells her friend: “O friend! Witness the unmatched beauty of Vṛndāvana’s forest today! In the sacred waters of Śrī Yamunā, the lotuses bloom fully, a truly enchanting sight.” [1]Cranes and swans dance gracefully, while the cuckoo and papihā delight all hearts. The harmonious calls of peacocks, partridges, and cuckoos fill the air with songs of love. [2]Beautiful creepers sway joyfully in all directions. Śrī Ṭhākura Sakhī says that the sakhīs behold this transcendental vision, where Svāmī Śrī Haridāsa is present alongside His worshipful deities, Śrī Kunjabihārī and Śrī Kunja Biharīṇī. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Tum Jaan Ayogya Bisaro Mujhe - Braj Ke Sawaiya
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Tum Jaan Ayogya Bisaro Mujhe, Par Main Na Tumhen Bisaraya Karun.Gunagaan Karun Tera Dhyan Karun, Tum Maan Karo Main Manaya Karun. [1]Tere Hi Pujariyon Ki Pad-Dhuri, Main Nitya Hi Shish Chadhaya Karun.Tere Bhakt Ki Bhakti Karun Main Sada, Tere Chahne Walon Ko Chaha Karun. [2]- Braj Ke SawaiyaO Kṛṣṇa, even if You consider me unworthy and choose to forget me, still bestow such grace upon me that I may never forget You. May I forever sing Your divine glories, meditate upon You without cease, and when You show loving sulk, may I gently and devotedly strive to appease You. [1]Make my heart so pure that I may daily put the sacred dust of Your devotees’ feet over my head lovingly. May I remain ever engaged in serving Your devotees, and may I constantly love those who love You selflessly. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Daya Prem Unmat Je Tann Ki Tani Sudhi Nahin - Shri Dayabai
hindi_text: ‘Daya’ Prem Unmatt Je, Tan Ki Tani Sudhi Naahin.Jhuke Rahein Hari Ras Chhake, Thake Nem Vrat Naahin.- Shri DayabaiDayābāī says that those who are absorbed in divine love of God lose all awareness of bodily consciousness. They are so immersed in the nectar of Śrī Hari that external injunctions and prohibitions, vows, and ritual observances no longer hold any special significance for them.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Lagyo Neh Sab Bhanti Nibhaiho - Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer (415)
hindi_text: Lagyo Neh Sab Bhanti Nibhaiho.Ye Mere Man Sudridh Bharoso, Baanh Gahe Ki Laaj Lajaeho. [1]Lok Ved Parlok Jati Kul, Paap Punya Dukh Dvand Chhudeho.‘Bhori’ Apni Jani Kripa Kari, Shri Pad Pankaj Subas Basaiho. [2]- Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer (415)O dearest Pyārī Jū (Śrī Rādhā), now that the sacred knot of love has been tied between us, I trust completely that You will sustain it. I know that by Your merciful nature, anyone whose hand You accept becomes Yours forever. Surely You will preserve the honor of one who has surrendered at Your feet. [1]Śrī Bhorī Sakhī humbly prays: bestow such grace that, freeing me from the constraints of worldly decorum, the bindings of the Vedas, fear of the next world, pride of family and status, and the dualities of sin and virtue, I may dwell eternally at the refuge of Your lotus feet. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kaam Na Aave Kaun Hu - Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (364)
hindi_text: Kaam Na Aavai Kaun Hoon, Ati Aparas Aachaar.Ant Nibaahai Prem Heen, Chhaande Khaat Kau Dwar.- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (364)Many people remain entangled throughout their lives in notions of saparasa and aparasa, or in external practices and rituals. At the moment of death, nothing proves of any use. Only the pure love offered to the Lord sustains; nothing else. That love alone has the power to carry the soul across the vast ocean of illusion.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aaj Khelen Hori Nav Nagari -  Shri Govindsharan Devacharya Ji Ki Vani (151)
hindi_text: (Rag Paraj)Aaj Khelen Hori Nav Nagari.Saras Gulal Dar Pritam Pai, Sakal Kala Gun Agari. [1]Shri Vrishbhan Bhavan Mein Sajni, Phaili Rahyo Anurag Ri.Kirti Kul Kirti Gavati Lakhi, Gobind Saran Badhbhag Ri. [2]- Shri Govind Sharan Devacharya, Shri Govindsharan Devacharya Ji Ki Vani (151)Today, the ever-youthful, Śrī Rādhā Nāgarī, is playing Holī. She, who is the foremost adept in all arts and virtues, showers delightful gulāla (red powder) upon Her beloved Śyāmasundara. [1]O sakhī! Within the palace of Śrī Vṛṣabhānu, a divine love is overflowing everywhere. The entire lineage of Mother Kīrti (the family and companions) is singing the glories of Śrī Rādhā; beholding this sight, Śrī Govindaśaraṇa considers himself most fortunate. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vyas Na Vyapak Dekhiye Nirgun Pare Na Jaani - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (07)
hindi_text: Vyas Na Vyapak Dekhiye, Nirgun Pare Na Jaani.Tab Bhaktani Hita Autare, (Shri) Radhavallabh Aani.- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Saakhi (07)Śrī Harirāma Vyāsa Jī declares that the Supreme Brahma, being all-pervading, remains invisible to the mundane eyes, and being beyond attributes (nirguṇa), is incomprehensible to the intellect. Thus, for the welfare of His devotees and to grant them the relish of divine rasa, that Supreme Personality has manifested visibly in the form of Śrī Rādhāvallabha.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kunj Mahal Rang Ho Ho Hori- Shri Vanshi Ali Ji, Varshotsav, Basant Ke Pad (15)
hindi_text: (Rag Gauri)Kunj Mahal Rang Ho Ho Hori,Khelat Naval Kishor Kishori.Bajat Taal Mridang Jhajh Dhap,Abir Gulal Udaavat Jhori. [1]Naachat Sakhi Jan Jhamak Mil Mil,Gavati Gari Lal Saun Jori.Hansat Hansavati Nij Swamin Ko,Shri Lalit Sakhi Jaishri ‘Banshi Ali’ Mori. [2]- Shri Vanshi Ali Ji, Varshotsav, Basant Ke Pad (15)In the kuṃja mahala (palace of the groves), the festival of Holī is in full bloom, where the eternally youthful pair, Śrī Rādhā Kṛṣṇa, are joyfully playing the Holī of divine love. The rhythms of tāla, mṛdaṅga (a double-sided drum), jhāñjha (cymbals), and ḍapha (tambourine) are being played, while heaps of abīra (scented powder) and gulāl (red powder) are being thrown by the sakhī’s. [1]The sakhīs dance together with rhythmic harmony, collectively singing playful and teasing songs (gārī) directed at the Beloved Śrī Lāla Jī. Śrī Vanśī Ali’s guru, Śrī Lalitā Sakhī, is laughing heartily and also bringing smiles to Her Sovereign Queen Śrī Rādhā during this celebration. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage
