hindi_text: Terat Shyamashyam Ko, ‘Daya’ Virah Vihal.Ek Divas Kahun Kunj Mein, Mile Ladali Laal.- Shri DayabaiThrough this couplet, Dayābāī Jī expresses the divine experience of beholding Śyāmā-Śyāma in Śrī Vṛndāvana Dhāma. She says, lost in the burning pain of separation, she cried out again and again, calling “Śyāmā-Śyāma,” until one day, in a secluded kuñja, the divine Couple, Lāḍilī Lāl, revealed Themselves to her. In that single moment, her life transformed into complete fulfillment.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kishori Main To Bhali Buri So Teri - Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (16)
hindi_text: (Rag Khanjanakshi Or Asavari) Kishori Main To Bhali Buri So Teri. Rahun Vikal Din Rat Virah Men, Suniyo Araj Saveri. [1] Man Ki Bat Chhupi Nahin Tum Som, Kariye Nahin Deri. Ab Jin Karo Aber Ladaiti, Rakhiya Charnan Neri. [2] Avagun Mere Sakal Visaro, Jan Apani Cheri. ‘Rupmadhuri’ Apani Kijai, Prem Najar Bhar Heri. [3]- Shri Roop Madhuri, Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (16)O Kiśorī Śrī Rādhe, whatever I may be — good or bad — I belong to You alone. I am restless day and night in the agony of your separation; kindly hear my call without delay. [1]Nothing within my heart is hidden from You, so please do not postpone Your grace any longer. O my beloved Sovereign, delay no more — keep me forever near Your lotus feet. [2]Forgetting all my faults, please accept me as Your maidservant. Śrī Rūpamādhurī says: with Your loving, compassionate glance, make me Your own anyhow. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Narayan Dukh Sukh Ubhai - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (101)
hindi_text: Narayan Dukh Sukh Ubhai, Bhramat Yatha Din Raat,Bin Bulay Jyon Aa Rahen, Bina Kahe Tyon Jaat.- Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (101)Joy and sorrow, like the cycle of day and night, come and go in life without being invited. Therefore, a wise person should remain calm in both situations and continue moving forward on the path without becoming disturbed.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dulah Madangopal Radha Nav Dulahi - Shri Surdas Madanmohan Ji Ki Padavali (47)
hindi_text: (Raag Dhanashri)Dulah Madangopal, Radha Nav Dulahi. Manon Taru Tamal Mili Nutan, Kanak-Beli Ulahi. [1] Rup-Bhup Yubaraj Birajat, Bais Kisor Ek Tulahi. Madanmohan Prabhu Sur Su Jivani, Jiya Men Huti Sulahi. [2]- Shri Surdas Madanamohan (of Gaudiya sect.), Surdas Madanmohan Ji Ki Padavali (47)Śrī Madanagopāla, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, stands as the bridegroom, and Śrī Rādhā appears as His ever-new bride. The beauty of this divine Couple shines so gracefully, appearing as if a golden vine is gracefully entwining itself around a newly blossomed tamāla tree. [1]This divine couple, the sovereigns of the empire of beauty, are seated together, their youthful forms perfectly match with one another. Sūradāsa Madanamohana Jī says: this Yugala Sarkāra alone is the foundation of my life, and beholding Them in this form today has fulfilled the yearning desire of my heart. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mana Nag Tako Dijiye Jo Prem Parkhi Hoy - Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (29)
hindi_text: Mana Nag Tako Dijiye, Jo Prem Paarkhi Hoy.Natar Rahiye Maun Vahe, Kahe Jivan Khoy.- Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (29)One should surrender the priceless jewel-like heart only to one who is a true connoisseur of love — a genuine rasika saint. If such a knower of love is not found, it is better to remain silent. What is the benefit of wasting this precious life in the company of those who cannot understand its true value?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aise Basie Braj Ki Bithini - Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar (1108)
hindi_text: (Raag Sarang)Aisen Basie Braj Ki Bithini. Gvaran Ke Panvare Chuni-Chuni, Udar Bharijai Sithini. [1] Painde Ke Sab Brichha Birajat, Chhaya Param Punitani. Kunj-Kunj-Prati Loti-Loti, Braj-Raj Lagai Rang-Ritani. [2] Nisi Din Nirakhi Jasoda-Nandan, Aru Jamuna-Jal Pitani. Parasat Sur Hot Man Pavan, Darasan Karat Atitani. [3]- Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar (1108)Brahmā says, one should live in the lanes of Braja in such a way that one sustains oneself through the remnants of food left upon the leaf-plates of the Brajavāsīs and cowherds. [1]This is my supreme longing — that I may reside along those paths adorned with big, shady trees, and roll again and again in the groves, covering my body with the sacred dust of Braja, so that my heart may become saturated with the color of divine love and devotion. [2]While living there, may I behold Śrī Kṛṣṇa day and night and partake of the waters of Yamunā. Sūradāsa says that by the mere touch of this sacred dust and the devotional contact of Yamunā Jī, the mind becomes pure and sanctified, and thus the vision of Śrī Kṛṣṇa becomes easily attainable. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mrignaini Aamodani Mahamod Ki Raas - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Mrignaini Aamodani, Mahamod Ki Raas.Giri Ban Pulin Vilasini, Moman Karhu Nivaas.- Braj Ke DoheO Śrī Rādhā Mahārāṇī, whose eyes are as graceful as a deer, who bestows bliss and is the very embodiment of supreme happiness — O my Svāminī, who performs Her loving pastimes in Govardhana, in the forests of Vṛndāvana, and along the banks of Yamunā — kindly reside forever within my heart.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Tarani-Tanaya Tir Lal Girivardharan - Shri Brajpati Ji
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Tarani-Tanaya Tir Lal Girivardharan, Radhika Sang Nrityat Subhag Ras Men. [1] Tatthei Tatthei Karat Gati Bhed Som, Piya Ang-Ang Milat Sundari Ta Samen. [2]Nandnandan Nirakh Sur Sahit Surnari, Venu Kal Nad Sun Mohe Akas Men. [3]Thakyau Ghan Chand Sab Tarika Thak Rahin, Tan Svar Gan 'Brajpati' Karat Ja Samen. [4]- Shri Brajpati JiUpon the banks of the Yamunā, Śrī Giridhara Lāla, together with Śrī Rādhikā, is dancing within the beautiful circle of the rāsa-maṇḍala. [1]With graceful variations of rhythm and movement, they dance to the enchanting rhythm of “tat-theī, tat-theī,” and in that divine moment, every limb of Śyāmasundara meets and unites with the form of that supremely beautiful Śrī Rādhā. [2]Beholding the splendor of Nandanandana Śrī Kṛṣṇa, even the celestial beings and heavenly maidens in the sky become enchanted, captivated by the sweet melody of His flute. [3]Śrī Brajapati says that when the divine music of melody plays, even the clouds, the moon, and all the stars stand still, spellbound in wonder. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bihari Ju Hai Tum Lau Meri Daur - Sri Roop Kunwari Ji
hindi_text: (Rag Sorath-Tal Titala) Bihari Ju Hai Tum Lau Meri Daur. [1] Dinanko Prabhu Rakhat Aye, Hau Tribhuvan Sirmaur, Jo Jan Saran Bhaye Tab Svami, Tinahin Diyo Shubh Thaur. [2] Mira Adi Draupadi Sauri, Sabke Rakhe Taur, Rani Rupkunvari Saranagat, Kariye Prabhu Aba Gaur. [3]- Sri Roop Kunwari JiO Bāṅke Bihārī Jū, You alone are my sole refuge. [1]O Lord, the crown jewel of the three worlds, You have always upheld the honor of the humble and the distressed. O Master, whoever has come to Your shelter, You have granted them Your most sacred refuge. [2]You have protected devotees such as Mīrā Bāī, Draupadī, and Śabarī. Rānī Rūpakuṁvarī says: O Lord, I too have now taken shelter of You — kindly cast Your compassionate glance upon me. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nami Nam Na Bhave - Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (132)
hindi_text: Naami Naam Na Bhavai, Tan-Man-Mansa Praan.Aasa Daasi Vihar Ki, Yon Basi Rasik Nidaan.- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (132)In the rasa-upāsanā of Svāmī Haridāsa Jī, the divine couple are so completely absorbed, through body, mind, thought, and every pore of Their being, that nothing other than uninterrupted nitya-vihāra (love-play) pleases Them, not even the hearing of Their own Names. For Śyāmā-Kuñjabihārī, nitya-vihāra alone is the very life and soul.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhagya Uday Hi Bhaye Lalite - Braj Ke Sawaiya
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Bhagya Uday Hi Bhaye Lalite, Ek Sundar Jodi Nihar Rahi. [1] Ghan Damin Avastha Kishor Si Hai, Tanpura Pai Tan Dikhay Rahi. [2] Mor-Markat Yukt Nikunjan Men, Nidhiraj Ki Raj Shri Raj Rahi. [3] Pyari Haridasi Ki Godi Lakhyo, Chhabi Banke Bihari Viraj Rahi. [4]- Braj Ke SawaiyaO Lalite, by your grace, such blessed fortune has arisen — before our eyes appears a vision of the supremely beautiful Divine Couple. [1]Śrī Kṛṣṇa, dark like a monsoon cloud, and Śrī Rādhā, radiant like lightning, shine together — ever youthful and absorbed in the sweetness of melody, delighting in the gentle notes of the tanpurā. [2]In these sacred nikunjas, where peacocks dance and monkeys move playfully, the wondrous beauty of Nidhīvana spreads its enchanting charm. [3]Within the loving lap of Svāmī Śrī Haridāsa Jī, that very unparalleled form of Śrī Bāṅke Bihārī is now manifest before us in all its splendor. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Atihin Lalachi Lal Piya - Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Prem Lata (34)
hindi_text: Atihin Lalachi Lal Piya, Nirakhat Hun Na Aghat. Priya-Rup Tan-Vipin Men, Rahe Nain Urajhat.- Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Prem Lata (34)Lāl Jī (Śrī Kṛṣṇa) remains intensely eager to relish the beauty of Śrī Rādhā. He gazes upon her constantly, yet never finds satisfaction. Beholding her forest-like beauty, His eyes become so deeply entangled that they refuse to turn away.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Log Kutum Sukh Arth Anantahi - Shri Hit Kishori Lal, Radha Sudha Nidhi Stva (32)
hindi_text: Log Kutum Sukh Arth Anantahi, Durahi Som Duriyayau.Jap Vritadi Sadhanan Yugan Saun, Hvay Nirash Bisarayau. [1] Adbhut Anand-Dhar Sahaj Hi, Shravat Puranani Gayau. So Radha Pag Lalit Rain Saun, Man Main Lay Lagayau. [2]- Shri Hit Kishori Lal, Radha Sudha Nidhi Stva (32)I have renounced, from a far distance, all worldly pursuits — the comforts of family life and endless material desires. Not only that, but after long practice, I have also become disheartened with disciplines such as japa, vows, and various spiritual practices, and have abandoned them all. [1]Placing complete faith in that unparalleled and effortless stream of divine bliss described in the Purāṇas, I have now lovingly enshrined within my heart the sacred dust of Śrī Rādhā Mahārāṇī Jū’s tender lotus feet. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhuja Paraspar Ansh De - Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Shrinikunj Prakash Ashtayam Mansi Sewa
hindi_text: Bhuja Paraspar Ansh De, Mand Mand Muskay. Pyari Pitam Ras Bhare, Ang-Ang Ras Chhay.- Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli MadhuriWith their arms gently resting upon each other’s shoulders, Śrī Rādhā and Śrī Kṛṣṇa smile gently. From every limb of the Priyā-Priyatama, a divine radiance of bliss overflows.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ham To Radhakrishna Upasi - Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Braj Nidhi Pad Sangrah (11)
hindi_text: (Rag Khamach) Ham Tau Radhakrishna-Upasi. Gaur-Syam Abhiram Manohar, Sundar Chhabi Sukh-Rasi. [1] Ek Pran Tan Man Dou Nit, Vrinda-Bipin-Bilasi. Kripa-Drishti Tain Pai "Brajanidhi", Dampati Khas Khavasi. [2]- Shri Braj Nidhi Ji, Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Braj Nidhi Pad Sangrah (11) We are devoted to the one and only divine Couple, Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa. This divine Couple — Śrī Rādhā, fair in complexion, and Śrī Kṛṣṇa, dark-complexioned — is supremely charming, enchanting, and the very embodiment of bliss. [1]Though They appear as two in body and mind, in truth They are eternally one, forever delighting in the plays of love within the forests of Śrī Vṛndāvana. Śrī Brajanidhi says that it is only by the gracious glance of Priyā-Priyatama that I have attained the privilege of Their intimate service. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jai Jai Shri Vrishabhanuja - Shri Kishori Ali
hindi_text: Jai Jai Shri Vrishabhanuja, Nand Suvan Pad Kanj.Rasik Janan Ke Manan Kon, Karat Raho Ras Ranj.- Shri Kishori AliGlory, glory to the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā, the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, and Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda, who ever immerse the hearts of rasika devotees in the nectar of divine love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रस में रहत गढ़ी हो रसिकनी
hindi_text:
रस में रहत गढ़ी हो रसिकनी
- श्री कुंभन दास 

देवदुर्लभ अचिन्त्य प्रेम रस की मूल स्रोत श्री राधिका जू पूर्ण रूप से अपने दिव्य स्नेह और रस में डूबी हुई हैं।
english_text:
Ras Mein Rahat Ghadhi Ho Rasikani
- Shri Kumbhandas

Sri Radhika, the embodiment of the nectar of pure love, is fully immersed in the bliss and playful mood.
english_translation:
Ras Mein Rahat Ghadhi Ho Rasikani
- Shri Kumbhandas

Sri Radhika, the embodiment of the nectar of pure love, is fully immersed in the bliss and playful mood.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: व्यास स्वामिनी के पदनख पर,वलि वलिजात रसिक नरनारी
hindi_text:
व्यास स्वामिनी के पदनख पर,वलि वलिजात रसिक नरनारी
- श्री हरिराम व्यास

श्री हरिराम व्यास कहते हैं, "समस्त रसिक भक्त श्री किशोरी जू के चरण कमलों के नख-पद पर स्वयं को न्योछावर करते हैं"।
english_text:
Vyas Swamini Ke Padnakh Par,Vali Valijaat Rasik Narnari.
- Shri Hariram Vyas

Shri Hariram Vyas says, "All the Rasik devotees sacrifice themselves on the nail-gem of Shri Radha's lotus feet".
english_translation:
Vyas Swamini Ke Padnakh Par,Vali Valijaat Rasik Narnari.
- Shri Hariram Vyas

Shri Hariram Vyas says, "All the Rasik devotees sacrifice themselves on the nail-gem of Shri Radha's lotus feet".
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Radhe Aan Pado Tere Dwaar - Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (33)
hindi_text: (Raag Durga Tritaal)Radhe Aan Pado Tere Dwaar.Tumhein Chhod Vrishbhaan Dulaari, Kaason Karu Pukaar. [1]Bhavsagar Mein Doob Rahi Hoon, Veg Lagaabo Paar.Sharan Tihaari Aan Padi Hoon, Ab Na Maano Bhaar. [2]Jeevan Praan Adhaar Tumhi Ho, Ye Man Leeno Dhaar.Shri Gopal Hit Hari Swaamini, Tum Bin Hon Bekaar. [3]- Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (33)O Radhe! I have come to your doorstep. Other than You, O daughter of Vrishbhanu, who else can I turn to? [1]I am drowning in the ocean of worldly existence, please take me across with the force of Your grace. I have come into Your shelter, please do not consider me a burden now. [2]You alone are the support of my life and breath; my mind has firmly resolved to remain absorbed in you. Sri Hita Gopaldas says, O Swamini of Shri Hari! Without You, I am nothing. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kabhu Hakdhak Ho Rahe Uthe Prem Hit Gaay - Sri Sahjobai
hindi_text: Kabhun Hakdhak Ho Rahai, Uthai Prem Hit Gaay. Sahjo Aankh Mundi Rahai, Kabhoon Sudhi Ho Jay. - Sri SahjobaiWhile describing the signs of a true premi bhakta, Sahajo Bai says that sometimes he stands motionless, deeply absorbed in bhava-samadhi (ecstasy) and loses all outer awareness. At other times, the force of divine love lifts him into spontaneous singing. Sometimes he closes his eyes and sinks into deep contemplation, and at other times he returns to his external consciousness.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dhan Dhan Vrindavan Mein Vase Kumhaar - Shri Abhay Ram, Vrindavan Rahasya Vinod (98)
hindi_text: Dhan Dhan Vrindavan Mein Vasain Kumhaar,Bhaawai Chaak Banaawai Baasan, Karuye Kulra Karain Apaar.Saadhu Sant Kau Paani Pyaawai, Inke Kul Ko Yahi Vichaar,Abhayaraam Ehuh Badbhaagi Sab Kaun Aawai Inke Dwaar.- Shri Abhay Ram, Vrindavan Rahasya Vinod (98)The potters of Vrindavan are truly blessed. Their hands turn the wheel to create beautiful vessels, creating karūvā (water pots) and kulahaḍ (earthen cups) from the soil of Vraja. [1]They serve the saints and sages by offering them water — this is the noble service tradition of their lineage. Shri Abhayram says, they are greatly fortunate, for everyone comes to their door. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Main To Tere Darshan Ki Hun Bhikhari - Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (125)
hindi_text: (Raag Desh and Sorath)Main To Tere Darshan Ki Hun Bhikhari,Arji Suniye Bhan Dulari. (Tek). [1]Jeevan Dhan Sarveshwari Shyama, Sab Gun Aagar Ati Abhirama,Dhyan Dharun Tumko Athyama, Kirat Raj Kumari. [2]Naam Ratun Nit Tumro Mukh Se, Jeevan Bite Yaasun Sukh Se,Jag Mein Khoye Bahut Din Dukh Se, Aai Sharan Tumhari. [3]Karunanidhi Jai Jai Shri Radha, Shobha Sindhu Roop Agadha,Haro Virah Ki Begahi Badha, “Roopmadhari” Vari. [4]- Shri Roop Madhuri, Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (125)I am but a humble beggar, yearning for just one glance of Yours, O Bhanu’s charming daughter, Shri Radha! Please hear my prayer. [1]O Shyama, Sovereign of all! You are my life’s treasure, the mine of all virtues, and supremely enchanting. O daughter of Kirti! Show such mercy upon me that day and night (all eight quarters), I may keep my mind fixed on You. [2]May I constantly remember Your name, so that in every breath only Your name resounds. Then alone will I attain true and supreme bliss. I have wandered much in this material world and gained nothing but sorrow; now I have come to seek Your shelter. [3]O ocean of compassion, O Shri Radha, glories be Yours! You are the boundless ocean of beauty! Kindly relieve me from the pain of Your separation quickly, for Roopmadhari sacrifices herself at Your lotus feet, again and again. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrindavan Vraj Ko Mahat Kape Varni Jaai Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar, Dasham Sakandh
hindi_text: Vrindavan Vraj Ko Mahata, Kape Varni Jaai.Chaturanan Pag Parasikai, Lok Gayo Sukh Paai.- Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar, Dasham SakandhThe significance of Shri Vrindavan and the entire land of Vraj is immeasurable. No one can describe it completely. When four-headed Brahma admitted his offense in Braj, he bowed down and placed his head at Shri Krishna’s lotus feet, and then returned to his own abode immersed in endless bliss.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nandalal Mo Tan Dukh Hero - Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Vinay (16)
hindi_text: (Raag Iman)Nandalal Mo Tan Dukh Hero.Shri Vraj-Raj Paavan Darasabahu, Jaason Sahajen Hoy Nivero. [1]Uk-Chook Sab Kshamo Sanware, Ha-Ha, Ab Na Karo Avasero.Lalit Ladaiti Dehu Kripa Kari, Shri Vrindavan Kunj Basero. [2]- Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Vinay (16)O Nandalal, please look towards me and see the pain of my body. Show me the vision of the supremely holy dust of Vraj, through which my distress will be easily removed. [1]O Shyamasundar, forgive all my mistakes and faults — delay no longer. Shri Lalit Ladaiti humbly prays: please grant me residence in the bowers of Shri Vrindavan. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Makka Madina Dvarika Badri Aur Kedar - Shri Maluka Das
hindi_text: Makka Madina Dwarika, Badri Aur Kedaar. Bina Daya Sab Jhooth Hain, Kahai Malook Vichar. - Shri Malook DasEven if one undertakes pilgrimages to Mecca, Medina, Dwarka, Badrinath, Kedarnath, or any sacred land, it bears no fruit if the heart is devoid of compassion.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bain Wahi Unko Gun Gai - Shri Raskhan, Raskhan Ratnavali
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Bain Wahi Unko Gun Gai, Au Kaan Wahi Un Bain Son Sani. Haath Wahi Un Gaat Sarai, Aru Pai Wahi Ju Wahi Anujani. [1]Gyaan Wahi Un Aan Ke Sang, Au Maan Wahi Ju Karai Manmani.Tyon Raskhan Wahi Raskhani Ju, Hai Raskhani Son Hai Raskhani. [2]- Shri Raskhan, Raskhan RatnawaliOnly that speech is meaningful which sings the glories of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and only those ears are truly blessed which listen to His nectar-like praises. Only those hands are meaningful which serve the limbs of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and those feet are truly blessed which always follow in His footsteps. [1]Only that knowledge is meaningful which prevents the mind from attaching to anyone other than Śrī Kṛṣṇa and His devotees. And only that sulking is worthy which, driven by self-willed love, melts the heart of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. Raskhān says—he alone is truly ‘Raskhān’ who is a genuine connoisseur of the nectar of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the mine of rasa, and remains forever immersed in His divine rasa. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ras Shekhar Rasarajvar Ras Ananya Haridas - Sri Prahlad Ji
hindi_text: Ras Shekhar Rasarajvar, Ras Ananya Haridas. Sumirat Darshat Man Harat, Rang Mahal Nit Vaas. - Sri Prahlad JiThe crown jewel of rasa, the supreme emperor of rasa (Rasarājvar), and the exclusive rasika of the eternal nitya-vihār rasa of the Divine Couple is none other than Swami Shri Haridās Ji. His darshan or mere remembrance immerses the mind in the blissful rasa of the Divine Couple. He eternally resides within the most secret Rang Mahal of Nidhivan.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Brajvasi Nahin Sab Devta Hain - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Brajvasi Nahin Sab Devta Hain, Yah Bhavana Chitt Mein La Rahe Hain.Chir-Kal Pratiksha Ke Baad Aha! Mam Swami Samip Mein Aa Rahe Hain. [1]Hare Krishna! Chalo, Der Mat Karo, Drig Darshan Ko Lalcha Rahe Hain.Jinhen Dekho Wahi Kuch Bhent Liye, Bas Nand Ke Dwar Ko Ja Rahe Hain. [2]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’The residents of Braj are not ordinary people; they are all divine beings—let this feeling fill my heart. After a long wait—aha! my Lord is coming near to me. [1]O Kṛṣṇa! Delay no longer, my eyes have become restless for Your darśana. Everyone you see carries an offering and heads toward Nanda’s door. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aaju Badhai Vrindavan Sukh Sindhu Hilor -  Shri Lalitmohini Dev, Ras Ke Pad (62)
hindi_text: Aaju Badhai Vrindavan, Sukh Sindhu Hilor.Priyalal Tan Man Hulasane, Manasij Meghani Ghor. [1]Sab Sakhi Umangi Umangi Gun Gawai, Naachat Mor Chakor.Shrilalitamohini Ke Ur Biharata, Nain Kamal Chit Chor. [2]- Shri Lalit Mohini Dev, Lalit Mohini Dev Ju Ki Vaani, Ras Ke Pad (62)An auspicious celebration fills the divine land of Vrindavan today, where the ocean of bliss constantly rises in waves. The divine couple, Priyālāla, remain ever ecstatic in body and mind, while the cloud-like cupid roars with great thunder. [1]The sakhis, filled with joy and delight, sing the songs of the nitya-vihāra (eternal love-play). Peacocks and chakors are dancing. In the heart of Sri Lalit Mohini, the lotus-eyed heart-stealers, the divine couple ceaselessly sport in divine play. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kahu Lakut Kahu Muralika  Pitambar Sudh Nahin - Shri Brajnidhi Granthawali, Preeti Lata (63)
hindi_text: Kahun Lakut Kahun Muralika, Pitambar Sudh Nahin. Mor Chandrika Jhuki Rahi, Priya Dhyan Man Mahin. - Shri Brajnidhi Ji, Shri Brajnidhi Granthawali, Preeti Lata (63)Shri Krishna is so deeply immersed in the meditation of Shri Radha that He is unaware of His stick, forgetful of His flute, and even has no awareness of His yellow garment. Even the peacock-feathered crown upon His head bends down in absorption, as if it too has merged into that same mood of devotion.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jaavak Charan Det Choom Ur Dhar Let - Shri Hita Chaturbhujdas
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Jaavak Charan Det Choom Ur Dhar Let, Romaanchit Bhaye Het, Vahai Jyon Banaari Hain. [1]Charanan Madhilaal Prem Hiy Ko Vishaal, Aadi Hai Na Ant, Kaal Bharyo Bharain Bhaari Hain. [2]Pad Aanguri Je Laal, Evai Laal Ki Hi Laal,Aise Laal Par Baal Lalitaadi Vaari Hain. [3]“Chaturbhujdas” Prabhu-Bhaar Saun Virad Padhai, Naachi Kai Ja Aage—Soi Swamini Hamaari Hain. [4]- Shri Hita ChaturbhujdasŚrī Kṛṣṇa applies jāvak (red alta‑like dye) to Śrī Rādhā’s lotus feet; as He kisses those tender feet and holds them to His heart, He becomes thrilled, completely intoxicated in divine love’s ecstasy, and sheds tears out of love. [1]In the midst of those divine feet resides Lal Jī (Kṛṣṇa), whose heart holds such deep and boundless love for them that it has neither beginning nor end. [2]The redness of Her toe‑fingers is such that it seems as though the redness of Śrī Kṛṣṇa (Lal Himself) has entered into them; upon that incomparable crimson hue, Lalitā and the other sakhīs offer themselves completely. [3]Śrī Chaturbhujdās declares — the one before whom even the Lord (Kṛṣṇa) bows and dances, She alone is our eternal Svāminī, Śrī Rādhā. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dhyan Dharo Sumiran Karo Shrimat Radhe Shyam - Shri Saras Madhuri
hindi_text: Dhyan Dharo Sumiran Karo, Shrimat Radhe Shyam.Gavo Gun Gan Prem Son, Pal Chhin Aathon Yaam.- Sri Saras MadhuriMeditate on Shri Radha-Krishna; remember Them constantly. Sing their glories lovingly every moment, through all eight quarters of the day, for this alone is the supreme essence of life.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Rakhi Dridh Bharoso Toko Poshaegi Jai ShriRadha - Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Vinayavali (141)
hindi_text: (Raag Dhanashri)Rakhi Dridh Bharoso Toko, Poshaegi Jai ShriRadha. (Tek). [1]Shyamvihari Agyakari, Tan-Man Ki Sab Maite Badha. Sundar Shyama, Shyam Manohar, Pranatan Ke Poshan-Sukh Saadha. [2]Daya-Udadhi Karuna Ke Sagar, Kripa-Sindhu, Sadgunan Agadha. Ali Madhuri Ke Sarvas-Dhan, Dampati Sarvopari Aaradha. [3]- Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Vinayavali (141)Place unshakable faith in Shri Radha, and firmly believe that Shri Radha Herself will take care of you and protect you always. [1]Even Lord Shri Krishna Himself moves under Her command. She, the supreme Swamini, is the remover of all obstacles of body and mind. This incomparable couple, Shyama-Shyam, bestows happiness and shelter upon those who take refuge in Them. [2]Shri Radha is the boundless ocean of compassion, the unbroken stream of mercy, and adorned with countless divine virtues. Shri Ali Madhuri Ji says — the entire treasure of my life is this divine couple, whom I always worship. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Chalu Man Shri Vrindavan Or - Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket Lata
hindi_text: Chalu Man Shri Vrindavan Or.Anupam Dhaam Kamna Pooran, Viharat Yugal Kishor. [1]Shat Ritu Rahat Pratyaksh Swachh Jal, Yamuna Let Hilor.Praphulit Lata Pata Mridu Phal Yut, Khag Dhvani Naachat Mor. [2]- Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket LataCome, O mind, let us go toward that divine Vrindavan, the unparalleled abode where all loving desires are fulfilled and where the youthful Divine Couple, Sri Radha Krishn, eternally engages in Nitya Vihara rasa. [1]All six seasons are present there at once. The pure waters of the Yamuna flow in gentle waves. The vines and leaves remain ever-blossoming, adorned with colorful fruits. Birds fill the atmosphere with melodious songs, and peacocks dance joyfully in bliss. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jag Mein Milan Anup Hai Bhagwadian Ko Sang - Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (26)
hindi_text: Jag Mein Milan Anoop Hai, Bhagwadian Ko Sang.Tinke Sang Pratap Ten, Hot Shyam So Rang. - Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (26)Among all associations, the most rare and sacred is the association of Premī saints (God realized), for in their presence, the heart effortlessly immerses in the rasa of Shri Krishna’s love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Swami Haridas Ji Rasik Maha Hari-Vyas - Shri Charan Das
hindi_text: Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Rasik Maha Hari-Vyas. Krishnadas Aru Hit Ali, In Marag Sukha-Ras. [1]Soi Mero Marg Hai, Maha Mod Ki Khaan. Unnat Param Nikunj-Ras, Tin Baanin Parmaan. [2]- Shri CharandasIn this verse, Śrī Caraṇdās Jī declares that the path of the exclusive rasikas who worship the nitya-vihāra (eternal loving pastimes) is indeed his own path. He says—Śrī Svāmī Haridās Jī, Śrī Harivyās Jī, Śrī Kṛṣṇadās, and Śrī Hit Alī (Harivaṃś Mahāprabhu)—all these are great rasika ācāryas. The path shown by them is truly an ocean of bliss. [1]  That very path is also mine—it is a mine of supreme divine happiness, directly leading to the gateway of nikuṃja (the confidential inner forest of divine love). The realization and perfection of that highest rasa is clearly expressed and confirmed in the divine vāṇīs (words) of these great saints. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrindavan Ki Chuhari Chali Mukti Thukray - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Vrindavan Ki Choohari, Chali Mukti Thukray.Vyas Kahai Acharaj Kahan, Yah Radha Mahal Khvay.- Braj Ke DoheEven the sweeper woman of Vrindavan kicks away mukti (liberation) with her feet and walks on with no desire to accept it. What is surprising in that? After all, this is the palace of Shri Radha Herself, whom she serves as a maid.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ham Vasi Barsane Ke - Shri Lalit Madhuri
hindi_text: (Raah Laavni Iman)Ham Vaasi Barsane Ke.Shri Chaitanya Upaasi Khaasi, Radha Govind Vaane Ke. [1]Lalit Kishori Garv Bhare Ham, Anyason Kyon Chit Laaneke.‘Lalit Madhuri’ Nit Avaloken, An Tan Man Bhatkaaneke. [2]- Shri Lalit MadhuriWe are residents of Barsana and intimate devotees in the tradition of Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, belonging to none other than “Radha-Govind.” [1]Proudly belonging to enchanting Kishoriji (Sri Radha), why would we fix our mind on anyone else? Shri Lalitmadhuri says — we behold Her eternally and never let our body or mind wander elsewhere. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pyari Preetam Son Likhyaun Mat Pariyau Mau Dhyan - Shri Dayaram Ji
hindi_text: Pyari Preetam Son Likhyaun, Mat Pariyau Mau Dhyan.Tum Mose Hvai Jauge, Karihon Ka Pain Maan.- Shri Dayaram JiPyariju writes, “Beloved, do not meditate upon me too much — otherwise you become like me. Then, to whom shall I display my loving sulk?”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Are Man Shri Vallabh Gun Gaay - Goswami Shri Harirai Ji
hindi_text: Are Man Shri Vallabh Gun Gaay.Vritha Kaal Kahe Ko Khonvat, Ved Puraan Padhay. [1]Shri Girirajdharan Pevai Ko, Naahin Aur Upaay.“Rasik” Sadaa Ananya Hoy Ke, Chitt It Ut Na Dulay. [2]- Goswami Shri Hariray JiO mind! Sing the glories of Shri Vallabh (Shri Vallabhacharya / Shri Krishna) lovingly. Why are you wasting your time reading the Vedas and Puranas? [1]There is no other way to attain Shri Krishna, the lifter of Govardhan. Goswami Shri Hariray Ji says that a true rasika always performs exclusive, single-minded devotion to his Lord; he does not allow his mind to wander here and there. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jyon Din Jat Ashadh Ke Tyon Tyon Ghate Meri Bhukh - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Jyon Din Jaat Ashaadh Ke, Tyon Tyon Ghatai Meri Bhookh.Bidhi Na Kab Darsaihau, Barsane Ke Rookh.- Braj Ke DoheAs the days of Ashadh (monsoon month) pass, my hunger keeps diminishing. O Creator! When will you let me see the trees of Barsana?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ankhiyan Dukhiya Nit Hi Tarasein - Shri Rashid Ji
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Ankhiyan Dukhiya Nit Hi Tarasein, Tum Aan Se Neh Lagate Raho.Bisrate Raho Mohi Jaan Ayog, Viyog Ki Jwaal Jalate Raho. [1]Yahu Nyav Kahaan Ka Gopal Bhala, Kal Paake Mujhe Kalpaate Raho.Viniti Hai Vineet ‘Rashid’ Yahi, Braj Mein Ghanshyam Bulaate Raho. [2]- Shri Rashid JiMy tearful eyes constantly yearn for You, while You continue to shower Your love on others. Counting me unworthy, You keep forgetting me and burning me in the fire of separation. [1]O beloved Gopāla! What kind of justice is this—that You remain peaceful, while You leave me to suffer in Your separation? Śrī Rāshīd Jī humbly prays only this—O Ghaṇśyām! Kindly keep calling me to Braj again and again. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Agradev Aagya Deyi Bhaktan Ko Jas Gaau - Shri Nabhadas
hindi_text: Agradev Aagya Deyi, Bhaktan Ko Jas Gaau.Bhavsagar Ke Taran Ko, Naahin Aur Upaau.- Shri NabhadasMy revered Gurudev, Sri Agradev, has instructed me to sing the glories of the devotees, for there is no greater means than this to cross the ocean of worldly existence.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Suniye Nath Gareeb Nivaj - Shri Yugal Priya
hindi_text: (Raga Jhanjhoti Taal Charchari)Suniye Nath Gareeb Nivaaj,Aayi Sharan Tumhe Sab Laaj. [1]Adham Udhaaran Birad Samhaaran, Tribhuvan Ke Sirtaaj.Kunjdwaar Haun Khadi Kabai Ki, Traahi Traahi Maharaj. [2]Karunaakar Ab Boli Lijiye, Kariye Bilam Na Aaj.Jugalpriya Ko Abhay Kijiye, Yah Nahin Kachhu Bad Kaaj. [3]- Sri Yugal PriyaO Lord, Protector of the humble! I am in your shelter—now my honor lies solely in Your hands. [1]You are the Redeemer of the fallen, the Master of all three worlds, renowned for this very glory! I have been standing long at the gate of Nikunja, repeatedly crying out — “Save me! Save me!” [2]O Ocean of Compassion! Please bestow Your mercy upon me — delay not today. Shri Yugal Priya Ji pleads: grant this maidservant the shelter of fearlessness — surely this is no great task for You. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrindaranya Lata Grriheshu Vasatam - Shri Vagish Shastriji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.65)
hindi_text: Vrindaranyalatagrriheshu Vasatam Govindalilasudha-Mapiyashru Vimu~nchatam Sumadhuram Radheti Samgayatam.Ardhonmilitalochanairvicharatam VrrindatavivithisuKutrapi Skhalatam Kvachichcha Patatam Yajjivanam Jivanam.- Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.65)Those great souls who reside in the vine groves of Shri Vrindavan, drink the nectar of Shri Govind’s pastimes, shed tears of love, always chant Shri Radha’s sweet name with devotion, and wander the alleys of Vrindavan with half-closed eyes—unaware of their own bodies, sometimes stumbling, sometimes falling in divine ecstasy—their life alone is truly blessed!
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Maya Ko Sab Jag Bhaje - Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyanishchayatmak Granth, Uttarardh (28)
hindi_text: (Kundaliyaa)Maya Kon Sab Jag Bhajai, Madhau Bhajai Na Koi.Jo Kadaapi Madhau Bhajai, Maya Cheri Hoi. [1]Maaya Cheri Hoi, Rahai Charanan Lapataani.Jyon Malayaj Ke Sang, Sahaj Saurabh Sukhdaani. [2]Bhagavat Rasik Ananya, Hoy Satguru Ki Daaya.Maadhau Saun Man Lagai, Moh Mad Chhootai Maaya. [3]- Shri Bhagwat Rasik, Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyanishchayatmak Granth, Uttarardh (28)The entire world, knowingly or unknowingly, is devoted to Maya — attachment to wealth, relationships, possessions, and even Ashrams has become the norm. But only a rare soul offers single-pointed devotion to Shri Krishna, the Lord of Maya. [1]For such a soul, Maya no longer binds; rather, she becomes an obedient servant — not just any ordinary servant, but one who clings to the devotee’s feet like fragrance to sandalwood. [2]He who constantly and selflessly remembers the Lord with exclusive devotion receives the special grace of the  Guru. Such a devotee effortlessly becomes immersed in divine love, and the knots of illusion, ego, and attachment naturally fall away. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Paande Maati Mein Sane - Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (320)
hindi_text: Paande Maati Mein Sanain, Karmath Nipat Nikor.Prem Padarath Kyon Gahein, Arujhe Lahai Na Chhor.- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (320)Just like dry clay, the pandits remain deeply entangled in endless rituals and external formalities, with no real spiritual depth. Immersed in such outward practices, how can such karma-kānḍīs people ever attain the supreme treasure of divine love?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aage Ki Aage Gai Ab Na Rukhai Dehu - Shri Vrindavan Das Chacha Ji, Vivek Lakshan Beli (106)
hindi_text: Aage Ki Aage Gai, Ab Na Rukhai Dehu.‘Vrindavan Hita’ Das Ki, Laaj Hiyein Dhari Lehu.- Shri Vrindavan Das Chacha Ji, Vivek Lakshan Beli (106)What is past is past, O Lord — please do not be harsh now. Shri Hit Vrindavan Das Ji humbly prays: “Please hold this servant’s honor in Your heart and bestow Your merciful grace upon me.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kaun Bhagya Bhari Nain Niharao - Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer (267)
hindi_text: Kaun Bhagya Bhari Nain Niharao.Binu Nakh Chandra Chandika Dekhe, Tribhuvan Sab Andhiyarao. [1]Sahaj Chhabili Chhabi Ke Upar, Tribhuvan Sobha Warao.Bhori Chhin Ik Darshan Karan, Koti Pran Taji Darao. [2]- Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer (267)When will that blessed moment arrive, O Pyari Ju, when I may behold Your divine beauty with my own eyes? Without the radiance of Your moon-like toenails, this entire world appears to me as shrouded in darkness. [1]Even the beauty of all three worlds pales in comparison to Your naturally graceful form. Shri Hit Bhorisakhi Ji declares — for a single glimpse of You, I would gladly sacrifice my millions upon millions of lives. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhala Kaha Rijhe Nahin Bura Kaha Na Khijant - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Vishisht Doha (54)
hindi_text: Bhala Kaha Rijhe Nahin, Bura Kaha Na Khijant. ‘Roop Rasik’ Soi Janiye, Anand-Rupi Sant. - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Vishisht Doha (54)One who remains free from pride when praised and shows no trace of anger or agitation when criticized — such a person alone is truly worthy of being called a blissful saint.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jyon Jyon It Dekhiyat Murakh - Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Tirthanand (01)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Jyon Jyon It Dekhiyat Moorakh Vimukh Log,Tyon Tyon Sukharashi Vrajvasi Jiya Bhavain Hain. [1]Khare Jal Chheelar Dukhare Andh Koop Chitai,Kalindi Ke Kaj Maha Man Lalchavain Hain. [2]Jaisi Ab Beetat Su Kahat Na Avain Bain,Nagar Na Chain Parain Pran Akulavain Hain. [3]Thohar Pharas Dekhi Dekhi Kain Bambur Bure,Hay Hare Hare Ve Tamal Sudhi Avain Hain. [4]- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Tirthanand (1)Once, Śrī Nāgarīdās Jī had to go to a desert for some personal reason; while living in that desolate land, a deep remembrance of Braj arose in his heart. He says —As my eyes fall upon these love‑deprived beings, the pure devotion and sweetness of the Brajvāsīs come to my mind with even greater intensity. [1]Seeing the salty‑water wells here, my heart becomes restless, and the memory of Yamunā Jī’s sweet waters surges with even more force. [2]I cannot express how the days are passing; without Braj, my heart finds no peace even for a moment — a deep yearning keeps rising within. [3]Śrī Nāgarīdās says — seeing the dry cactus (thuhar), thorny feras, and lifeless babool trees here, I am struck with intense remembrance of Braj’s lush, beautiful, dark tamal trees and their cooling shade. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Gahi Gahi Radha Kar Kamal Jhumak Nacho Naach- Shri Vanshi Ali, Hriday Sarvasv (37)
hindi_text: Gahi Gahi Radha Kar Kamal, Jhoomak Nachon Naach.Radha Ke Pad Kamal Gahi, Akhiyan Laun Saanch.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Hriday Sarvasv (37)Holding Shri Radha’s soft, lotus-like hands again and again, I wish to dance in joyful ecstasy, and with a pure heart, I long to place her lotus feet upon my eyes.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hum To Yonhi Bhakt Kahaye - Shri Kishori Ali
hindi_text: Hum To Yonhi Bhakt Kahaye. Rasik-Janan Ki Sangati Tajikai, Bimukhan Sanmukh Dhaye. [1]Svaang Sinh Kau Dhari, Swaan Sam Man Nai Chal Chalay. Bishayan Ke Bas Karikai Indrin, Kapi Laun Naach Nachaye. [2]Kahani Si Karni Na Kari Kachhu, Jag-Jan Bahut Hansaye. Param Kripalu Kishori Ju Ne, Aise Hoo Apnaye. [3]- Shri Kishori AliI call myself a devotee, but in truth, I have not yet lived up to that sacred name. Instead of seeking the company of Rasik saints, I kept running after the world and those who turned away from God. [1]Outwardly, I disguised myself like a lion, but my inner nature was like that of a dog. I failed to control my mind; under the sway of desires, my senses kept dancing like monkeys. [2]I did not practice what I preached—my conduct was limited to mere words, and because of this, the world mocked me. Yet even in such a fallen state, the most compassionate Shri Kishori Ji (Radha) accepted me. Who else but Shri Radha could bestow such causeless grace? [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrindavan Sabson Bado, Yatha Dudh Mein Gheev - Shri Charandas
hindi_text: Vrindavan Sabson Bado, Yatha Dudh Mein Gheev.Sab Dharman Hari Bhakt Jyaon, Yatha Pind Mein Jeev.- Shri CharandasAs ghee is the pure essence extracted from milk, so is Vrindavan the supreme essence among all abodes. And just as the soul is the essence of the body, devotion to Lord Hari is the essence of all dharmas.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Banki Rasik Viharini Radhe - Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
hindi_text: Banki Rasik Viharini Radhe, Banke Rasik Bihari. [1]Banki Mukut Chandrika Banki, Banki Chitvan Pyari. [2]Banki Chalan Chaaru Gati Chanchal, Pag Nupur Jhunkari. [3]Saras Maadhuri Banki Jhanki, Jivan Praan Humari. [4]- Shri Saras MadhuriRasika’s beloved Queen, Shri Radha, who eternally engages in Nitya-Vihāra, and Rasik Bihari Shri Krishna, are both mischievous. [1]Their crown and moon-shaped forehead ornament (chandrika) are tilted, and their sidelong glances are playful. [2]Their enchanting walking style and movements are enchanting, and even the anklets on their feet jingle in rhythm with that graceful, mischievous gait. [3]Shri Saras Madhuri says — These bāṅkī (tilted/mischievous) glimpses of the Divine Couple are the very life-breath of my soul. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pyariju Kaun Tihari Khot - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (68)
hindi_text: (Raag Bhairavi)Pyariju Kaun Tihari Khot.Moso Vani Na Kachu Vai Swamini, Hon Augunki Mot. [1]Shrivan Daras Dikhayke Radhe, Meto Jiyaki Chot.Lalit Kishori Ko Apanavahun, Gahi Tihari Ot.  [2]- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (68)O Pyārījū! There is no fault in You — Your grace is boundless. The fault lies entirely within me, for I am nothing but a massive bundle of sins. [1]O Queen of Shri Vrindavan! Please grant me the vision of Your eternal divine abode, Shri Vrindavan, and relieve the deep pain of my heart. Shri Lalit Kishori humbly prays — Accept me as Your maidservant, for I have no shelter except your lotus feet! [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jehi Binu Jane Kachhhi Nahin - Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (18)
hindi_text: Jehi Binu Jaane Kachhuhi Nahin, Jaatyau Jaat Bisesh.Soi Prem Jehi Jaanikai, Rahi Na Jaat Kachhu Sesh.- Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (18)Without which nothing can be understood, through which divine knowledge arises, and after knowing which nothing remains to be known, that very essence of all essences is Prema (love).
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Man Re Shyam Son Kar Het - Shri Surdas, Sura Sagara
hindi_text: (Raag Vihaag)Man Re Shyam Son Kar Het.Krishn Naam Ki Vaar Karle To Vache Tero Khet. [1]Man Sua Tan Peenjra Ho Tasu Baandhyo Tero Het.Kaal Roopi Majhaar Dole Ab Ghadi Tohai Let. [2]Vishay Vish Ras Chhand De Re Utar Sagar Set.‘Soor’ Shri Gopal Bhajle Guru Bataye Det. [3]- Shri Surdas, Sura SagaraBind yourself, O mind, in the bond of love with Shyamsundar. Encircle your life with the protective boundary of the holy name “Krishna” to safeguard the field of your very life. [1]This parrot-like mind is trapped in the cage-like body, entangled in attachments. Meanwhile, Yamraj, the God of death, like a prowling cat, circles all around, ready to eat you at any moment! [2]Therefore, abandon these poisonous sensual desires and cross the bridge over this ocean of worldly illusion. Shri Surdas says — the Guru instructs us to perform exclusive devotion to Shri Gopal. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Banshivat Yamuna Nikat Jahan Saghan Ghan Chhaah - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Vanshivat Yamuna Nikat, Jahan Saghan Ghan Chhaah.Pyari Mukh Bihasat Bhayi, Daari Gale Piy Baah.- Braj Ke DoheShri Lalita Sakhi says — On the banks of the Yamuna, at Vamshivata, where the dense trees provide their cooling shade, Shri Radha stands with a sweet smile on her face, and her beloved Shri Krishna has lovingly placed his arm around her neck.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Lakhi Augun Tan Aapne Bhul Sabe Sudhi Jai - Shri Rasnidhi
hindi_text: Lakhi Augun Tan Aapne, Bhula Sabe Sudhi Jaai.Adham-Udharan-Virad Tuva, ‘Rasnidhi’ Sumir Suhai.- Shri RasnidhiWhen I look at my own faults, my mind becomes restless with fear, losing all awareness of myself. But, O Lord! The moment I contemplate Your glorious titles such as Patita-Pāvana (Savior of the fallen), Adhama-Udhārana (Redeemer of the wretched), I am filled with great peace, trusting that surely, the Lord will also deliver someone fallen like me.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shvaan Kahu Ki Shrigal Kahu Ki - Shri Sundardas Ji
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Shvaan Kahu Ki Shrigal Kahu Ki,Vidal Kahu Man Ki Matti Taisi. [1]Dhed Kahu Kidhao Doom Kahun Kidhao,Bhaad Kahu Ki Bhadāi De Jaisi. [2]Chaur Kahu, Batmaar Kahu,Thag Jai Kahu, Upma Kahu Kaisi. [3]Sundar Aur Kaha Kahiye Ab,Ya Man Ki Gati Dostat Aisi. [4]- Shri Sundardas JiWhat can I say about the strange nature of this mind? At times, it seems like a dog—always restless with greed and hunger; sometimes like a jackal—filled with deceit and trickery; and sometimes like a cat—outwardly calm but inwardly cunning. [1]Sometimes, this mind behaves like a Ḍheḍha (untouchable)—immersed in impure, inappropriate thoughts; sometimes like a Ḍoma (one who performs cremations)—always inclined towards death and destruction; and sometimes like a clown—treating everything as a joke and creating chaos. [2]At times, it acts like a thief, hiding its corrupt desires; sometimes, like a bandit, it becomes violent; and at times, like a conman, it deceives others with clever tricks. What analogy can truly capture this mind that defies all boundaries? [3]Śrī Sundara Dās says—truly, the nature of this mind is horrifying and wicked. It is the very root of all our problems. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vasi Ki Aasa Karo Vasi Haath Vikaun - Shri Hita Damodar Das, Nem Battisi (6)
hindi_text: Vasi Ki Aasa Karo, Vasi Haath Vikaun.Shri Vrindavan Chhadi Kai, Anat Na Kit Hoon Jaun.- Shri Hita Damodar Das, Nem Battisi (6)My hope rests only upon the residents of Vrindavan, and I surrender myself into their hands. Now I will never leave Shri Dham Vrindavan and go anywhere else.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sabso Sundar Hai Barsano - Braj Ke Lokgeet
hindi_text: Sabsau Sundar Hai Barsano Vraj Mein Radharani Kau.Jahaan Birajain Radharani, Jaaki Shyam Karai Agwani,Mahima Vedan Hoo Noy Jani, Parbat Ooni Mandir Chamkai,Sab Jag Jani Kau. [1] Sabsau Sundar….Khor Sankari Badi Raseeli, Dadhi Lai Chali Kunwari Garvili,Sakhi Sang Mein Vahut Hathili, Aage Mohan Gail Rok Diyo,Roop Lubhani Kau. [2] Sabsau Sundar….Dai Ja Daan Kunwari Rasiya Kau, Peet Pichhauri Kati Kasiya Kau,Kunwari Hansi Lakhi Man Wasiya Kau, Ghunghat Mein Te Chheen Liyo Man,Waa Manmani Kau. [3] Sabsau Sundar….- Braj Ke LokgeetIn Vraj Dham, the most beautiful place is Barsana Dham, for it is the divine abode of Shri Radharani Herself. Even Shri Krishna personally comes to welcome Her there, and such is its glory that even the Vedas cannot fully describe it. On the peak of Brahmachal hill in this sacred Barsana stands the magnificent temple of Shri Radha Rani, shining with unmatched divine splendor. [1]When Shri Radha, adorned with divine beauty and grace, walks with Her sakhis carrying yogurt through the narrow alley of Sankari Khor, Shri Krishna suddenly appears and blocks Her path. This enchanting lila is among the most divine pastimes that take place in Barsana Dham. [2]Dressed in yellow garments with a scarf tied around His waist, Shri Krishna sweetly demands a toll (daan) from Shri Radha. But just one gentle smile from Her instantly captures His heart. Even from behind Her veil, Her divine face steals the mind of the ever-playful Krishna. Such are the nectar-filled pastimes that make Barsana the true kingdom of Rasa. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Achari Son Thakur Darein - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (113)
hindi_text: Achaari Son Thakur Darain, Dhing Nahi Avani Dehin.Premi Sadhu Kau Umangi Kai, Rijhi Ank Bhari Lehin.- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (113)Thakurji (Shri Krishna) keeps His distance from those absorbed in injunctions, prohibitions, rituals, and outward formalities. But to a pure-hearted lover, He joyfully draws near — embracing them again and again with loving affection.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hari Mohi Yon Apnay Liyo - Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (118)
hindi_text: Hari Mohin Yon Apnaay Liyau.Jahan Jahan Bighan Janyau Apne Kon, Tahan Tahan Jatan Kiyau. [1]Haun Tau Patit Aparadhi Atisai, Kripa Katakshi Jiyau.Shri Bihari Das Prabhu Ati Karunamay, Pragat Prasad Diyau. [2]- Shri Biharin Dev, Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (118)O Hari! You embraced me in such a way that wherever You saw obstacles in my life, You Yourself removed them time and again. [1]Though I am utterly fallen and sinful, still, through Your merciful gaze, You always protected and nurtured me. Shri Biharindev says — the ocean of compassion, Shri Banke Bihari Ji Maharaj, has bestowed upon me this manifest grace as a divine prasada. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Na Kahu Ko Nindano, Na Kahu Ki Sans - Shri Kant Kishor, Kant Rasik Ji Ki Vani, Doha (20)
hindi_text: Na Kahoo Ko Nindano, Na Kahoo Ki Sans.Kaant Rasik Haridas Ju, Mere Ur Avatans.- Shri Kant Kishor, Kant Rasik Ji Ki Vani, Doha (20)Neither do I criticize anyone, nor do I engage in anyone’s praise to win favor. Shri Kant Rasik says that the only true ornament of my heart is none other than my beloved Master, Swami Shri Haridas Ji.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ananya Vrat Khande Kisi Dhaar - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardh (175)
hindi_text: Ananya Vrat Khaande Keesi Dhaar.It-Ut Dagat Jagat Hit Tehari, Pheri Na Karat Samhaar. [1]Kaha Gyaasi Kul-Karmani Chhade, Jolagi Vishay Vikaar.Binu Premahi, Na Prasad Nem Tahan, Hari Na Grahat Jyaun Nar. [2]Kaun Kaam Keerati Binu Preetihi, Ganikaa Kaiso Jaar.Vyaasdas Ki Pati Gati Naasai, Gayein Paraaye Dwaar. [3]- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardh (175)The vow of ‘Ananyta’ (exclusive devotion) is as subtle and sharp as the edge of a sword. If the mind wavers here and there and slips into worldly attachments, even though Hari is the well-wisher of all, He does not uphold such wavering devotion. [1]What use is it to abandon social or family norms if the mind remains trapped in sensual cravings? Without love, neither rituals nor offerings (prasada) hold meaning, for Hari accepts only devotion filled with heartfelt bhava. Just as a husband will not accept an unfaithful wife, Hari too rejects loveless worship or rituals. [2]Fame without love is empty, like lying in the arms of a prostitute, where no real love exists,  only selfish desire. Sri Hariram Vyas says: when a wife goes to another’s door, her fidelity perishes; likewise, devotion loses its essence when 'Ananyta' is broken. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Barsano Vrishbhanu Ko Lakhi Saankari Khor - Shri Priyadas Ji, Rasik Mohini (22)
hindi_text: Barsano Vrishbhanu Ko, Lakhi Saankari Khor.Sakhin Sahit Shri Ladili, Nikasat Yahi Or.- Shri Priyadas Ji, Rasik Mohini (22)In Barsana, the town of King Vrishabhanu, there is a narrow alley known as Sāṅkarī Khora. Along this sacred path, Shri Radha, the charming daughter of Vrishabhanu, walks gracefully with her sakhis.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Man Vach Kaik Ek Ras Dhare Maha Vrat Prem - Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Premavali (28)
hindi_text: Man Vach Kaik Ek Ras, Dhare Maha Vrat Prem.Pran Priyahim Sevat Kunwar, Yahi Sukh Kau Nem.- Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Premavali (28)With mind, speech, and body aligned in a single flow, and with complete concentration upon the supreme vow of divine love, Rasik Lalju (Shri Krishna) is wholly immersed in the loving service of Shri Radha. For Him, giving happiness to Shri Radha is the only blissful rule He follows; He acknowledges no other regulation or discipline.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kahat Ju Baat Ari Suni Lalita - Shri Vrindavan Das Ji
hindi_text: Kahat Ju Baat Ari Suni Lalita.Piy Ke Sang Rang Ki Baaten, Kyon Tum Pragat Karat Hit-Salita. [1]Tumkau Kaaj Aur Kachu Nahi, Laaj Ki Aaj Majajahi Dalita.Vrindavan Rani Kar-Kamal Su, Kamalahi Dai Hansikai Van Chalita. [2]- Shri Vrindavan Das JiShri Radha says to Lalita — “O Lalita! Why do you reveal the private, intimate pastimes of love of my beloved, letting the stream of rasa overflow?” [1]You seem to have no other task — today you have completely cast aside all sense of modesty! Shri Vrindavan Das says — smiling sweetly, Shri Radha, the Queen of Vrindavan, placed a lotus flower in Lalita’s hands and gracefully walked off into the forest. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Prem Khel Sabson Kathin Khelat Kou Sujan - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (151)
hindi_text: Prem Khel Sabson Kathin, Khelat Kou Sujaan.Narayan Bin Prem Ke, Kaha Prem Pahchan.- Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (151)The play of divine love is the most difficult of all games, and only the truly wise can play it. Sri Narayan Swami says, “Without engaging in this play of love of God, no one can understand what love truly is.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Lochan Laalchi Mahaari - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya
hindi_text: Lochan Laalchi Mahaari.Lokalaj Kulkaani Sabai Taji, Chitavat Laalvihaari. [1]Tan Baajaar Haat Ang Angani, Sauda Karat Na Haari.Bharat Aharnis Hriday Bhandaarani, Det Na Ek Lagaari. [2]Nafa Bahut Aavat Hai Tope, Adhik Adhik Adhikaari.Rooprasik Ras-Lobh Lapete, Ade Bade Byopaari. [3]- Shri Roop Rasik DevacharyaMy eyes have become extremely greedy! They have cast aside all concern for societal norms and family honor, wholly absorbed in beholding Shri Lal Vihari (Shri Krishna). [1]This body has become like a marketplace, where every limb is engaged in the trade of Shri Lalju’s beauty. In this sacred exchange, the heart’s treasury is constantly enriched, and there is never any loss. [2]Such is the boundless profit of this trade that it multiplies endlessly, beyond measure. Rooprasik says, this is a miraculous exchange of divine rasa (nectar), in which the rasik devotees stand firm—faithful merchants of love. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pran Priya Praneshwari Laad Ladi Sukuvar - Shri Kishori Ali, Radha Namavali (25)
hindi_text: Praan Priya Praaneshwari, Laad Ladi Sukuvaar.Alak Ladaiti Laadili, Lalna Param Udaar.- Shri Kishori Ali, Radha Namavali (25)Shri Radha, dearer than life itself, the sovereign Queen of my soul, is lovingly playful and eternally youthful. She is “Alaka Laḍaitī” — worthy of all affection. She is the very embodiment of supreme generosity and compassion.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Phool Kunj, Barsana
hindi_text: Phool Kunj (Flower Bower) is a peaceful place in Barsana. It is located at the foothill of Brahmanchal Parvat, in the lane opposite the Chitra Sakhi Temple on the Chiksauli Rupnagar road. A small pond called Bicchua Kunda is also found here, adding to the quiet and sacred atmosphere of the area.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bade Bade Nayan Arun Ratnare - Shri Albeli Ali, Samay Prabandh (68)
hindi_text: Bade Bade Nayan Arun Ratnare.Chhakani Chhake Rasmatt Uninde, Neendar Ghoom-Ghumare. [1]Sundar Indu-Badan Ambuj Par, Deepat Roop Ujare.Albeli Ali Phirai Chapal Gati, Chanchal Mad-Matware. [2]- Shri Albeli Ali, Samay Prabandh (68)Shri Radha’s large eyes are bewitchingly reddish, like crimson jewels. They are so drenched in rasa that they appear drowsy, as if sleep is gently circling her eyelids. [1]Her lotus face, like the full moon, radiates a glow that illuminates everything around. Sri Albeli Ali says, the movements of her mischievous eyes are so playful that they seem completely intoxicated by the divine love. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Prem Punj Pragatai Jahan Tahan Pragat Hari Hoy - Shri Dayabai
hindi_text: Prem Punj Pragatai Jahan, Tahan Pragat Hari Hoy.‘Daya’ Daya Kari Det Hain, Shri Hari Darshan Soy.- Shri DayabaiWherever true love manifests, God Himself appears. Shri Dayabai says that, moved by compassion, God continually blesses such a premi bhakata with His divine darshan, making their life truly blessed and eternally fulfilled.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kim Krrishnasyaiva Rupam - Shri Govardhan Bhatt, Shri Radhakund Stava (46)
hindi_text: Kim Krrishnasyaiva Rupam Tribhuvanamanaso Hari Kim Yuthapayah Premamurttah Kimishte Kimu Vijayate Kelirevanayo Rva. Ittham Yatraiva Radha Pranayasahachari Samchayamodavrrindad Vambhramyante Suramyam Pranamata Sarasim Tam Mahadbhih Sunamyam.- Shri Govardhan Bhatt, Shri Radhakund Stava (46)Ah! How wondrous is the divine form of Shri Radhakund! Is it the form of Shri Krishna Himself, the Enchanter of the three worlds, manifest as a sacred pond? Or the personified love of ever-youthful Shri Radha, taking the form of a divine kund? Or perhaps the playful pastimes of both Radha and Krishna now appear in this form? Amid such divine wonder, Shri Radha’s intimate sakhis, lost in ecstatic rasa, wander in blissful bewilderment. Let us bow to that sacred and most enchanting Radhakund, revered by great souls.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Radhe Ju Ko Adhadhundh Darbar -  Shri Kripaluji, Prem Ras Madira, Shri Radha Madhuri (46)
hindi_text: Shri Radhe Ju Ko, Adhaadhundh Darbaar.Jin Vancharin Aacharan Kutsit, Jag Jehi Kah Vyabhichaar.Tin Kahun Nij Sahchari Kari Hari Son, Karavaavati Manuhaar.Jehi Raasahin Tarasati Kamala Si, Tap Kari-Kari Gai Haar. Tehi Vancharihīn Sakhin Kiy Raasahin, Ko As Saral Udaar.Kah ‘Kripalu’ Yah Jaani Gahahu Man! Sharan Gaur Sarkaar. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Shri Radha-Madhuri (46)Grace is bestowed in absolute abundance in Shri Radha’s court. The conduct of the women of Braj is considered immoral in the eyes of the world, known as fornication (because they loved Shyamsundar with exclusive devotion, despite having husbands at home and not knowing He is the Supreme Lord). Yet Shri Radha accepted them as Her intimate companions. Not only that, She even compelled Supreme Lord Shri Krishna Himself to lovingly plead before them. In the Maharaas, even Mahalakshmi was denied entry despite performing penance for ages. Yet, in that very Rasa, Shri Radha lovingly included these women as Her dearest soul-companions. Who else could possess such a soft, generous, and love-filled heart? Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji says: “O mind! Realizing the limitless mercy of such a supremely compassionate Swaminiji, surrender at Her lotus feet without delay.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ke Hve Rahu Drum Gulam Lata Beli Ban Mahi-  Nanddas Granthwali, Bhanwar Geet (67.1)
hindi_text: Kai Hvai Rahaun Drum Gulam Lata Beli Ban Maahin.Aavat Jaat Subhay Parai Mope Parchhayin.- Shri Nanddas, Nanddas Granthwali, Bhanwar Geet (67.1)The self-realized Uddhava says to Lord Shri Krishna — “O Lord! I now desire to become a tree, a vine, or a creeper in the holy land of Braj. Let me reside there forever, so that when the maidens of Braj wander here and there, their shadow may naturally fall upon me, and I may become truly fulfilled then.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Niratat Raas Mein Piy-Pyari - Shri Vitthal Das
hindi_text: (Raag Vihagaro)Niratat Raas Mein Piy-Pyaari.Jamuna-Pulin Subhag Vrindavan, Sharad Chand Ujiyaari. [1]Bajat Taal Mridang Jhanjh Dhap, Sapt Suran Gati Nyaari.Urap-Tirap Gati Let Sulap Ati, Laadili-Laal Bihaari. [2]Jai-Jai Kahi Barasat Kusumaavali, Suran Sahit Suranaari.Shri Vitthal Giridharn Laal Par, Sarvas Daarat Vaari. [3]- Shri Vitthal DasUnder the full moonlight of Sharad Purnima, on the banks of the Yamuna in the sacred land of Shri Dham Vrindavan, the divine couple Shri Radha Krishna are immersed in the blissful Rāsa dance. [1]All around, the sweet and rhythmic sounds of mṛdaṃga, jhāṅjha, ḍhapa, and tāla resound rhythmically. The seven musical notes flow with unparalleled sweetness. Shri Lāḍlī Lāla dance together ecstatically in divine love, with swift, graceful movements of Urapa-Tirapa. [2]The gods and goddesses shower flowers while singing “Jai Jai.” Shri Vitthal Das Ji, overwhelmed in divine bliss, offers his entire being to the upholder of Govardhan, Shri Krishna. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Brajraaj Son Naata Juda Ab Hai - Braj Ke Sawaiya
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Brajraaj Son Naata Juda Ab Hai, Tab Jag Ki Kya Parvaah Karein.Bas Yaad Mein Rote Rahein Unki, Palkon Par Ashru Pravah Karein. [1]Jitni Veh Door Rahein Hum Son, Utni Hum Unki Chaah Karein,Sukh Adbhut Prem Ki Peer Mein Hai, Ham Aah Karein Vo Vaah Karein. [2]- Braj Ke SawaiyaNow that I belong to the Lord of Braj (Śrī Kṛṣṇa), why should I care about this selfish world anymore? I will keep shedding tears in loving remembrance of Him, and let my eyelids remain forever wet with love. [1]Even if Śyām Sundar ignores me endlessly, I will not retreat; rather, my love for Him will only grow. There is a unique rasa in the pangs of separation. My only hope is that when I sigh in love, those sighs become so dear to Him that He smiles joyfully and says, "Vāha!" (Wow). [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Agra Ubhay Taaki Bani, Hai Santan Ke Saath - Shri Agradas, Agragranthawali (1.45)
hindi_text: ‘Agra’ Ubhay Taaki Bani, Hai Santan Ke Saath.Ik Dvai Dvai Aru Chupri, Puni Laadoo Do Haath.- Shri Agradas, Agragranthawali (1.45)Shri Agraswami Ji says that those who associate with saints and strictly follow their guidance attain all kinds of welfare. As long as they live in this world, they experience bliss, and even in the afterlife, they remain forever immersed in spiritual rasa.  Such a person truly has sweets in both hands — meaning, he gains happiness in both worlds.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sarad Ujyari Raas Rachyo Piy Pyari - Shri Priyadas, Bhakti Ras Bodhini (371)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Sarad Ujyari, Ras Rachyo Piy Pyari,Tamai Rang Chadhyo Bhari, Kaisai Kahikai Sunaaiye. [1]Priya Ati Gati Lai, Bijuri Si Kaundh Gai,Chakchaudhi Bhai, Chhavi Mandal Mein Chhaiye. [2]Nupur So Tooti Parsayu, Man Arbarayo Bhayau,Tori Kai Janeu Bandhyo Vahi Bhanti Bhaiye. [3]Sakal Samaj Mein Youn Kahyo - Aaj Kaam Aayau,Dhoyau Hau Janam, Taaki Baat Jia Aaiye. [4]- Shri Priyadas, Bhakti Ras Bodhini (371)In the commentary of Bhaktamāl, Śrī Priyadās Jī narrates a unique incident from the life of Śrī Harirām Vyās Jī —On the full moon night of Śārad Pūrṇimā, when the Divine Couple (Śrī Rādhā‑Kṛṣṇa) performed the divine Rāsa, the entire atmosphere became immersed in the color of divine love, whose sweetness cannot be expressed in words. [1]During the Rāsa, Śrī Rādhā displayed such a wondrous movement, like a sudden flash of lightning; Her brilliance illuminated the entire Rāsa Maṇḍal, casting a glow in every direction. [2]Meanwhile, as the Rāsa continued, an anklet from Śrī Rādhājū’s foot fell off; upon witnessing this scene, Harirām Vyās Jī’s heart burst forth with intense, restless love, and instantly he broke his sacred thread (janeū) and tied it at Śrī Rādhā’s feet in place of the anklet. [3]Afterwards, in front of all the rasika saints, he said, “I wore this sacred thread all my life, but it never had real meaning; today, it became truly valuable by being used in Rādhā Jī’s service” — this touched everyone’s hearts and filled all the devotees with divine love. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Braj Brahmachal Shikhar Pai Sundar Pyaari Thaam - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Braj Brahmaachal Shikhar Pai, Sundar Pyaari Thaam.Jahaan Laadili Sakhin Sang, Viharat Aathon Yaam.- Braj Ke DoheOn the peak of the Brahmachal Hill in Barsana, within the most sacred realm of Braj, lies a beautiful and supremely holy place where beloved Ladili Shri Radha eternally engages in various sports with Her beloved sakhis throughout all eight quarters of the day.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dhara Dhaam Mein Madhav Ne Itna - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Dhara Dhaam Mein Madhav Ne Itna, Kisi Gopika Ko Apnaya Nahin.Jise Lekar Saath Akele Gaye, Us Bhed Ko Ved Ne Paya Nahin. [1]“Hare Krishna”! Vishesh Rahasya Chhipa, Shiv Shesh Ke Dhyaan Mein Aaya Nahin.Samjha Sab Saaron Ka Saar Atah, Shuk Vyas Ne Naam Bataya Nahin. [2]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’Śrī Kṛṣṇa never embraced any gopī as completely as He embraced that one gopī (Śrī Rādhā), whom He took alone with Him during the Rāsa pastimes. Even the Vedas could not grasp the mystery behind this. [1]Śrī Hare Kṛṣṇa Jī says—The subject of Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī is supremely mysterious, so subtle that even great jñānīs like Śiva and Śeṣa are unable to grasp Her in their deep meditation. Therefore, considering Her the essence of all essences, both Śukadeva and Ved Vyāsa did not explicitly mention Her name (Śrī Rādhā). [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hau Tere Varane Mand Gati - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (12)
hindi_text: (Raag Vilabal)Haun Tere Vaarane Mand Gati Chali Piy Soin.Mere Pachhain Duri Muri Nilambar Odh Sakhi,Abhi Miluun Lalahin Gupat Ki Gaunhi. [1]Aatur Hwye Avainge Tab Na Banengi,Mero Kahyo Maan Pyari, Kahat Haun Tohi.Shri Beethal Vipul Vinod Bihari Saun Hil Mili,Kai Tero Jyon Janain Kai Haun Hi. [2]- Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (12)While thoughtfully arranging the loving meeting of Shri Radha with Her beloved Lalji (Krishna), the close companion (Vitthal Vipul) gently says to Sri Radha —O Sakhi! I sacrifice myself to you. Let us walk slowly toward the Beloved. I promise, this plan will bring such a divine rasa that its sweetness will be unmatched. If you wear a deep-blue veil and quietly follow me from behind, then meeting Lalji in this hidden way will awaken a new, special delight. [1]However, if you delay, and Shyamasundara meets you halfway in eager excitement, the rasa I am vividly conducting will not unfold in its intended fullness. So I kindly ask you — trust my words and come with me without delay. In this sudden meeting with Shyamasundara, a wondrous, playful ecstasy will manifest — either you alone will be able to relish it, or perhaps only I will truly comprehend its essence. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hamari Sudh Lije Ho Mohan Pyare - Shri Guruchauna Ji Maharaj
hindi_text: (Raag Sorath and Vibhas)Hamari Sudh Lije Ho Mohan Pyare.Tum Bin Mere Aur Na Koi, Preetam Nand Dulare. [1]Bahiyaan Gahi Ki Od Nibaho, Bhav-Sagar Kari Paare.“Sakhichhauna” Ko Daras Dikhao, Tarasat Nain Vichare. [2]- Shri Guruchauna Ji MaharajO beloved Mohan! Please think of me as well. O darling son of Nanda, my beloved! Without You, there is no one else I seek. [1]Hold my hand, O Lord, and carry me across this ocean-like world. ‘Sakhichhauna’ cries out — grant me Your divine darshan, for these poor eyes are yearning to behold you. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ratan-Khachit Vrindavipun Bhumi Lata Drum Rang - Shri Roop Sakhi, Siddhant Ke Doha (22)
hindi_text: Ratan-Khachit Vrindavipun, Bhoomi Lata-Drum Rang.Shri Swami Ke Laadile, Rache Sukeli Anang.- Shri Roop Sakhi, Siddhant Ke Doha (22)The divine land of Shri Dham Vrindavan, adorned with precious gems, is decorated with various creepers and trees of many colors. There, the beloveds of Shri Swami Haridas Ji, the divine couple Sri Śyāmā Kuṃjabihārī, are eternally engaged in love kelī, immersed in the rasa of nitya vihāra.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Avadhi Prem Ki Dou Pyare - Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (101)
hindi_text: (Raag Vihagarau)Avadhi Prem Ki Dou Pyare.Tan-Man-Nain Rahe Ekai Hai, Kabahoo Hot Na Nyaare. [1]Ruchi-Ruchi Saun Rachi Rahe Dou Jan, Jyaun Nainani Ke Taare.Hit Dhruv Reejhi Paraspar Chhavi Par, Tan-Man Det Hain Vaare. [2]- Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (101)O Sakhi! Our divine youthful couple is the very embodiment of love. Their bodies, hearts, and glances have become one, inseparable in every way. [1]Immersed in the sweetness of each other’s love, they remain united like the very apple of each other’s eyes. Shri Hit Dhruvdas Ji says that, captivated by one another's beauty, they constantly offer their body and mind in pure devotion to each other. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Koti Vishv Aishwarya Sukh - Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer, Sohni Mahima (435.10)
hindi_text: Koti Vishv Aishwarya Sukh, Nahin Ju Ek Kan Tool.So Raj Tokon Khel Hai, Meri Jeevan Mool.- Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer, Sohni Mahima (435.10)Shri Hit Bhorisakhi Ji says — “O dear broom! The joy found in the splendor of countless universes cannot match even a single speck of this divine dust of Vrindavan. You may think that sweeping away this dust is mere play, but for me, this sacred dust is the very breath of my life.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jay Shri Radhika Ras Bhari - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (32)
hindi_text: (Doha)Puran Prem Prakas Ken, Pari Payodhini Puri.Jay Shri Radha Ras Bhari, Shyam Sajeevan Muri.(Pad)Jay Shri Radhika Ras Bhari.Rasik Sundar Sanware Ki Pran Jeevan Jari. [1]Gaur Ang Anang Adbhut Surati Rangani Rari.Sahaj Sang Abhang Jori Subhag Sanche Dhari. [2]Param Prem Prakas Puran Par Payodhini Pari.Hitu Shri Haripriya Nirakhati Nikat Nij Sahchari. [3]- Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (32)(Doha)All glories to the one and only, Shri Radha Maharani, who is filled with divine rasa and is the very source of life of Sri Krishn. By whose grace pure love became manifest, and who, after filling the ocean of love, submerged herself in it.(Pad)All glories to Shri Radha Maharani, overflowing with divine sweetness, the very source of life and bliss for Shyamasundara. [1]Her fair form is draped in divine love and the colors of amorous pastimes. She always performs eternal plays of love through her own Yugala form (Shri Radha and Sri Krishna together), never separated from His beloved Sri Krishna. Every limb of Her divine body radiates natural beauty, elegance, and auspiciousness. [2]The complete revelation of supreme love manifests only through Shri Radha Maharani, who is Herself immersed in that infinite ocean of love. Hari Priya Sakhi beholds Her intimately amidst the circle of Her beloved companions [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bahut Bhoomi It Ut Phirayo - Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani
hindi_text: Bahut Bhoomi It-Ut Phirayau, Maaya Bas Jhakhajor.Ab Kab Hvaihain Safal Page, Vrindavan Ki Or.- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh)I have wandered long through this world, entangled in the spell of Maya. Alas, when will that blessed day arrive — the day my feet find their true purpose, carrying me to Vrindavan at last, never to turn back again.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jihi Jihi Angani Drishti Parat Ho - Shri Vanshi Ali, Siddhant Ke Pad (35)
hindi_text: (Raag Devgandhar)Jihin-Jihin Angani Drishti Parat Ho Ladaiti, Tahan-Tahan Ataki Rahat Man Mero. Teri Saunhan Khaun Lakhan, Haun To Tero Cherau. [1]Teri Ye Aas Bihaar Karat Nit, Tum Upajeev Hero. Rasikan Shri Lalita-Sakhi Kripa Te, Mo Hiy Seban Tero. [2]- Shri Vanshi Ali, Siddhant Ke Pad (35)O Sri Radha! Wherever my eyes rest upon Your divine limbs, my mind becomes captivated and remains fixed there. I swear by you, I am your eternal servant. [1]It is only through the hope of You that I taste the sweetness of the nitya vihāra (eternal love-play) rasa. You alone are the highest refuge and the very support of my life. Shri Vamsi Ali says that, by the grace of the Rasika devotees and Lalita Sakhi, my heart is forever engaged in Your eternal service. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ur Prakash Ho Rupa Ko - Sri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Sri Radha Naam Ank (21)
hindi_text: Ura Prakaash Ho Roop Ko, Naina Jhalakai Prem.Roop Maadhuri Priya Ko, Naam Japo Rakh Nem.- Shri Roop Madhuri, Sri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Sri Radha Naam Ank (21)If one sincerely takes a firm vow to constantly chant the holy name “Shri Radha,” then soon Shri Radha’s divine form reveals itself within the heart, and the radiance of love begins to shine through the eyes.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pyari Tohi Kaise Ke Maan Manaaun - Shri Ramray Ji, Aadivani (37)
hindi_text: Pyari! Tohi Kaise Ke Maan Manaaun.Sab Vidhi Vivas, Rajdhaani Vasi, Chhadam Kadam Bahu Baat Banaun.Gun-Aagar, Sagar Karuna Ki, Kaun Naveen Keli Jo Janaun.Shri Ramraay Tav Pad-Pankaj Navi, Nipat Deen Tan Haa-Haa Khaun.- Shri Ramray Ji, Aadivani (37)To please Shri Radha, Shri Krishna speaks in a voice full of compassion —O Pyārījū! I am trying every possible way to appease your sulking, but I am now completely helpless. Even while residing in your very own capital, Vrindavan, I keep devising new ways every moment to please You, but all My efforts end in vain. [1]O most merciful One, O ocean of divine virtues, Shri Radha! Tell me, what new playful pastime should I now perform so that a sweet smile once again graces your lips? Shri Ramray says — In the end, Shri Krishna humbly bows down and places His head at the lotus-feet of Shri Radha, pleading from the depths of His heart with utmost love and devotion. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Raas Rachyo Vrindavan Banvari - Sri Purushottam Ji
hindi_text: Raas Rachyo Vrindavan Banwaari.Bansivat Kunjan Jamuna-Tat, Manmohan Piy Rasik Bihaari. [1]Nirat Karat Man Harat Sakhin Kau, Upjat Rang-Tarang Ati Bhaari.Purushottam Prabhu Ki Chhabi Nirakhat, Braj-Jan Baar-Baar Balihari. [2]- Sri Purushottam JiRasika Bihari, Lord Shri Krishna, performs the divine Rasa dance in the sacred groves of Bansivat, on the banks of the Yamuna in Vrindavan. [1]As he dances, he enchants the hearts of the sakhis, immersing them in the vibrant hues of divine love. Shri Purushottam Ji reveals that upon witnessing this captivating form of Krishna, the residents of Braj repeatedly offer themselves at His feet. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Chari Badan Main Kah Kahyo - Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar, Dasham Sakandh
hindi_text: Chari Badan Main Kah Kahau, Sahsanan Nahi Jaan.Gai Charavat Gwal Sang, Karat Nand Ki Aan.- Sri Surdas, Soor SagarBrahma Ji, humbly apologizing to Shri Krishna, says — “O Lord! You lovingly tend the cows in Braj and constantly remind everyone of Nand Baba’s oath. Even Sheshnag, with his thousand mouths, could not fully understand Your divine pastimes — how then can I, Brahma, with only four mouths, hope to sing Your glories?”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mahali Ki Gati Mahli Jaane - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Mahali Ki Gati Mahli Jaane, Kaha Jane Bahar Varo.Nrip Ki Rahan-Sahan Kaha Jane, Bhedh Charavan Haro.- Braj Ke DoheThe most confidential love-plays of Shri Radha within Her personal palace with Krshn are known only to Her intimate sahacarīs (closest companions) who reside there. It is impossible to comprehend such secrets for those who are devoid of that rasa. It is just like a shepherd trying to understand the royal lifestyle of a king — how could that be possible?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrishabhanu Nandini Durant Ki Nikandini Hain - Braj Ke Kavitt
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Vrishabhanu Nandini Durant Ki Nikandini Hain, Nitya Nand Nandan Anandini Hain Radhika. [1]Roop Rang Ras Ki Sakal Chhavi Chandini Hain, Gandh Ki Madir Makarandini Hain Radhika. [2]Kalpana Srijan Ki Hain, Kamna Mithun Ki Hain, Sphurana Pranay Ki Hain, Spandini Hain Radhika. [3]Prerana Yajan Ki Hain, Bhavana Bhajan Ki Hain, Abhinandini Hain, Vishva Vandini Hain Radhika. [4]- Braj Ke KavittŚrī Rādhā, the enchanting daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, dispels all kinds of sorrow and delusion, and always bestows bliss upon Nand Nandan, Śrī Kṛṣṇa. [1]She is the very embodiment of beauty, color, and rasa — like the nectar of divine fragrance, she irresistibly captivates every heart. [2]She is the eternal inspiration behind creation itself, the yearning for divine union, the spontaneous pulse and radiance of love. [3]Rādhikā is the very foundation of worship, the very sentiment of devotion; she is the one who is honored and revered by the whole world. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hirani Ke Bore Nahin Hansan Ki Nahin Paant - Shri Biharin Dev, Rasopasna Tilak
hindi_text: Heerani Ke Bori Nahin, Hansani Ki Nahi Pant.Sheran Ke Nahin Revade, Rasikan Ki Na Jamaat.- Shri Biharin Dev, Rasopasna TilakDiamonds are not found in sacks, nor do swans walk in rows. Lions, too, do not gather in flocks like sheep — similarly, Rasikas (true connoisseurs of divine love) never gather in groups; they are extremely rare and remain hidden.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ladaiti Anand Nidhi Sukha Rasi - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (2)
hindi_text: Ladaiti Anand Nidhi Sukha Raasi.Maha Prem Bhari Sahaj Chhabeeli, Sadaa Hi Preetam Paasi. [1]Adbhut Roop Raseeli Bhaamini, Bandhe Madhur Mridu Haasi.Shri Lalita Kisori Rasik Shiromani, Vilasat Keli Vilaasi. [2]- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (2)Nitya Vihāriṇī, Shri Radha is the treasure of supreme bliss and the unfathomable ocean of happiness. Overflowing with divine love, She is effortlessly enchanting and always remains near Her beloved Kuṃjabihārī. [1]Her form is unparalleled and full of rasa, and her sweet smile is extremely captivating. Shri Lalitakishori says — She is the crown jewel among all rasikas, forever immersed in kelī plays, engaged in eternal nitya vihāra. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Yasyah Sphurjatpadanakhamani Jyoti - Shri Hita Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (136)
hindi_text: Yasyah Sphurjatpadanakhamani Jyotirekachchatayah Sandra Premamrritarasa Mahasindhu Kotivilasah. Sa Chedradha Rachayati Krripa Drrishtipatam Kadachin, Muktistuchcho Bhavati Vahushah Prakrrita Prakrritashrih.- Shri Hita Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (136)From just a single ray of light shining from the jeweled nails of Her lotus feet, countless waves of divine love and bliss arise like endless oceans of nectar. Should Sri Radha ever bestow even the slightest merciful glance upon me, then all worldly and even spiritual opulences, including liberation, become utterly insignificant to me.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shyama Sujhat Nahi Kachhu Mohe - Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (17)
hindi_text: (Raag Vibhas, Trital)Shyama Sujhat Nahi Kachhu Mohe.Tum Jaanat Sab Mere Man Keen, Kahaan Janaaun Tohe. [1]Teri Sharan Lai Ab Shyaama, Tum Bin Mera Kohai.Shri Gopalhit Hari Laadli, Pal-Pal Tohe Johe. [2]- Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (17)O Shyama Ju! I have no clue what to do. You already know every thought within my heart—so what more could I possibly tell you? [1]After wandering through countless lifetimes, I have now finally taken refuge in you, O Shyama Ju! I have no one besides you. Shri Hit Gopal Das says—O beloved of Hari, Shri Radha! My heart waits for you every single moment. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Vrindavan Saghan Saras Sukh - Shri Rasik Govind, Shri Yugal Ras Madhuri, Doha (4)
hindi_text: Shri-Vrindavan Saghan Saras-Sukh, Nit Chhavi Chhaajat. Nandan-Van Se Koti-Koti, Jihi Dekhat Laajat. - Shri Rasik Govind, Shri Yugal Ras Madhuri (4)The divine land of Shri Vrindavan Dham is dense, blissful, and filled with the essence of transcendental rasa. Its beauty radiates in all directions, enchanting every heart. Even the countless celestial gardens like Indra’s Nandanvan feel shamed before its splendour — for Vrindavan’s glory far surpasses it in every way.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kim Karishyanti No Veda - Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (102)
hindi_text: Kim Karishyanti No Veda Kimva Deva Saheshvarah. Kushala Kushalamvapi Shriradha Bhajato Mamah.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (102)In the exclusive devotion of Shri Radha, I do not need to follow the injunctions of the Vedas and scriptures, nor do I need to please or fear any other deity or god. Whether they bring me good or bad results, I do not care. My only longing is to serve the lotus feet of Sri Radha, which is not attained through the grace of gods or scriptural rituals, but solely through the mercy of Shri Radha Maharani herself.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Radha Pyari Sukumari - Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
hindi_text: Shri Radha Pyari Sukumari, Chhabi Par Main Bali Jaun.Lekar Kamal Adhar Dhar Bansi, Tero Hi Gun Gaun. [1]Kripa Tihari So Main Shyama, Radha Raman Kahaun.Saras Madhuri Sarbas Meri, Nirakh Nain Hulsaun. [2]- Shri Saras MadhuriŚrī Kṛṣṇa says— O beloved Śrī Rādhāpyārī Jū! I surrender myself completely to Your enchanting beauty. Through the flute on my lips, I sing only of Your divine virtues. [1]O Śyāmā Jū!
