It is solely by Your grace that I am known as “Rādhāramaṇa.” Śrī Saras Mādhurī says—O my dearest Beloved! You alone are my everything. My eyes find true fulfillment only in beholding Your divine form. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Anuchhin Lalhu Rahat Hain Sada Priya Aadhen - Sri Ramsakhiji, Shri Bhaktiras Manjari, Doha (92)
hindi_text: Anuchhin Lalhu Rahat Hain, Sada Priya Aadheen.Tehi Ras Mein Sahchari Sakal, Rahat Magan Jimi Meen.- Sri Ramsakhiji, Shri Bhaktiras Manjari, Doha (92)Lālajī (Śrī Kṛṣṇa) forever remains under the loving control of His Priyājī (Śrī Rādhā). In that same divine mood and rasa, all the sahacarīs remain completely absorbed, just as fish are ever immersed in water.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aaj Jhulat Ladeti Jhulavat Lalit Tribhangi - Shri Kishoridas (of Gaudiya sect.)
hindi_text: (Raag Kaafi)Aaj Jhoolat Ladeeti Jhulaavat Lalit Tribhangi.Sahaj Shringaar Keshari Angiyan, Saadi Vani Pachhrangi. [1]Chahu Or Gopi Madhure Sur, Gaavat Taan Tarangi.Shri Vrajchandra Kishori Ju Ki, Vaanik Nav Nav Rangi. [2]- Shri Kishoridas (of Gaudiya sect.)Today, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, whose graceful form bends in three places, joyfully swings Śrī Rādhā upon a beautiful swing. Her limbs, naturally adorned with divine ornaments, glisten with saffron hues, and she is dressed in a radiant five-colored saree. [1]All around, the gopīs sing in soft, melodious voices. The enchanting scene of the Jhūlā-līlā of Śrī Vrajachandra and Kiśorī overflows with ever-fresh colors and blissful rasa. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Giridhar Piy Ke Hridyavasi  - Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki Vani (163)
hindi_text: (Raag Nat Narayan)Giridhar Piy Ke Hridyavasi Tere Badan Ki Param Sudes Chhabi.Ek Ang Ke Roop Ke Aag Jat Sakhi, Kotisat Chandrama Davi. [1]Nain Ans Ki Sobha Varni Sakai Esau Kaun Kavi.‘Kumbhandas’ Swamini Radhika, Ihai Gati Tohi Kon Yon Aai Phavi. [2]- Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki Vani (163)O Sakhi! The beauty of Shri Radhika, who resides in the heart of beloved Giridhar (Shri Krishna), is supremely enchanting. The radiance of even one of her limbs surpasses that of millions of moons and suns. [1]Who among the rasik poets can truly describe the beauty of her eyes and arms? Shri Kumbhandas says — O Swamini Radhika! The sight of your divine beauty completely captivates the mind. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Vanraj Vilasini Mridu Hasini Sukh Punj - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Shri Vanraj Vilaasini, Mridu Haasini Sukh Punj.Shri Krishnavallabha Radhike, Jai Jai Sevakunj.- Braj Ke DoheO You who sport in the blissful forest of Vṛndāvan, O one with a most innocent smile, O embodiment of nectar, Sri Krishn's beloved  — Śrī Rādhikā, all glories to You! O Sovereign of Sevakunj, again and again, all glories to Sevākuñj — Your eternal abode!
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nitya Bihar Son Kari Priti - Shri Roop Sakhi Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (61)
hindi_text: (Raag Vibhas)Nitya Vihar Son Kari Priti.Sang Rasik Ananya Anusari, Bhaav Bhakti Prateeti. [1]Dhyaan Chit Chintaa Raho Nitya, Maani Rasik Ki Reeti.Laal Roop Viloki Dampati, Lakhi Jagat Bipareeti. [2]- Shri Roop Sakhi, Roop Sakhi Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (61)Develop love for the nitya-vihāra-rasa (the eternal love-plays of the Divine Couple), for that alone is the very essence of life for the ananya rāsika saints. By associating with such exalted rāsikas and walking in their footsteps, firm faith in this path of devotion naturally awakens within the heart. [1]Firmly grasp and adopt the mode of divine love followed in the rāsika tradition, and constantly engage your contemplation, mind, and heart in that rasa. Śrī Rūpa Sakhī declares—when the Divine Couple, Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, appear vividly both in outward vision and inward meditation, then all worldly pursuits and pleasures seem utterly insignificant. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mangana Ho To Mango Seva Shyama Shyama - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Shyama Shyam Geet (55)
hindi_text: Mangana Ho To Mango, Seva Shyama Shyama.Seva Hit Puni Mango, Prem Nishkama.- Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Shyama Shyam Geet (55)If one must ask for something, then ask only for the service of the divine couple, Śrī Śyāma-Śyām. For that service, beg only for the pure, selfless love. Let no other desire or request arise within your heart—this alone is the true path of devotion.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Det Sada Yamuna Sukh Raashi Ko - Shri Hita Damodar Das, Phutakar Vani (12)
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Det Sada Yamuna Sukh Raashi Kon, Naam Liye Yamuna Shram Na.Yamuna Hari Dhaam Kau Prapak, Kovid Shuddha Saroop Jahaan Tam Na. [1]Yamuna Hit Ras Mein Hit Daas Damodar Vaari Viloki Rahai Bhram Na.Bhaniye Yamuna Yamuna Yamuna Yamuna Yamuna Yamuna Yamuna. [2]- Shri Hita Damodar Das, Phutakar Vani (12)Śrī Yamunā always bestows eternal bliss, and her name, “Yamunā”, is so effortless to chant that it requires no strain at all. Yamunā is the one who grants the way to Hari’s sacred abode. She is the embodiment of pure wisdom, dispelling all the darkness of illusion and ignorance. [1]Śrī Hit Dāmodar Dās declares that he offers himself entirely to Yamunā, who is forever immersed in the nectar of divine love and lifts others into that same blissful rasa. Whoever gazes upon Yamunā with a devoted heart finds all doubts vanish from within. So, chant again and again—“Yamunā, Yamunā, Yamunā, Yamunā, Yamunā, Yamunā, Yamunā!” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nit Bihar Vrindavan Radha Mohan - Shri Anandghan Ji, Shri Ghanananda Granthavali, Padavali (637)
hindi_text: (Raag Alahiya Bilaval - Ikatala)Nit Bihar Vrindavan Radha Mohan Karat Rahain.Sahaj Rangeele Chhail Chhabeele Hit Chit Laah Lahain. [1]Nit Braj Nit Vyavhaar Nit Nae Tan Man Panani Bahain.Nit Hee Hit Jhoomain Anandghan Jamuna Teer Gahain. [2]-  Shri Anandghan Ji, Shri Ghananand Granthawali, Padavali (637) Śrī Radha and Śrī Mohan (Śrī Krishna) eternally engage in their divine love-plays (nitya-vihāra) in the supremely divine land of Vṛndāvan. They are naturally playful and charming, always exchanging the rasa of pure love in their hearts. [1]Braj is ever-fresh; every sport here is ever-new. The body, mind, and very life flow continually in this stream of divine love. Śrī Anandghan beautifully describes how on the banks of the Yamunā﻿, the Divine Couple, along with their beloved companions (Sahcharis), sway joyfully every moment, immersed constantly in divine prema. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Vallabh Var Ko Chhandi Ke - Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (59)
hindi_text: Shri Vallabh Var Ko Chhandi Ke, Bhaje Jo Bhairav Bhoot.Anta Phajiti Hoygi, Jyon Ganika Ko Poot.- Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (59)A person who abandons devotion to the Supreme Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa and instead worships Bhairava-spirits meets a shameful end—just like the son of a courtesan, who never gains respect or honor in society.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Lalit Mohini Kunj Me Dayi Punj Darsay - Sri Thakur Das Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (3)
hindi_text: Lalit Mohini Kunj Mein, Dayi Punj Darsay.Thakur Daasi Nit Sahchari, Sevat Hiy Hulasay.- Shri Thakur Das, Sri Thakur Das Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (3)In the Lalit Mohinī Kunja (the charming and enchanting groves of Vrindavan), Śrī Thākur Dāsī is blessed with the privilege to behold the treasure of that divine beauty and rasa. He says that there, the Sahcarīs (female companions) are intoxicated with love and remain ever engaged in the selfless service of the Divine Couple, Śrī Śyāma Kunjbihārī.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sadho Yah Vichar Man Jancha Hai - Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (49)
hindi_text: (Raag Barwa Va Kalangda)Sadho Yah Vichaar Man Jaanchaa Hai. (Tek)Preet Nahin Unmein Bilkul Bhi, Jin Hari Se Kuch Yaancha Hai.Vishay Bhog Sab Feeke Laage, Jin Hari Se Man Rancha Hai. [1]Lok Laaj Kul Kaan Taje Soi, Daas Hari Ka Saancha Hai.‘Roopmaadhuri’ Ishq Hari Mein, Prem Magan Hoy Naancha Hai. [2]- Shri Roop Madhuri, Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (49)O seekers! I have thoroughly contemplated this truth within my heart — There is no trace of real love in those who ask anything from the Lord. Those who truly love Sri Hari find worldly pleasures tasteless. [1]One who renounces the sense of social modesty and family decorum is the true servant of Lord Hari. Sri Rūpamādhurī says — one who is immersed in the divine love for Hari, dances in divine ecstasy. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vyas Kulinani Koti Mili, Pandit Laakh Pachis - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (16)
hindi_text: Vyas Kulinani Koti Mili, Pandit Laakh Pachees.Swapach Bhakt Ki Paanahi, Tulai Na Tinke Sees.- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Saakhi (16)Even if crores of high-born nobles and lakhs of learned Pandits were to gather, all their combined heads still cannot equal the dust of the feet of that low-born (so-called untouchable) devotee of Vrindavan, who, though born in a very low family, is a true servant of God.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jamuna-Pulin Kunj Gahbar Ki - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (65)
hindi_text: (Raag Chaiti Gauri)Jamuna-Pulin Kunj Gahbar Ki, Kokil Hvai Drum Kuk Machaun.Pad-Pankaj Priy Laal-Madhup Hvai, Madhure-Madhure Gunj Sunaun. [1]Kookar Hvai Ban-Veethini Dolau, Bache Seeth Rasikan Ke Khaun.Lalitkishori Aas Yahi Mam, Brajraj Taji Chhin Anat Na Jaun. [2]- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (65)When will that blessed moment arrive when I become a cuckoo, sweetly singing from a tree in some secluded grove by the Yamunā﻿ in Vrindavan? Or, becoming a bumblebee at the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, may I softly hum sweet melodies in Their loving service? [1]Or perhaps I may be like a dog, wandering the lanes of Vṛndāvan, surviving on the remnants of the rāsika saints. Śrī Lalitkiśorī expresses a single heartfelt desire: that never for a moment shall I leave the sacred dust of Braj. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Guru Deen Dayal Ju Yah Abhilasha Mor - Shri Premdas Ji [Brother of Shri Lal Balbir Ji], Shri Premdas Ji Ki Vani (86.1)
hindi_text: Shri Guru Deen Dayal Ju, Yah Abhilasha Mor. Yugal Chand Pad Kanj Chhabi, Man Malind Gat Chor. - Shri Premdas Ji [Brother of Shri Lal Balbir Ji], Shri Premdas Ji Ki Vani (86.1)O Merciful Gurudev! My only wish is that the lotus feet of the Divine Couple, Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa﻿, may steal away the restless movements of my bee-like mind with their sweetness, so that it may forever remain immersed in the bliss of those sacred feet.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nainan Ke Tare Dulare  - Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Vinay Prem Pachasa (24)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Nainan Ke Taare Dulare Praan-Pyaare Mere,Dukh Ke Daran Sukh-Karan Visaal Hain. [1]Mero Dhyaan Mero Gyaan Mere Ved Au Puraan,Vividh Pramaan Mere Ek Nandalal Hain. [2]‘Harichand’ Aur Son Na Kaam Sapnehoon Mohin,Mere Sarvas Dhan Yasuda Ke Vaal Hain. [3]Meri Rati Meri Mati Mere Pati Mere Aan,Mere Jag Maahin Sabai Keval Gupaal Hain. [4]- Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Vinay Prem Pachasa (24)Beloved Nandalāl (Kṛṣṇa), the apple of my eyes, dearer than life itself, fills me with joy and dispels all sorrows. [1]He alone is the essence of my meditation, my wisdom, my Vedas and Purāṇas — the very foundation of all scriptural knowledge. [2]Śrī Hariśchandra declares: Even in dreams, none other occupies my mind, for all my treasures reside in Yaśodā’s son, Śrī Kṛṣṇa. [3]He is my love, my mind, my husband, my pride and honor — everything in this world means only Śrī Gopāl to me. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Utakantha Ati Hi Badhi Tuv Darshan Ke Kaaj - Sri Kishori Ali
hindi_text: Utakantha Ati Hi Badhi, Tuv Darshan Ke Kaaj.Daya Drishti Mo Tan Karo, Sri Radhe Sirtaj.- Sri Kishori AliO Shri Radhe! The longing to behold Your divine form has become extremely intense in my heart. Please, O supreme Queen, cast Your merciful glance upon me now.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ab Ka Samujhavti Ko Samujhe - Shri Thakur Ji
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Ab Ka Samujhavati Ko Samujhai, Badnami Ke Beej To Bo Chuki Ri. Tab Tau Itnao Na Bichar Kayo, Ihin Jal Pare Kahu Ko Chuki Ri. [1]Kahi Thakur, Ya Ras-Riti Range Kari Preeti, Pativrat Kho Chuki Ri. Sakhi, Neki-Badi Jo Badi Hoti, Bhal Pai Honi Hoti, So To Ho Chuki Ri. [2]- Shri ThakurjiOne sakhi (friend) says to another—Now what will you explain, and who will understand you? You have already sown the seeds of infamy. What’s the use of overthinking now? Since you yourself have fallen into the snare of love, whom can you blame? [1]Whoever once becomes immersed in the path of prema-rasa (divine love) for Banke Bihārī naturally gives up worldly pativratā. O friend! What was destined already unfolds according to fate—so give up your pointless worry. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Vrindavan Sahaj Ji Lalit Madhuri Roop - Shri Lalit Madhuri
hindi_text: Shri Vrindavan Sahaj Ji, Lalit Madhuri Roop.Lalit Tribhangi Bhamini, Nitya Vihar Anoop. - Shri Lalit MadhuriSri Vrindavan is naturally the embodiment of beauty and sweetness, where the charming Śrī Lālajī, in his tribhaṅga (threefold-curved) form, remains immersed in the unparalleled rasa of nitya-vihāra (eternal love-play) with Bhāminī Sri Radha.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jai Bolo Shri Radha Maharani Ju Ki - Shri Hita Parmanand Das
hindi_text: Jai Bolo Shri Radha Maharani Ju Ki.Ikchhat Raj Karati Vrindavan, Akhil Lok Rajdhani Ju Ki. [1]Roop-Gunanin Kau Dham Bhamini, Mohan Kau Sukhdani Ju Ki.Radha-Radha Japahu Sada, ‘Parmanand’ Madhuri Vani Ju Ki. [2]- Shri Hita Parmanand DasVictory to Shri Radha Maharani Ju! In Shri Dham Vrindavan, the capital of all realms, there is only one sovereign ruling authority—that is Sri Radha Ju. [1]She is the embodiment of beauty and virtues, always bringing joy to Sri Krishna, the enchanter Himself. Śrī Parmānanda Dās says that his tongue endlessly chants the sweet name “Radha-Radha” without pause. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Prem Diwane Jo Bhaye Palti Gayo Sab Rupa - Sri Sahjobai
hindi_text: Prem Divaane Jo Bhaye, Palti Gayo Sab Roop.Sahjo Drishti Na Aavaee, Kahaa Rank Kahaa Bhoop.- Sri SahjobaiThose who are mad in divine love of God have their entire vision of the world transformed. They no longer see any distinction between a king and a beggar, for they behold their beloved Lord pervading all beings equally.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Baso Mere Nainani Mein Dou Lal - Sri Radha Prasad Dev Ju Ki Vani (26)
hindi_text: (Raag Vihag)Baso Mere Nainani Mein Dou Lal.Syam Baran Shri Kunj Bihari, Gaur Biharini Bal. [1]Nainani Nirakhat Rup Madhuri, Upajat Sukh Ke Jal.Shri Radhaprasad Trn Torati, Parasat Prem Bisal. [2]- Shri Radha Prasad Dev Ju, Sri Radha Prasad Dev Ju Ki Vani (26)May the dark-complexioned Shri Krishna, the Kunj Bihari, and the fair-complexioned Shri Radha, the Kunj Biharini, my two beloveds, always reside in my eyes. [1]When the eyes behold the divine beauty of this couple, waves of infinite bliss arise all at once. Immersed deeply in this vast ocean of love, Shri Radhaprasad Ji is sacrificing Himself, moment by moment. Out of concern that an evil eye might fall upon them, he keeps plucking and scattering straws as a protective act. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dare Sada Chahe Na Kachu Sahe Sabe Ho Hoy - Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (22)
hindi_text: Dare Sada Chahe Na Kacchu, Sahe Sabe Ho Hoy.Rahe Ek Ras Chaahi Ke, Prem Bakhano Soy.- Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (22)Raskhan says — That love alone is called pure love, in which the lover constantly fears that none of his actions should ever cause the Beloved even the slightest trouble. The one who seeks nothing in return from the Beloved, whose love continues to deepen even amidst all kinds of hardships, and who remains forever immersed in the nectar of love for the one and only Beloved — that is true, selfless love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dhan Dhan Vrindavan Ki Lata Pyari - Shri Abhay Ram, Vrindavan Rahasya Vinod (01)
hindi_text: Dhan Dhan Vrindavan Ki Lata Pyari.Phulele Kadam Madhuri Lapati, Koyal Bolat Kaari. [1]Chhahau Raag Chhattis Raagini, Kunj-Kunj Uchhari.‘Abhayram’ Raj Van Ki Mahima, Dekhat Hain Piyapyari. [2]- Shri Abhay Ram, Vrindavan Rahasya Vinod (01)Blessed, blessed are the charming creepers of Vrindavan, blossoming with sweetness as they lovingly wrap around the Kadamba trees, while the black cuckoo dwelling there sings its melodious tunes. [1]In every grove, one can hear the six rāgas and the thirty-six rāginīs. Sri Abhayarāma says that even the Divine Couple, Sri Radha Krishna, feels bliss upon beholding the glory of the sacred dust of Vrindavan. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Gaur Shyam Ki Kripa Bin Jani Sake Kou Naahi - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Gaur Shyam Ki Kripa Bin, Jaani Sakai Kou Naahin.Koti Janam Tap Hoy Kin, Parasi Sake Nahin Chhanhai.- Braj Ke DoheWithout the grace of this divine couple of fair and dark complexion (Shri Radha Krishna), no one can ever know the rasa (essence) of their eternal love-play (nitya-vihār). Even if one performs penance for millions of lifetimes, one cannot attain even a shadow of this rasa.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hum Balak Tum Maay Hamari - Sri Sahjobai
hindi_text: (Raag Bhairav)Hum Balak Tum Maay Hamari, Pal-Pal Maahim Karo Rakhwaari. [1]Nishidin Godi Hi Mein Rakho, Anvit Vachan Chitavan Bhaasho. [2]Vishay Or Jaane Na Devo, Dur-Dur Jaaun To Gahi Levo. [3]Main Ajaan Kachhuhoo Nahi Jaanun, Buri-Bhali Ko Na Pahichaanun. [4]Jaisi Taisi Tumhin Cheenho, Guru Hoy Dhyaan Khilauna Deenho. [5]Tumhari Raksha Hi Sun Jaaun, Naam Tumhaaro Amrit Paaun. [6]Drishti Tumhaari Upar Mere, Sadaa Rahun Main Sharanai Tere. [7]Maari Jhirkau Tau Nahi Jaaun, Sarki-Sarki Tumhi Pai Aauun. [8]Charandas Kahai ‘Sahjo’ Daasi, Ho Rakshak Pooran Avinaashi. [9]- Sri SahjobaiO Gurudev! I am your child, and you are my true divine Mother, protecting me every moment. [1]Keep me always in Your lap, guarding me with Your loving words and compassionate gaze. [2]Do not let me be drawn toward worldly desires; if I stray away, pull me gently back to You. [3]I am ignorant — I do not know what is right and wrong. [4]However, I am, only You truly know me; You have given me the bliss of contemplation. [5]I live because you protect me. I drink the nectar of your holy name. [6]May Your merciful eyes always rest upon me, and I remain forever in your refuge. [7]Even if You scold me or beat me, I will not leave; I will only humbly crawl and come closer to You again and again. [8]Sahjobai says to her Gurudev, Charandas — I am your servant and You are the all-protector, the complete and my eternal master. [9]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kare Bhakti Bhagwant Ki Kabhu Kare Nahin Chuk - Shri Maluka Das
hindi_text: Karein Bhakti Bhagwant Ki, Kabhun Karei Nahin Chook.Hari Ras Mein Racho Rahai, Sanchi Bhakti Malook.- Shri Malook DasOne who worships the Lord continuously with a devoted heart and never lets the mind wander away from Śrī Hari, even for a single moment, always remains immersed in the nectar of Hari’s rasa. Śrī Malūk Dās says—this alone is true devotion.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kou Kahe Alakh Anant Puni Kou Kahe - Shri Vrindavan Das Ji
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Kou Kahe Alakh Anant Puni Kou Kahe,Kou Kahe Brahm Kou Jyoti Kaun Bakhanat Hain. [1]Kou Kahe Gunateet Sagun Kahat Kou,Kou Kou Andh-Dhundh Aadi Hi Te Maanat Hain. [2]Kou Kahe Shesh Sir Paudhyau Sou,Kou Maha Tattvani Ginti Ur Aanat Hain. [3]Vrindavan Hit Roop Kunjani Mein Kridat,Hum Tau Ek Radhikai Vallabh Ko Janat Hain. [4]- Shri Vrindavan Das JiSome call Him “Alakh‑Anant” (the Unseen and Infinite), while others describe Him as Brahman (formless), and some as divine light. [1]Some say He is Nirguṇa (without attributes), others call Him Saguna (with attributes); there are some who, without reasoning or personal experience, simply accept and worship God as He has been traditionally believed since ancient times. [2]Some claim He rests upon the hoods of Śeṣanāga, while others try to understand Him through philosophical principles. [3]Śrī Hit Vṛndāvan Dās says—“For us, that Supreme Personality eternally plays in the enchanting bowers of Vṛndāvan; we know only that Supreme Beloved who is in the form of a divine couple and known by the name Śrī Rādhikā Vallabh”. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrindavanam Tadgatavastujatam Sarva Namasyam - Shri Vagish Shastriji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.54)
hindi_text: Vrindavanam Tadgatavastujatam Sarva Namasyam Na Kadapi Nindyam. Ye Va Vinindantyaparadhibhistaih Svapneapi Sango Mama Naiva Bhuyat.- Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.54)Sri Dham Vrindavan and all the beings and objects that exist there are always worthy of reverence. Those who blaspheme or show disrespect to it are offenders. May I never, even in a dream, associate with those offenders who blaspheme them.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ras Ki Nit Nav Uthat Tarang - Shri Kant Kishor, Kant Rasik Ji Ki Vani (41)
hindi_text: Ras Ki Nit Nav Uthat Tarang.Hansat Khilat Latika-Si Jhoomat, Kaam-Kusum Bhari Ang. [1]Tuv Tan Sravat Amit Amrit-Ras, Peebat Nain Kurang.Kaant Rasik Ke Praan Kishori, Shyam Kiye Rati-Rang. [2]- Shri Kant Kishor, Kant Rasik Ji Ki Vani, Pad (41)In Śrī Dham Vṛndāvan, ever-new waves of divine love (prema-rasa ) continuously rise and flow. There, the beloved Divine Couple, Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, laugh, play, and sway like delicate creepers in the breeze. Their limbs are adorned with the blossoms of kāma-kusuma —the flowers of divine love. [1]From their divine forms, endless streams of nectar-like bliss flow, which the deer-like eyes constantly drink in. This radiant, dark, and fair-complexioned pair, the very life of Kānta Rāsika , forever showers the colors of divine love. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aadi Anta Vrindavipin Nirdoshik Kari Baas - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (440)
hindi_text: Aadi Anta Vrindavipin, Nirdoshik Kari Baas.Adbuta Sukhad Bihar Kon, Det Tinhein Haridas.- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (440)Before creation began, and even after the universe dissolves, the one eternal and unchanging realm upon Earth remains Śrī Vṛndāvan Dham. Those who dwell there ceaselessly, without any offenses, are dearly loved by Śrī Swāmī Haridās Jī Mahārāj, who bestows upon them the supreme nectar of the eternal love-plays (nitya-vihāra-rasa) of Priyā Priyatama.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Soi Rasik Ananya Kahave - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya
hindi_text: (Raag Maru)Soi Rasik Ananya Kahave.Jinko Jugal Charitra Bina Kachhu, Shravanan Naahin Aur Suhave. [1]Yaahi Rang Rangirahe Rangeele, Tinihi Ko Sang Bhaavai.Anudin Rahas Bhaavana Bheene, Nav-Nav Ruchihin Badhaavai. [2]Jo Kou Baadhak Ya Vatihan Mein, Tin Ko Sang Chhitakaavai.‘Rooprasik’ Anupam Chhabi Lakhi-Lakhi, Pulak Na Ang Samaavai. [3]- Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya‘Rasik ananya’ (exclusively devoted connoisseur of divine rasa) is the one whose ears find bliss in nothing except the rasa-filled pastimes of the divine couple, Sri Radha Krishn. [1]He relishes only the association of those who are fully colored in the rasa of the divine couple. Every day, absorbed in deep inner sentiments, he cultivates his love in ever-new ways. [2]He keeps his mind away from anyone or anything that may obstruct the path of this divine rasa. Śrī Rūprasik﻿ says that when he beholds the unparalleled beauty of Śrī Priya-Priyatam﻿, his body is thrilled and immersed in the ecstasy of love-bliss, again and again.​ [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Tan Man Vachan Pratiti So Basi Vrindavan Manj -  Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.105)
hindi_text: Tan Man Vachan Prateeti Saun, Basi Vrindavan Manjh. Premi Rasik Ananya Kau, Sang Karo Din Saanjh. - Shri Ananya Ali, Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.105)With body, mind, speech, and firm inner conviction, one must reside in the sacred land of Vrindavan. Keep only the association of Premi ‘Rasika Ananya’ (exclusive connoisseurs of this rasa), throughout the day and night. Only then can the soul attain that extremely rare divine rasa.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Param Prem Gun Roop Amit Kavi Ko Kahe - Shri Albeli Ali
hindi_text: Param Prem, Gun, Roop Amit Kavi Ko Kahe? Meen, Deen Jal-Leen, Su Kyon Antahin Lahe. [1]Lahe Ant Na Koti Kalpan, Sarada Mooku Rahe. Jeevan-Kripan Ki Ka Chalai, Binu Tav Kripa Jo Kachhu Kahe. [2]Charan-Rati Jo Dehu Swamini, Janm Ko Phal Paiye. Shri Vansi Ali ‘Albeli’, Jeevan Sujas Tumharo Gaiye. [3]- Sri Albeli AliO Supreme Queen Śrī Rādhe! Who among poets can truly describe the boundless love, virtues, and unmatched beauty that You possess? A lowly fish living in water can never know the depth of the infinite ocean. [1]Even after countless ages, no one can fully speak of Your glories—and so even Sarasvatī, the goddess of speech, remains silent. So what place do I, a powerless soul, have to say anything about You without Your grace? [2]O Swāminī Śrī Rādhā! If You give me pure, selfless devotion at Your lotus feet, only then will my life find its real meaning. Sri Albeli Ali says, You are the very breath of Śrī Vaṃśīalī, whose life is fulfilled only in singing Your divine glories. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Brajmohan Ur Avani Mein - Shri Anandghan Ji, Ghananand Granthawali, Priya Prasad (75)
hindi_text: Brajmohan Ur Avani Mein, Radha-Supad-Vihaar.Rom Rom Anand Ghan, Bheeje Rasik Udaar.- Shri Anandghan Ji, Ghananand Granthawali, Priya Prasad (75)Within the heart of Sri Krishna, the divine lotus feet of Sri Radha playfully wander. Every pore of His being is filled with such bliss that He is drenched in an abundance of nectar.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Janiju Ab Jaani Shrivan - Shri Lalit Madhuri
hindi_text: (Raag Jila)Jaaniju Ab Jaani Shrivan, Deho Vaas Vihaarni Rani.An Karni Jo Vani Daasi Son, So Karni Nij Hiye Na Aani. [1]Darasai Chhavi Lalit Kishori, Bhuj Gal Meli Shyaam Sukhdani.Aisi Kaun Kripaa Ki Saagar, Aisihu Patit Sukhad Ras Saani. [2]- Shri Lalit MadhuriNow I truly feel the need to go to Śrī Vṛndāvan. O Queen of Vṛndāvan, I know only You can grant me residence in Vṛndāvan. Please have mercy on me now and bless me with the dwelling in Shri Dham Vrindavan. If I, Your maidservant, have done anything not according to Your will, kindly do not hold it in Your heart. [1]O Lalit Kishorī, show me Your divine form, embracing Śyāmsundar, with Your arms around His neck. Who else is such an Ocean of Compassion like you? Who else can bestow such sweet nectar of bliss even upon the fallen like me? [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kahu Ki Manat Na Priy Lalan Chitt Udaas - Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket Lata (657)
hindi_text: Kahu Ki Manat Na Priy, Lalan Chitt Udaas.Gaye Soch ‘Sanket Ali’, Sri Lalita Ke Paas.- Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket Lata (657)When Śrī Rādhā, in Her loving māna (loving sulk), refused to be pacified by anyone, Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s heart became sorrowful. Thinking deeply—“How will this sulk come to an end now?”—He finally went to seek help from Śrī Lalitā Jī.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ravi Ko Bharoso Andh Meti Ko Udhot Kare - Taj Begam
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Ravi Ko Bharoso Andh Meti Ko Udhot Karai,Sasi Ko Bharoso Sheet Karat ‘Taaj’ Khyaal Ko. [1]Ees Ko Bharoso Sab Devan Ko Dichchha Det,Sukra Ko Bharoso Sarb Daitya Pratipal Ko. [2]Sani Ko Bharoso Drishti Raakhai Jo Kurur Buddhi,Mangal Ko Bharoso Sut Hone Bhuv-Paal Ko. [3]Rahu Ko Bharoso Sees, Ketu Ko Na Parse Kahoon,Moko To Bharoso Ek Preetam Gupaal Ko. [4]- Taj Begam (Taj Bibi)Some trust in the Sun, believing it will dispel darkness and bring light; others rely on the Moon, hoping it will bestow coolness and comfort. [1]Some place their faith in Jupiter (Guru), who imparts divine knowledge to the demigods, while others trust Venus (Śukra), the protector of demons. [2]Some believe in Saturn (Śani), who punishes the cruel‑hearted through his gaze, and some in Mars (Maṅgal), hoping to gain sons and kingdoms. [3]Some trust Rāhu and Ketu, the shadow planets; but as for me, I place my unwavering faith in the one and only — my beloved Śrī Gopāl (Lord Kṛṣṇa). [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Taj Shesh Khagesh Ko Daudate Jo - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Taj Shesh Khagesh Ko Daudate Jo, Sunate Yadi Swapn Mein Aah Dukhi Ki.Chhilke Vidurani Ke Pyaare Lage, Mridu Meva Taji Kujraaj Sukhi Ki. [1]Hare Krishna! Ka Bhagya Na Cheta Abhi, Had Bhi Kuch Hoti Hai Berukhi Ki.Chaturanan Chaah Karen Jinki, Karte Vah Chaakari Chandramukhi Ki. [2]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’Even if a sorrowful soul sighs and calls out to Him in a dream, He abandons even Śeṣanāga and Garuḍa and rushes toward that soul. He is pleased with Vidurāṇī’s simple banana peels, rejecting the royal delicacies of King Duryodhana. [1]Śrī Hare Kṛṣṇa Jī says, Has your inner wisdom still not awakened? How strange it is that you are still turned away from such a compassionate Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa! The One whom even Lord Brahmā longs to serve as a humble servant—that very Lord finds pleasure only in serving the moon-faced Śrī Rādhā Jū. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Viharat Kunj Kutir Dou - Shri Priya Sakhi (Sri Brahm Gopal Goswami), Shri Hari Leela (2)
hindi_text: Viharat Kunj Kutir Dou, Sri Jamuna Ras Teer.Nitya Vihar Gambhir Gati, Surati Judh Balvir.- Shri Priya Sakhi (Sri Brahm Gopal Goswami), Shri Hari Leela (2)By the sacred, rasa-filled banks of Śrī Yamunā, in the charming bower-cottages, the divine couple Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa engage in Their eternal Nitya-vihāra. There, an unending, blissful play of love unfolds—a sweet battle where both are undefeated warriors, and the rasa of loving exchange never ends.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Humpar Kab Kripalu Hari Huiho - Sri Roop Kunwari Ji
hindi_text: (Raag Bibhas – Titalā Tāla)Humpar Kab Kripalu Hari Huiho.Main Adhamin, Tum Adham-Udhaaran, Kaise Pran Na Nibaaiho.Kotin Khal Prabhu Tumne Taare, Deen Jaan Ka Mohi Lajaiho. [1]Main Sharanagat Naath Tihari, Daas Jaan Kin Aas Pujaiho.Kaa Kahihai Jag Lok Naath, Jab Roopkunwri Ki Sudh Bisaraiho. [2]- Sri Roop Kunwari JiO Hari! When will You show mercy upon me? I am extremely fallen, and You are the Savior of the fallen—so how can You not fulfill Your own vow?O Lord! You have delivered millions of wicked souls—then why hesitate to uplift someone destitute like me? [1]I have taken refuge in You, O Krishn, please consider me as Your servant and fulfill my hope. O Lord of the Universe, what will the world say if You forget Your own servant Rūpkunwarī? [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Prem Bhare Chhavi So Bhare Bhare Anand Hulas. - Shri Brajavasidas, Braj Vilas
hindi_text: Prem Bhare Chhavi Son Bhare, Bhare Anand Hulaas.Yugal Madhuri Ras Bhare, Brajmein Karat Vilaas.- Shri Brajavasidas, Braj VilasOverflowing with divine love and beauty, carrying joy and delight in their hearts, the divine couple, Śrī Rādhā Krishna, immersed in the nectar of yugala rasa, perform their enchanting plays of love (vihāra) in the land of Braj.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Suni Man Madhukar Gyan Sikhau - Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (40)
hindi_text: Suni Man Madhukar Gyan Sikhau.Charan Kamal Rati Ruchi Upjau. [1]Tihi Path Chalau Ju Bahuri Na Aau.Janam Maran Bhai Bharm Bhulau. [2]Basi Vrindavan Uttam Thaun.Satsangati Paramarth Pau. [3]Nit Dampati Sampati Hi Dikhau.Shri Biharini Dasi Bhai Gun Gau. [4]- Shri Biharin Dev, Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (40)O bee-like mind! You keep wandering from place to place—listen to me now. I will tell you something wise: if you somehow develop true love for the divine lotus feet of Śrī Śyāma-Śyām, you will experience unfathomable bliss.​ [1]By following this path, you will never have to come back to this material world. You will be freed forever from the cycle of birth and death, as well as from fear, confusion, and sorrow. [2]If the mind asks, “What is that secret?” then Śrī Bihārīndev gives the answer—reside forever in the holy land of Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvan. There, you will easily get the association of true rasika saints. [3]In Vṛndāvan, you will receive the divine vision of Śrī Bihārī Bījāriṇī Ju, the source of all bliss and spiritual treasures. You will keep drinking the beauty of their lotus feet and, in overflowing joy, will sing their divine glories again and again. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhine Ati Ras Rang Mein Naval Rangile Laal - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Bhine Ati Ras Rang Mein, Naval Rangile Laal.Bahaan Jori Chalat Dou, Matt Maralani Chaal.- Braj Ke DoheEver-new divine couple, Śrī Rādhā Krishna, immersed in the hue of divine love-bliss, with arms around each other and an enchanting gait like a swan, roam gracefully.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhajani Kyon Darihai Upahasahi - Sri Neh Nagridas Ji Ki Vani
hindi_text: Bhajani Kyon Darihai Upahasahi. Apni Vastu Nauhari Kajai, Sahai Jagat Ke Trasahi. [1]Suhrid Sanehi Apni Apni, Aatam Maan Karahu Vas Vasahi. Beparvahi Vyas Suvan Kau, Bal Hai Nagaridasahi. [2]- Shri Neh Nagridas, Sri Neh Nagridas Ji Ki VaniAn aspirant of divine love should not fear the ridicule or criticism of the world. He endures everything for the sake of his true treasure, God realization. Even if he faces insults or hardships, he remains unconcerned and moves steadfastly toward his spiritual goal. [1]In this world, everyone, whether friend or relative, thinks according to their own viewpoint. Therefore, one should not worry about other’s opinions but focus on their own spiritual upliftment and seek residence in Śrī Dham Vṛndāvan. Śrī Nāgarīdās says that his true strength lies in the son of Śrī Vyāsji, Śrī Hit Harivansh Mahāprabhu, under whose shelter he lives forever fearlessly. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Agra Alakas Jani Karo Hari Bhajibe Ke Het - Shri Agradas, Agragranthawali
hindi_text: Agra Alakas Jani Karo, Hari Bhajibe Ke Het. Bahut Gayi Thodi Rahi, Thode Mein Haun Chet. - Shri Agradas, Agragranthawali Shri Agradāsa says, “Do not be lazy in the devotion of Lord Hari. Most of your life has already slipped away; only a little remains. Awaken now, and make this life truly successful.”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhatakat Phirat Nahak Chit Chalu - Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket Lata (827)
hindi_text: Bhatakat Phirat Nahak Chit Chalu Tu Braj Bhu Sakal Aram.Vrindavan Madhupuri Mahavan Barsane Nand Gram. [1]Radhakund Govardhan Yamuna Pulin Manohar Dham.‘Ali Sanket’ Sukhad Drig Lakhiye Biharan Shyamashyam. [2]- Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket Lata (827)O mind! What is the use of wandering aimlessly? Come—let us go toward the sacred land of Braja, the abode of peace and divine bliss. Vrindavan, Mathura, Mahavan, Barsana, and Nandgaon—all are supremely holy places of divine pastimes. [1]Radhakund, Govardhan, and the banks of the Yamuna—all are enchanting abodes. Sanket Ali says—Behold these blissful līlā places, where the divine couple, Sri Śyāma-Śyāma, eternally wander together. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dou Kanan Lagi Kahe Chumban Dehi Ankor -Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ji Ki Vani, AnanyaRasikabharan Granth 1 (16)
hindi_text: Dou Kanan Lagi Kahein, Chumban Dehin Ankor.Abkai Mohin Jitab Sakhi, Lehun Balaiyan Tor.- Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ji, Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ji Ki Vani, AnanyaRasikabharan Granth 1 (16)In the evergoing plays of love (Nitya-Vihāra), Śrī Bhagavat Ali Ji — absorbed in the loving service of Śyāmā–Śyām — narrates: In that state, when the Divine Couple had become impatient with longing, They drew close to my ears, touching Them gently, and bestowing tender kisses as loving offerings. While doing so, they said: “O beloved sakhi! I sacrifice myself to you. In whatever way, this time you must ensure my victory!”
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Vrindavan Ki Dhuli - Sri Ramsakhiji Maharaj, Shri Bhaktiras Manjari
hindi_text: Shri Vrindavan Ki Dhuli, Param Sumangal Muli. [1]Jehi Munijan Dhyan Lagavai, Brahmadik Chhuvan Na Pavai. [2]Jo Alin Pad Aradhai, So Pavai Bina Upadhai. [3]Jo Apna Sheesh Chadhavai, Aru Vrindavan Jas Gavai. [4]Jab Kripa Karen Shri Radha, Sab Puren Man Ki Sadha. [5]Uddhavadhi Shiradhari, Shuk Muni Mukhahi Uchari. [6]Jehi Agam Nigam Pukarai, Sab Riddhi Siddhi Taapai Varai. [7]Kahlon Kahon Vakhani, Mahima Kou Na Jani. [8]Shri Ramsakhi Man Dinho, Nij Ang-Ang Bhushan Kinho. [9]- Sri Ramsakhiji, Shri Bhaktiras ManjariThe dust of Sri Vrindavan is the very root of all auspiciousness.​ [1]That sacred dust, upon which sages meditate, whose touch even Brahmā and other gods find supremely rare.​ [2]Only those sakhīs who worship the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhāraṇī can attain that dust without any obstacle.​ [3]One who completely surrenders himself to this dust and sings the glories of Vṛndāvan becomes truly blessed.​ [4]When Śrī Rādhā bestows Her grace, all the aspirations of the heart are fulfilled.​ [5]That dust which Uddhava and others place upon their heads, and whose virtues sages like Śukadeva sing aloud.​ [6]Its glory is praised by the scriptures and the Vedas—even all Siddhis (wealth) and Riddhis (mystic powers) could be sacrificed for it.​ [7]Who can ever describe the full greatness of that divine dust of Vrindavan? Its true glory remains beyond all comprehension.​ [8]Śrī Ramsakhi says—she has surrendered her heart completely to the dust of Vrindavan and adorned every limb of her being with it.​ [9]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Leela Nitya Vihar Ko Brahmadik Lalchat - Shri Saras Madhuri
hindi_text: Leela Nitya Vihar Ko, Brahmadik Lalchat.Sur Nar Muni Janki Sakhi, Kaun Chalave Baat.- Shri Saras MadhuriO Sakhī! What to speak of demigods, humans, or sages— even the great personalities like Brahmā and others eagerly long to taste the eternal love-play of the divine couple (Nitya-vihāra-rasa).
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Yah Tan Yah Van Jamun Tat, Milyau Vanyau Hai Dau - Shri Hita Damodar Das, Aasha Tyag (42)
hindi_text: Yah Tan Yah Van Jamun Tat, Milyau Vanyau Hai Dau.Tatai Aasha Chhadikai, Jugal Kishorahi Gau.- Shri Hita Damodar Das, Aasha Tyag (42)To receive a human birth and the grace to reside at the bank of the Yamuna in Shri Dham Vrindavan is an extremely rare fortune. Therefore, one should abandon all worldly desires and engage constantly in the loving remembrance of the eternal Youthful divine couple, Shri Radha Krishna.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Radharaman Adhar Rachi Biri - Shri Gunmanjari Das
hindi_text: Shri Radharaman Adhar Rachi Beeri. Napan Sakal Karle Huri Aali, Nirikhat Raho Chhabi Ri. [1]Shri Lalita Ju Ne Mukh Dini, Kaise Adhar Fabi Ri. Gun Manjari Pyari Beeri, Rang Barne Kaun Kavi Ri. [2]- Shri Gunmanjari DasThe redness of the betel leaf (pān﻿) glows upon the lips of Śrī Rādhāramaṇ, and the sakhīs stand entranced, gazing upon that enchanting vision. [1]Śrī Lalitājī has lovingly offered the pān into Rādhāramaṇ’s mouth, where it shines resplendent upon lips. Śrī Guṇmañjarī says—such an exquisite pān has been prepared that no poet could ever describe the beauty of its color.​ [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jayti Jayti Nam Jayti, Nam Srivrindavan Vag - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Vishisht Doha (7)
hindi_text: Jayati Jayati Nam Jayati, Nam Srivrindavan Vaag.Jamein Pyari Peey Ko, Avichal Sada Suhaag.- Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Vishisht Doha (7)Endless salutations to the holy land of Shri Vrindavan Dham, where the divine union of Shri Radha Krishna remains eternally unbroken, and the nectar of Their Yugal Rasa flows ceaselessly, without beginning or end.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hari Tero Bhajan Kiyo Na Jaay - Shri Surdas, Sura Sagara
hindi_text: Hari, Tero Bhajan Kiyo Na Jaye.Kah Karau, Teri Prabal Maya Deti Man Bharmai. [1]Javain Avau, Sadhu Sangati Kachhuk Man Thharai.Jyo Gayand Anhai Sarita, Bahuri Vahai Subhai. [2]Vesh Dhari Dhari Haryau Par Dhan, Sadhu-Sadhu Kahai.Jaise Natwa Lobh Karan, Karat Swang Banai. [3]Karau Jatan, Na Bhajau Tumkau, Kachhuk Man Upjai.Sur Prabhu Ki Sabal Maya, Deti Mohi Bhulai. [4]- Sri Surdas, Soor SagarO Lord Sri Hari! I find myself incapable of truly performing Your bhajan. What can I do? Your powerful Maya keeps deluding my mind again and again. [1]When I associate with saints, my mind becomes calm for a while due to their holy company, but soon that same old restlessness returns — just like an elephant that bathes in a river and then throws dust upon itself again. [2]Despite dressing like a saint, I remained only a pretender — outwardly pious but inwardly deceitful, looting other’s wealth like an acrobat who performs a prank only for money. [3]O Lord! Though I am determined to worship You, however, as soon as I begin, worldly thoughts arise within me. Shri Surdas says — O Lord! Your Maya is so powerful that it constantly keeps me lost in delusion. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nityam bhaktpradheena Ten Radha Biharini - Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (21)
hindi_text: Nityam bhaktpradheena Ten Radha Biharini.Saamyam Bhajati Bhakten Rase Krishnen Leelya.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (21)Sri Radhika Maharani always remains under the loving control of Her devotees. Sri Krishna Himself is Her foremost devotee; thus, under the influence of His Bhakti, She performs divine pastimes in the same loving mood as Him. According to the bhāva of each devotee, Swāminījī reciprocates with that very rasa, worshipping them with the same tender feeling of love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mann Mein Basi Bas Chah Yahi - Braj Ke Sawaiya
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Mann Mein Basi Bas Chah Yahi, Piya Naam Tumhara Uchara Karun. Bithla Ke Tumhe Man Mandir Mein, Man Mohini Roop Nihara Karun. [1]Bhar Ke Drig Patra Mein Prem Ka Jal, Pad Pankaj Nath Pakhara Karun.Ban Prem Pujari Tumhara Prabhu, Nit Aarti Bhavya Utara Karun. [2]- Braj Ke SawaiyaO Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa! Now my only desire is to chant Your holy name day and night. Enthroning You in the temple of my mind, may I always behold Your enticing form. [1]With eyes filled with tears, may I wash Your feet continuously. O Lord! Make me Your loving devotee, and I shall continuously perform Your ārtī. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Chhauna Chhadi Tu Jagat Ko Shyam Sumir Sukh Leh - Shri Guruchauna Ji Maharaj
hindi_text: ‘Chhauna’ Chhandi Tu Jagat Ko, Shyam Sumir Sukh Leh.Kutumb Mitra Tere Nahin, Jaar Karenge Kheh.- Shri Guruchauna Ji MaharajGuru Chaunā says, give up worldly attachments and keep your mind fixed on Śyāmasundara (Krishna), for only through His remembrance will you find real happiness. Your relatives and friends cannot go with you after death, and in the end, they will burn your body to ashes, leaving you alone.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kou Phirai Nange Pai - Shri Sundardas Ji
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Kou Phirai Nange Pai, Kou Gudari Banai, Deh Ki Dasha Dikhai, Aai Log Ghootyau Hai. [1]Kou Dudhadhari Hoi, Kou Phalahari Toy, Kou Adhomukh Jhooli-Jhooli Ghum Ghootyau Hai. [2]Kou Nahin Pahin Laun, Kou Mukh Gahai Maun, ‘Sundar’ Kahat Yonhin Vritha Bhus Kootyau Hai. [3]Prabhu Saun Na Preeti Mahin, Gyaan Saun Parchai Nahin,Dekhau Bhai, Aandharani Jyon Bazaar Lootyau Hai. [4]- Shri Sundardas JiSome wander barefoot, some wear torn rags; they torment their bodies only to display their renunciation. [1]Some live on milk, some on fruits; some hang upside down, imagining such acts lead to God. [2]Some reject salt, others vow silence; Śrī Sundar Dās says all this is in vain, like beating a husk with no grain. [3]Without pure love for the Lord and real knowledge, all such austerities are like a blind man looting the market — utterly useless. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kahon Kahan Lon Varni Mei Vanshivat Ki Keli - Shri Madhuri Das, Vanshivat Madhuri (297)
hindi_text: Kahon Kahan Lon Varni Mei, Vanshivat Ki Keli.Va Sukh Mein Samjhe Soi, Je Nij Sang Saheli.- Shri Madhuri Das, Vanshivat Madhuri (297)How can I possibly describe, or to what extent can I express, the supremely enchanting pastimes of the divine Couple at Vanshivat? That rasa can only be understood by those who, along with the intimate sakhis, actually participate in that transcendental play of love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Rasa-rasa Rasika Rangili Radha -  Shri Kripaluji, Prem Ras Madira, Shri Radha Madhuri (35)
hindi_text: Rasa-rasa Rasika Rangili Radha.Ja Pada-nakha-mani-chamdra Chamdrikahim, Shambhu Samadhihim Sadha. [1]Bike Shyama Binu Dama Yama-vasu, Jasu Nama Aradha. Jasu Viraha Virahatura Harihu.n, Rahi Na Sakata Pala Adha. [2]Nitya Vihara Karati Vrrimdavana, Kumjani Prema Agadha. Kimi 'Kripalu' Tah.n Rahi Saka Sapanehun, Bhukti Mukti Dui Badha. [3]- Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Shri Radha-Madhuri (35)Shri Kishori Ji, absorbed in the nectar of the rāsa dance, enchants the rasikas with her divine charm. The radiance from Her gem-like toenails shines like the moon, and even Supreme Yogi, Lord Śiva, considering it the effulgence for Brahma (the Impersonal God), remains forever absorbed in nirvikalpa samādhi. [1]Even Śyāmasundara, who has sold Himself to Her without price, ceaselessly worships Her name day and night. In her separation, even the Supreme Lord finds no peace, not even for a single moment. [2]Overflowing with boundless love, she eternally engages in ‘nitya vihāra’ (eternal play of love) in the bowers of Vrindavan. Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji says that upon receiving even a slightest merciful glance from her, the bliss of pleasures up to those of the realm of Brahmā and the salvation of becoming one with the Absolute (Ekatva Mukti) becomes utterly insignificant, even in dreams. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jo Hamre Dosana Lakhau - Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Bhakta Sarvasva (20)
hindi_text: Jaum Hamare Dosana Lakhau, Tau Nahim Kachu Avalamba.Apuni Dina-dayalata, Kevala Dakhahu Amba.- Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Bhakta Sarvasva (20)O Lord! If you look upon my faults, then I shall have no refuge left. My humble prayer is that You turn Your gaze toward Your own merciful nature, which bestows grace upon the fallen. Only through that compassion can a sinner like me attain deliverance.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kaun Phirat Ya Vipin Raj Mein Radhe Radhe Kahi Terat - Shri Lachhiram
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Kaun Phirat Ya Vipin Raj Mein, Radhe-Radhe Kahi Terat.Param Dukhit Unmatt Bhav Mein, Chahun Dis Chakit Tushatur Herat. [1]Satya Kaho Priya Sakha Kaun Ho, Kyon Tum Nainani Aansu Gerat.Krishna Jeevani Kaha Lagat Hai, Jinke Jas Ki Maala Ferat. [2]- Shri LachhiramUpon hearing Śrī Kṛṣṇa calling out the name of "Rādhe Rādhe" in the divine land of Śrī Vṛndāvana, a devotee wonders:Who is this, wandering through Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvana, crying out "Rādhe Rādhe" in deep longing? He appears restless in divine love, looking around in every direction with tearful eyes, as though searching for someone most dear. [1]O dear friend! Tell me truly—who are you, and why do tears flow ceaselessly from your eyes? Who is Śrī Rādhā to You, whose sacred name-beads you keep chanting in endless devotion? [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Beni Gunthi Kaha Kou Jane Meri Si - Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (70)
hindi_text: (Raga Saramga)Beni Gunthi Kaha Kou Jane Meri Si Teri Saun. Bicha Bicha Phula Seta Pita Rate Ko Kari Sakai Eri Saun. [1]Baithe Rasika S.nvarani Barani Komala Kara Kakahi Saun. Shriharidasa Ke Svami Syama Nakhasikha Lon Banai De Kajara Nakha Hi Saun. [2]- Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (70)Today Shri Lāla (Śrī Kṛṣṇa) yearns for the fortune of braiding the hair of Shri Pyārī Jū (Śrī Rādhā). Shri Priyājū gently remarks that this service belongs to the sakhis, but Lalji, with loving insistence, pleads again and again—O PyārīJū! I swear by You, who else knows the art of braiding hair as I do? No one can arrange white, yellow, and red flowers between the strands as beautifully as I can. [1](At this, Shri PyārīJū agrees, and Śrī Lālji, filled with joy, begins to braid Her hair.)Sitting gracefully, the crown-jewel among Rasikas, Śrī Lālji, takes a soft comb in His delicate hand and gently arranges Her locks. When Lālji finishes the braid, PyārīJū, pleased, permits Him to adorn Her with garments and ornaments. Then Śrī Lālji lovingly decorates Her from head to toe, even applying kājala (kohl) with His own fingernail. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Parayo Rahau Nit Charan Tal - Shri Hanuman Prasad Poddar (Bhaiji), Pad Ratnakar, Vandana Evam Prarthna (14.5)
hindi_text: Parayo Rahau Nit Charan-Tal, Parasau Nit Pad-Dhool.Pagdaasi Pauncht Rahau, Ag-Jag Sgaro Bhool.  - Shri Hanuman Prasad Poddar (Bhaiji), Pad Ratnakar, Vandana Evam Prarthna (14.5)O my Divine Couple, Shri Radha Madhav! May I always remain at Your lotus feet, forever touching their sacred dust. May I serve Your lotus feet as a humble maidservant, forgetting everything else.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jo Kou Vrindavipin Base - Shri Hita Damodar Das, Phutakar Vani (172)
hindi_text: (Raag–Malar)Jo Kou Vrindavipin Base.Jaddapi Paap-Pahaar Rahyau Badhi, Taamein Dolat Sahaj Nase. [1]Jin Ahi Kaal Grase Surapati Se, Taahi Na Kabhun Bhul Dase.Dampati Sampati Dhari Hriday Din, Santat Anand Maahin Hanse. [2]Jinh Bhav-Nidhi Mein Budat Uchharat, So Kabhoon Nahin Supan Dhase.‘Damodar Hit’ Guru Karuna Ten, Gaavai Paavai Raas Rase. [3]- Shri Hita Damodar Das, Phutakar Vani (172)Whoever resides in Shri Dham Vrindavan, though burdened with sins as vast as mountains, finds them effortlessly destroyed by the divine power of Vrindavan. [1]Even Kāla, the terrible serpent of time that devours the lords of heaven, cannot harm a devotee who lives in Vrindavan. Such a devotee, beholding the Divine Couple within the heart, remains immersed forever in divine bliss. [2]Those souls who have been drowning in the ocean of worldly existence since time immemorial are easily saved by the grace of residing in Vrindavan — they are divinely protected, even in their dreams. Shri Hit Damodar Das Ji says that one who dwells in Vrindavan while singing the glories of Shri Radha Krishna ultimately attains the nectar of the Rās-rasa. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vibhcharani Ko Sang Taji - Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (186)
hindi_text: Vibhcharani Ko Sang Taji, Bhaji Ananya Nihkam.Shri Biharidas Sukh Mein Sukhi, Dampati Rati Dhan Dham.- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (186)If you completely renounce the company of the ‘vyabhicārī’ (those enslaved by worldly desires) and instead worship the Divine Couple with pure, selfless, and exclusive love, finding happiness only in Their happiness, then your heart will be filled with the priceless treasure of Their divine love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Manmohan Sam Sundar Ko Hai - Shri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Prem Pariksha Leela (4)
hindi_text: (Raag Malhaar)Manmohan Sam Sundar Ko Hai.Main Apne Anumaan Kahoon Ab, Unki Pattar Aur Na Sohe. [1]Chitvan Chapal Roop Ujiyaaro, Jaakon Mukh Nit Chandahu Johe.Narayan Jo Ek Drishti Mein, Sur Nar Naag Sakal Ko Mohe. [2]- Shri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Prem Pariksha Leela (4)Sakhi says to Sri Radha - There is no one as beautiful as the enchanter Sri Krishna. From my experience, none can match His loveliness. [1]His playful glances and radiant form are so enchanting that even the moon gazes at His face in admiration every day. Sri Narayan Swami says, "With just one glance, He effortlessly captivates gods, humans, and serpents." [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Radha Radhe Radhike, Radhe Roop Nidhan - Shri Hita Parmanand Das
hindi_text: Radha Radhe Radhike, Radhe Roop Nidhan. Radha Radha Mantra Niju, Hit Paramanand Pran. - Shri Hita Parmanand DasO Rādhā, O Rādhe, O Rādhike — You are the very embodiment and treasure-house of beauty. Shri Hit Paramanand Das says, The sacred mantra ‘Radha Radha’ itself is my very life and soul.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nikunj Mein Thadhe Yugal Kishor -  Shri Roop Manjari
hindi_text: (Raag Malhar)Nikunj Mein Thadhe Yugal Kishor.Garbahin Diyai Dou Preetam, Ras-Ranjit Jage Bhor. [1]Chhaya Rahi Ghanaghor Ghata Ati, Bich-Bich Bolat Sundar Mor.Madhurai Raag Malharahi Gavat, Rup Manjari Nand Kishor. [2]- Shri Roop ManjariIn the sacred nikuṃja (divine bower), the Divine Couple, Shri Radha Krishna, are beautifully adorned, their arms lovingly entwined around each other. In the drowsy sweetness of dawn, they have just awakened, and the entire morning seems filled with the glow of their love. [1]All around, thick clouds gather in the sky, and amidst them, graceful peacocks call in melodious tones. In this enchanting scene, the Rūpa Mañjarī of the ever-youthful couple sings the sweet Rāga Mālhar, filling the Divine Couple’s hearts with an indescribable nectar. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Gore Mukh Pai Til Banyau Taahi Karun Main Pranaam - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Gore Mukh Pai Til Banyau, Taahi Karun Main Pranaam.Manon Chand Bichaayake, Paudhe Saalagramam.- Braj Ke DoheI bow down to the beautiful dark mole that adorns the fair and radiant face of Shri Radha. It appears as though a wondrous black śāligrāma stone is gracefully resting upon the full moon itself.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Shyama Mano Vinati Mori - Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
hindi_text: (Raag Vihag)Shri Shyama Mano Vinati Mori.Main Nij Dasi Charan Upasi, Janm Janm Ki Tori. [1]Mosi Tere Ali Anekan, Mere Tu Ek Gori.Karunasagar Gunah Maaf Kar, Suniye Kunvari Kishori. [2]Paravas Pran Fasyo Nahi Nikasat, Virah Karat Barjori.Saras Madhuri Ki Sudh Lije, Nek Chito Mo Ori. [3]- Shri Saras MadhuriO Shri Radha! Please accept my humble plea. I am your own maidservant, a devoted worshipper of your divine feet. I belong to no one except you from countless births. [1]You may have many dear Sakhis like me, but for me, you alone are everything. O ocean of compassion! O fair-complexioned Kishoriji! Kindly forgive all my faults. [2]My very life-breath is bound so deeply in separation from you that it cannot escape. Shri Saras Madhuri says — O Supreem Queen! Please think about me and, with your merciful glance, bless me with your divine grace. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Chakit Nain Kampat Hiyo - Shri Albeli Ali
hindi_text: Chakit Nain Kampat Hiyo, Maha Virah Ki Peer.Aasuan Manon Jharna Jhare, Paryo Jaman Ke Teer.- Sri Albeli AliSri Albeli, longing for the darshan of Shri Radha, describes her state of separation: eyes widened in wonder, heart and limbs trembling unceasingly, tears flowing in an endless stream like a spontaneous fountain, lying intoxicated upon the banks of the Yamuna, absorbed in the remembrance of Shri Kishori Ji.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kasumbi Saari Pahrein Sodhen Sani - Shri Vanshi Ali, Madhurya Shat (8)
hindi_text: Kasumbi Saari Pahrein Sodhen Sani.Mohan Man Mohani Mohan Ki, Nisdin Rahat Bani. [1]Bhrikuti Champ Madh Nainan Jugal Sar, Kajar Rekh Ani.Kari Aapun Adhin Rachik Chit, An Tiya Kalah Hani. [2]Rajat Kunj Mahal Ras Rani, Lalan Gunani Bhani.Jai Shri Banshi Ali Ki Jeevan Shyama, Avichal Nath Mani. [3]- Shri Vanshi Ali, Madhurya Shat (8)Śrī Radha, adorned in a deep red kusumbī sāṛī, appears as the very embodiment of enchantment, and even enchants the heart of Mohana (Śrī Krishna), the enchanter Himself. She is eternally adorned in divine beauty. [1]Her arched brows, like a graceful bow, frame her two radiant eyes like an arrow, adorned with the kājala. The crown‑jewel among the rasikas, Śyāmasundara, along with all other rasikas, remains ever captivated by her charm, while her graceful presence renders the beauty of all other women ineffective. [2]Seated in the divine nikuṃja‑mahala, the Empress of Rasa, Śrī Radha Mahārāṇī, the very presiding deity of love, shines with infinite splendor. Śrī Krishna constantly sings praises of her divine glories. Śrī Vanshi Alī says: Such a Śyāmā Maharani is the very source of my life and my eternal sovereign. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Panth Prem Ko Atpato Koi Man Janat Peer - Shri Dayabai
hindi_text: Panth Prem Ko Atpato, Koi Man Janat Peer.Kai Man Janat Aapno, Kai Lago Jeh Peer.- Shri DayabaiThe path of love is absolutely mysterious and unlike any other. Its sweet pain can only be understood by one whose own heart has been wounded by it — one who has experienced that divine agony.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pyari Dekh Mere Kaise Biri Rachi. - Shri Ramray Ji, Aadivani (26)
hindi_text: Pyari Dekh Mere Kaise Beeri Rachi.Tere Adharaamrit Kau Jah Phal, Arun Mein Arun Khachi. [1]Darpan Dekhi Roop Mohi Mero, Mohini Saach Jachi.Charvan Raamraay Ko Haun De, Jaakon Adhik Ruchi. [2]- Shri Ramray Ji, Aadivani (26)A sakhi (companion) says to Sri Radha—O beloved Pyārījū! Look, I have prepared such a beautiful bīrī (betel leaf) for you. Through this, the nectar-like redness of your lips will deepen further, adding a deeper red hue to your already red lips. [1]As I gazed upon your lotus-like face in the mirror, my heart became completely enchanted. Truly, O enchantress! It is impossible to describe your divine beauty. Now, please chew this bīrī and offer its prasād to Śrī Ramray, for he finds special delight in receiving your prasād. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Radha Krishn Sarovar Jugal Govardhan Naina - Shri Manohar Das, Rasik Karnabharan (356)
hindi_text: Radha Krishna Sarovar Jugal Govardhan Naina. Inki Pattar Priya-Priyatam Bin Aur Vanai Na.- Shri Manohar Das, Rasik Karnabharan (356)The two eyes of Govardhan Hill are none other than the two twin sacred ponds — Shri Radha Kund and Shri Shyam Kund. Their glory is such that they are none other than the Divine Couple, Shri Radha and Shri Krishna Themselves. No other comparison can ever do justice to their divine essence.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Suni Paramit Piy Prem Ki Chatak Chitvati Pari - Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar
hindi_text: Suni Paramit Piy Prem Ki, Chaatak Chitavati Paari.Ghan Aasha Sab Dukh Sahai, Ant Na Yaanchai Waari.- Sri Surdas, Soor SagarHearing of the greatness of the beloved’s love, the chataka bird gazes endlessly at the clouds with single-minded devotion. Despite every hardship, it waits only for the rain of that cloud, yet even until its last breath, it never begs a drop of water. Such is the nature of a true lover — he never asks or demands anything from his beloved.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jahan-Jahan Jav Tahan Radhe-Radhe Hoy Rahyo - Shri Madhuresh Ji
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Jahan-Jahan Jav, Tahan Radhe-Radhe Hoy Rahyo, Mahima Nirali Nitya Punyabhumi Braj Ki. [1]Nainan Na Aghat Radha-Krishna Ki Nihari Chhabi, Bhashat Banai Na Neeke Shobha Saj-Dhaj Ki. [2]Tarat-Sudharat-Udharat Anekhan Ko, Kahne Ko Keval Kahani Grah-Gaj Ki. [3]‘Madhuresh’ Lalasa Sadaiv Sant-Sajjan Ko, Yugalvihari Ke Padaravind-Raj Ki. [4]- Shri Madhuresh JiWherever you go, the divine sound of “Rādhe! Rādhe!” is naturally heard — such is the divine glory of this eternally sacred land of Braj. [1]No matter how many times one beholds the beautiful forms of the divine couple, Śrī Rādhā Kṛṣṇa, the eyes are never satisfied; Their divine beauty is so incomparable that words cannot capture it. [2]They uplift, purify, and liberate countless beings — the tale of Gajendra’s deliverance is merely one example of Their infinite grace. [3]Śrī Madhureś Jī says that saints and rasikas constantly long for the dust of the divine feet of the ever‑enchanting Yugal‑Vihārī (Rādhā‑Kṛṣṇa). [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ganga Jamuna Surasati Saat Sindhu Bharpoor - Shri Tulsidas Ji
hindi_text: Ganga, Jamuna, Surasati, Saat Sindhu Bharpoor.‘Tulasi’ Chatak Ke Mate, Bin Swati Sab Dhoor.- Shri TulsidasEven if the most sacred rivers like Ganga, Yamuna, and Sarasvati, along with all seven oceans, were overflowing with water, for the chataka bird, they would still be insignificant, because it never accepts anything other than the raindrops that fall from the Swati star. In the same way, the exclusive love of a true devotee is such that, even when surrounded by countless exalted beings, His heart longs only for His beloved (deity), and desires nothing from anyone else.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sahaj Bihar Nirantar Mero - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (103)
hindi_text: Sahaj Bihar Nirantar Mero, Tan Man Mili Viharat Dou Preetam, Chhin Chhin Prem Ghanero. [1]Jeevan Pran Sukeli Hamari, Daas Biharini Kiyon Nibero. Sada Prasann Lalit Haridasi, Kou Dahinon Rahau Ki Dero. [2]- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (103)Through the divine grace of the divine Couple, their eternal love-play (nitya-vihār) is now effortlessly available to me. Both beloveds are united through body and mind, and with every passing moment, their love deepens ever more. [1]Their enchanting divine play of kelī is the very life-breath of my existence. By the mercy of Shri Biharini Ju (Shri Radha), all obstacles in this servant’s life have been removed. Shri Lalita Kishori Dev says that in the holy company of Lalita (Haridasi) Ji, his heart now remains ever joyful — what is there to fear now, whether anyone accompanies him or not. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jhulat Phulat Kunjavihari -  Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Uttarardh (321)
hindi_text: (Raag Malar)Jhoolat Phulat Kunjavihari.Dusari Or Kishor Vallabha Shri Vrishabhan Dulari. [1]Kulkata Hansat Khasat Kusumavali Sundar Jhumak Saari.Kabahun Pattari Jhullavati Gavati Pyari Hi Piya Rasiya Ri.Dekhti Nain Safal Kari Khelat, Koti Vyas Valihari. [2]- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Uttarardh (321)In Nikuṃja bower, Sri Kuṃjavihārī (Sri Krishna) is joyfully swinging on a swing, while on the other side, the youthful daughter of Vrishabhanu, Sri Radha Maharani, is gracefully seated. [1]She laughs sweetly as the swing moves — her flower garlands slip from her neck, and her sari flutters gently in the breeze. Sometimes one sakhī swings her, sometimes another, all singing melodious songs of divine love in harmonious rhythm. Gazing upon this enchanting jhūlā-līlā (swing pastimes) of the divine couple, Sri Harirāma Vyāsa Ji’s eyes are filled with pleasure, and he repeatedly offers himself in loving surrender. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Braj Ki Toy Laj Mukut Vaare - Sri Purushottam Ji
hindi_text: Braj Ki Toy Laaj Mukut Vare. Chanda-Suraj Tero Dhyan Dharat Hain, Dhyan Dharat Naulakh Tare. [1]Indra Ne Kop Kiyau Braj Upar, Tab Girivar Kar Par Dhare. ‘Purushottam’ Prabhu Ki Chhavi Nirakhat, Gai-Gop Ke Rakhvare. [2]- Sri Purushottam JiO Sri Krishna! The honor and protection of Braj rest in Your hands. Even the moon and the sun meditate upon You, and the countless stars gaze endlessly at Your divine form. [1]When Indra, the king of heaven, in anger unleashed torrential rains upon Braj, You effortlessly lifted Govardhana Hill upon Your lotus hand and sheltered all the residents of Braj. Śrī Puruṣottama Jī forever beholds the divine form of that Lord Kṛṣṇa who is the protector of cows and cowherds, and the eternal guardian of Braj. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sri Haridas Anany Jai Var Vihar-Ras Keli - Shri Roop Sakhi, Siddhant Ke Doha (26)
hindi_text: Sri Haridas Anany Jai, Var Vihar-Ras Keli.Damapti Rati Gati Madhuri, Raakhi Nainani Jheli.- Shri Roop Sakhi, Siddhant Ke Doha (26)Those who are the exclusive devotees of Swami Haridas Ji keep their minds absorbed only in the rasa-keli of the divine couple, Sri Śyāmā Kuṃja bihārī in their nitya vihāra (eternal love-play). They continually behold with their eyes the sweetness of the beauty of the ever-youthful couple.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Meri Ankhiyan Radha-Roop Pagin - Shri Hita Parmanand Das
hindi_text: Meri Ankhiyan Radha-Roop Pagin.Mridu Muskyani Bikani Nisi-Din, Sovati Nahin Jagin. [1]Nain-Sain Rukh-Sukh Samjhi Hain, Ekahi Thaur Lagin.Radhaballabh ‘Hit Paramanand’, Prem-Surag Rangin. [2]- Shri Hita Parmanand DasMy eyes have become so absorbed in the divine beauty of Shri Radha that they are sold, without price, to the sweetness of Her smile. Captivated by her charm, they remain wide open day and night. [1]Now they understand even the subtlest signal of Her eyes; thus, their gaze stays fixed solely on Her. Shri Hit Paramanand says — such deep divine love fills Shri Radha’s eyes that my own have become completely intoxicated in that prema-rasa. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Suni Lai Meri Baat Jugal Charan Chitt Laaiye - Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Khyal Hullas (23)
hindi_text: Suni Lai Meri Baat, Jugal Charan Chitt Laaiye.Jo Chuukyau Yah Ghaat, Phiri Paachhein Pachhitai.- Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Khyal Hullas (23)Shri Dhruv Dasji says that I am going to speak the most confidential philosophy, and listen very carefully. Fix your mind on the lotus feet of the divine couple, Sri Shyama Shyam, and ensure you do not lose this golden opportunity of human birth, else you will surely have to repent forever in the future.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Syama Sukumari Pran Pyari Shri Vihari Ji Ki - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Syama Sukumari Pran Pyari Shri Vihari Ji Ki, Sundari Siromani Sakal Lok Sirataaj. [1]Bipin Viharini Sakal Hit Karini Ju, Preet Ur Dharini Rahe Hain Jas Vrind Gaaj. [2]‘Lal Balbir’ Jan Janiyai Adhir Bir, Karuna Nidhan Suniye Ju Ter Sukh Saaj. [3]Ye Hi Man Aas Rakho Cheri Kar Paas Dekhun, Yugal Bilas Hai Nikunj Puri Meri Raaj. [4]- Shri Lal Balbir, Braj BinodŚrī Rādhā is supremely tender and the very life‑source of Śrī Vihārījī (Kṛṣṇa); She is the embodiment of supreme beauty and the crown‑jewel among all. [1]She eternally performs love‑plays in Vṛndāvan, bestowing grace upon all; She is the embodiment of divine love, and Her divine glory spreads across every corner of Vṛndāvan. [2]Śrī Lāl Balbir humbly prays — O compassionate Supreme Queen! Please hear the cry of my heart and fill it with the nectar of Your divine love. [3]My only desire is to remain forever as Your humble maidservant, to stay near You in the sacred Nikunja and behold the eternal plays of the Divine Couple. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kunwari Kishori Naval Piy Karat Paraspar Het - Shri Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Hari Pad Sangrah (45)
hindi_text: Kunwari Kishori Naval Piy, Karat Paraspar Het. Tanik Madhur Muskaikai, ‘Brajanidhi’ Man Hari Let. - Shri Braj Nidhi Ji, Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Hari Pad Sangrah (45)Ever-youthful Shri Radha and the ever-new Rasika Shri Krishna are bound together in the sacred bond of divine love. With just a slight, gentle smile, they completely steal away my heart.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aasro Shyama Ju Aap Charan Ko - Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (112)
hindi_text: (Raag Vihag or Kafi)Aasro Shyama Ju Aap Charan Ko.Hoy Nishchint Rahun Ab To Main, Bhay Nahin Janam Maran Ko. [1]Baat Niharat Rahun Kripa Ki, Yehi Ik Jatan Taran Ko.Jap Tap Nem Sadhana Nahi, Hai Bal Mohi Sharan Ko. [2]Tumharo Dridh Vishwas Bharyo Ur, Yachun Na Dev Naran Ko.“Rupmadhuri” Preet Nibhajyo, Tajiyo Nahin Paran Ko. [3]- Shri Roop Madhuri, Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (112)O Śrī Śyāmā Jū (Rādhā), my every hope rests solely at the shelter of Your lotus feet. For this reason, I now live free from fear — even the fears of birth and death no longer touch me. [1]I look only to Your mercy, which alone can carry me across this endless ocean of worldly existence. I possess no power of japa, austerity, vows, or sādhanā — my sole strength lies in Your lotus feet. [2]My heart holds firm trust in You, and thus I ask nothing from any other gods or mortals. Śrī Rūpamādhurī humbly prays — O my beloved Svāminījū Ju! I trust fully that You will always uphold this exclusive love and never forsake someone like me who is in your shelter. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Puri Madhupuri Aadi Lai Dvaravati Je Tham - Sri Kishori Ali
hindi_text: Puri Madhupuri Aadi Lai, Dvaravati Je Tham.Te Charanakit Janiye, Yah Rasnankit Dham.- Sri Kishori AliAll sacred pilgrimage sites, such as Purī, Mathurā, and Dvārakā, are revered as holy because they bear the footprints of the Lord. But Śrī Vrindavan Dhām is uniquely blessed because it is directly imprinted with divine rasa (nectar). Therefore, it is known as Rasa‑dhām.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Are Man Vrindavan Nit Bhajiye - Shri Radhacharan Das, Vrindavan Virudavali
hindi_text: Are Man Vrindavan Nit Bhajiye.Ih Sukh Sakal Sukhan Ki Seema, Jag Sukh Lalas Tajiye. [1]Radha Pad Dasi Bani Manua, Nij Swaroop Nit Sajiye.Radhacharan Das Vrindavan Ras Nikunj Mahin Majiye. [2]- Shri Radhacharan Das, Vrindavan VirudavaliO mind! Perform the bhajana of Vrindavan ceaselessly. The bliss found here is the highest of all nectars. Don't waste your time on worldly pleasures; they are nothing compared to this divine bliss. [1]O mind! Become the maidservant of Shri Radha’s lotus feet and lovingly refine your true self daily in this bhāva. Shri Radhacharan Das says that taste the nectar of Vrindavan’s rasa and remain forever absorbed in the blissful Nikuṃja groves of divine love. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ban Gahvar Sar Premsar Ghat Shriyugal Vihar - Shri Charandas
hindi_text: Ban Gahbar Sar Premsar, Ghat Shriyugal Vihar. Kunj Gali Path Janiye, Giri Govardhan Charu. - Shri CharandasAmong forests, Gahvar-vana, among lakes Prem-sarovara, among riverbanks Śrī Yugal-Vihār Ghāṭ, among lanes the kunja-galīyan, and among mountains Śrī Govardhana are supremely delightful.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aisi Ko Karihai Shri Radha - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (292)
hindi_text: (Raag Iman)  Aisi Ko Karihai Shri Radha,  Metyo Timir Hiye Dasi Ko, Kahat Naam Nij Aadha.  [1] ‘Lalit Kishori’ Charan Upasan, Jo Kaahu Dridh Saadha,  Nishchai Jugul Prakasain Ta Ur, Mitai Trividh Jagvaadha. [2]  - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (292)O Sri Radha! Who else in this vast universe could be so merciful that, merely by uttering half of Your name, “Ra” from “Rādhā,” You remove the darkness from the hearts of Your surrendered ones? [1]Śrī Lalit Kishori says that whoever sincerely and exclusively worships Your lotus feet, the divine splendor, the love-plays of the Divine Couple surely awaken in their heart, and all threefold sufferings—daihika (intrinsic), daivika (superhuman), and bhautika (extrinsic)—are dispelled. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Baithai Laal Phoolan Ki Pichbari - Goswami Shri Harirai Ji
hindi_text: (Raag Sarang)Baithe Laal Phulan Ki Pichbari.Sundar Syam Subhagta Seema, Kanthamaal Manhaari. [1]Naval Kishor Rasik Nandanandan, Sang Radhika Pyari.Rasikaray Prabhu Sab Gun Puran, Sukhanidhi Shri Girdhari. [2]- Goswami Shri Hariray JiIn a flower-adorned arbor, our beloved Lālji (Śrī Kṛṣṇa) is seated. The beautiful Śyām embodies the pinnacle of charm, His garlands captivating the heart. [1]The playful adolescent, the rasika Śyāmsundar, beloved son of Nanda, is present with His beloved Śrī Rādhikā Pyari. Śrī Rasikaray declares, Śrī Girdhar Lāl is full of all virtues, truly the treasure-house of bliss. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ke Hve Rahu Drum Gulam Lata Beli Ban Mahi-  Nanddas Granthwali, Bhanwar Geet (68.2)
hindi_text: Gopi Prem Prasaad So, Hau Hi Seekhyo Aay.Udhau Ten Madhukar Bhayo, Dubidhaa Yog Mitaay.- Shri Nanddas, Nanddas Granthwali, Bhanwar Geet (68.2)Through the impact and grace of Gopi’s selfless love, even an enlightened being like Uddhava, immersed in the bliss of merging with the ‘Brahma' (Impersonal God), renounced all its Yogic practices and became a Rasika, a true connoisseur of divine love, accepting the path of pure love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aise Nahin Hum Chahan Haar - Braj Ke Sawaiya
hindi_text: Aise Nahin Hum Chahan Haar, Jo Aaj Tumhen Kal Aur Ko Chahain. Phenk Den Aankhen Nikari Dou, Yadi Doosri Or Karen Ye Nigahein. [1]Laakh Milain Tumte Badh Ke, Tumhin Ko Chahain Tumhin Ko Sarahain.Jaunlaun Yah Jeev Rahe Tan Mein, Tau Laun Hum Neh Ko Naata Nibahain. [2]- Braj Ke SawaiyaO Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa! We are not the kind of lovers who love You today and turn to another tomorrow. If these eyes ever look away from You to another, we would rather pluck them out and cast them aside. [1]Even if a million better than You appeared, we would love only You and sing only Your praise. As long as life remains in this body, we shall faithfully uphold this bond of divine love with You alone. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Janen Rasik Ananya Je Anurage Ras Prem - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Janen Rasik Ananya Je, Anurage Ras Prem. Phirat Sada Unmatt Se, Taji Nishedh Vidhi Nem.- Braj Ke DoheThe true exclusive rasikas are those whose hearts remain forever immersed in the loving remembrance of the divine couple, Sri Shyama Shyam. Abandoning all kinds of injunctions, prohibitions, and rules, they wander ever intoxicated in the nectar of divine love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrriddhayarthat Radhadhatoshva Radha - Shri Vagish Shastriji, Sri Radha Naam Sudha (5)
hindi_text: Vrriddhayarthat Radhadhatoshva Radha Brahmagunadhika. Svayam Tu Vardhate Nityam Anyan Vardhayate Tatha.- Shri Vagish Shastriji, Sri Radha Naam Sudha (5)The name ‘Rādhā’ originates from the root ‘Rādh’, which means to increase or to uplift. Therefore, devotees consider Shri Radha to possess divine qualities even greater than those of Brahman. Shri Radha herself is ever-growing and constantly increases the devotional sentiments (rasa and bhava) of her devotees.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dola Jhule Syama-Syama Saheli - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (16)
hindi_text: (Raga Saranga)Dola Jhule Syama-Syama Saheli.Nava Nikunja, Nava Ramga Piya Sanga, Biharata Garva-gaheli. [1] Kabahunka Pritama Ramaki Jhulavata, Kaba Hun Priya Naveli.Shribithalavipula Pulaki Lalitadika, Dekhata Anamda Keli. [2] - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (16)O dear friend! The divine couple, Śrī Śyāma‑Śyām, are joyfully swinging on a swing. In the ever‑fresh, blossoming forest‑temple of nikuṃja, the most magnificent and graceful, Śrī Rādhā, is lovingly engaged in sweet love‑play with Her beloved, Śrī Kṛṣṇa. [1]Sometimes Kṛṣṇa gently swings His beloved, and at other times, the tender‑hearted Priya‑jū swings Him. The sakhīs, with Śrī Lalitā and the others, behold these delightful nikuṃja‑līlās, completely entranced and filled with waves of divine ecstasy. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Lalitpriye Haridasi Ju Nitya Keli Sukh Dani - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (65)
hindi_text: Lalitpriye Haridasi Ju, Nitya Keli Sukh Dani.Kunjbiharini Ladali, Pragati Ras Ki Khani.- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (65)Swami Shri Haridās Ji Maharaj, the incarnation of Shri Lalitā Sakhi, is an unparalleled Rasika Acharya who bestows the nectar of the eternal love plays of the divine couple. By his grace, the very embodiment of rasa, Kunj Bihariṇī Lādili, Shri Radha Maharani, effortlessly appears before the devotee.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jo Marag Khojat Firat  Ajahun Shesh Mahesh - Chacha Vrindavan Das Ji, Sri Rasik Ananya Parchavali (32)
hindi_text: Jo Marag Khojat Firat, Ajahun Shesh Mahesh.So Durlabh Bhootal Kiyau, Jai Jai Rasik Naresh.- Chacha Vrindavan Das Ji, Sri Rasik Ananya Parchavali (32)The rare path of Vṛndāvan-rasa (the nectar of Vrindavan), which even Brahmā, Śeṣanāga, and Lord Śiva yearn for, yet which remained inaccessible since time immemorial, is now made attainable. O crown-jewel of rasika devotees, Śrī Hit Harivaṃś Mahāprabhu, all glories to you.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ari Mere Nainani Ko Aahar - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Surat Sukh (37)
hindi_text: (Doha)Safal Manorath Hot Sab, Avat Hiye Jitek.Mere Nainani Ko Ari, Yah Aahar Hain Ek.(Pad)Ari Mere Nainani Ko Aahar.Kal Na Parai Pal Ek Bina Mohin Avloken Sukhsar. [1]Sakal Manorath Safal Hot Tab Karat Hiye Sanchar.Shri Haripriya Pran-Jeevan-Dhan Kau Yah Surat Bihar. [2]- Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Surat Sukh (37)(Doha)Śrī Haripriyā Sakhi says: "O Sakhi! my eyes are truly satisfied only when they behold the vihāra (love-plays) of the divine couple. Through this darśana alone, all the cherished desires of my heart are fulfilled."(Pada)O Sakhi! The only sustenance for my eyes is the sight of the playful vihāra of the Divine Couple, which is the essence of the sweetest nectar. Without beholding their love-plays, I find no peace even for a moment. [1]Through the sweetness of the glimpses of their divine plays within my heart, all my desires find fulfillment. Śrī Haripriyā declares, their vihāra alone is my treasure, my very breath, my soul. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jin Jin Aparadhin Sir Nayo - Shri Kishori Ali Ji, Vinay Ke Pad (37)
hindi_text: Jin Jin Aparadhin Sir Nayau, Rasna Naam Uchari, Te-Te Nij Parikar Mein Liye, Kari Seva Adhikari. [1]Meri Baar Abar Kari Kihi, Het Kahan Sukuwari? Karo Vichar “Kishori” Hiy Mein, Haansi Hoi Tihari. [2]- Shri Kishori Ali Ji, Vinay Ke Pad (37)Whoever, though sinful, bowed their head and uttered Your name, You lovingly accepted them into Your intimate circle of sakhīs and granted them the honor of divine service. [1]O Pyārī Śrī Rādhā Jū, why then this delay—only in my case? Please ponder, for if You do not, the world will not mock me, but You. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Vrishabhan Kumar Nit- Shri Vanshi Ali, Hriday Sarvasv (4)
hindi_text: Shri Vrishabhan Kumar Nit, Naam Kunwar Nandanand. Boode Rahat Vihar Mein, Sahachar Anand Kand.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Hriday Sarvasv (4)Vrishabhanu’s daughter, Shri Radha, and Nand’s son, Shri Krishna, remain immersed in the blissful rasa of eternal love-plays (nitya-vihār), continuously bathing the hearts of their sahacarīs (companions) in the same divine nectar.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhanunandini Mo Tan Hero - Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Vinay (15)
hindi_text: (Raag Iman)Bhanunandini Mo Tan Hero. Tapat Rahat Man Vishay Vasana, Sheetal Drishti Kripa Kan Gero. [1]Khol Lehu Darbar Swamini, Ha-Ha Ab Na Karo Avasero. Lalit Ladaiti Tan Man Akulit, Shri Vrindavan Dehu Basero. [2]- Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Vinay (15)O Bhānu-Nandini, Śrī Rādhā! Please cast Your merciful glance upon me. My heart burns in the fire of worldly desires—please shower even a single drop of Your grace to bring soothing coolness. [1]O my beloved Svāminī jū! Please open the gates of Your divine palace, delay no longer. This body and mind of Lalita Laḍaitī are restless; therefore, kindly grant the uninterrupted residence in Śrī Vṛndāvana forever. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sahajo Bhav Sagar Bahe Timir Baras Ghar Ghor - Sri Sahjobai
hindi_text: “Sahajo” Bhav Sagar Bahai, Timir Baras Ghar Ghor. Ta Mein Naam Jahaj Hai, Paar Utaaren Tor.- Shri SahjobaiSahjobai says that this world is like an unfathomable ocean of material existence, in which the dense darkness of ignorance constantly pours down like rain. The only means that can safely carry the soul across is the ship of the Divine Name of the Lord.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Naval Navnaagari Roop Gun Aagari - Shri Dwarkesh Ji (of Pushtimarga)
hindi_text: (Raag Kedaara, Taal: Charchari)Naval Navnaagari Roop Gun Aagari,Subhag Shyamaa Lalit Raajaraajeshwari. [1]Naval Ras Bhaav Bhushit Nayan Chapal,Chit Chaah Chanchal Bhrikuti Sneh Hit Rasbhari. [2]Naval Nav Ras Den, Ulat Ras Len Kachhu,Kahat Rasben Rasreet Son Anusari. [3]Nikat ‘Dwaarkesh’ Kar Jor Binati Kare,Yugal Ras Keli Mein Karahu Mohe Anuchari. [4]- Shri Dwarkesh Ji (of Pushtimarga)Śrī Śyāmā (Rādhā) remains eternally youthful, the peerless empress of beauty, embodying perfect form and virtues.
