Utterly enchanting, gracefully sovereign among all queens. [1]Bathed in ever-fresh nectar, brimming with divine bhāva, Her playful eyes sparkle. Her heart perpetually longs for union with Priyatam. Playful eyebrows frame Her loving, rasa-filled, benevolent gaze; Her entire being overflows with divine rasa. [2]She ceaselessly bestows newer and newer rasa and receives rasa in return. Her speech is filled with rasa, and She follows only the eternal path of rasa. [3]Śrī Dvārakēśa humbly bows, praying: "O supreme queen Śrī Rādhā! Grant me service in Your Yugala-rasa Kelī Līlā alongside Śyāmasundara." [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aay Kunvar Thaade Bhaye - Shri Madhuri Das, Vanshivat Madhuri (154)
hindi_text: Aay Kunvar Thaade Bhaye, Naval Kunvari Ke Sang. Aho Priye Ya Pulin Mein, Upajat Koti Tarang. - Shri Madhuri Das, Vanshivat Madhuri (154)Ever-fresh Śrī Kṛṣṇa stands beside ever-youthful Śrī Rādhā on the bank of the Yamunā in Vaṃśīvaṭa in Vṛndāvana, where countless waves of divine love-bliss arise.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Naath Muhin Keejai Vrajki Mor - Sri Roop Kunwari Ji
hindi_text: (Raag Puriya Kalyan – Taal Titala)Naath Muhin Keejai Vrajki Mor.Nish Din Tero Nritya Karaungi, Vrajki Khoran Khor. [1]Shyam Ghata Sam Ghaat Nirakhike, Kookoongi Chahun Or.Mor Mukut Maatheke Kaajen, Dehaun Pankha Tor. [2]Brajbasin Sang Rahas Karungi, Nachihoun Pankh Maror.‘Roopkunvari’ Rani Saranagat, Jai Jai Jugalkishor. [3]- Sri Roop Kunwari JiO Lord, grant me the form of the peacock of Braj. I will dance day and night in the streets of Vraj for You. [1]Beholding Your beauty, dark as monsoon clouds, I shall call out in every direction, offering my feathers to grace Your crown as the peacock's crest. [2]I will dance in delight with the residents of Braj, spreading my wings and dancing in love-bliss. Śrī Rūp Kuṃwarī Jī says, keep me in any way You wish; I am forever in Your refuge. Glory to the Divine Couple! [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Patitan Mein Vikhyaat Ho Mahapatit Mam Nam - Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (17)
hindi_text: Patitan Mein Vikhyaat Hon, Mahaapatit Mam Naam.Ab Yaachak Hoy Jaach Ho, Sharanagati Sab Yaam.- Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (17)O Śrī Kṛṣṇa, I am known as the most fallen among the fallen—indeed, “Mahāpatit” is my very name. Yet now, as a humble beggar at Your feet, I pray that my surrender may ever remain firm and unbroken throughout day and night.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Karuna Bhare Priya Drig Tore - Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer (76)
hindi_text: Karuna Bhare Priya Drig Torain.Sahaj Kripa Ki Uthat Tarangen, Tribhuvan Ras Mein Borain. [1]Umadat Kripa Sindhu Paripuran, Dis-Dis Let Hilorain.‘Bhori’ Param Abhagi Tauhu, Inkau Asarau Morain. [2]- Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer (76)O Śrī Priya Ju (Rādhā), within Your eyes resides an ocean of compassion, whose lofty waves of grace continually rise and flood all three worlds with divine rasa. [1]When this ocean of mercy swells to its fullness, its waves spread everywhere. Śrī Hit Bhorisakhī Jī says that although I am most unfortunate and still deprived of Your grace, I have not abandoned hope. In truth, I no longer merely hope; I possess firm faith that Your mercy will surely descend upon me. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mukti Bhukti Sab Khokhli Bhakti Bhari Ras Rang - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Mukti Bhukti Sab Khokhli, Bhakti Bhari Ras Rang.Mukti Achal Jas Pokhari, Bhakti Bahe Jas Gang.- Braj Ke DoheMukti (liberation) and bhukti (material pleasures) are hollow at their core, whereas devotion is filled with rasa and bliss. Liberation resembles stagnant water in a pond, while devotion flows alive and ever fresh, like the sacred Gaṅgā.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jake Priye Na Ram Badaidi - Shri Tulsidas (A letter sent to Mirabai)
hindi_text: (Rag Sorath)Jake Priya Na Ram Badaidi.Tajiye Tahi Koti Bairi Sam, Jadyapi Param Sanehi. [1]Tajyo Pita Prahlad, Bibhishan Bandhu, Bharat Mahatari.Bali Guru Tajyo Kant Braj-Banitanh, Bhaye Mud-Mangalkari. [2]Nate Neh Ram Ke Maniyat, Suhrid Susebya Jahan Lau.Anjan Kaha Aankh Jehi Phutai, Bahutak Kahau Kahan Lau. [3]Tulsi So Sab Bhanti Param Hit, Pujya Pranate Pyaro.Jaso Hoy Saneh Ram-Pad, Eto Mato Hamaro. [4]- Shri Tulsidas (A letter sent to Mirabai)Once, Mīrābāī asked Tulsīdās Jī, “My family members create obstacles in my path of devotion, what should I do?” In response to this question, Tulsīdās Jī composed this verse and sent it to her.Those who do not love Lord Rām should be renounced like millions of enemies, even if they are extremely dear to us. [1]Prahlād renounced his father Hiraṇyakaśipu, Vibhīṣaṇ his brother Rāvaṇa, Bharata his mother Kaikeyī, Bālī his guru Śukrācārya, and the Gopīs of Braj renounced their husbands, and in every case, such renunciation proved supremely auspicious. [2]Love for Rām alone is the true relationship. Anyone worthy of friendship or reverence in this world is so only because of their love for Lord Rām. What is the use of applying collyrium to the eyes if it causes blindness? In the same way, if even one’s loved ones become obstacles in the path of God, one should renounce them and engage fully in devotion to God. [3]Śrī Tulsīdās says that whoever’s association or teachings awaken exclusive love for the feet of the Lord is, in every way, our greatest benefactor, most worthy of worship, and dearer than life itself—this alone is my firm conviction. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kiti Na Gokul Kul Vadhu - Mahakavi Shri Bihari Lal, Bihari Satsai (22)
hindi_text: Kiti Na Gokul Kula-Vadhu, Kahi Na Kihin Sikh Deen.Kaune Taji Na Kul-gali, Hvai Murali-Sur Leen.- Mahakavi Shri Bihari Lal, Bihari Satsai (22)In Gokul there were many married women, and all were well-trained in social conduct; yet, despite family bonds and moral teachings, not one remained who, upon being captivated by the sweet melody of Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s flute, did not abandon shame and family decorum.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kahon Ri Jo Kahibe Ki Hoi - Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Ras Ke Pada (182)
hindi_text: (Raag Sarang)Kahon Ri Jo Kahibe Ki Hoi.Shri Bihari Biharani Kau Sukh Sakhi Ri, Janat Nahine Koi. [1]Prem Magan Ras Matt Rahat Nit, Tan Man Pran Samoi.Shri Bihari Biharani Dasi Ladavat, Ang Sang Rahi Bhoi. [2]- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Ras Ke Pada (182)O Sakhi, No matter how much someone tries to explain it, the truth is that the eternal Nitya-vihāra (love-plays) of the divine couple, Śrī Bihārī–Bihāriṇī Jū is filled with such wondrous and unparalleled rasa that no one can ever fully comprehend their depth. [1]In that rasa, the Beloved Couple and their Sahacārīs are so completely immersed that body, mind, and very life-breath merge into it. The maidservants of Śrī Bihārī–Bihāriṇī Jū, filled with ecstatic love, tenderly serve Them ceaselessly and, remaining ever close to Them, continuously partake of that unbroken rasa. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ab To Kahibe Ki Na Rahi - Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh) Ki Vani, Chootak Pad (123)
hindi_text: Ab To Kahibe Ki Na Rahi.Apni Banh Chhahatar Rakhyo, Vrindavipun Mahi. [1]Aisen Hi Kari Kripa Metiyai, Kaam Krodh Sabhi.Nagariya Ki Chhuti Jay Tumhain Sab Hi Kaha-Kahi. [2]- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Chootak Pad (123)O Śrī Rādhārānī, now nothing remains for me to say. You have held me in Your arms, granted me the cool shelter of Your lotus feet, and bestowed residence in the supremely sacred land of Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvan. [1]In the same way, extend this grace further by removing all faults within me, such as desire and anger, so that Nāgarīdās may be freed from all speaking and hearing, and serving only You selflessly, night and day. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Maan Apman Abhiman Taji Kari Vrindavan Vas -  Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.83)
hindi_text: Maan Apmaan Abhimaan Taji, Kari Vrindavan Vaas.Raj Mein Rajraj Hvai Rahau, Man Mein Adhik Prakaash. - Shri Ananya Ali, Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.83)Abandon pride, honor, and dishonor, and dwell in Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvan. Become like a speck of dust in its supremely auspicious raj (dust)—only then does the light of divine love awaken within the heart.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ladili Vinay Suno Sukh Raasi - Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
hindi_text: (Raag Bihaag)Laadili Vinay Suno Sukh Raasi.Tav Mukh Aanandkand Chand Ki, Nain Chakori Pyaasi. [1]Bin Nirkhe Ras Roop Madhuri, Nishi Din Rahat Udaasi.Saras Madhuri Jaan Aapni, Nij Daasin Ki Daasi. [2]- Shri Saras MadhuriO Lāḍilī, O embodiment of bliss, please accept my humble prayer. Your moonlike face is the supreme source of bliss, and my eyes, like the chakora bird, remain restlessly longing to behold it. [1]Until I drink the nectar of Your beauty and sweetness, my heart remains lost in sadness day and night. Saras Mādhurī says—O Beloved, please consider me the servant of Your own maidservant. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Radha Raas-Siromani  Radha Keli-Kulin - Shri Anandghan Ji, Ghananand Granthawali, Priya Prasad (81)
hindi_text: Radha Raas-Siromani, Radha Keli-Kulin.Radha Sakal Kala-Bhari, Rasmurati Hitaleen.- Shri Anandghan Ji, Ghananand Granthawali, Priya Prasad (81)Śrī Rādhā is the crown jewel of the Rāsa dance, ever immersed in the divine play of Kelī. She is skilled in every art, the very personification of rasa, and the presiding deity of divine love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Syama Tu Karuna Ko Sagar - Shri Roop Sakhi Ji Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (186)
hindi_text: (Raag Sarang)Syama Tu Karuna Ko Sagar.Tuv Duti Nirakhai Kunjabihari, Param Rasik Var Nagar. [1]Lalit Badan Drig Sobha Sundari, Adbhut Roop Ujagar.Gore Tan Sukh Surang Chunari, Nirakhi Roop Gun Paagar. [2]- Shri Roop Sakhi, Shri Roop Sakhi Ji Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (186)O Śyāmajū (Śrī Rādhā), boundless ocean of compassion, Your divine splendor enchants even Śrī Kuñjabihārī, the crown-jewel among rasikas. [1]Your lotus face glows with supreme charm, and Your playful, love-laden eyes radiate matchless sweetness. Beholding Your fair and smiling face, draped in a five-colored Chunarī, Rūpa Sakhī is intoxicated in Your love. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kunjbhavan Sarveshwari Sahibni Sirtaj - Sri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Sri Radha Naam Ank (16)
hindi_text: Kunjbhavan Sarveshwari, Sahibni Sirtaj.Anandkandani Mridul Chitt, Sada Garibnivaj.- Shri Roop Madhuri, Sri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Sri Radha Naam Ank (16)Śrī Rādhā is the sovereign of Kuñjamahal, the supreme protectress and the crown jewel among all. She is the very source of bliss, endowed with an infinitely tender heart, and ever compassionate toward the poor and the distressed.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jayati Jayati Vrishabhanu Dulari - Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (06)
hindi_text: (Raag Kalyan Trital)Jayati Jayati Vrishabhanu Dulari.Jay Vrindavan Param Manohar, Lata Phool Phulwari. [1]Jay Vanshivat Jay Shri Yamuna, Sevakunj Tihari.Jayati Jay Manmohan Pyari, Jay Jay Rasik Hiyari. [2]Jay Ho Shrivan Vraj Mandal Ki, Jay Chhavi Roop Ujari.Shri Gopalhit Hari Swamini, Sab Vraj Ki Rakhwari. [3]- Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (06)All glories, again and again, to Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī, the beloved daughter of Vṛṣabhānu. All glories to that supremely enchanting Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvan, where fragrant gardens of creepers, groves, and flowers are forever splendid. [1]All glories to the most sacred pastime places of Śrī Rādhārānī—Vaṁśīvaṭ, Śrī Yamunā, and Sevākuñj. All glories to Śrī Rādhā, the very life of the enchanter Śyāmasundar, and the one who eternally resides in the hearts of rasikas. [2]All glories to Śrī Rādhārānī, whose radiant divine form illuminates the entire Vraja-maṇḍal and Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvan. Śrī Hit Gopāl Dās says: eternal victory to Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī, the sovereign Svāminī of Śrī Hari and the protectress of all Vraja. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Roop Ki Rasi Kishor Kishori -  Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Shringar Shat (3.44)
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Roop Ki Rasi Kishor-Kishori, Range Ras-Keli Nikunj Bihara.Mate Anang Praveen Sabai Ang, Phool Sirishahu Te Sukumara. [1]Basau Ur-Nainani Mein Din-Rain, Nasau Man Ke Jite Aahin Bikara.Janchat Baat Na Aur Kachhu ‘Dhruv’, Dehu Priye Ras-Prem Ki Dhara. [2]- Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Shringar Shat (3.44)The treasure of beauty, the divine couple, Śrī Lāḍilī-Lāl, are adorned in the nectarine sports of eternal love-play, Kelī līlā, within the groves of Vṛndāvan, skilled in every art of divine love and tenderer than the softest blossom. [1]May They ever dwell within my heart and eyes, and by Their grace may all impurities of my mind be washed away. Śrī Hit Dhruv Dās says—there is no greater desire in my heart than this: may They unceasingly pour the sweet stream of Their divine love into my heart. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Param Pran Dhan Kunj Mein Karat Vihar Vishal - Shri Priya Sakhi (Sri Brahm Gopal Goswami), Shri Hari Leela (36)
hindi_text: Param Pran Dhan Kunj Mein, Karat Vihar Vishal. Viharahu Anand Sindhu Vidhu, Radha Madhav Lal. - Shri Priya Sakhi (Sri Brahm Gopal Goswami), Shri Hari Leela (36)The divine couple, Śrī Rādhā Mādhava, the supreme treasure of life, the moonlike embodiments of the ocean of bliss, are eternally engaged in the plays of love (nitya vihāra) within the groves of Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvan.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Yahi Te Sab Mukti Te Lahi Badai Prem - Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (35)
hindi_text: Yahi Ten Sab Mukti Ten, Lahi Badai Prem.Prem Bhaye Nasi Jahin Sab, Bandhen Jagat Ke Nem.- Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (35)Love has the power to unite two bodies into one; therefore, it stands even higher than liberation. When love awakens, all rules and restraints become irrelevant—love acknowledges no regulations.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Gunjan Madhupan Sunat Aliri - Shri Albeli Ali, Samay Prabandh (22)
hindi_text: (Rag Bhairav)Gunjan Madhupan Sunat Alinri.Umgin Manau Prem Ki Sarita, Roop Ke Sindhu Chalinri. [1]Vihansat Badan Hansat Vigasat-Si, Janu Anurag Kalinri.Roop Anoop Lakhen Albeli, Aai Vari Bhalinri. [2]- Shri Albeli Ali, Samay Prabandh (22)At dawn, upon hearing the gentle humming of bees, the sakhīs became intoxicated with joy and gracefully made their way toward the palace. Each step they took resembled a rippling river of love rushing toward the infinite ocean of divine beauty. [1]Their lotus faces bloomed with radiant smiles, and every pore of their being thrilled with awakening love, like tender buds of love blossoming in full delight. Śrī Albelī Alī narrates that upon witnessing the unparalleled form of Śrī Rādhā, their hearts overflowed with such bliss that they repeatedly offered themselves. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Parabhakti Ras Vardhini Shyama Sab Sukh Den - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sewa Sukh (51)
hindi_text: Parabhakti Ras Vardhini, Shyama Sab Sukh Den.Rasik Mukut Mani Radhika, Jai Nav Neeraj Nain.- Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sewa Sukh (51)Śrī Śyāmā Jū (Śrī Rādhā) grants the highest form of devotion, who continually increases the nectar, and is the bestower of every form of happiness. For rasikas, Śrī Rādhikā alone is the supreme crest-jewel—Glory, glory to such Śrī Rādhā Mahārāṇī, whose eyes resemble newly blossomed lotuses.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pachhe Lalita Ta Aage Syama Pyari - Shri Surdas Madanamohan (of Gaudiya sect.)
hindi_text: (Raag Poorvi)Paachhen Lalita, Taa Aage Syaama Pyaari,Taa Aagen Piy Maarag Phool Bichhaavat Jaat. [1]Kathin Kali Beeni Karat Nyaari-Nyaari,Pyaari Ke Charan Komal Jaani, Sakuchit Garibe Daraat. [2]Arujhi Lata Su Kar Nirvaarat,Paachhen Daarat Drum Pallav-Paat. [3]Surdas Madanmohan Piy Ki Adheenatai,Dekhat Mere Nain Siraat. [4]- Shri Surdas Madanamohan (of Gaudiya sect.)Behind walks Śrī Lalitā, while ahead moves her Śyāmā Jū (Śrī Rādhā) and in front, Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself leads, gently spreading flowers along the path. [1]He carefully removes the hard buds one by one, knowing how exceedingly tender Pyāri Jū’s feet are, fearing they might be pricked or hurt, thus proceeding with loving caution. [2]With His own hands, He clears the way of entangled creepers and spreads soft leaves and tender buds upon the path for Her to tread. [3]Śrī Sūrdās Madanmohan says that on witnessing such loving submission and servitude of the Beloved Śyāmsundar toward Śrī Rādhā, his eyes are satiated. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Chhabile Neel Ghan Ki Putari - Shri Nanddas, Nanddas Granthwali
hindi_text: (Raga Gaud Sarang, Taal Jhumra)Chhabile Neel Ghan Ki Putari Kreedat Brindaban Maahin.Bibidh Bhooshan Dharen Bansi Adhar Dhari Chalat Dekhat Parchhaahin. [1]Sabke Hiy Karshat, Sobha Boondan Barshat,Gopijan Lochan Chaatak Nirakhat Jivaahin. [2]‘Nanddas’ Kou Ek Daamini Si Dhing,Thaadi Taake Garen Bar Diye Baahin. [3]- Shri Nanddas, Nanddas GranthwaliO friend! A graceful, dark cloud–like form of Śrī Kṛṣṇa delights in loving play within this Vṛndāvana. Every limb is adorned with splendid ornaments, the sweet flute rests upon His lips, and even the charm of His very shadow enchants the heart. [1]His splendor effortlessly draws all beings toward Him. The gopīs, like cātaka birds, ceaselessly drink the nectar of His moonlike form with thirsty eyes, seeing His darśana alone as the sole sustenance of their lives. [2]Śrī Nanddās says that just as lightning clings to the rain cloud, so His supremely beloved gopī, Śrī Rādhā, stands beside Him, arms entwined in divine love, in a tender embrace. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jo Main Aisa Jaanti Preet Kare Dukh Hoye - Sri Mirabai
hindi_text: Jo Main Aisa Jaanti, Preet Kare Dukh Hoye. Nagar Dhindora Peetti, Preet Na Kariyo Koy. - Sri MirabaiHad I ever known earlier that love brings so much pain, I would have gone from town to town announcing that no one should fall in love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ab Sagar Ke Taran Ko Hai Hari Naam Aadhar - Shri Maluka Das
hindi_text: Ab Sagar Ke Taran Ko, Hai Hari Naam Aadhar.So Bisraayo Sahaj Hi, Re Man Mudh Ganvaar.- Shri Malook DasThe sole support for crossing this ocean of material existence is the sacred Name of Lord Śrī Hari. O foolish, deluded mind, how effortlessly you have let it slip from remembrance.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kaho Piya Kin Tohin Rasik Banayo - Jagadguru Shri Kripaluji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Virah Madhuri (80)
hindi_text: Kaho Piya!, Kin Tohin Rasik Banayo.Kab Varah Bani Roop-Rashi-Bal, Mohanmadan Kahayo.Dhari Tanu Meen Vari Bich Basi Kab, Gopin Cheer Churayo. [1]Lalit Tribhang Roop Dhari Kachhap, Kab Var Venu Bajayo.Raghvendra, Vaman Bani Kab Tum, Sakhiyan Ras Rachayo. [2]Kab Nrsingh Bani Rudra Roop Dhari, Pranay-Man-Ras Payo.Lahi ‘Kripalu’ Radhe-Bal Kachhu Ras, Rasikan Naam Ginayo. [3]- Jagadguru Shri Kripaluji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Virah Madhuri (80)A sakhī teasing Lord Krishna—O Beloved! Tell me, whose grace has granted You this title of “Rasika” (connoisseur of divine love)? In Your previous Śūkra-avatāra, when, taking the form of a pig, were You called ‘Madan Mohan’ (captivator of even the God of beauty, Kamadeva)? In the Matsya-avatāra, when, assuming the form of a fish and dwelling in water, did You ever perform the pastimes of stealing the garments of the Gopīs? [1]In the Kacchapa-avatāra, when, taking the form of a tortoise, did You play the sweet notes of Your flute in a tribhaṅga (threefold-curved) form? In the Rāma-avatāra and Vāmana-avatāra, when did You ever relish the rasa of Mahārāsa with the Gopīs? [2]In the Nṛsiṁha-avatāra, when did your terrifying form ever derive pleasure from pleasing a māninī Radha? Jagadguru Shrī Kripālu Jī teases Shyāmasundara: “It is only in this present incarnation of Krishna that even You started regarding Yourself as a rasika, after attaining some divine love-bliss through the grace of Śrī Radha Jī. In Your previous incarnations, what else did you do except destroying demons, protecting saints, and establishing dharma?” [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Rakhi Hriday Priya Prem Sudha Ras - Shri Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (18)
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Rakhi Hriday Priya Prem Sudha-Ras, Sar Durai Dikhavat Bur.Kari Vishai Tan Maya Prapanch, Kripa Binu Vastu Lahai Kyon Moor. [1]Shri Guru Prem Prasann Base Ban, Dharm Ananya Maha Man Soor.Shri Nagaridas Ko Dai Sukh Sang, Shri Biharini Jani Parayo Gar Koor. [2]- Shri Nagri Dev, Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (18)In this pada, the devotee humbly cries out to Śrī Nityavihāriṇī Jū, Śrī Rādhā —O Swāminī, You are the infinite source of divine love-bliss. Why, then, have You hidden that supreme treasure and let my mind become entangled in the worthless chaff of mundane affairs and worldly pleasures? This is an absolute truth that without Your grace, this ignorant soul can never attain Your divine love. [1]Only that devotee who, obedient to Śrī Gurudeva’s command, resides in Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvana with exclusive devotion truly walks this rare path and becomes a true saint. Śrī Nāgarīdev Jī prays, therefore, immerse me in Your rasa, grant me Your association, and accept even a fallen, hard-hearted soul like me who is in the shelter of Your lotus feet. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bandau Shri Haridas Ke - Shri Kant Kishor, Kant Rasik Ji Ki Vani, Doha (19)
hindi_text: Bandau Shri Haridas Ke, Charan Kamal Chit Lai.Jin Nij Ur Ki Madhuri, Dai Pratyaksh Dikhai.- Shri Kant Kishor, Kant Rasik Ji Ki Vani, Doha (19)With a mind fully surrendered, I bow at the lotus feet of Śrī Swāmī Haridās Jī, who has revealed the nectarean sweetness of His heart, the eternal nitya vihār of the Divine Couple.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Det Deen Ko Daan Nit Sada Vrindavan Vas - Sri Thakur Das Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (2)
hindi_text: Det Deen Kun Daan Nit, Sadaa Vrindavan Vaas.Samata Aur Seetal Mai, Bhaji Lai Shri Haridas.- Shri Thakur Das, Sri Thakur Das Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (2)To humble souls, He effortlessly bestows eternal residence in Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvan. Therefore, one must immerse oneself in the loving devotion of Śrī Swami Haridās by constantly engaging in the nitya-vihāra-rasa of the Divine Couple, Śrī Śyāma Kunjbihārī.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhajo Mann Radhe Maharani - Sri Hita Parmanand Das Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (79)
hindi_text: (Raag Adano)Bhajo Mann Radhe Maharani.Jinke Ras-Jas Gaavat Pramudit, Manmohan Sab Sukhdaani. [1]Karat Singarani Dhani-Dhani Maanat, Chhabi Nirakhat Aananddani.Radhaballabh ‘Hit Parmaanand’, Preeti Paraspar Ham Jaani. [2]- Shri Hita Parmanand Das, Sri Hita Parmanand Das Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (79)O mind! Worship Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī Jū with exclusive devotion. Even Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the great enchanter, becomes intoxicated with bliss while singing Her rasa-filled glories, for She is indeed the very source of all happiness. [1]While decorating Her, Śrī Kṛṣṇa feels Himself most fortunate, and the mere sight of Her divine beauty showers limitless nectar. Śrī Hit Paramānand Dās Jī declares that only by the grace of Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī has he attained the experience of yugala-rasa. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nar Dehi Dvaro Khulyo Hari Pavan Ki Ghat - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (87)
hindi_text: Nar Dehi Dwaro Khulyau, Hari Paavan Ki Ghaat.‘Vyas’ Feri Nahin Lagatu Hai, Taruvar Tutyau Paat.- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Saakhi (87)Human birth is the wide-open gateway for attaining Lord Hari and for forever escaping the cycle of birth and death. Śrī Harirām Vyās Jī warns that once this precious chance slips away, realization of God is no longer possible, just as a leaf fallen from a tree can never be restored.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kidho Roop Sagar Ten Pragate Kamal Jug - Shri Premdas Ji Ki Vani (25)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Kidhau Roop Saagar Ten Pragate Kamal Jug,Kidhau Ratiraajju Ke Man Ke Haran Hain. [1]Kidhau Har Bhooshan Ki Kshan Haran Haare,Kidhau Praan Pyaare Bhaare Vishv Ke Bharan Hain. [2]Kidhau Hain Maraal Kidhau Indumandali Ke Bhoop,Kidhau Chhavi Chhatra Sab Sukh Ke Karan Hain. [3]Kidhau Ban Dharan Hain Ki Van Heen Dharan,‘Prem Sakhi’ Hain Saran Kidhau Pyaari Ke Charan Hain. [4]- Shri Premdas Ji [Brother of Shri Lal Balbir Ji], Shri Premdas Ji Ki Vani (25)At times, they seem like a pair of lotuses that have arisen from the ocean of beauty; at times, it surpasses the beauty of Cupid himself. [1]Sometimes they appear as if able to outshine all ornaments in a single moment, and at other times, as the sustainer of the entire world, dearer than life itself. [2]Sometimes they appear gentle like swans, sometimes like sovereigns of the lunar sphere, and sometimes their beauty seems the shelter and source of all happiness. [3]Sometimes they appear as the holder of Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvan, and at other times, they seem to be the very essence of Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvan. ‘Premasakhī’ says—such are the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī, in whose shelter she always remains. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Premamrrita Rasananda - Shri Hita Krishn Chandra, Shri Radha Upsudha Nidhi (29)
hindi_text: Premamrrita Rasananda Makarandaugha Varshinim.Kada Padaravindeham Vinde Dasyam Taveshvari.- Shri Hita Krishn Chandra, Shri Radha Upsudha Nidhi (29)O Swāminī! O Śrī Rādhe, who pour forth the sweet, blissful nectar of love— when will you grant me the eternal servitude of Your lotus feet?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Tosi Na Nihaari Main - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Nitya Vihar Padavali (58)
hindi_text: (Raag Kaanro)Tosi Na Nihaari Main Tihaari Sonh Mohiri.Karat Itai Pai Praanpreetam Son Maan Man,Konav Sayaann Yah Sikhyo Hai Tohiri. [1]Saday Sudrishti Ras-Varishti Kari Pyaari Ahe,Praanpratipaal Rahe Laal-Mukh Johiri. [2]Rooprasik Vas Rahat Sadaai Bali,Taason Yah Duchitai Uchit Na Honhiri. [3]- Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Nitya Vihar Padavali (58)O Pyārījū (Śrī Rādhā)! I vow that I have never beheld anyone comparable to You in beauty, virtues, or cleverness. Even toward Your own beloved, You display such loving sulk (māna)—please tell, from where did You learn this art? [1]Now, please cast a glance of compassion, shower the rain of your divine love-bliss, and grant life to your beloved, for he stands gazing only toward you with unwavering humble eyes. [2]Śrī Rūp Rasik says—I sacrifice myself to you again and again, for Lāl Jī (Śrī Kṛṣṇa) forever remains under your control; such extended māna toward Him does not suit You. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Man Lagyo Sukh Bhog Mein Taran Chahe Sansar - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (51)
hindi_text: Mana Laagyo Sukh Bhog Mein, Taran Chahai Sansar.‘Narayan’ Kaise Bane, Divas Rain Ko Pyar.- Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (51)Śrī Nārāyaṇ Swāmī says, "When the mind remains absorbed in pleasures and sensual desires, attached to them night and day, how can one ever hope to cross the vast ocean of worldly existence?"
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jay Jay Shri Lalita Lalit Yugal Anandini - Shri Vanshi Ali, Shri Lalita Mangal (5)
hindi_text: Jai Jai Shri Lalita Lalit Jugal Anandini.Jeevan Praan Saman Su Kirati Nandini. [1]Dampati Kari Gati Rati Mati Jug Dhan Swamini.Nij Sampati Nit Vilasati Gun-Abhiramini. [2]Abhiram Gun Barnat Thake Mati Kavi Katha Kaise Lahen.Jake Prasad Prabhav Lakhi, Jiy Lal Hu Muke Rahen. [3]Seva Vivid Vidhi Chaturi, Gun Kah Sakati Nahin Radhika.Dasi Janani Nit Poshini, Priya Sahachari Sukh Sadhika. [4]- Shri Vanshi Ali, Shri Lalita Mangal (5)Glory to Śrī Lalitā Jī, who constantly intensifies the nectar of the divine couple, Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa’s mutual love. Her very life is none other than Śrī Rādhā, the beloved daughter of Śrī Kirti. [1]Her goal, mind, and love are fully dedicated to the divine couple, Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa. Thus, Śrī Lalitā Jī is called the Swāminī of the treasure, the Yugala-rasa. For her, Śrī Yugal alone is her exclusive possession, and she remains ever immersed in the rasa of the divine couple, endowed with limitless virtues. [2]Describing Śrī Lalitā Jī’s greatness and qualities tires even the intellect of the great Rasikas; capturing her true essence in words is impossible. Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself falls silent in awe at witnessing her service, prasāda, and influence. [3]Her expertise in serving the divine couple through various kinds of services is unparalleled, and words cannot do it justice. Even Śrī Rādhā Jū cannot fully describe her glories. Śrī Lalitā Jī alone possesses such a rare qualification that she serves Śrī Rādhā eternally both in the mood of a maidservant and in the affectionate mood of a mother. Śrī Lalitā Jī is the favorite Sahchari of Śrī Rādhā, bringing immense happiness to Her. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jugal Lagan Mein Man Magan Raakhu Aathon Yaam - Shri Saras Madhuri
hindi_text: Jugal Lagan Mein Man Magan Raakhu Aathon Yaam. ‘Saras Madhuri’ Surati Son, Sumirahu Shyama Shyam.- Shri Saras MadhuriKeep your mind absorbed in loving devotion of the Divine Couple, Śrī Śyāmā Śyām, throughout all eight quarters of the day. Śrī Sarasamādhurī says — with rasa-filled remembrance, meditate upon them continuously.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Vrindavan Vaas Ki Aasa Yahi Manmaani - Shri Lalit Madhuri
hindi_text: Shri Vrindavan Vaas Ki Aasa Yahi Manmaani. Lalit Madhuri Laal Daras Taji Aan Na Chit Aani. [1]Shri Radha Govind Kripa Aval Dridh Jiya Mein Thaani.Yugal Bihaari Lakhaun Drigan Chhavi Roop Suraskhani. [2]- Shri Lalit MadhuriI now have only one firm longing—to reside in Śrī Vṛndāvan alone. The heart of ‘Lalitamādhurī’ no longer finds even the slightest delight anywhere else, having once tasted the darśan of Śrī Lālajī. [1]Through the boundless compassion of Śrī Rādhā-Govinda, an unshakable faith in Their grace has arisen in the heart. With these very eyes, I may forever behold the enchanting form of Yugala-bihārī. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dou Rajat Syama Syam - Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar (1696)
hindi_text: (Rag Devgandhar)Dou Rajat Syama Syam.Braj-Juvati-Mandali Birajati, Dekhatin Surgan-Baam. [1]Dhanya Dhanya Vrindavan Kau Sukh, Surpur Kaunain Kaam.Dhani Brishbhanu-Suta, Dhani Mohan, Dhani Gopani Kau Naam. [2]Inki Ko Dasi Sari Hwai Hai, Dhanya Sarad Ki Jaam.Kaisenhun ‘Sur’ Janam Braj Pavain, Yah Sukh Nahin Tihun Dhaam. [3]- Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar (1696)Śrī Rādhikā and Śyāmasundar are both magnificently adorned, and along with them, the entire group of the women of Vraja shines in beauty. From the sky, celestial maidens too gaze eagerly, longing for their darśan. [1]They say to one another—“This Vṛndāvan is supremely blessed, for here bliss spreads in every direction. Compared to it, even the beauty of heaven appears insignificant. Blessed is Vṛṣabhānu-nandinī Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī, blessed is Nanda-nandan Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and blessed indeed are all these gopīs.” [2]Who could ever attain a fortune equal to that of these maidservants of the divine couple, Śrī Rādhā Mādhava? Blessed is this full moon night of Śarada. How might we take birth in this Vraja to experience such bliss? In the words of Śrī Sūrdās, such nectar does not exist anywhere in the three worlds. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Seva Ang Singaar Mein, Param Chatur Ghanshyam - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Seva Ang Singaar Mein, Param Chatur Ghanshyaam.Gori Ki Beni Guhat, Purven Man Ke Kaam.- Braj Ke DoheRasik Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the supreme knower of divine love, is highly skilled in the intimate services of adornment. While braiding the locks of fair Śrī Rādhā, He pleases Her greatly and also fulfills the deepest desire of His own heart.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Paavan Vrinda Vipin Ki, Mahima Kahi Na Jaay - Shri Santsharan Ji
hindi_text: (Kundaliyan)Paavan Vrinda Vipin Ki, Mahima Kahi Na Jaay.Jaaki Raj Paavan Parasi, Paapi Jan Tari Jaay. [1]Paapi Jan Tari Jaay, Naikahu Kasht Na Paave.Radheshyaam Sunaam Rati, Dhaam Shrohaar Ko Paavai. [2]‘Sant’ Sakal Sansaar Mein, Vrindavan Man Bhaavan.Saadhu Sang Satsang So, Bane Apaavan Paavan. [3]- Shri Santsharan JiThe unfathomable glory of the supremely sacred Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvan is impossible to describe. By merely touching its holy dust, even the greatest sinner is effortlessly lifted across the ocean of material existence. [1]Such a sinner attains deliverance without any special effort or hardship. While continually chanting the sacred names of Rādhā–Śyām, he ultimately reaches the eternal abode of Śrī Hari. [2]Śrī Saṃtaśaraṇa says—in the entire world, for the community of saints, Vṛndāvan alone is the most beloved abode, because by the influence of sādhu-saṅga and satsanga there, even the most fallen of souls is effortlessly purified.  [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dvai Lar Motin Ki Ek Punja  - Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (20)
hindi_text: (Raag Kanharau)Dvai Lar Motin Ki Ek Punja Poti Kau SaadaNetrani Drishti Laagai Jini Meri.Haathani Chaari Chaari Churi Paaeni Ikasaar ChuraChaupahalu Ikatak Rahe Hari Heri.Ek Maragaji Saari Tan Tein Kanchuki NyariAru Anchara Ki Baaeen Gati Mori Urasani Pheri.Shriharidas Ke Swami Syama KunjbihariYa Ras Hi Bas Bhaye Harain Harain Sarakani Neri.- Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (20)Śrī Kuñjabihāriṇī Jū (Śrī Rādhā) wears around her neck a simple necklace of two strands of pearls. O sakhī! My gaze cannot move away from her, even for a moment. [1]On each of her hands shine four bangles, and on her feet gleams a single four-sided anklet. Śrī Hari beholds her steadily, without even blinking his eyes. [2]She wears a single, maragajī (rumpled) sārī, the bodice showing distinctly, as she has twisted and drawn the left edge of the sārī over her breasts. [3]Svāminī Śyāmā Jū, the worshipful deity of Svāmī Śrī Haridās, has completely enslaved Kuñjabihārī (Śrī Kṛṣṇa) through Her love. Enchanted by Her charm, Kuñjabihārī slowly and irresistibly moves closer toward her. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mansa Baacha Karmana - Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (121)
hindi_text: Manasa Baacha Karmana, Sarva Aatama Jaani.Shri Biharinidasi Basikaran, Fabi Priya Sukh Daani.- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (121)Through mind, words, deeds, and with one’s entire sense of self, one should offer oneself solely unto Śrī Nitya-Vihāriṇī Jū (Śrī Rādhā). Empowered by this very rasa, attaining the state of a maidservant of Śrī Vihāriṇī Jū and entering Her captivating sway, that Śrī Vihāriṇī-Dāsī manifests in Śrī Nikuñja-Mahāl as a source of happiness to Śrī Priyā Herself.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bainu Mai Baaje Bansivat - Shri Hita Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Hit Chaurasi (64)
hindi_text: (Raag Gauri)Bainu Maai Baajai Bansivat.Sada Basant Rahat Vrindavan Pulin Pavitra Subhag Yamuna Tat. [1]Jatit Kreet Makarakrit Kundal Mukhaarvind Bhanvar Maanau Lat.Dasanan Kund Kali Chhabi Lajjit Sajjit Kanak Samaan Peet Pat. [2]Muni Man Dhyaan Dharat Nahin Paavat Karat Vinod Sang Baalak Bhat.Daas Ananya Bhajan Ras Kaaran Hit Harivansh Prakat Leela Nat. [3]- Shri Hita Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Hit Chaurasi (64)O Sakhī!  Śrī Kṛṣṇa plays the sweet melody of the flute at Vaṁśīvaṭa. Along the supremely sacred and beautiful banks of the Yamunā in Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvana, spring ever prevails. [1]Śrī Kṛṣṇa is adorned with a jewel-studded crown and crocodile-shaped earrings. His face is like a blooming lotus, with locks of hair swaying like bumblebees. The beauty of His teeth puts even jasmine buds to shame, and His yellow garments shine like radiant gold. [2]He who even great sages cannot attain through meditation, is delightfully sporting with His friends here. Śrī Hit Harivaṁśa Mahāprabhu says that this supremely graceful acrobat has manifested these pastimes solely to bestow the perfection of devotional rasa upon His exclusive servants. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Yadi Kuntal Kaale Sanvaare Hi The - Braj Ke Sawaiya
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Yadi Kuntal Kaale Sanvaare Hi The, To Kapolon Pai Yon Latkaana Na Tha.Jab Kajjal Rekh Lagaayi Thi To, Tirchhe Drig Baan Chalaana Na Tha. [1]Pahna Pat Peet Manohar To, Har Baar Use Fahraana Na Tha.Yah Sundar Vesh Banaaya Tha To, Is Bhaanti Hamen Tadpaana Na Tha. [2]- Braj Ke SawaiyaO Śrī Kṛṣṇa, if Your hair was already perfectly adorned, then why allow those curls to dance upon Your cheeks and enchant us so deeply? When You lined Your eyes with kohl, why did You send forth the arrows of those sidelong glances that wound our hearts with love? [1]If You wore the captivating yellow garment, then why keep fluttering it again and again, stealing every trace of our awareness? Having adorned Yourself in such beauty, why leave us to burn in the agony of separation? [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nam Radhika Ke Sunat Hit Saun Mohanlal - Shri Hita Parmanand Das
hindi_text: Naam Radhika Ke Sunat, Hita Saun Mohanlaal.Subas Hoi Sukh Det Hain, 'Parmanand' Kripal.- Shri Hita Parmanand DasŚrī Kṛṣṇa listens to the name of Śrī Rādhikā with the utmost love. Enchanted by the power of the name “Rādhā,” Śrī Kṛṣṇa, who is the very embodiment of supreme bliss, becomes merciful toward the soul and bestows divine happiness upon it.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dhan Dhan Vrindavipin Papiha Pyare - Shri Abhay Ram, Vrindavan Rahasya Vinod (69)
hindi_text: Dhan Dhan Vrindavipin Papiha Pyare.Aur Neer Kau Peevat Naahin, Swati Boond Ke Paare. [1]Baarah Maas Pyaas Ko Paamein, Jinke Hari Rakhvaare.Abhayraam Ye Ha Badbhaagi, Raj Mein Rahein Vichaare. [2]- Shri Abhay Ram, Vrindavan Rahasya Vinod (69)Truly blessed are the papīhās (hawk cuckoo) of Vṛndāvan. They drink no other water and wait exclusively for the raindrops from the Svātī star. [1]Śrī Hari Himself satisfies their yearlong longing. Śrī Abhayarām says—most auspicious is the fate of that papīhā who lives in Vṛndāvan’s sacred dust. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aiso Barsanao Nirkhi Gahbar Aayo Prem - Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Tirthanand (28)
hindi_text: Aiso Barsaanao Nirkhi, Gahbar Aayo Prem.Karat Dandavat Lutata Raj, Chhuti Gaye Raajas Nem.- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Tirthanand (28)Beholding such divine sights of Barsānā and gazing upon the sacred Gahvar Van, waves of love surged within the heart. The moment I offered a heartfelt daṇḍavat praṇām to this holy land and rolled in its divine dust, all royal decorum and formal restraint naturally fell away.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Radhekrishn Radhekrishn Radhekrishn Bol Re - Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (47)
hindi_text: (Raag Prabhati)Radhekrishn Radhekrishn Radhekrishn Bol Re.Jagat Baad Son Maun Ley Mukh, Hari Characha Mein Kholre. [1]Svans Svans Hari Naam Sumir Le, Manush Janam Anamol Re.Bhakti Vidya Padho Manush Tan, Nahin Rahoge Tol Re. [2]Guru Sharan Mein Mauj Karo Nit, Aan Thaur Mat Dol Re."Roopmadhuri” Naam Sharkara, Prem Dugdh Pee Ghol Re. [3]- Shri Roop Madhuri, Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (47)Chant the name of Rādhe–Kṛṣṇa constantly. Keep silent towards worldly talks, and open your mouth only to sing glories of Hari. [1]With every breath, remember the Name of Hari, for this human birth is exceedingly precious. Study the wisdom of devotion in this human body, and your life will not go in vain. [2]Live joyfully in the shelter of the Guru and do not wander elsewhere. Rūpamādhurī says—dissolve the sugar of the Holy Name in the milk of love, and drink it fully. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ram Inhai Sab Kahat Hain Taako Arth Rasaal - Sri Ramsakhiji, Shri Bhaktiras Manjari
hindi_text: Ram Inhai Sab Kahat Hain, Taako Arth Rasaal. Ra Akshar Shriradhika, Ma Manmohan Laal.- Sri Ramsakhiji, Shri Bhaktiras ManjariThe name spoken by all as “Rāma” overflows with the supreme essence of divine rasa in the vision of rasika devotees. Within “Rā” resides Śrī Rādhikā, and within “Ma” dwells Manamohana Lāla, Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pyare Teri Vanshi Radha-Radha Bole - Shri Priyadas
hindi_text: Pyare Teri Vanshi Radha-Radha Bole.Radha Roop Dikhaai Aapano, Binahu Mol Liyau Mole. [1]Vanshi-Vanshi Kari Dampati Ke, Prem-Manjoosha Khole.‘Priyasakhi’ Radha Suni Mohan, Gohan Laagyo Dole. [2]- Shri Priyadas JiO beloved! Your flute continually sings the sweet name of “Rādhā, Rādhā.” Through its melody, it reveals the very form of Śrī Rādhā and, without demanding any price, steals the hearts of all. [1]Through the notes of the flute, the priceless treasure of the divine couple’s love is revealed. Śrī Priyāsakhī says—the moment the name of Śrī Rādhā reaches the ears of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, His heart begins to sway in a flood of divine love. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Niraye Sthiti Revastu Na Syat - Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (101)
hindi_text: Niraye Sthiti Revastu Na Syat Parapade Gatih.Yatra Tatra Janirvarstu Masturadha Padachyutih.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (101)Even if I am cast into hell, even if I never reach the supreme abode; even if I wander through countless births in any realm whatsoever—may I never, even for a moment, turn away from exclusive devotion to the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā, nor from the loving service of those divine feet.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kaindho Raskhan Ras Kos - Shri Raskhan, Raskhan Ratnavali
hindi_text: (Kavitta)Kaindho Rasakhana Rasa Kosa Drriga Pyasa Jani,Ani Ke Piyusha Pusha Kino Bidhi Chamda Ghara. [1] Kaindho Mani Manika Baitharibai Ko Kamchana Maim,Jariya Jobana Jina Gadaiya Sughara Ghara. [2]Kaindho Kama Kamana Ke Rajata Adhara Chinha,Kaindho Yaha Bhaura Gyan Bohita Gumana Hara. [3]Eri Meri Pyari Duti Koti Rati Rambha Ki,Vari Daron Tehi Chita Chorani Chibuka Para. [4]- Shri Raskhan, Raskhan RatnawaliDescribing the beauty of Śrī Rādhā, Raskhān says—Brahmā, knowing the world to be thirsty, filled Your eyes with an inexhaustible treasure of bliss so that the world might be fully satisfied. Your face appears as if the moon of the essence of nectar has assumed a personal form. [1]The graceful formation of Your limbs is as though a master jeweler, perfected in his art, has fashioned an incomparable abode of youth, setting gems and pearls into gold, each limb complete and flawless in its own splendor. [2]The crimson hue of Your lips is so enchanting that it seems the entire kingdom of Kāma resides within them, and this beauty, like a bumblebee, shatters the pride of the boat of knowledge, causing it to sink. [3]O my lovely Rādhā! Upon the beauty of Your charming chin, I would gladly sacrifice millions of Ratis and Rambhās, for such unparalleled beauty is found nowhere else. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Thakurai Pyari Lai Sevkaai Pi Vant - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Phutkar Pad (69)
hindi_text: Thakuraai Pyaari Lai, Sivkaai Pi Vaant.Preeti Reeti Yak Saar Sakhi, Dai Manon Yak Saant.- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Phutkar Pad (69)In divine rasa of Vrindavan, Rādhā assumed lordship, Kṛṣṇa took servitude. Both surrendered their hearts and their entire being to one another, so completely that their minds became one. O friend, is the supreme secret of the prem-rīti (mode of love).
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Man Pachhitaihai Avsar Bite - Shri Tulsidas
hindi_text: Man Pachhitaihai Avasar Beete.Durlabh Deh Pai Haripad Bhaju, Karam, Bachan Aru Heete. [1]Sahasbaahu, Dasbadan Aadi Nrip, Bache Na Kaal Baleete.Ham Ham Kari Dhan Dhaam Sanvaare, Ant Chale Uthi Reete. [2]Sut Banitaadi Jaani Svaarath Rat, Na Karu Neh Sabheete.Antahu Tohin Tajenge Paamar! Too Na Tajai Abheete. [3]Ab Naathahin Anuraagu Jaagu Jad, Tyaagu Duraasa Jeete.Bujhai Na Kaam Agini Tulasi Kahen, Vishaybhog Bahu Ghee Te. [4]- Shri Tulsidas O mind! If this golden opportunity slips away, in the end you will do nothing except regret. You have attained this rare human birth, therefore, worship the lotus feet of Śrī Hari with exclusive devotion through action, speech, and heart. [1]Even mighty kings like Sahasrabāhu and Rāvaṇa could not save themselves from the fierce force of God of death. Lost in the pride of “I” and “mine,” they adorned wealth, splendor, and palaces—yet in the end they abandoned everything and departed empty-handed. [2]Do not become entangled in the web of selfish attachment by considering son, wife, and relatives alone as your own. O foolish mind! In the end they will all forsake you—so why not renounce their delusion now itself? [3]O incautious mind! Now awaken love for the supremely compassionate Lord and abandon vain hopes. Śrī Tulasīdāsa says—sense enjoyments do not extinguish the fire of desire; rather, they pour ghee into it and make it blaze all the more fiercely. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sab Ras Kau Ras Prem Hai Vishayi Khele Saar - Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar
hindi_text: Sab Ras Kau Ras Prem Hai, Vishayi Khele Saar.Tan-Man-Dhan-Jauban Khase, Tau Na Mane Haar.- Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar (325.11)Among all nectars in this world, the supreme and highest is prema-rasa, the rasa of divine love. The gambler stakes everything—body, mind, wealth, youth—losing all in the play, yet he never accepts defeat. In the same way, one who enters the play of love surrenders everything into it, unwilling to turn back, for love itself becomes his sole victory.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jab Prem Ke Panth Mein Pair Diya - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Jab Prem Ke Panth Mein Pair Diya, Tab Kya Uske Dukh Se Darna Hai.Jal Bhojan Ki Mat Chaah Karo, Talvaar Tale Shir Ko Dharna Hai. [1]Bas Yaad Mein Rote Huye Unki, Nij Praan Visarjan Bhi Karna Hai.Vah Aasha Niraasha Liye Apni, Kabhi Jeena Hai Mitra. Kabhi Marna Hai. [2]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’Once one steps onto the path of love, why  fear the sorrows encountered along it? On this path, even the desire for water and food is to be abandoned, and one must walk forward without hesitation, placing one’s head willingly beneath the sword. [1]Shedding tears incessantly in remembrance of the Beloved, one must be ready to offer one’s very life in complete self-surrender. Bearing both hope and despair within your heart, O friend—sometimes you must live, and sometimes you must be prepared to die. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kab Lotun Ati Vikal Hvai Vraj-Raj mahan Harshay - Shri Prabhudutt Brahmachari, Sri Vrindavan Mahatmya (3)
hindi_text: Kab Lotun Ati Vikal Hvai, Vraj-Rajmahan Harshaay.Karu Keech Kab Dhuriki, Nayanan Neer Bahay.- Shri Prabhudutt Brahmachari, Sri Vrindavan Mahatmya (3)When will I, utterly restless in longing, joyfully roll in the dust of Vraja? When will I moisten that sacred dust with my own tears, turning it into a mire of love as streams of loving tears flow from my eyes?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Vrindavan Teri Jai Hove - Shri Radhacharan Das, Vrindavan Virudavali (35)
hindi_text: Shri Vrindavan Teri Jai Hove.He Karuna Dhan Rasikan Jeevan Rasamay Kanan Jai Hove. [1]He Abhayankar Param Shubhankar Yugal Priyankar Jai Hove.Hridaya Dharohar Param Manohar Mahamodkar Jai Hove. [2]Param Prabhakar Prem Sudhakar Ras Ratnakar Jai Hove.Radha Charan Das Hriday Dhan Jai Hove Teri Jai Hove. [3]- Shri Radhacharan Das, Vrindavan Virudavali (35)O Śrī Vṛndāvan Dhām, all glories to you. You are an unfathomable ocean of compassion, the very life-breath of rasik devotees, and a divine forest overflowing with rasa-filled līlās—all glory to you. [1]You are the benefactor of fearlessness, supremely auspicious, and the eternal abode of the divine couple, Śrī Rādhā Kṛṣṇa. You are the priceless treasure of devotees’ hearts, exceedingly enchanting and the bestower of incomparable bliss. [2]You are the supreme embodiment of divine light, endlessly showering the nectar of love, and an inexhaustible mine of rasa. You are the entire wealth of the heart of Śrī Rādhācaraṇ Dās—O Śrī Vṛndāvan, endless glories to You! [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hamare Yahan Ke Sadhu Prasad Na Chahe -  Shri Lalit Mohini Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (13)
hindi_text: Hamare Yahan Ke Sadhu Prasada Na Chahen. Na Vastra Ko Adanga Lagaven. [1]Magana Bhaye Guna Gaven. Priyacharana China-China Saharavain. [2]Basi Vrindavan Anata Na Javein. Lalitamohini Tinhe Ladaavein. [3]-  Shri Lalit Mohini Dev, Shri Lalit Mohini Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (13)The saints of our lineage, followers of Śrī Svāmī Haridās Jī, do not prefer to accept prasād from any deity except Śrī Priya-Priyatam, nor do they pay heed to special clothing or other outward formalities. [1]Absorbed in divine bliss, they ceaselessly sing the glories of the divine couple and worship the lotus feet of Śrī Priyājī (Śrī Rādhā), every moment. [2]They dwell exclusively in Śrī Vṛndāvana and do not go elsewhere. Such rare and fortunate rasik devotees are forever dear to me, says Śrī Lalitmohinī. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nitt Sarad Nitt Teej Hai - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (1185)
hindi_text: Nitt Sarad Nitt Teej Hai, Nitt Hori Su Basant.Nitt Keli Chhin Chhin Nai, Jaake Sukhahi Na Ant.- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (1185)Where the autumn season is ever-present, where the festival of Tīj is celebrated eternally, and where the joy of spring and Holī is forever experienced; where at every moment the Divine Couple performs ever-new plays of love, whose bliss knows no end—that alone is the eternal abode of Śrī Vṛndāvan.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Khelat Hain Vasant Vihari Viharin - Goswami Shri Hitalal Ji
hindi_text: Khelat Hain Vasant Vihari Viharin.Abeer Gulaal Ghumad Ras Ambud, Jhar Laayau Manu Rang Pichkarin. [1]Madhur Garaj Baajenu Dhuni Manu Pik, Mor Kuhuk Ho-Ho Kilkarin.Jai Shri Hitlal Prem Ur Bheejan, Hansat Hansavat Dai Kartarin. [2]- Goswami Shri Hitalal JiThe Divine Couple, Śrī Vihārī–Vihārin, are celebrating the festival of spring today. Clouds of abīra and gulāla surge like showers of color, as if syringes of hues are raining down the very colors of love. [1]Sweet music resounds—the cuckoo’s song, the peacock’s call, and bursts of laughter with sounds “Ho Ho Hori Hai” fill the atmosphere. Śrī Hitlāl says—they soak hearts in love, laughing and making others laugh as they perform this divine play. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Koti-Koti Rasana Jo Rom - Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Shringar Sabha Mandal (126)
hindi_text: Roop Priya Ko Kahan Ko, Kitaki Budhi Hai Mor.Tei Kunwar Charanani Luthat, Nirakhi Nain Ki Kor.- Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Shringar Sabha Mandal (39)How could my limited intellect ever have the power to describe the divine beauty of Śrī Priyājī (Śrī Rādhā)? With just a single glance from the corner of Her eyes, even the Supreme Lord, Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself, becomes enchanted and, overwhelmed in divine ecstasy, rolls at Her lotus feet.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Chalo Lal Khelen Basant Mili - Shri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Vasant Leela (15)
hindi_text: (Raga Vasant Dheematal)Chalo Lal Khelen Vasant Mili Shri Yamuna Ke Kula.Nav Nikunj Van Nai Ritu Aai Naye Naye Phoole Phula. [1]Drum Daarin Baithe Nav Pakshi Bolat Ati Anukula.‘Narayan’ Ut Nai Bahar Sukh, Itmen Tum Sukh Mula. [2]- Sri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Vasant Leela (15)Kiśorī Jī (Śrī Rādhā) says to Lāl Jī (Śrī Kṛṣṇa): O Beloved! Come, let us go and play vasanta (spring) season plays together on the banks of Śrī Yamunā. In the forest bowers, the new season has arrived, and fresh flowers have blossomed everywhere. [1]On the branches of the trees, new birds sit and sing in sweet and pleasing tones. Śrī Nārāyaṇ Swāmī says—there, the joy of the new spring thrives, but here, You are the very source of all joy. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shyam Sada Vash Priti Ke Tin Bhuvan Vikhyat - Shri Brajavasidas, Braj Vilas
hindi_text: Shyaam Sada Vash Preeti Ke, Teen Bhuvan Vikhyaat.Vina Preeti Nahin Paiye, Nandmahar Ko Taat.- Shri Brajavasidas, Braj VilasŚyāmasundar is always under the control of love—this truth is well known throughout the three worlds. Without pure love, Nanda Mahārāja’s son, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, can never be attained.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Lalit Phagu Rachna Rachi - Shri Ghananand Ji, Ghananand Granthawali, Saras Vasant (66)
hindi_text: Lalit Phagu Rachna Rachi, Bilasat Saras Basant.Jai Jai Radha Madhavi, Jai Banmali Kant.- Shri Ghananand Ji, Ghananand Granthawali, Saras Vasant (66)A supremely enchanting celebration of Phāg (the playful Holī) has been beautifully arranged, and the sweet spring season shines forth in full delight. All glories to Śrī Rādhā Jū, the beloved of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and all glories to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the garland-wearing Lord of the forest.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Darsan Dai Nikasi Ata Mein Te - Sri Purushottam Ji
hindi_text: Darsan Dai Nikasi Ata Mein Te.Lat Sarakay Dars Dai Pyari, Nikasyo Chand Ghata Mein Te. [1]Koti Rama Savitri Bhavani, Nikasi Charan Chhata Mein Te. Purushottam Prabhu Yah Ras Chakhyo, Makhan Kadhyo Matha Mein Te. [2]- Sri Purushottam JiŚrī Puruṣottam Ji, while describing the beautiful form of Śrī Rādhā and humbly yearning for Her darśan, says —When Śrī Rādhikā steps out upon the high terrace and bestows Her darśan, gently moving aside Her dark locks to unveil Her face, it seems like the full moon rising from behind a veil of clouds. [1]From the radiance of Her lotus feet, it seems as though countless Lakṣmīs, Sāvitrīs, and Bhavānīs manifest on the spot. Puruṣottam Ji says that the taste of this divine rasa is like freshly churned butter drawn out from buttermilk. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ratan Jatan Anso Karo Satan Karo Banvas - Shri Kishori Ali (Letter to Ratan Ali)
hindi_text: Ratan Jatan Anso Karo, Satan Karon Banvaas.Latan-Latan Tari Nain Bhari, Nirakho Bibidh Bilas.- Shri Kishori Ali (Letter to Ratan Ali)Give up worldly pleasures and make such an effort that you may attain residence in Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvan, the capital city of rasik devotees, in the association of rasikas. Then, there among the vines and leaves, behold the divine plays of love of the divine couple, Śrī Śyāmā–Śyām.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhare Drig Vari Uchchar Van Prem San - Sri Albeli Ali, Vrindavansata (24)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Bharai Drig Vari Uchchar Van Prem Saun,Poorn Soi Preeti Kab Hoi Man Ki. [1]Shaan Aur Paan Sukh Sain Jo Na Mile,Daiv-Gati Hoi Jo Hasi Tan Ki. [2]Vivas Hvai Jai Ang-Ang Sat Took Jo,Tajat Nahin Soor Jyon Bhoomi Ran Ki. [3]Hohi Tan Chheen Dushleen Jo Koti Vidhi,Albeli Jin Jaav Raj Chhaandi Ban Ki. [4]- Sri Albeli Ali, Vrindavansata (24)O Śrī Rādhā Rāṇī! While dwelling in Śrī Vṛndāvan, when will that blessed moment come when streams of tears will flow from my eyes in Your love, and I shall chant Your holy name lovingly? When will such pure and selfless love awaken within my heart? [1]Let honor be lost, let food and rest not come—there is no sorrow in that, even if destiny makes this body suffer. [2]Even if this body were torn apart piece by piece, still I would not leave Vṛndāvan, just as a brave warrior never leaves the battlefield. [3]Even if the body becomes deficient and countless troubles come together, Alabelī Ali still never wishes to abandon the dust of holy Vṛndāvan. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhalein Karo Jap Yog Tap - Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Madhurya Ras Dohavali (106)
hindi_text: Bhalein Karo Jap Yog Tap, Daan Dharm Vrat Nem.‘Lalit Ladaiti’ Prem Bin, Swapane Kushal Na Kshem.- Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Madhurya Ras Dohavali (106)Even if a person remains constantly engaged in japa, yoga, austerities, charity, religious duties, vows, and disciplines, if the mind is devoid of God’s love, then true welfare, inner peace, and contentment cannot be attained — not even in a dream.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aaj Sakhi Doun Kunj Bihari - Shri Dayabai
hindi_text: Aaj Sakhi Doun Kunj Bihari.Auchak Aay Mile Kunjan Mein, Laal Laadili Pyaari. [1]Gaur Shyam Shobha Ke Sagar, Ang-Ang Ki Chhavi Nyaari.Nirakhat Roop Seetal Bhaye Naina, Ur Anand Apaari. [2]Safal Manorath Bhaye Sab Man Ke, Virah Bitha Sab Taari.‘Daya’ Kunwari Daasi Nij Kini, Charan Kamal Par Vaari. [3]- Shri DayabaiSeeing her intense longing for God realization, Śrī Dayābāī Jī was instructed by her Gurudeva, Śrī Caraṇdās Jī, to reside in Vṛndāvan. The vision of Śyāmā–Śyām that she received there is described as follows—O friend! Today, the two Kuñja-Bihārīs (Śrī Lāḍilī-Lāl) suddenly met me within the secluded forest bower. [1]Fair and dark in complexion, Śyāmā-Kuñja-Bihārī are oceans of beauty. The splendor of each of their limbs is utterly unique. Beholding their form, the eyes became cooled, and the heart filled with boundless bliss. [2]All the desires of my heart were fulfilled, and every pain of separation vanished. Śrī Dayābāī says, “Sri Rādhā made me Her own maidservant; I offer myself completely at Their lotus feet.” [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Vrindavan Ke Vriksh Ko Maram Na Jaane Koy - Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (73)
hindi_text: Shri Vrindavan Ke Vriksh Ko, Maram Na Jaane Koy.Ek Paat Ko Sumar Ke, Aap Chaturbhuj Hoy.- Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (73)No one can truly comprehend the mystery of the trees of Śrī Vṛndāvan. Simply remembering even a single leaf of these trees grants one divine strength like that of the Lord’s four-armed form, for Śrī Kṛṣṇa personally resides in every tree and every leaf here.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Hori Aai Ri Rang Rangeeli - Shri Kishoridas (of Gaudiya sect.)
hindi_text: Hori Aai Ri Rang Rangeeli Chhabeeli Man Bhaai.Nav Pallav Kusumit Vrindaban Madhup Gunj Sukhdaai. [1]Vaajan Lage Dhaf Aur Murali, Bolan Kokil Lagat Suhaai.Shri Brajchandra Kishori Manvanchhit Vraj Par Phag Ghumaai. [2]- Shri Kishoridas (Of Gaudiya Sect.)The colorful festival of Holī, which delights everyone’s heart, has arrived. The humming of bumblebees, amidst fresh leaves and blossoms in Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvan, appears utterly mesmerizing. [1]The ḍhaph drum and flute have begun to sound, and the cuckoo’s song feels pleasant. Śrī Brajachandra (Kṛṣṇa) and Kishorī (Rādhā), following their own sweet will, joyfully play Holī and immerse all of Braj in their divine colors. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Braj Vrindavan Aghat Rasa Radha Krishna Sarupa - Braj Ke Dohe
hindi_text: Braj-Vrindavan Aghat Ras, Radha Krishna Saroop.Naam Let Paatak Katai, Jyon Harinaam Anoop.- Braj Ke DoheBraj Vṛndāvan is filled with unparalleled divine rasa, which is the very embodiment of Śrī Rādhā–Kṛṣṇa Themselves. Merely uttering the names of their sacred pastime places destroys sins. Their glory is incomparable, equal to the supreme glory of Śrī Harinām.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nek Aage Aa Shyam Tope Rang Daaron - Shri Chandrasakhi Ji
hindi_text: Nek Aage Aa Shyam Tope Rang Daaron.Abeer Gulaal Malo Mukh Tere, Gaalan Par Gulcha Maaron. [1]Choba Chandan Aur Aragaja, Kanak Katoran Bhari Dhaaron.‘Chandrasakhi’ Bhaj Balakrishna Chhavi, Tan Man Dhan Tope Vaaron. [2]- Shri Chandrasakhi JiO Śyāmasundara, come a little closer so I may sprinkle colors upon You. I will anoint your face with abīra (scented powders) and red gulāla, and give your cheeks a playful, loving tap. [1]I will pour fragrant sandalwood powder and aragajā (aromatic paste) over you again and again from golden bowls. Śrī Candrasakhī says that by the grace of her Gurudev Śrī Hita Bālakṛṣṇa Ji, she offers her body, mind, and wealth entirely unto You. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Karo Kripa Sri Radhika - Shri Hanuman Prasad Poddar (Bhaiji), Pad Ratnakar, Vandana Evam Prarthna (15.1)
hindi_text: Karo Kripa Sri Radhika, Binavon Barambar.Bani Rahe Smriti Madhur-Suchi, Mangalmay Sukhsar. - Shri Hanuman Prasad Poddar (Bhaiji), Pad Ratnakar, Vandana Evam Prarthna (15.1)O most merciful Śrī Rādhikā, I earnestly beg for Your grace. Repeatedly, I bow with this gentle prayer, that Your supremely pure and charming form may always reside within my mind, for it is all-auspicious and the very source of divine bliss.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrishabhanu Kunvari Khelati Basant - Shri Krishndas, Shri Krishndas Adhikari Ji Ki Vani (961)
hindi_text: (Raag Basant)Vrishabhanu Kunvari Khelati Basant, Phooli Sakhi Jahan Naval Kant.Taal Mridang Bajai Aru Nisan, Khelan Nikasin Sukhnidhan. [1]Choba Kunkum Machi Hai Keech, Mrigamad Sakhi Javadi Beech.Saghan Kunj Mein Sukh-Tarang, Krishnadas Aali Radhe Ravan-Sang. [2]- Shri Krishndas, Shri Krishndas Adhikari Ji Ki Vani (961)Śrī Vṛṣabhānu’s charming daughter, Śrī Rādhā, is engaged in the plays of the spring season, where Her ever-new beloved Śyāmasundara is also present. The sakhīs have blossomed with joy. The sounds of drums, cymbals, and kettledrums resonate through the air, while Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī, the very mine of bliss, has stepped out from her palace to engage in the festivities. [1]Colored powders and fragrant paste of saffron powder and vermilion powder have transformed sand into crimson mud, while the sakhīs revel amidst the fragrance of musk and fine perfumes. In the dense bowers, waves of nectar arise. Śrī Kṛṣṇadāsa says that, together with her lovely companions, Śrī Rādhā is relishing the spring līlā in the company of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Taadatterpitvastuni Radhasanketmantara - Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radha Saptashati (1.45)
hindi_text: Taadatterpitvastuni Radhasanketmantara.Kevalasya Cha Krishnasya Doshayaradhanam Matam.- Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radha Saptashati (1.45)Śrī Kṛṣṇa does not accept offerings without Śrī Rādhā’s approval. Worshipping Śrī Kṛṣṇa alone, without Śrī Rādhā, is considered incomplete and spiritually faulty.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrajleela Ras Bhave Ab To - Shri Yugal Priya
hindi_text: (Raag Peelu - Taal Kaharva)Vrajleela Ras Bhaavai Ab To,Shrigiriraaj Ank Mein Rahiye. [1]Kariye Binay Nihori Bhaanti Bahu, Syamroop Mridu Madhuri Lahiye. [2] Chaliye Sang Rasik Bhaktanke,Prem Prabaah Magan Hvai Bahiye. [3] Gaay Gubind Naam Gun Keertan,Janam Janamke Tahn Dukh Dahiye. [4]Kariye Kaalindi Jal Majjan,Nit Madhukari Lai Nirabahiye. [5] Jugalpriya Preetam Bhuj Bharikai,Paiy Jo Kachhu Chahiye. [6]- Shri Yugal PriyaNow nothing feels pleasing to me apart from the divine līlās of Braj. Supreme perfection of life lies in residing in the sacred foothills of Girirāj Ji alone. [1]With humble prayers offered at the lotus feet of Śrī Girirāj Jī, one is blessed with the darshan of Śrī Śyāmsundara’s supremely sweet form. [2]Always remain in the association of rasik devotees, for from their presence flows the river of divine love, naturally carrying the soul into blissful absorption. [3]By chanting Govinda’s holy names and glories, the grief accumulated over innumerable lifetimes is reduced to ashes. [4]Daily bathe in the sacred waters of Śrī Yamunā Jī and, sustaining life through madhukarī, dwell in holy detachment. [5]Śrī Yugala-priyā Jī says, “Hold your beloved Śrī Kṛṣṇa close in your arms and fulfill the deepest desires of your heart.” [6]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Piya Pyari Nij Keli Main - Shri Roop Sakhi, Shringar Rasa Ke Dohe (15)
hindi_text: Piya Pyari Nij Keli Main, Tan Man Mili Abhiram.Ang Ang Sobha Saras, Kunj Mahal Nij Dham.- Shri Roop Sakhi, Shringar Rasa Ke Dohe (15)Absorbed in Their intimate kelī, the divine couple, Priyā–Priyatam, appear irresistibly enchanting as They become one in body and mind. The sweetness of each of Their limbs shines beautifully, and the kuñja-mahal serves as the hidden abode of Their love-filled pastimes.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ras Matt Biharini Pyari Hai - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (69)
hindi_text: Rasa Matt Biharini Pyari Hai.Nenk Lakhen Bas Bhaye Ladile, Adbhut Roop Ujyari Hai. [1]Umgyau Rang Sarovar Hiy Mein, Mridu Muskan Kachu Nyari Hai.Shri Haridasi Ke Hit Viharat, Jeevani Praan Hamari Hai. [2]- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (69)Śrī Kuñjabihārinī (Śrī Rādhā) remains ever intoxicated in the nectar of love. Her form is endowed with unparalleled radiance. Merely a slight glance enslaves Śrī Kṛṣṇa under Her control. [1]Such enchantment dwells in her gentle smile that a lake of love-nectar begins to surge within the heart. The whole treasure of our life, Śyāmā Pyārī, eternally engages in love-plays of nitya vihāra only to bestow nectar upon Her intimate sakhīs such as Lalitā Haridāsī Jī. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Anvar Kanvar Jo Jure Rukho Utam Bhog - Shri Hita Damodar Das, Nem Battisi (19)
hindi_text: Anvar Kanvar Jo Jurai, Rukhau Uttam Bhog.Vrindavan Pari Rahau, Dukh Sukh Kuch Sanjog.- Shri Hita Damodar Das, Nem Battisi (19)Whether one has garments to wear or blankets for warmth, whether one is given rich food, simple fare, or nothing at all, and whatever joys or sorrows may arise, in whatever condition life unfolds, to reside always in Śrī Vṛndāvan alone is life’s highest fulfillment and truest perfection.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dharm Arth Phal Kaam Moksh Sab Dur Viraje - Shri Hit Kishori Lal, Radha Sudha Nidhi Stva (77)
hindi_text: (Chappay)Dharm Arth Phal Kaam Moksh Sab Door Virajen.Kaha Tin Ki Batran Vritha Kijai Bin Kajen. [1]Hari Ki Bhakti Ananya Maha Padavi Kahi Gai.Sir Mathe Pai Rahau Kahau Pai Nij Man Bhai. [2]Adbhut Naval Kishori Mani Vasat Kunj Vrindavipin.Ruchat Na Mero Man Kahoon Jasu Rasamritdasya Bin. [3]- Shri Hit Kishori Lal, Radha Sudha Nidhi Stva (77)Let the four revered pursuits of life—Dharma, Artha, Kāma, and Mokṣa—remain honored in the world for those who aspire to them; I have no inclination even to speak of them. [1]Let the supreme attainment of exclusive devotion to Śrī Hari also be held dear by devotees; we offer it reverence, yet it is not our path. Those whose hearts are drawn to it may glorify it. [2]Our hearts, however, are satisfied only by the nectar of servitude to the wondrous, jewel-like Kiśorī, Śrī Rādhā, who eternally resides within the sacred realm of Śrī Vṛndāvan. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mukh So Bhashe Ananyta - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Vishisht Doha (30)
hindi_text: Mukh So Bhashe Ananyta, Tan Mein Rakhe Thonti.Thakur Ke Aage Dhare, Ujjavana Ki Aunthi.- Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Vishisht Doha (30)People speak of exclusive devotion—“I belong only to Thākurjī; God alone is mine!”—yet within themselves they tightly conceal their attachments behind closed lips. Before the Lord, they merely display a hollow show of purity, while the inner darkness and deceit remain unchanged; their minds stay attached to wealth, honor, status, and family ties.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Brahma Indra Kahain Ham - Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Braj Shringar (7)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Brahma Indra Kahain Ham Chaahain Naahin Padavi Kau,Braj Ke Na Brichh Bhaye Baithe Ihaan Haarikai. [1]Barnat Hain Gopi Ham Haari Naahi Laal Sang,Maan Hiy Haari Rahe Vaar Man Maarikai. [2]Kahat Kuber Hote Braj Ke Bater Tau To,Ber-Ber Brajanidhi Rahat Nihaarikai. [3]Braj-Raj Mein Lotat Gopal Hain Karat Khyaal,Yahai Dekhi Haal Daarau Teerath Sabai Vaarikai. [4]- Shri Braj Nidhi Ji, Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Braj Shringar (7)Lord Brahmā and Indra say, “We do not desire the sovereignty of Brahmaloka or even the throne of heaven. If we could obtain the fortune of becoming even a single tree in Braj, we would remain there forever.” [1]The Gopīs say, “In Braj Dham, we have not been defeated, for by accepting Lāl (Śrī Kṛṣṇa) as our everything and offering ourselves entirely unto Him, we have attained victory in love.” [2]Kubera says, “If only I were a tiny bird in Braj, I would again and again behold this treasure of Braj, Śrī Rādhā Kṛṣṇa, without cease.” [3]Seeing Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa rolling in the dust of Braj, Sri Brajanidhi contemplates—upon this Braj-dhāma, endowed with such supreme glory, even all holy places could be offered in sacrifice. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aath Pahar Sumiran Kare Bisare Na Chhin Ek - Shri Sahjobai
hindi_text: Aath Pahar Sumiran Kare, Bisare Na Chhin Ek.Ashtadash Aur Chaar Mein, Sahjo Yahi Vishes.- Shri SahjobaiOne should remember the Lord constantly throughout all eight quarters of the day, with every single breath, and not forget Him even for a moment. This alone is the essence of all the four Vedas, the eighteen Purāṇas, and all sacred scriptures.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bihari Lal Bankare Ju Anokhe - Shri Kishori Ali Ji, Vinay Ke Pad (50)
hindi_text: Bihari Laal Baankare Ju Anokhe.Karat Naye-Naye Khyaal Kautuki, Bhooli Rahe Kaau Dhokhe? [1]Naana Rang Darasai Vipin Main, Sab Hi Ras Dai Pokhe.Ab Kyon Jaarati Birah Jarani Bali, Kishori, Roop Ras Tokhe. [2]- Shri Kishori Ali Ji, Vinay Ke Pad (50)Śrī Kiśorī Alī Jī humbly addresses Śrī Bihārī Jī—O Bihārī Jī, You are so extremely mischievous. While performing Your countless playful līlās, have You somehow forgotten me in playful deception? [1]You once nourished me in Vṛndāvan with incomparable rasa through endless loving pastimes. Why now, O Bihārī Jī, have You left me to burn in the fire of Your separation? [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dhing Vilasgarh Dangarh, Aur Mangarh Naam - Shri Priyadas Ji, Rasik Mohini (23)
hindi_text: Dhing Vilas-garh Daan-garh, Aur Maan-garh Nam.Gaur Khata Unvati Ihan, Chatrik Vah Ghanshyam.- Shri Priyadas Ji, Rasik Mohini (23)In the divine līlā-places of Barsānā, such as Vilāsgarh, Dāngarh, and Māngarh, the love-laden clouds of fair-complexioned Śrī Rādhā are forever showering. There, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, like a chataka bird longing for that rain, constantly drinks the flowing stream of Her love-bliss.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Radha Naam Son Chit Raanch - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (202)
hindi_text: (Raag Desa)  Radha Naam Son Chit Raanch.Radha Naam Rekh Suchi Ruchison Antas Kaagad Khaanch. [1]Radha Naam Ank Aabhooshan Bhooshit Kar Ang Naach.Radha Naam Likhi Paatuliya Lalit Kishori Vaanch. [2]- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (202)Let the mind be fully absorbed in the holy name “Śrī Rādhā.” With pure, loving intent, inscribe the name Rādhā upon the inner paper of your heart. [1]Adorn every limb with the sacred marks of Rādhā-nāma as your true ornaments, and dance in that divine bliss. Śrī Lalitā Kiśorī says that such a “pāṭuliyā”(notebook/letter) lovingly written with the name Rādhā is eagerly read by the divine couple, Śrī Śyāma-Śyāma, with great joy. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Swarathmula Asudh Tyon Sudh Swabhav Anukul - Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (41)
hindi_text: Swarathmool Asuddh Tyon, Suddh Swabhaav-Anukool.Naradadi Prastaar Kari, Kiyau Jaahi Ko Tool.- Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (41)That love which is mixed with selfish motive is called impure love; and that which is selfless, effortlessly performed solely for the happiness of the Beloved, is known as pure love. Nārada and other exalted sages have explained these two forms of love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dhaike Jai Ji Jamuna Tire - Shri Chhit Swami Ji Ki Vani (164)
hindi_text: (Raag Ramkali)Dhaike Jai Ji Jamuna Tire.Taaki Mahima Ab Kahan Laun Baraniye, Jai Parasat Ati Prem Neere. [1]Nisidin Keli Karat Manmohan, Piya Lai Ju Bhakt Ki Sang Bheere.“Chheet Swami” Giridharan Shri Vitthal, In-Binu Neku Na Dharat Dheere. [2]- Shri Chhit Swami, Shri Chhit Swami Ji Ki Vani (164)Run swiftly to the banks of the Yamunā. How far can her glory ever be described? The very touch of her sacred waters drenches the heart in divine love. [1]There, day and night, Manmohana Śrī Kṛṣṇa performs sweet amorous pastimes with His beloved Śrī Rādhā, bestowing supreme rasa upon the devotees. Śrī Chīta Svāmī says — Giridhara Lāla and His devotees cannot remain peaceful even for a single moment without these Yamunā-bank pastimes. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aasamho Charanrenujushamaham Syama - Shrimad Bhagwatam (10.47.61)
hindi_text: Aasamho Charanrenujushamaham Syama Vrindavane Kimapi Gulamlatoshdheenam.- Shrimad Bhagwatam  (10.47.61)Oh Lord, may I be blessed to take birth as a bush, creeper, or simple herb in Vṛndāvana, so that these gopīs bless me with the dust of their lotus feet.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nav Kunj Sadan Main Aaj Rangili Hori - Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyarasikabharan Granth (12.2)
hindi_text: Nav Kunj-Sadan Main Aaj Rangili Hori.It Syama, Ut Syam Manohar, Khelat Umang Na Thori. [1]Chhal-Bal Ghat Lagavat Mohan, Ang Bachavat Gori.Savadhan Dou Sughar Manohar, Apni-Apni Ori. [2]Kok-Kala Kal-Keli Paraspar, Joban Jor Kisori.Chatur Khilar Ladili Lalan, Tum Jin Janao Bhori. [3]Haha Karau, Parau Payan Ab, Na Chalihain Barjori.Bhagavat Rasik Udar Swamini, Daihain Sarbasu Chhori. [4]- Shri Bhagwat Rasik, Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyarasikabharan Granth (12.2)In the ever-new Nikunja palace, today a festival of colors, Holī, unfolds. On one side stands Śrī Kiśorījī, and on the other stands Śrī Śyāmasundara, firm and enthusiastic. [1]With playful mischief and gentle force, Śyāmasundara tries again and again to shower Her with colors, but Kiśorījī skillfully guards Her delicate form. These beautiful, enchanting Beloveds, Priyā Lāla, are equally alert and skillful on their respective sides. Neither can impose color upon the other. [2]A smiling sakhī then says, “O Lālajī, do not think our Lāḍilījī naive. She is eternally youthful and unmatched in these loving sports. However clever you may be, she will not be conquered through these clever strategies.” [3]Your cleverness and force will not prevail here. Adopt the means you have always embraced—plead before Her and bow at Her lotus feet humbly. Svāminījī is exceedingly gracious; the moment You do so, She will lovingly offer Herself unto You. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Swarath Ko Sansar Sab Paramarath Ko Khol - Shri Kant Kishor, Kant Rasik Ji Ki Vani, Doha (7)
hindi_text: Swarath Kau Sansar Sab, Paramarath Kau Khol.Baat Karen Ras-Reeti Ki, Bheetar Bhandar Dol.- Shri Kant Kishor, Kant Rasik Ji Ki Vani, Doha (7)The entire world remains absorbed in fulfilling its own selfish desires, while what is called spirituality, welfare, or charity is often nothing more than a display. Grand words are spoken about divine love and sacred rasa, yet the inner heart holds no treasure at all.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Gavat Pyaro Radha Tero Jasu -  Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Uttarardh (170)
hindi_text: (Rag Sarang)Gavat Pyaro Radha Tero Jasu.Teroi Naam Japat Aur Bilapatu Hai, Kaamkau Syamhin Sank Su. [1]Kahyo Na Parai Darun Dukh Pyari, Tere Virah Mohan Ke Kanth Rahyo Asu.Vyas Swamini Karunakari Rakhyo, Hari Chakhyo Adhar-Sudharasu. [2]- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Uttarardh (170)Śrī Harirāma Vyāsa, absorbed in the mood of a confidential sakhī, offers a heartfelt prayer to Śrī Rādhā—O Śrī Rādhe! Your beloved Śrī Kṛṣṇa sings only Your glories without cease. He chants none but Your holy name and sheds tears heavily in the agony of separation.  Divine passion has so tormented Kṛṣṇa that he is utterly restless, wholly agitated in your devotion. [1]O Pyārī Jū! The unbearable anguish that Śrī Mohana suffers in Your absence cannot be expressed in words. His very life-breath has risen to His throat—such is the extremity of His viraha, as though He endures a death-like torment. Śrī Harirāma Vyāsa humbly pleads, “O my Svāminī Śrī Rādhe! Bestow Your merciful darśana upon Him now and preserve His life, so that Śrī Hari may once again taste the ‘adharāmṛta’ (nectar of Your lips).” [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Yasyah Sphurjatpadanakhamani Jyoti - Shri Hita Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (72)
hindi_text: Yatpadamburuhek Renu-kanikan Mudhrna Nidhatun Na Hi Prapurabrahm Shivadayopyadhikrtin Gopyaik Bhavashrayah.Sapi Premasudha Rasambudhinidhi Radhapi Sadharani Bhuta Kalagatikramen Balina He Daiv Tubhyan Namah.- Shri Hita Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (72)Even Brahmā, Śiva, and other gods, after taking shelter of the mood of the gopīs, could not obtain even a single particle of dust from Her lotus feet. Such a supreme Queen of love, Śrī Rādhā, the treasure of the great ocean of nectar, now appears like an ordinary gopī due to the powerful flow of time. O Destiny — I bow to you.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Radha Naam Japo Din Raina - Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (72)
hindi_text: (Raag Malkosh, Tritaal)Radha Naam Japau Din Raina.Jo Koi Radha Naam Sunave, Tabahi Parai Hiy Chaina. [1]Shri Radha Gaun Radha Ladaun, Radha Sune Ye Baina.Radha Naam Raseelo Ratihon, Chhavi Aave Hiy Naina. [2]Ravi Tanaya Pyari Jab Dekhun, Bolun Kar Kar Sena.Hitgopal Shri Naam Ki Mahima, Kaise Kahat Banaina. [3]- Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (72)One should chant the holy name of Śrī Rādhā day and night. Only when this sacred name enters my ears does my heart find true peace and rest. [1]May I sing the glories of Śrī Rādhā at every moment, tenderly love Her, and offer all my prayers at Her lotus feet. The name “Rādhā” is filled with infinite divine rasa. By remembering this holy name, the enchanting form of Śrī Rādhā vividly manifests within my heart and before my eyes. [2]Whenever I behold the gentle stream of Śrī Yamunā, the daughter of the Sun, it feels as though she too is softly singing the sweet name of Rādhā. I bow to her again and again. Śrī Hitgopāl Dās declares that the glory of this sacred Rādhā-name cannot be fully expressed in words. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kunjmahal Mein Aaj Rang Hori - Shri Bani Thani Ji
hindi_text: (Raag Khammayachi)Kunjmahal Mein Aaj Rang Hori.Phag Khel Mein Banavaniki, Hvai Rahi Pat Gathjori. [1]Mudit Hvai Naari Gulaal Udaaven, Gaaven Gaari Duhun Ori.‘Rasikvihari’ Sundar Dulah, Dulahani Naval Kishori. [2]- Shri Bani Thani JiToday, in the bowers of the kuñja-mahal, a vibrant festival of Holī unfolds. Amidst the playful exchange of colors, a most beautiful union has arisen — the garments of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa are being lovingly tied together in a sacred knot of oneness. [1]The sakhīs, overflowing with joy, scatter clouds of gulāl into the air and sing sweet, love-laden Holī songs from both sides. In this divine festivity, the charming Śrī Kṛṣṇa appears as the bridegroom, and Śrī Rādhā shines resplendent as the bride. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Radha Bhajaniya Cha Tad Bhaktakanam - Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (97)
hindi_text: Shri Radha Bhajaniya Cha Tad Bhaktakanam Cha Sangatih.Karya Manishibhir Nityam Iti Siddhanta Samsthiti. - Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (97)One should worship Śrī Rādhā and constantly remain in the association of Her exclusive devotees. The truly wise follow this path every moment, for it firmly establishes unwavering devotion at the lotus feet of Kiśorī Jī — this is the conclusion of the spiritual doctrine.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Priya Badan Sukhma Sadan - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sewa Sukh (05)
hindi_text: Priya Badan Sukhma Sadan, Rahyo Prem Paripoori.Ja Madhi Preetam Praan Ki, Sarbas Jeevani Moori.- Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sewa Sukh (05)The lotus-face of Śrī Rādhā is the abode of bliss, filled with divine love, where the life-breath of Her beloved, Śrī Kṛṣṇa resides. Indeed, it alone is the source of life of His very existence.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage
